title: When Do Pilots Matter for OFDM Sensing? Pilot-Data Resource Design for ISAC
summary: Practical OFDM-based integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) signals contain deterministic pilots and random data payloads, yet how these two types of resources jointly affect matched-filter sensing performance remains insufficiently understood. This paper establishes an analytical and optimization framework for pilot-data (P-D) OFDM sensing. We first derive a closed-form mean-square periodic autocorrelation function (MS P-ACF), which characterizes the respective contributions of the average subcarrier power spectrum and data-symbol randomness to sensing sidelobes. Based on this result, we reveal that pilot placement has no impact on normalized sidelobes under uniform power allocation or on the normalized global expected integrated sidelobe level (EISL), whereas it becomes an effective design degree of freedom for reshaping sidelobes under nonuniform power allocation. We further derive the globally optimal two-level pilot-data power allocation for global EISL minimization and characterize pilot placement for peak sidelobe suppression. For region-of-interest (ROI) sensing, we jointly optimize pilot placement and subcarrier power allocation to minimize the normalized ROI-EISL. A strictly uniform pilot placement is proved globally optimal under specified conditions, while a bisection-and-branch-and-bound algorithm is developed for general resource configurations. Numerical results validate the theoretical analysis and demonstrate that the proposed design reduces the ROI sidelobe level by up to 2.19 dB compared with optimized uniform-pilot OFDM, while improving ranging accuracy at an SNR of -10 dB by 84.3$\%$. These results reveal when and how pilot placement can be exploited to regulate the sensing behavior of random OFDM communication signals, providing practical resource-design principles for OFDM-based ISAC.

AI.tldr: 本文针对含确定性导频与随机数据的OFDM一体化感知通信信号，建立P-D OFDM感知的自相关分析与资源优化框架；通过推导均方周期自相关函数，揭示导频位置、功率分配与感知旁瓣之间的关系，并提出全局EISL和ROI-EISL优化方法。结果表明，合理的非均匀功率分配及导频设计可降低ROI旁瓣并提升低信噪比测距精度。
AI.motivation: 实际OFDM-ISAC信号同时包含确定性导频和随机数据，但二者如何共同影响匹配滤波感知性能，尤其是旁瓣结构、全局积分旁瓣电平和感兴趣区域（ROI）旁瓣，尚未得到充分理解。现有设计原则难以明确说明何时导频位置有效、如何联合导频布局与子载波功率分配，因此需要统一的理论分析和优化框架。
AI.method: 首先推导均方周期自相关函数（MS P-ACF）的闭式表达式，用于分离平均子载波功率谱和数据符号随机性对感知旁瓣的贡献。随后分析导频位置在均匀与非均匀功率分配下对归一化旁瓣及全局期望积分旁瓣电平（EISL）的影响；推导全局EISL最小化的两电平导频-数据最优功率分配，并研究峰值旁瓣抑制下的导频位置设计。针对ROI感知，联合优化导频位置和子载波功率分配，以最小化归一化ROI-EISL；在特定条件下证明严格均匀导频布局的全局最优性，并针对一般资源配置提出二分搜索与分支定界算法。
AI.result: 理论结果表明：均匀功率分配时，导频位置不影响归一化旁瓣；全局归一化期望EISL也不受导频位置影响；非均匀功率分配时，导频位置可以有效重塑旁瓣。数值实验显示，所提设计相较于优化的均匀导频OFDM，ROI旁瓣电平最高降低2.19 dB，并在SNR=-10 dB时将测距精度提升84.3%。
AI.conclusion: 本文明确了导频位置发挥作用的条件：在均匀功率分配或全局归一化EISL指标下，其作用有限；结合非均匀功率分配和ROI目标时，导频位置可成为调控随机OFDM感知旁瓣的重要设计自由度。提出的理论和优化方法为OFDM-ISAC中的导频布局、功率分配及低信噪比测距设计提供了实用原则。

title: A New Upper Bound on the Binary Deletion Channel Capacity
summary: We prove that the capacity of the binary deletion channel satisfies $C(d)\le (1-d)/4$ for every $13/20\le d<1$. The proof describes the output from right to left, using a six-bit context to assign a description length. We bound the increase in expected description length minus output entropy when one input bit is added. A relative-entropy identity reduces this bound to finitely many linear inequalities. A potential on input windows of length 26 makes the inequalities telescope, giving a bound for every input word. Deletion composition extends the result from $d=13/20$ to all larger deletion probabilities. We also obtain finite-block bounds on mutual information and decoding error, with explicit $O(\log n/n)$ corrections. The finite certificate is checked using exact integer arithmetic, and the proof is formalized end to end in Lean.

AI.tldr: 本文证明二元删除信道容量在删除概率13/20≤d<1时满足 C(d)≤(1-d)/4，并给出有限码长修正项及端到端Lean形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 二元删除信道容量的精确刻画较为困难，尤其是在高删除概率区域。本文旨在建立一个严格、可验证的容量上界，同时提供有限码长下互信息和译码错误的定量控制，并提高证明的机器可验证性。
AI.method: 从右向左描述信道输出，利用六比特上下文分配描述长度；分析加入一个输入比特时“期望描述长度增加量减输出熵”的变化。通过相对熵恒等式，将问题化为有限组线性不等式；再在长度为26的输入窗口上构造势函数，使这些不等式望远镜求和，从而对任意输入串成立。最后利用删除信道的复合性质，将d=13/20的结论推广到更大的删除概率，并以精确整数运算检查有限证书、用Lean完成形式化证明。
AI.result: 得到容量上界 C(d)≤(1-d)/4，适用于13/20≤d<1。与此同时，论文给出互信息和译码错误的有限块长界，其修正项为显式的O(log n/n)，并实现了完整的机器形式化验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部上下文、相对熵转化和势函数望远镜化，本文建立了高删除概率区间内二元删除信道容量的严格上界。结果具有有限码长意义，且证明经过精确算术和Lean端到端验证，增强了可靠性与可复核性。

title: From Priors to Projections: Geometry and simplified MIMO demodulation of probabilistic shaping
summary:
Probabilistic shaping (PS) is a well-known method to achieve improved performance upon a regular quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) by taking the target constellation and making the distribution of underlying points non-uniform. It has been extensively studied over the years for the additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and Rayleigh fading channels. However, the potential of probabilistic shaping in the multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO) setting needs further investigations.
  In this paper, we prove that if shaped symbols follow Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, the optimal maximum a posteriori (MAP) detection is equivalent to the case of uniform constellation with a simple preprocessing step. Our approach has multiple benefits. It enables to utilize the same processing chain for both shaped and unshaped system, which simplifies the receiver architecture. This technique can be applied for both linear MMSE and nonlinear (near-)MAP demapper types. In addition, the complexity of adaptive methods such as sphere decoding can be reduced.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MIMO系统中的概率整形，证明当整形符号服从Maxwell–Boltzmann分布时，可通过简单预处理将最优MAP检测转化为与均匀星座等价的问题，从而复用接收机处理链、支持线性与非线性检测，并降低球形译码等自适应方法的复杂度。
AI.motivation: 概率整形能够相较于常规均匀QAM改善通信性能，但其在MIMO场景中的检测与接收机实现仍缺乏充分研究。特别是，非均匀先验分布可能增加MAP检测、软解调及自适应搜索算法的实现复杂度。因此，本文旨在寻找一种能够兼顾概率整形性能与现有MIMO接收机架构的方法。
AI.method: 作者针对服从Maxwell–Boltzmann分布的整形符号，推导其先验概率与符号能量之间的关系，并证明最优MAP检测可以通过一个简单的预处理步骤，等价转换为均匀星座下的检测问题。该方法可嵌入线性MMSE检测器和非线性近似MAP解调器，也适用于球形译码等自适应检测方法。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，Maxwell–Boltzmann概率整形的MAP检测无需完全重新设计检测流程，而可借助预处理复用均匀星座系统的处理链。该方案同时适用于线性MMSE与非线性（近似）MAP解调，并能够降低球形译码等自适应方法的计算复杂度。摘要未提供具体仿真参数、性能增益数值或复杂度下降比例。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了Maxwell–Boltzmann概率整形MIMO系统与均匀星座检测之间的等价性，为低复杂度接收机实现提供了理论基础。其主要价值在于兼容现有处理架构、支持多类检测器，并缓解概率整形引入的额外检测复杂度。

title: Worse Routes, Fresher Information: Preemption Redefines Which Route is Best
summary: This paper studies joint sampling, route activation, and preemption control over $N$ heterogeneous transmission routes under a long-run objective combining Age of Information (AoI) with sampling and transmission costs. We formulate the problem as an average-cost impulse-control model, derive a vector-form integral average-cost optimality equation over a hybrid state space, and establish structural reductions on the state. We consider a two-route case and compute optimized policies using discretized policy iteration. Surprisingly, the results show that preemption can reverse routing preferences: the optimized policy may exclusively use a route with both a larger mean delay and a larger delay variance while avoiding the seemingly superior route. Relative to baselines that do not allow preemption, the proposed policy reduces average AoI by up to $96\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究异构传输路线下联合采样、路线激活与抢占控制问题。作者将其建模为平均成本冲动控制问题，推导混合状态空间上的向量积分平均成本最优性方程，并通过状态结构化简与离散化策略迭代求解两路线情形。结果表明，抢占机制可能改变直观的路由选择：即使某路线具有更大的平均时延和时延方差，最优策略仍可能只使用该路线而避开表面上更优的路线；与不允许抢占的基线相比，平均AoI最高降低96%。
AI.motivation: 现有路由与信息更新研究通常分别处理采样、传输和路由选择，或忽略传输过程中的抢占控制，因而难以刻画异构路线、随机时延和信息时效性之间的耦合关系。本文的动机是设计一种统一的联合控制框架，在长期平均AoI与采样/传输成本之间取得平衡，并揭示抢占对路线选择和信息新鲜度的实际影响。
AI.method: 作者将联合采样、路线激活和抢占决策建模为平均成本冲动控制问题，状态空间为混合型状态空间。基于该模型，推导向量形式的积分平均成本最优性方程，并利用状态结构获得问题简化。针对两条异构路线，采用离散化策略迭代计算近似最优策略，并与不允许抢占的基线策略进行比较。
AI.result: 数值结果显示，抢占会产生反直觉的路由偏好反转：最优策略可能完全选择平均传输时延更大、时延方差也更大的路线，同时避开表面上更优的路线。这说明路线质量不能仅依据均值或方差独立判断，抢占与AoI演化的耦合会显著改变最优决策。与不允许抢占的基线相比，所提策略最多可将平均AoI降低96%。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个统一分析联合采样、路由激活和抢占控制的理论框架，并证明抢占不仅是局部传输操作，还可能从根本上改变长期最优路由结构。结果表明，在AoI优化中，应综合考虑时延分布、当前信息状态、采样成本和抢占机制，而不能仅凭平均时延或时延方差选择路线。

title: Token Merging for Multilingual Speech Recognition: A Systematic Study Across Model Scale and Fine-Tuning
summary: Leading multilingual speech recognition models like Whisper transcribe diverse, low-resource languages without language-specific training but are computationally expensive to deploy. Token merging mitigates this inefficiency by dynamically combining redundant features, shortening the sequence length during inference without requiring retraining. In this paper, we systematically evaluate token merging on the Whisper model family across sixteen diverse languages and three different model sizes. We also test how token merging interacts with fine-tuning (DoRA) on low-resource languages. Our findings show that merging tokens increases computational efficiency with almost no loss in transcription accuracy across most low-resource languages and model sizes, and it works even after the model has been fine-tuned. Our results demonstrate that token merging is a highly practical method for making multilingual speech recognition faster and cheaper to deploy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了 Token Merging（令牌合并）在 Whisper 多语种语音识别模型中的加速效果。实验覆盖 16 种语言、3 种模型规模，并考察其与低资源语言 DoRA 微调的兼容性。结果表明，令牌合并可显著降低推理计算成本和序列长度，同时在大多数低资源语言及不同模型规模下几乎不损失转录准确率，即使模型经过微调仍然有效。
AI.motivation: Whisper 能够处理多种低资源语言，但其推理成本较高，限制了实际部署。传统的效率优化方法可能需要重新训练或针对特定语言进行调整，因此本文旨在验证一种无需重训练、通过动态合并冗余特征来缩短序列的 Token Merging 方法，是否能在多语种、低资源和不同模型规模场景下稳定提升部署效率。
AI.method: 作者在 Whisper 模型系列上开展系统实验，覆盖 16 种具有多样性的语言和 3 种模型规模。实验比较了使用与不使用 Token Merging 时的推理效率和转录准确率，并进一步研究了该方法与低资源语言 DoRA 微调的交互关系，以评估其在适应特定语言后的有效性。
AI.result: Token Merging 能够缩短推理阶段的序列长度并提高计算效率。在大多数低资源语言和模型规模上，转录准确率几乎没有下降；同时，该方法在模型经过 DoRA 微调后仍可正常发挥作用。摘要未提供具体的速度提升、计算量下降或准确率变化数值。
AI.conclusion: Token Merging 是一种实用且无需重训练的多语种语音识别加速方法，能够在基本保持识别质量的同时降低推理成本。其对不同语言、模型规模以及微调后模型均具有较好的适用性，适合用于 Whisper 的低成本部署。

title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
summary: In this work, we present ZGCM-1, a fully open 7B dense foundation model trained from scratch with extreme data, system, and algorithmic efficiency. ZGCM-1 is founded on a core premise: compact models cannot passively memorize the open web, but can overcome parametric capacity limits by coupling deliberate internal thinking with active external tool use. To support this paradigm across a 256K context, we develop an end-to-end, high-efficiency open training recipe: Architecture & System Co-design: interleaved gated sliding-window and full attention, and a stable FP8 Muon optimizer; Progressive Curriculum & MDP Mid-Training: context scaling across 16K, 64K, and 256K, and the reformulation of interaction traces into Markov Decision Processes. Furthermore, we establish an AI-native R&D workflow where agent swarms autonomously manage cluster operations, data curation, and rapid diagnostic evaluation. Extensive evaluations show that ZGCM-1-7B is competitive across 7B model family on general benchmarks. On several challenging mathematical reasoning and agentic search suites, it remains competitive with frontier models orders of magnitude larger, such as Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.1. We also show that our pre-training design offers a ~4.2x efficiency improvement in 16K pre-training time-to-loss. Across the full development lifecycle, we distill eight actionable empirical findings-spanning architectural scaling, SFT quality pruning, long-context generalization, and agentic co-training dynamics. To facilitate community research, we open-source model weights from the pre-training, mid-training, and post-training stages, intermediate checkpoints, training code, per-stage data and data recipes, and W&B logs.

AI.tldr: ZGCM-1 是一个从零训练、完全开放的 7B 稠密基础模型，核心通过内部推理与外部工具调用协同突破小模型容量限制；论文提出高效的架构、训练系统、长上下文课程和智能体研发流程，并报告了具有竞争力的性能与约 4.2 倍的 16K 预训练 time-to-loss 效率提升。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在解决 7B 等紧凑模型在知识容量、长上下文建模、复杂推理和智能体任务上的能力瓶颈，同时降低大规模预训练的计算、系统和数据成本。作者的基本假设是，小模型不应仅依赖参数记忆开放网络信息，而应通过更有效的内部思考和主动外部工具使用增强能力。此外，论文还试图建立一个可复现、完全开放且覆盖模型全生命周期的训练范式。
AI.method: 1. 架构与系统协同设计：采用交错式门控滑动窗口注意力与全注意力，以兼顾长上下文效率和全局信息交互；使用稳定的 FP8 Muon 优化器。2. 渐进式课程学习与 MDP 中期训练：将上下文长度逐步扩展至 16K、64K 和 256K，并把交互轨迹重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程，以支持推理和工具交互能力。3. AI 原生研发流程：利用智能体群自主执行集群运维、数据筛选和快速诊断评测。4. 开放训练资源：发布预训练、中期训练和后训练阶段的模型权重、中间检查点、训练代码、分阶段数据及配方和 W&B 日志。
AI.result: ZGCM-1-7B 在通用基准上达到 7B 模型家族中的有竞争力水平；在若干高难度数学推理和智能体搜索评测中，其表现可与参数规模大得多的模型相竞争。预训练设计在 16K 上实现约 4.2 倍的 time-to-loss 效率提升。论文还总结了八项经验性发现，涉及架构扩展、SFT 数据质量剪枝、长上下文泛化以及智能体协同训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，通过架构—系统协同优化、渐进式长上下文训练、MDP 化交互学习以及工具增强的智能体范式，7B 级开放模型可以在显著降低训练成本的同时获得较强的推理和智能体能力。其主要贡献不仅是 ZGCM-1 模型本身，也包括一套端到端、开放且可复用的训练方法与经验总结。不过，摘要未提供各基准的具体分数、训练规模、工具调用设置、消融实验细节及“4.2 倍”效率提升的严格测量定义，因此对结论的可复现性和跨任务普适性仍需结合正文验证。

title: Personalized and Explainable Blood Pressure Estimation from PPG via Hybrid CNN--Morphological Features
summary: Continuous cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring using photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a promising solution for personalized healthcare. However, existing methods have two major limitations. Handcrafted feature-based approaches rely on precise fiducial point detection and are limited to short-term analysis, while deep learning models, despite their accuracy, often operate as black boxes with limited physiological interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose a physiology-guided hybrid framework for personalized BP estimation that couples a convolutional neural network (CNN) branch capturing global and local waveform dynamics with a morphology-prior branch that explicitly encodes person-specific vascular characteristics. By embedding a morphology-based feature set that explicitly encodes individual vascular characteristics, the proposed framework enhances personalization and reduces dependence on large-scale training datasets. Evaluated on a subset of the MIMIC-III database under a subject-specific (personalized) testing protocol, the proposed personalized physiology-guided hybrid approach achieved mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 3.77 mmHg for systolic BP and 2.36 mmHg for diastolic BP, corresponding to relative improvements of 43.7% and 32.4% over a subject-specific (personalized) CNN-only baseline. SHAP-based analysis confirmed that the introduced morphology-prior features align with individual vascular characteristics, reinforcing per-subject interpretability. These findings highlight the potential of personalized, physiology-guided hybrid learning with novel morphological descriptors for accurate and explainable BP monitoring in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种生理学引导的个体化混合框架，将CNN提取的PPG全局/局部动态与显式编码个体血管特征的形态学先验结合，用于无袖带连续血压估计。在MIMIC-III个体内测试中，SBP和DBP的MAE分别为3.77和2.36 mmHg，相比个体化CNN基线提升43.7%和32.4%，并通过SHAP增强了可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有PPG血压估计方法存在两类问题：基于人工特征的方法依赖精确的特征点检测，且通常只能进行短时分析；深度学习方法虽然具有较高精度，但往往缺乏生理学可解释性。此外，个体血管特征差异使模型个体化和小样本适应成为重要需求。因此，论文旨在构建兼顾预测性能、个体化能力与生理可解释性的血压估计方法。
AI.method: 提出生理学引导的混合框架，包括两个分支：1）CNN分支，从PPG波形中学习全局与局部动态模式；2）形态学先验分支，引入显式的形态学特征集合，以编码受试者特异性的血管特征。两类信息进行融合，用于个体化收缩压和舒张压估计；同时使用SHAP分析特征贡献及其与个体血管特征的一致性。实验采用MIMIC-III数据库子集，并遵循受试者特异性的个体化测试协议。
AI.result: 模型在个体化测试下取得SBP MAE 3.77 mmHg、DBP MAE 2.36 mmHg；相较个体化CNN-only基线，SBP和DBP误差分别相对降低43.7%和32.4%。SHAP分析表明，形态学先验特征能够反映个体血管特征，并提升模型的逐受试者可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将生理学先验形态特征与深度神经网络结合，可以在减少对大规模训练数据依赖的同时提升个体化血压估计精度和可解释性。该方法为真实场景下准确、可解释的PPG无袖带血压监测提供了潜在方案，但其有效性仍需通过跨数据库、跨设备及非个体化测试进一步验证。

title: Weight spectra of some families of GRM codes
summary:
Let $\mathrm{RM}_q(r,m)$ denote the generalized Reed--Muller code of order $r$ and length $q^m$ over the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$.
  We completely determine the weight spectra of $\mathrm{RM}_3(2m-i,m)$ for $i=3,4$, $\mathrm{RM}_4(3m-i,m)$ for $i=2,3$, $\mathrm{RM}_5(4m-4,m)$, and $\mathrm{RM}_7(6m-4,m)$, in the ranges of $m$ specified in the corresponding results.
  The proofs proceed by induction on $m$, using a sumset inclusion for GRM weight spectra together with results on low-weight codewords. The required base cases are established by computations in Magma and, for certain ternary cases, exact constraint solving with Z3.

AI.tldr: 本文完整确定了若干广义 Reed–Muller 码族的重量谱：RM_3(2m-i,m)（i=3,4）、RM_4(3m-i,m)（i=2,3）、RM_5(4m-4,m) 和 RM_7(6m-4,m)，并给出相应的 m 取值范围。核心证明采用关于重量谱和集和包含关系的归纳方法，结合低重量码字结果；基础情形通过 Magma 计算以及部分三元情形的 Z3 精确约束求解验证。
AI.motivation: 广义 Reed–Muller 码的重量谱描述了码中所有可能汉明重量及其出现情况，是研究码的组合结构、最小重量码字及译码性能的重要问题。对于高阶码和接近特定阶数的参数范围，完整重量谱通常难以确定。本文旨在填补若干具体参数族的重量谱缺口。
AI.method: 作者按 m 进行归纳证明。主要工具是广义 Reed–Muller 码重量谱满足的集和包含关系，以及已有的低重量码字结构与分类结果。归纳所需的基础情形通过 Magma 进行有限域和编码计算；对于部分三元码，进一步使用 Z3 进行精确约束求解，以验证基础案例。
AI.result: 本文完全确定了以下码族的重量谱：RM_3(2m-i,m)，其中 i=3,4；RM_4(3m-i,m)，其中 i=2,3；RM_5(4m-4,m)；RM_7(6m-4,m)。结论仅在各定理所规定的 m 的范围内成立。摘要未给出具体重量集合、重量分布数量或各族的明确参数边界。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，结合重量谱的集和结构、低重量码字理论以及计算机辅助基础验证，可以系统地求解若干高阶广义 Reed–Muller 码族的完整重量谱。研究推进了这些码族的精确组合刻画，但从摘要来看，结论覆盖的是若干特定参数族，而非所有广义 Reed–Muller 码。

title: PhysMent: An Interactive Approach For LLM Reasoning In Physics Problems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform strongly on static science benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about the physical world through active experimentation remains poorly understood. We introduce PhysMent, a benchmark that evaluates LLM physical reasoning via iterative, toolmediated interaction with a MuJoCo physics simulator. Unlike static benchmarks that supply all quantities upfront, PhysMent requires models to discover information by applying forces, querying object states, advancing time, and modifying scene geometry before answering. The benchmark comprises 105 scenes of classical mechanics, organized across four difficulty regimes (Easy/Hard and Single/Multi), three scene modalities (standard, object creation, hidden objects), and a scene-manipulation category, evaluated with a six-dimensional scoring framework. Results show that current models perform reasonably well on qualitative single-concept tasks (up to 80% accuracy) but degrade substantially on quantitative tasks that demand precise, multi-step experimental procedures: most models fall below 30% on the hardest single-concept category, where the bottleneck is procedural (adaptive multi-step tool use) rather than conceptual load. Across the seven models, accuracy ranges from 25% to 67%, with failures due to premature answer submission, inefficient exploration, and inconsistent grounding in simulator feedback rather than conceptual gaps.

AI.tldr: PhysMent 是一个基于 MuJoCo 物理模拟器的交互式基准，用于评估大语言模型通过主动实验进行物理推理的能力。结果表明，模型在定性、单概念任务上表现尚可，但在需要精确测量、规划和多步工具操作的定量任务上显著下降，主要瓶颈是实验程序执行与反馈利用，而非物理概念理解。
AI.motivation: 现有科学基准多为静态问答，通常直接提供所有必要物理量，无法充分评估模型是否能够像真实科学探究一样主动获取信息、设计实验、操作环境并依据反馈推理。因此，论文旨在系统测量 LLM 在动态物理环境中的主动实验能力及其失败模式。
AI.method: 论文提出 PhysMent 基准，利用 MuJoCo 物理模拟器构建 105 个经典力学场景，覆盖 Easy/Hard 与 Single/Multi 四种难度组合，以及标准场景、物体创建、隐藏物体和场景操控等模态。模型需要通过施加力、查询物体状态、推进时间、改变场景几何等工具交互，自主发现信息并回答问题。评测采用六维评分框架，并比较七个模型在定性与定量、单步与多步任务中的表现。
AI.result: 模型在定性单概念任务上最高达到 80% 准确率，但在要求精确数值推断和多步实验流程的任务上明显退化；最困难的单概念类别中，多数模型准确率低于 30%。七个模型总体准确率为 25%–67%。主要错误包括过早提交答案、探索过程低效，以及未能稳定依据模拟器反馈修正推理。结果显示，性能瓶颈主要来自自适应的多步工具使用和程序性执行，而非概念负担过重。
AI.conclusion: PhysMent 表明，静态科学问答中的良好表现并不等价于具备物理世界中的主动实验推理能力。提升 LLM 的关键方向应包括实验规划、信息价值判断、工具调用策略、状态跟踪以及根据反馈进行迭代修正。该基准为研究模型从“回答已知问题”走向“通过实验发现答案”提供了更贴近真实环境的评估框架。

title: Converge Then Diversify: Decoupling Convergence and Diversity in Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimisation (MOBO) is a sample-efficient approach for optimising expensive black-box functions with multiple objectives. In MOBO, the goal is to adequately approximate the Pareto front; that is, to obtain a high-quality solution set with 1) good convergence (closeness to the Pareto front) and 2) good diversity (spread across the Pareto front). Existing MOBO methods typically aim to accomplish these two tasks simultaneously, i.e., driving the search towards the Pareto front while maintaining a diverse set of nondominated solutions, such that the solutions, ideally, can gradually approach the entire front. When sufficient search budgets are available, this approach is effective. However, considering both convergence and diversity throughout the search is not easy and requires careful design. Under very tight budgets, there may not be enough solutions generated to be able to simultaneously approach the entire Pareto front. To address this issue, this paper proposes a \textit{converge-then-diversify} (CTD) approach that decouples convergence and diversity into two stages. In the first stage, CTD focuses on convergence, aiming to quickly drive the search toward a single point on the Pareto front. In the second stage, CTD focuses on diversity, aiming to spread solutions across the front. We present two simple instantiations of CTD by using widely adopted acquisition functions in the area. Experimental results show that, across all 446 pairwise comparisons, CTD statistically outperforms state-of-the-art methods in 72.9\% of the cases, performs equivalently in 21.1\%, and is statistically worse in only 6.1\%, with the advantage being particularly evident in settings with very tight evaluation budgets or in high-dimensional problems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种“先收敛、后多样化”（Converge-Then-Diversify, CTD）的多目标贝叶斯优化策略，将逼近帕累托前沿与覆盖前沿两个目标解耦为两个阶段。在有限评估预算和高维问题中，CTD较现有方法表现出明显优势。
AI.motivation: 多目标贝叶斯优化需要同时兼顾解集的收敛性与多样性。现有方法通常在整个搜索过程中同步优化二者，这会增加采集函数设计和搜索控制的难度；当评估预算非常有限时，生成的解数量不足以同时逼近并覆盖整个帕累托前沿。因此，论文旨在设计一种更适合紧预算场景的搜索策略。
AI.method: 提出CTD框架，将优化过程分为两个阶段：第一阶段优先优化收敛性，使搜索快速到达帕累托前沿上的某个区域或单点；第二阶段再优先优化多样性，使解集沿帕累托前沿扩散。论文基于领域内广泛使用的采集函数构造了两种简单的CTD实例，以验证该思想的通用性和有效性。
AI.result: 在446次成对比较中，CTD有72.9%的比较在统计上优于当前最先进方法，21.1%的比较表现等效，仅6.1%的比较显著较差。其优势在评估预算极其有限以及目标维度较高的场景中尤其明显。
AI.conclusion: 将收敛与多样化分阶段处理，比在整个搜索过程中同步兼顾二者更适合紧预算的多目标贝叶斯优化。CTD能够以较高的样本效率先找到帕累托前沿，再扩展解集覆盖范围，具有较好的实用价值和方法通用性。

title: Part Grounding, Not Action Knowledge: Locating the Bottleneck in VLM Affordance Prediction
summary: Benchmarks agree that vision-language models reason poorly about low-level manipulation, but an aggregate accuracy score does not say which step fails. We separate two steps that affordance questions conflate: identifying which part of an object to act on, and knowing what action that part requires. Across 19 articulated objects we asked eight models, spanning three developers, what motion a robot should apply. Under an open prompt, push was produced once in 64 evaluations where it was correct, despite being correct for 8 of 19 objects and appearing in the offered label set every time. Inspecting the outputs showed why: models described a different part than the one being scored, e.g. explaining how to pick up a camera rather than press its button. Naming the target part raises action accuracy by 0.32 to 0.63 for every model, from 0.158-0.474 to 0.684-0.947, and push recall from 0-1/8 to 7-8/8. No model beats a constant answer that ignores the image under the open prompt; once the part is named, all eight do. Asked to describe the same part in free prose with no label set, models produce pressing language for 6 to 8 of 8. These results are hard to reconcile with missing action knowledge, and instead point to part grounding as the dominant bottleneck, a pattern that holds across all three model families and does not diminish with capability. Naming the part supplies the grounding variable, so this bounds what a perfect part detector would offer rather than demonstrating a general model of mechanics. Two supporting results agree: on real photographs only three of eight models localize grasp points better than a constant baseline, and on rendered objects none do. We also document two measurement errors of our own, a threshold that let a constant baseline score 0.929 and a labelling rule wrong on 4 of 19 objects, both caught only by testing our numbers against trivial alternatives.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，视觉语言模型在低层次物体操作推理中的主要瓶颈不是动作知识缺失，而是未能正确定位需要操作的目标部件。将“部件识别”和“动作选择”分离后，显式指定目标部件可显著提升动作准确率与推、按压等动作的召回率。研究还通过常数基线和复核发现了两项测量错误，强调了使用简单替代基线进行评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型基准通常只报告总体准确率，无法区分模型究竟是没有识别出应操作的物体部件，还是不知道该部件需要执行什么动作。该研究旨在拆分这两个步骤，定位模型在低层次操作推理中的具体失败环节，并检验模型是否真正掌握了物体部件与动作之间的关系。
AI.method: 研究在19种可动结构物体上测试来自3家开发者的8个模型，询问机器人应施加何种运动。实验比较开放式提示、显式指定目标部件、自由文本描述以及带标签选项等条件，并将模型表现与忽略图像的常数答案基线进行比较。此外，研究还在真实照片和渲染物体上评估抓取点定位能力，并复查评测阈值与标注规则，以发现潜在的测量误差。
AI.result: 开放式提示下，在64次正确答案机会中，模型仅有1次输出正确的“推”动作，尽管该动作适用于19个物体中的8个，且始终出现在候选标签中。显式指定目标部件后，所有模型的动作准确率提升0.32至0.63，从0.158–0.474升至0.684–0.947；“推”动作召回率从0–1/8提升至7–8/8。开放式条件下没有模型超过忽略图像的常数基线，而指定部件后8个模型均超过该基线。无标签自由描述时，模型在8个相关案例中的6至8个能够生成按压语义。真实照片中仅3/8模型的抓取点定位优于常数基线，渲染物体中则没有模型超过该基线。研究还发现评测阈值曾使常数基线获得0.929分，且19个物体中有4个存在错误标注规则。
AI.conclusion: 研究认为，部件定位而非动作知识缺失，是视觉语言模型低层次操作推理的主导瓶颈；这一现象跨越三类模型家族，且不会随模型能力增强而明显缓解。显式提供目标部件相当于补充了关键的部件 grounding 变量，但这只能估计理想部件检测器可能带来的收益，不能证明模型已经具备完整、一般化的物理机制模型。研究同时说明，常数基线、自由文本检查和标注复核对于避免高估模型能力至关重要。

title: Adaptive Coding for Two-Way Wiretap Channels with One-Sided Strong Secrecy
summary: We study a discrete memoryless two-way wiretap channel under strong one-sided secrecy, where User 1's message is confidential and User 2's message is not required to be secret. We develop non-adaptive and key-assisted adaptive inner bounds from a common resolvability estimate for selected index components. For the adaptive construction, we prove a multiround leakage theorem that accounts both for information revealed about a key before its later use and for the possibility that an encoder uses an incorrectly decoded key. The proof includes an ideal-to-implemented coupling, deterministic codebook selection, and a growing-round argument that removes the initialization-rate loss. We eliminate the internal component rates exactly and characterize the adaptive gain at each fixed auxiliary distribution. For an open two-parameter family of binary channels, we also prove a converse for arbitrary non-adaptive stochastic codes and obtain an operational adaptive-versus-non-adaptive separation. For one representative channel, the complete non-adaptive strong one-sided secrecy capacity region is identified exactly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究强单边保密约束下离散无记忆双向窃听信道，构造非自适应与密钥辅助自适应内界，建立多轮泄漏定理，并证明某类二元信道存在自适应相对非自适应的严格优势；同时精确刻画一个代表性信道的非自适应容量区域。
AI.motivation: 现有双向窃听信道研究对单边保密、交互式自适应编码以及密钥在多轮传输中的泄漏与误译码影响刻画不足。本文旨在统一分析非自适应和自适应方案，消除内部辅助码率，并判断自适应交互是否能够带来真正的保密通信增益。
AI.method: 从选定索引分量的共同可恢复性估计出发，构造非自适应和密钥辅助自适应内界；针对自适应方案建立多轮泄漏定理，同时处理密钥后续使用前已泄漏的信息以及编码器使用错误译码密钥的情形。证明采用理想到实现的耦合、确定性码本选择和随轮数增长的极限论证，以消除初始化速率损失；随后精确消去内部码率，在固定辅助分布下刻画自适应增益，并对一个开放的二参数二元信道族证明任意非自适应随机码的逆定理。
AI.result: 得到非自适应与密钥辅助自适应的内界；建立适用于多轮交互的泄漏上界；精确消去内部索引分量速率并刻画固定辅助分布下的自适应增益。对开放二参数二元信道族，证明非自适应随机编码的 converse，并确认存在操作意义上的自适应—非自适应性能分离；进一步精确求出一个代表性信道的非自适应强单边保密容量区域。
AI.conclusion: 自适应交互与密钥辅助机制在强单边保密双向窃听信道中能够产生严格且可操作的增益，而这种增益并非仅来自分析松弛。本文还提供了处理多轮密钥泄漏和错误密钥使用的通用证明框架，并在特定二元信道上完成了非自适应容量区域的精确刻画。

title: Lexical Prompt Compression for Large Language Models: A Training-Free, Deterministic Pipeline with Empirical Pareto Analysis Across Eleven Task Categories
comment: the paper is 27 pages with 10 figures and 4 tables. Code and data for the experiments: https://github.com/shaminchokshi/Lexical-Prompt-Compressor---Research-Experiment-Code. Python package (pip install less-tokens): https://pypi.org/project/less-tokens/
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made prompts increasingly large and complex. Techniques such as chain-of-thought reasoning (Wei et al., 2022) and in-context learning (Brown et al., 2020) frequently push real-world prompts past several thousand tokens, increasing inference cost and latency. Learned compression methods such as LLMLingua (Jiang et al., 2023) and Selective Context (Li et al., 2023) achieve high compression ratios but require auxiliary language models and are non-deterministic. We ask a complementary question: how far can a training-free, fully deterministic, CPU-only pipeline based on classical lexical NLP be pushed before output quality degrades significantly? Eleven toggleable lexical transformations - stopword removal, filler-phrase deletion, contraction and abbreviation substitution, part-of-speech-based pruning, lemmatization, WordNet-driven synonym shortening, and named-entity preservation - are assembled into a configurable pipeline. Fifteen configurations are evaluated on 1,242 English-only prompts from six sources (Dolly-15k, LMSYS-Chat-1M, WildChat-1M, MMLU, GSM8K, HellaSwag), spanning eleven automatically derived task categories, yielding 18,630 paired GPT-4o-mini completions. Output preservation is measured using BLEU, ROUGE-1/2/L, BERTScore-F1, and SentenceBERT cosine similarity. The most aggressive configuration achieves a mean token reduction of 40.3% (sigma = 9.2) at a BERTScore-F1 of 0.876 against the original-prompt output; a stopword-only configuration achieves 29.6% reduction at 0.913. The compression-versus-fidelity Pareto frontier is characterized per task category, with commonsense reasoning a systematic failure mode under aggressive compression. All code, prompts, and per-cell results are released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一种无需训练、完全确定性、仅依赖CPU和经典词汇级NLP的提示词压缩流水线。通过组合11种词汇变换，评估15种配置在1242条英文提示上的压缩率与输出保真度。最激进配置平均减少40.3%的token，BERTScore-F1为0.876；仅删除停用词可减少29.6%，BERTScore-F1为0.913。结果显示压缩与保真度存在明显权衡，常识推理是激进压缩下的系统性失效类别。
AI.motivation: LLM提示词日益变长，链式思维和上下文学习会显著增加推理成本与延迟。现有学习式压缩方法虽然压缩率高，但通常依赖辅助语言模型且具有非确定性。因此，本文希望回答：在无需训练、无需辅助模型、完全确定性且仅使用CPU的经典词汇NLP方案下，提示词最多可以被压缩到什么程度，同时仍保持可接受的输出质量。
AI.method: 构建可配置的词汇级压缩流水线，包含11种可切换变换，主要包括停用词删除、填充短语删除、缩写与简写替换、基于词性的裁剪、词形还原、基于WordNet的同义词缩短，以及命名实体保留等。共评估15种配置。数据包含来自Dolly-15k、LMSYS-Chat-1M、WildChat-1M、MMLU、GSM8K和HellaSwag的1242条英文提示，覆盖11个自动生成的任务类别，共产生18630组GPT-4o-mini配对输出。使用BLEU、ROUGE-1/2/L、BERTScore-F1和SentenceBERT余弦相似度衡量压缩后输出相对于原始提示输出的保真度，并按任务类别分析压缩率—保真度Pareto前沿。
AI.result: 最激进配置平均token减少40.3%，标准差为9.2，BERTScore-F1为0.876；仅删除停用词的配置平均减少29.6% token，BERTScore-F1达到0.913。不同任务类别呈现不同的压缩—保真度权衡。常识推理在激进压缩下表现出系统性退化，说明词汇删除可能破坏任务所需的语义线索。论文同时发布代码、提示词和逐单元实验结果，以支持复现。
AI.conclusion: 经典词汇级NLP方法在不依赖训练和辅助模型的情况下，能够实现约30%至40%的提示词压缩，并保持较高但非完美的输出保真度。停用词删除提供了更稳健的折中方案，而更激进的组合会进一步提高压缩率，却增加语义损失风险，尤其影响常识推理任务。该方法适合资源受限、强调可解释性、确定性和可复现性的场景，但不能普遍替代学习式压缩方法。

title: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: When we speak of recursive self-improvement (RSI), are we speaking of a phenomenon, a mechanism, or a prospect? Towards autonomous and evolving intelligence, RSI is being claimed at many scales, while no single framework that formally describes these emerging instances exists. Its counterpart in the classical realm, iterative policy improvement, is characterized by generalized policy iteration (GPI), a framework of broad applicability with well-understood theoretical properties, but only where the update principle and the evaluation base lie outside the agent. In this paper, we propose Generalized Agent Iteration (GAI), a formal framework that describes iterative policy improvement and RSI as two cases of a single learning paradigm. GAI defines the agent as a configuration of modifiable components within a system and models the learning process as a cycle of agent evaluation and agent improvement. Two pivotal dials then distinguish the instances: whether the improving mechanism is part of the agent and whether the standard it is measured against is grounded outside it. The former dial delineates the boundary between GPI and RSI, and the latter determines a system's polarity as anchored, goal drift, or fully self-referential. Moreover, we use these coordinates to place existing systems on the same two axes and make the defects of recursive self-improvement statable one condition at a time. We see this paper as a first step toward exploring a formal characterization of RSI that rests on the classical account, makes existing systems comparable, and provides a principled basis for analyzing and designing new ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出广义智能体迭代（GAI）框架，将经典的迭代策略改进与递归自我改进（RSI）统一为“智能体评估—智能体改进”的学习循环，并用两个维度刻画其差异：改进机制是否属于智能体，以及评价标准是否来自外部。该框架进一步将系统划分为锚定型、目标漂移型和完全自指型，为比较现有系统、形式化分析RSI缺陷及设计新系统提供基础。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进在不同尺度和系统中被广泛提出，但其概念可能指现象、机制或发展前景，缺乏统一且形式化的描述框架。经典领域中的广义策略迭代（GPI）具有成熟理论，但其更新原则和评价基准均位于智能体之外，无法直接覆盖RSI。因此，本文旨在建立一个既继承经典策略改进理论、又能描述自我改进系统的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出广义智能体迭代（GAI）框架，将智能体定义为系统中可修改组件的配置，并把学习过程建模为“智能体评估—智能体改进”的循环。框架引入两个关键维度：一是改进机制是否属于智能体内部，用于区分GPI与RSI；二是评价标准是否基于智能体外部，用于区分锚定型、目标漂移型和完全自指型系统。作者还依据这两个坐标对现有系统进行定位，并逐条件描述RSI可能存在的缺陷。
AI.result: 本文形成了一个统一的形式化概念框架，将迭代策略改进和RSI视为同一学习范式的不同实例；明确了区分二者及刻画系统自指程度的两个坐标轴；能够在同一表示空间中比较现有系统，并使RSI的缺陷可以按照具体条件加以陈述。摘要未报告具体实验、定量指标或经验性验证结果。
AI.conclusion: GAI是对RSI进行形式化刻画的初步尝试。它以GPI这一经典理论为基础，统一描述外部驱动的策略改进与内部驱动的递归自我改进，提供系统比较、缺陷分析和新系统设计的原则性基础。不过，本文定位为框架性工作，后续仍需补充更完整的理论性质、实例验证以及对不同RSI系统的深入分析。

title: Synthetic Leprosy Image Generation Using Mask-Conditioned Latent Diffusion and Transfer Learning from Large Chronic Wound Datasets
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables. Code and data pipeline: https://github.com/Yusufa09/SyntheticImageGeneration
summary: Machine learning for neglected tropical diseases is limited by data, not algorithms: public annotated image sets for leprosy (Hansen's disease) number in the hundreds, orders of magnitude below what generative models require. We ask whether a model trained on abundant chronic wound photography transfers to this low-data regime. We build a three-stage pipeline. First, a DeepLabV3-ResNet50 segmentation network (validation Dice 0.876, IoU 0.799) supplies lesion masks for two wound datasets that ship without them. Second, we assemble a mask-conditioned latent diffusion model from Stable Diffusion 1.5 components and train it on 3,280 region-of-interest wound crops, widening the UNet input convolution from 4 to 11 channels to admit three mask feature maps and a blurred low-frequency context latent. Third, we fine-tune this model on 708 leprosy image-mask pairs drawn from 764 images of approximately 150 patients. We evaluate with LPIPS perceptual distance, anchored by a real-versus-real baseline computed on the same 242 anchor images as the cross-set comparisons; without that reference the cross-set distances cannot be interpreted. The generated set shows no mode collapse: its internal perceptual diversity (0.662) is statistically indistinguishable from that of the real leprosy set (0.672, 95% CI [0.664, 0.680]). Generated images sit 0.044 LPIPS outside the real distribution - measurably apart, but under half of one standard deviation. Fine-tuning shifted the output distribution only marginally, which we trace to lesion geometry reaching the network through input concatenation alone. Chronic wound photography is therefore a viable donor domain for leprosy lesion synthesis: low-level appearance transfers well, and the remaining barrier is semantic control rather than image quality.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了利用慢性伤口图像预训练的掩膜条件潜扩散模型，迁移到低数据量的麻风病皮损图像生成任务；结果显示生成图像具有接近真实数据的感知多样性，但语义控制仍有限。
AI.motivation: 麻风病等被忽视热带病的公开标注图像极其稀缺，难以直接训练生成模型。论文希望验证：能否利用数据更丰富的慢性伤口摄影作为供体域，通过迁移学习缓解麻风病图像生成中的小样本问题。
AI.method: 构建三阶段流程：首先使用 DeepLabV3-ResNet50 为缺少掩膜的两个伤口数据集生成病灶分割掩膜；其次基于 Stable Diffusion 1.5 组件，在3280个伤口感兴趣区域裁剪图上训练掩膜条件潜扩散模型，并将 UNet 输入通道从4扩展至11，以接收三个掩膜特征图和一个经模糊处理的低频背景潜变量；最后利用来自约150名患者、764张图像中的708组麻风病图像—掩膜对进行微调。采用 LPIPS 评估生成图像与真实图像的感知距离，并设置同一组242张锚定图像上的真实—真实基线，以便解释跨数据集距离。
AI.result: 分割模型验证集 Dice 为0.876、IoU为0.799。生成数据未出现模式坍塌：其内部感知多样性为0.662，与真实麻风病数据的0.672（95%置信区间[0.664, 0.680]）在统计上无显著差异。生成图像与真实分布的 LPIPS 距离为0.044，虽可测但低于半个标准差。微调仅使输出分布发生轻微变化，表明病灶几何信息主要通过输入拼接传入网络，未充分改变生成语义。
AI.conclusion: 慢性伤口摄影可以作为麻风病皮损合成的有效供体域：低层次视觉外观能够较好迁移，并且生成图像保持了接近真实数据的多样性；但模型的主要瓶颈已从图像质量转向病灶语义和条件控制能力。

title: A Novel Approach to Counterexamples of the Polujan-Pott Conjecture via Set-Partition Permutations
summary: In this paper, we settle a conjecture of Polujan and Pott by constructing an explicit, infinite family of Maiorana--McFarland bent functions $f_t$ in $2(2^t-1)$ variables with algebraic degree $°(f_t) = t + 1$ for any integer $t \ge 2$. Our construction builds upon a minimal commutative algebra $I_t$, which naturally induces a triangular set-partition polynomial permutation $P_t$. By identifying an elementary abelian subgroup within the direct sum $ I_t \oplus I_t^*$, we establish an explicit nonlinear coordinate transformation that pulls $f_t$ back to a canonical quadratic form. This linearizes the translation development $\operatorname{Dev}(D_{f_t})$ under an exotic group structure and proves that it is isomorphic to the classical symplectic design $S^\pm(2(2^t-1))$, thereby fully resolving the conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个适用于任意整数 t≥2 的无限族 Maiorana–McFarland 弯函数，并证明其平移发展与经典辛设计同构，从而解决 Polujan 和 Pott 提出的猜想。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决 Polujan 和 Pott 关于特定 Maiorana–McFarland 弯函数及其平移发展结构的猜想。核心动机是构造具有指定代数次数的显式无限函数族，并澄清其关联设计的几何与代数结构。
AI.method: 作者构造最小交换代数 I_t，并利用它诱导出一个三角形集合划分多项式置换 P_t。在直和 I_t⊕I_t^* 中识别初等阿贝尔子群，建立显式的非线性坐标变换，将所构造的弯函数 f_t 拉回到标准二次型。随后在一种非常规群结构下，将平移发展 Dev(D_{f_t}) 线性化，并分析其与经典辛设计 S^±(2(2^t−1)) 的关系。
AI.result: 得到适用于任意 t≥2 的显式无限族 f_t，定义在 2(2^t−1) 个变量上，代数次数为 t+1。作者证明其平移发展在所构造的群结构下与经典辛设计 S^±(2(2^t−1)) 同构。
AI.conclusion: 该构造完全解决了 Polujan 和 Pott 的猜想，表明这类高代数次数的 Maiorana–McFarland 弯函数仍可通过适当的非线性坐标变换与经典二次型及辛设计建立精确联系。

title: TestHallVQA: Exploring LVLMs' Document-Level Reasoning under Redundant Contexts from Scientific Exams
summary: Large Vision--Language Models (LVLMs) are increasingly expected to perform visual question answering (VQA) over planar media. However, existing planar VQA benchmarks typically emphasize isolated challenges: some emphasize long-document understanding with limited reasoning depth, while others require complex visual reasoning but remain restricted to single-page, noise-free settings. Moreover, through theoretical analysis, we identify the impact of irrelevant visual tokens, which leads to measurable performance degradation but has received little attention with respect to systematic quantification. To address these limitations, we introduce TestHallVQA, a multi-image VQA benchmark that simultaneously embodies document-level scale and the difficulty of human examinations, while providing comprehensive task coverage. Leveraging TestHallVQA's ability to controllably inject multi-level contextual redundancy, we further propose a novel metric, F1-R\textsuperscript{2}, which jointly quantifies LVLMs' computational reasoning capability and their evidence retrieval robustness against document-level redundancy. Extensive experiments and analyses on mainstream LVLMs reveal their latent deficiencies across multiple dimensions, offering concrete insights and directions for future research. The associated datasets, code, and complete theoretical derivations are available at https://github.com/yqyu2317/TestHallVQA-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TestHallVQA 多图视觉问答基准及 F1-R² 指标，用于评估 LVLM 在文档级、多页、含冗余视觉信息场景下的推理能力与证据检索鲁棒性。实验表明，主流 LVLM 在计算推理和抵抗无关视觉 token 干扰方面存在系统性不足。
AI.motivation: 现有平面媒体 VQA 基准存在两类局限：长文档基准通常推理深度不足；复杂视觉推理基准又多局限于单页、无噪声环境，难以反映真实文档级任务。同时，无关视觉 token 会造成可测量的性能下降，但其影响缺乏系统量化方法。因此，作者希望构建一个兼具文档规模、考试式复杂度和多维任务覆盖的基准，并量化模型在视觉冗余下的性能稳健性。
AI.method: 作者提出 TestHallVQA，一个多图 VQA 基准，覆盖文档级规模和类似人工考试的复杂视觉推理任务，并支持可控注入多层次上下文冗余。在此基础上提出 F1-R² 指标，联合衡量 LVLM 的计算推理能力，以及面对文档级冗余信息时的证据检索鲁棒性。作者还对相关现象进行了理论分析，并在主流 LVLM 上开展广泛实验。
AI.result: 实验与分析显示，主流 LVLM 在多个维度存在潜在缺陷，尤其体现在复杂推理能力不足，以及容易受到无关视觉 token 和文档级上下文冗余的干扰。F1-R² 能够揭示传统 VQA 性能指标难以区分的推理能力与冗余鲁棒性差异。
AI.conclusion: TestHallVQA 为文档级、多图、含冗余信息的 LVLM 评测提供了更综合的测试环境，F1-R² 则提供了联合评估推理和证据检索鲁棒性的工具。研究结果说明，未来 LVLM 需要加强深层视觉推理、长文档处理及对无关视觉信息的抑制能力。相关数据集、代码和理论推导已公开。

title: Vibe Patenting: Evaluating LLM Judges for Professional Patent-Drafting Agents
summary: LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate and improve AI-generated outputs, yet their reliability for complex professional work remains unclear. We study this problem through Vibe Patenting, an end-to-end patent-drafting testbed for AI-agent evaluation. A separately-invoked LLM judge evaluates generated patent drafts and provides structured feedback for iterative revision. Across multiple inventions and drafting-agent configurations, judge-guided revision consistently improves judge-assessed quality, while unguided revision tends to saturate. Notably, iterative judge feedback enables a low-reasoning agent to approach the performance of a substantially more expensive high-reasoning agent. Stronger models and increased reasoning generally improve judge-assessed drafting quality, while domain-specific agentic workflows provide further gains. We validate the judge against independent evaluation by a professional patent attorney and find meaningful but strongly metric-dependent agreement and systematic calibration differences. These results highlight both the utility and limitations of LLM judges as evaluators and optimization signals for complex professional workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM评审器在复杂专业任务中的可靠性，提出并使用Vibe Patenting作为端到端专利起草评测平台。结果表明，评审器反馈可有效驱动迭代改进，使低推理成本代理接近高推理成本代理的表现，但评审结果与专业专利律师评价之间存在显著的指标依赖和系统性校准差异。
AI.motivation: 现有研究广泛使用LLM评审器评价和优化AI生成内容，但其在专利起草等复杂、专业、长流程任务中的可靠性、有效性及与人类专家判断的一致性仍不明确。论文旨在检验LLM评审器能否作为可靠的评价器和优化信号，并分析其潜在偏差。
AI.method: 构建Vibe Patenting端到端专利起草测试平台，使用不同发明案例、不同起草代理配置以及不同推理能力的模型生成专利草案。实验比较评审器指导的迭代修订与无指导修订，并考察模型能力、推理强度和领域特定代理工作流的影响。同时邀请专业专利律师进行独立评价，将其结果与LLM评审结果进行对比，分析二者在不同指标上的一致性和校准差异。
AI.result: 评审器指导的迭代修订在多个发明案例和代理配置下均能持续提升评审器评定的质量，而无指导修订通常较快进入饱和。迭代反馈使低推理代理的表现接近成本显著更高的高推理代理。更强模型、更高推理强度及领域特定代理工作流总体上带来更高的评审质量。与专业专利律师评价相比，LLM评审器呈现有意义但强烈依赖指标的一致性，并存在系统性校准差异。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审器既可作为复杂专业工作中的有效迭代优化信号，也不能被视为完全可靠或等同于专家判断的评价机制。其应用需要结合具体评价指标，进行独立专家验证、校准分析和对潜在偏差的审慎解释。

title: Don't Just Look, Intervene: Perturbation Based Region Labeling for VQA Images
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) should rely on visual evidence that directly determines the correct answer, but supervision for grounding visual reasoning is often expensive to obtain manually or tied to dataset-specific annotation primitives. We instead introduce model-causal visual evidence as an annotation target, defined as the set of image regions whose counterfactual intervention changes a model's answer distribution for a given image-question pair. Based on this principle, we introduce Counterfactual Search for Grounding Regions (CSGR). CSGR is a scalable pipeline that proposes candidate regions, perturbs them, measures their effect on answer sensitivity, and aggregates this evidence across multiple judges to approximate answer-critical regions in VQA data. To assess whether CSGR annotations contain a useful supervision signal, we plug them into three existing grounding-aware training routines: attention steering, Visual CoTfinetuning, and latent visual reasoning. These experiments test whether the proposed annotation scheme can provide a useful supervision signal across multiple ways of consuming region labels, rather than introducing a new way of using them. Across competing automatic region-labeling mechanisms, CSGR annotations provide the most consistent gains over Cross Entropy-only finetuning in both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations, indicating that the proposed labeling scheme captures useful region-level information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CSGR，通过反事实干预识别会改变视觉语言模型答案分布的关键图像区域，并将其作为可扩展的视觉证据标注，用于提升视觉问答中的视觉 grounding 与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 grounding 监督通常需要昂贵的人工标注，或依赖特定数据集的标注原语，难以规模化且泛化性有限。本文希望定义一种更贴近模型实际决策过程的视觉证据，并验证该证据能否作为通用监督信号。
AI.method: 提出 Counterfactual Search for Grounding Regions（CSGR）流程：首先生成候选图像区域，然后对候选区域进行扰动，通过测量扰动对模型答案分布和答案敏感性的影响，识别答案关键区域，最后综合多个评判模型的结果以获得更稳健的区域标注。将这些标注接入三种已有的 grounding-aware 训练方法：attention steering、Visual CoT 微调和 latent visual reasoning，以检验标注本身的有效性，而非提出新的标注使用方式。
AI.result: 在多种自动区域标注机制的比较中，CSGR 标注相较于仅使用交叉熵微调，在域内和域外评估中都取得了最稳定的性能提升，并且在三种不同的区域监督训练流程中均表现出有用性。
AI.conclusion: 反事实干预得到的模型因果视觉证据能够捕捉视觉问答中与答案相关的区域信息，并可作为跨训练范式、具有较好泛化性的视觉 grounding 监督信号。

title: GNN-Based Polarforming for Multi-User MISO Short-Packet URLLC under Imperfect CSI
summary: This paper investigates polarization-aware transmission for multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) short-packet ultra-reliable low-latency communications (URLLC) under imperfect channel state information (CSI). We consider a system in which the base station (BS) and users are equipped with polarization-reconfigurable antennas that enable adaptive polarization states through controllable polarization coefficients. A multi-objective optimization problem is formulated to jointly maximize the finite-blocklength (FBL) achievable sum rate and minimize the maximum decoding error probability (DEP), subject to transmit-power, latency, reliability, and discrete polarization-control constraints. The resulting multi-objective problem is scalarized using a normalized weighted-sum utility. To enable low-complexity online decision-making, a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) is developed to learn the joint mapping from estimated polarized CSI to digital beamforming and transmit/receive polarforming vectors (PFVs) while accounting for the system constraints. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed GNN-based polarforming (PF) framework substantially improves the FBL sum rate while reducing the maximum DEP compared with conventional fixed-polarization schemes, particularly under channel depolarization and imperfect CSI. This highlights the potential of adaptive polarization control for reliable low-latency transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不完美CSI条件下，面向短包URLLC的偏振感知MU-MISO传输，并提出基于异构图神经网络的联合数字波束成形与偏振控制方法，以提升有限码长和可靠性性能。
AI.motivation: 短包URLLC同时要求极低时延和极高可靠性，传统固定偏振方案在信道去偏振及CSI不完美时性能明显受限。可重构偏振天线能够自适应调整偏振状态，但数字波束成形、收发偏振控制以及有限码长速率和译码错误概率之间存在复杂耦合，亟需一种兼顾性能与在线决策复杂度的方法。
AI.method: 建立带有发射功率、时延、可靠性和离散偏振控制约束的多目标优化问题，联合最大化有限码长可达和速率、最小化最大译码错误概率。通过归一化加权和将多目标问题标量化，并设计异构图神经网络，从估计的偏振CSI中学习到数字波束成形向量以及发射端和接收端偏振成形向量的联合映射，实现低复杂度在线控制。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，与传统固定偏振方案相比，所提出的基于GNN的偏振成形框架能够显著提高有限码长和速率并降低最大译码错误概率；在信道去偏振和CSI不完美场景下，性能增益尤其明显。
AI.conclusion: 自适应偏振控制结合图神经网络能够有效提升短包URLLC系统在不完美CSI下的传输性能，在保证低时延和高可靠性的同时降低在线优化复杂度，体现了偏振可重构技术在可靠低时延通信中的应用潜力。

title: Clinical Reasoning Under a Partially Observed Objective in Cone Beam CT Report Generation
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. ODIN 2026 CBCT report generation challenge system. Code: https://github.com/GIND123/CBCT-Clinical-Reasoner
summary: Maxillofacial report generation from cone beam computed tomography is scored here by a composite objective placing 80% of its weight on a large language model judgement of factual entailment and 20% on lexical overlap, of which only the lexical fifth is visible during development. The grader's BLEU-4 and METEOR routines are reproduced in pure Python and match the reference to machine precision, and an offline entailment surrogate, which tells a report written for one patient from one written for another at an area under the curve of 0.987, makes the composite objective cheap enough to optimise directly. Over the 622-case public release, a report selected against the visible lexical ranking scores 0.2909, whereas one selected against the composite objective scores 0.4122, because pursuing n-gram overlap drives entailment precision from 0.522 down to 0.266. A 29 million parameter encoder fine-tuned on the release reaches a prevalence-weighted out-of-fold area under the curve of 0.486 over 985 statements, indistinguishable from the corpus prior, while nine numbers read from the image header reach 0.945 for mandible coverage and 0.872 for condyle coverage, and acquisition centre alone predicts sentence choice at 0.718 against 0.663 for the image-derived model, identifying dictation convention rather than anatomy as the quantity the lexical metrics reward. The delivered system emits eight unconditional statements and five gated on header geometry under polarity, laterality and tooth-level consistency constraints, and reaches METEOR 0.3542 over 50 held-out cases from an unseen centre. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/GIND123/CBCT-Clinical-Reasoner

AI.tldr: 本文分析锥形束CT（CBCT）颌面报告生成中的评估偏差：提出由80%事实蕴含判断和20%词汇重叠组成的复合目标，并通过离线蕴含代理实现直接优化。结果显示，词汇指标容易奖励采集中心和书写习惯，而非真实解剖信息；最终系统结合固定陈述、基于头信息几何的门控规则及一致性约束，在外部中心测试集上取得METEOR 0.3542。
AI.motivation: 现有报告生成系统常依赖BLEU-4、METEOR等词汇重叠指标，但这些指标可能无法反映医学事实正确性，并可能鼓励模型模仿机构或医生的书写习惯。本文旨在构建更关注事实蕴含的评估与优化目标，检验词汇指标是否真正衡量解剖学内容，并开发具有一致性约束的CBCT报告生成系统。
AI.method: 在复合评价目标中，将大语言模型对事实蕴含的判断赋予80%权重，将BLEU-4和METEOR等词汇重叠指标赋予20%权重；用纯Python复现BLEU-4和METEOR，并训练离线事实蕴含代理以降低直接优化成本。基于622例公开数据进行目标选择和比较，使用29M参数编码器进行微调，并在985条陈述上开展离线评估。进一步提取9个影像头信息字段，比较其与影像模型、采集中心对句子选择的预测能力；最终系统输出8条无条件陈述和5条受头信息几何门控的陈述，同时施加极性、侧别和牙齿层面一致性约束，并在未见过的中心的50例数据上测试。
AI.result: 按可见词汇排序选择的报告复合得分为0.2909，而按复合目标选择的报告得分为0.4122；单纯追求n-gram重叠时，事实蕴含精确率由0.522降至0.266。29M编码器在985条陈述上的流行率加权留出AUC为0.486，接近语料先验，说明其影像判别能力有限。相比之下，9个头信息字段对下颌骨覆盖和髁突覆盖的AUC分别为0.945和0.872；采集中心单独预测句子选择的AUC为0.718，高于影像模型的0.663，表明词汇指标主要奖励书写或听写规范，而非解剖学内容。最终系统在未见中心的50例上获得METEOR 0.3542。
AI.conclusion: CBCT颌面报告生成的词汇重叠指标可能严重偏离事实正确性，并受到机构性书写风格的影响。将事实蕴含纳入主要评价权重能够更有效地区分医学内容质量；结合头信息几何、规则门控和一致性约束，可以构建更稳健的报告生成流程。但影像编码器在当前数据规模和任务设置下尚未表现出明显超越语料先验的陈述级判别能力，未来需要更大、更具跨中心代表性的数据及更可靠的医学事实评估器。

title: Toward Self-Adaptive Physical AI: Can LLM Agents Manage Long-Horizon Physical Tasks?
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents offer a promising path toward autonomously managing long-term physical tasks without human intervention. However, physical tasks require agents to continuously observe the environment, make consequential actions, and remain effective as the environment changes. Existing approaches either require substantial data and retraining, or primarily focus on agents operating in the virtual world. In this work, we explore the feasibility of building a self-adaptive physical AI agent that manages long-term physical tasks in a zero-shot manner and adapts to environmental changes without human intervention. We design a multi-agent framework that integrates planning, tool calling, observation, and verification, and evaluate it on agricultural tasks against reinforcement learning (RL) agents under different weather patterns. Our results show that zero-shot LLM agents can achieve comparable management outcomes to RL agents under the same weather pattern and adapt more effectively than RL when evaluated under a shifted environment, highlighting a promising path toward self-adaptive physical AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向长期农业物理任务的零样本自适应多智能体框架，将规划、工具调用、环境观测与结果验证结合起来，并与强化学习智能体在不同天气条件下进行比较。结果表明，LLM智能体在同分布天气下达到与RL相近的管理效果，在环境发生变化时表现出更强的适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有物理任务智能体通常依赖大量数据和重新训练，且研究重点多集中于虚拟环境，难以持续感知环境、执行具有后果的动作并应对动态变化。因此，本文旨在探索无需人工干预、无需针对新环境重新训练的零样本自适应物理AI智能体。
AI.method: 构建多智能体框架，整合任务规划、工具调用、环境观测和执行结果验证等模块，使LLM智能体能够持续管理长期农业任务。实验在不同天气模式下开展，并与强化学习智能体进行对比，分别考察相同天气模式下的任务管理能力，以及天气分布发生变化后的环境适应能力。
AI.result: 在与训练或评估相同的天气模式下，零样本LLM智能体取得了与RL智能体相当的管理结果。在天气模式发生偏移的环境中，LLM智能体相比RL智能体展现出更强的适应性，说明其对环境变化具有更好的泛化潜力。摘要未提供具体的性能指标、任务细节或统计显著性信息。
AI.conclusion: 零样本LLM智能体结合多智能体协作机制，有望成为管理长期物理任务的自适应方案。其优势主要体现在环境变化下的灵活调整能力，但仍需通过更多任务、更复杂环境和定量实验验证其可靠性、成本与可扩展性。

title: What Does the Encoder Actually Decide? A Controlled Comparison of Vision Backbones on Joint Tree Segmentation and Stereo Depth
summary: A robot pruning trees needs two facts per pixel: whether it belongs to a tree, and its distance. Both are usually obtained via task heads attached to a vision backbone chosen by reputation rather than measurement. Holding dataset, decoders, losses, schedule, and evaluation fixed, we ask: how much does the encoder choice change joint semantic segmentation and stereo depth on thin vegetation? We build a hard parameter-sharing network with one encoder feeding both branches, swapping only the encoder without downstream retuning. We evaluate [N] encoders across [M] architecture families (CNNs, transformers, hybrids, MLP-mixers, state-space models) near a ~25M budget, trained from scratch. Depth is evaluated on tree pixels only; segmentation uses boundary F1 and background IoU to prevent "label-everything-tree" shortcuts. Three findings stand out. First, the strongest encoders are convolutional and hybrid, not transformers: [BestEncoder] leads with [MIoU] segmentation mIoU and [Delta] depth $δ_1$, while [X] of [Y] plain vision transformers collapse when trained from scratch. Second, parameter count does not predict quality --- [SmallEncoder] at only [P]M parameters outranks models two orders of magnitude larger. Third, segmentation and depth rankings agree strongly (Spearman $ρ$ = [RhoValue]), showing no task conflict. Finally, [K] of [N] encoders collapse to degenerate all-tree segmentation --- exposed by boundary F1 but hidden by region IoU.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了不同视觉编码器在树木细枝场景下联合语义分割与立体深度估计中的影响。研究在约2500万参数规模、从头训练、固定解码器与训练设置的条件下，仅替换编码器。结果显示卷积和混合架构整体优于纯Transformer；参数量不是性能可靠指标；分割与深度性能高度一致；边界F1揭示了区域IoU可能掩盖的全树类别退化问题。
AI.motivation: 机器人修剪树木需要逐像素判断像素是否属于树木，并估计其距离。现有研究通常凭经验选择视觉骨干网络，缺乏在统一条件下对编码器选择影响的系统测量，尤其缺乏针对细薄植被、联合分割与立体深度任务的比较。本文旨在隔离编码器因素，回答不同编码器对两项任务的实际影响，以及模型规模、架构类型和任务间关系如何影响性能。
AI.method: 构建一个硬参数共享网络：单一编码器向语义分割和立体深度两个分支提供特征，保持数据集、解码器、损失函数、训练计划和评估协议不变，仅替换编码器。比较[N]个、来自[M]类架构族的编码器，包括CNN、Transformer、混合架构、MLP-Mixer和状态空间模型；模型规模约为25M参数，并从头训练。深度仅在树木像素上评估；分割同时采用边界F1和背景IoU，以避免“将所有像素标为树木”的投机策略。进一步使用Spearman相关系数分析两项任务的排名一致性，并统计退化为全树预测的编码器数量。
AI.result: 主要发现有四点：1）卷积和混合编码器整体优于纯Transformer；[BestEncoder]取得最佳表现，分割mIoU为[MIoU]，深度δ1为[Delta]；从头训练时，[X]/[Y]个普通视觉Transformer发生性能崩溃。2）参数量不能可靠预测性能；仅有[P]M参数的[SmallEncoder]超过了参数规模大两个数量级的模型。3）分割与深度的编码器排名高度一致，Spearman ρ=[RhoValue]，表明两项任务之间没有明显冲突。4）[K]/[N]个编码器退化为全树分割；这一问题可被边界F1识别，却可能被区域IoU掩盖。由于摘要中的方括号仍是占位符，具体数值和模型名称尚未确定。
AI.conclusion: 在细薄植被的联合语义分割和立体深度估计中，编码器架构选择具有显著影响，且卷积归纳偏置或卷积-其他架构的混合设计比未经预训练、从头训练的纯Transformer更稳健。模型参数量并非性能的充分指标。分割与深度性能的高度相关意味着可以通过编码器整体能力同时改善两项任务，而不必在二者之间进行明显权衡。评估时应结合边界F1等抗退化指标，不能仅依赖区域IoU。

title: Finite-Mask Gaussian-Process Reconstruction on a Periodic Sensor Ring: Mask-Geometry Dependence, Fourier-Mode Coupling, and Posterior Trace
summary: We analyze how an arbitrary observation mask on a finite periodic ring of equally spaced sensors affects the posterior covariance, Fourier-mode coupling, and normalized posterior trace in Gaussian-process reconstruction. Under a rotationally stationary prior and homogeneous independent measurement noise, complete observation gives independent scalar posterior formulas for the Fourier modes. For an arbitrary mask, however, the matrix $Q_M=F D_MF^\ast$ is generally non-diagonal; its off-diagonal entries are finite Fourier components of the realized mask and couple modes in the posterior precision. Consequently, masks with the same unavailable-channel fraction can have different normalized posterior traces because their geometries differ. A dimensionless 64-channel synthetic benchmark illustrates this finite-matrix effect. A circumferential array of equally spaced wall-mounted microphones at a fixed axial station of a circular fan or compressor duct provides one concrete mechanical-engineering interpretation: failed, saturated, corrupted, or dropped-out channels form the observation mask. The analysis is a finite-dimensional reference calculation under the stated rotational-stationarity and common-noise assumptions, not a performance claim for a nonuniform or unequally instrumented operating duct.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限周期环上任意观测掩码对高斯过程重构后验协方差、傅里叶模态耦合及归一化后验迹的影响。完整观测时各傅里叶模态相互独立；任意掩码会通过其有限傅里叶分量引入模态耦合，因此相同缺失比例的掩码也可能产生不同的不确定性。论文还给出64通道合成算例，并将其解释为圆形风机或压气机管道周向麦克风阵列中的通道失效、饱和、污染或丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有完整观测情形下，旋转平稳先验与均匀独立测量噪声使傅里叶域后验分析十分简洁；但实际传感器可能存在失效、丢失或异常通道，形成任意观测掩码。仅用不可用通道比例衡量观测质量可能忽略掩码空间几何及其引起的模态耦合，因此有必要建立有限维、可解析的参考分析。
AI.method: 在有限周期环的等间距传感器模型中，引入任意观测掩码，并在旋转平稳高斯过程先验和齐次独立测量噪声假设下，将掩码变换为Q_M=F D_M F^*。通过分析后验精度矩阵，比较完整观测与任意掩码情况下的傅里叶模态结构；其中Q_M的非对角元素被解释为实际掩码的有限傅里叶分量，并用于刻画模态耦合及归一化后验迹。
AI.result: 完整观测时，傅里叶模态具有独立的标量后验公式。任意观测掩码通常使Q_M非对角化，从而在后验精度中耦合不同傅里叶模态。结果表明，即使不可用通道比例相同，不同掩码几何仍会导致不同的归一化后验迹。64通道无量纲合成算例展示了这一有限矩阵效应。
AI.conclusion: 观测掩码的几何结构，而不仅是缺失通道比例，会决定高斯过程重构中的后验不确定性和模态耦合。该分析为周向麦克风阵列中的通道缺失问题提供了有限维参考，但其适用范围限于等间距传感器、旋转平稳先验和共同噪声假设，不能直接视为对非均匀或非等间距实际管道系统性能的保证。

title: RFCLLM: Evaluating LLMs' Reasoning Ability of Network Protocol State Machines
summary: Mapping textual specifications into formal representations is essential for ensuring the correctness of protocol designs and implementations. LLM-generated mappings, used for networking security or testing, are assumed to capture a perfect understanding of the specification, which may not hold in practice. The goal of this paper is to assess the extent to which LLMs can interpret the specification correctly. We examine the degree to which an LLM's implicit representation of a finite-state transition system-defined via natural language descriptions-aligns with a manually generated ground-truth model. We designed 4 tasks and 1482 task queries for 16 protocols. We evaluated different judge biases, observed the inherent difficulty gaps between tasks, looked into the effect of 4 context types, and the influence of protocol characteristics. Our work contributes to a step toward verifying whether LLMs can really be trusted in FSM (Finite State Machine) reasoning of protocol specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文评估大语言模型（LLM）能否根据自然语言协议规范，准确构建并推理有限状态机（FSM）表示，并将其隐式理解与人工构建的真实模型进行比较。研究覆盖16种协议、4类任务和1482个任务查询，同时分析评测者偏差、任务难度、上下文类型及协议特征的影响。
AI.motivation: 协议规范从自然语言到形式化表示的映射是验证协议设计与实现正确性的基础。当前网络安全和协议测试工作常使用LLM生成这类映射，但其是否真正、完整且准确地理解规范尚未得到充分验证。本文旨在系统评估LLM对协议有限状态转移系统的理解程度，以及其隐式模型与人工标注真实模型之间的一致性。
AI.method: 作者围绕16种协议设计4类FSM相关任务，共构造1482个任务查询，并将LLM产生的结果与人工生成的ground-truth模型进行比较。实验进一步考察四个方面：不同评测者或判定标准带来的偏差、任务之间的固有难度差异、四类上下文信息对模型表现的影响，以及协议特征对推理结果的影响。总体上，这是一个面向协议规范理解的系统性实证评估框架。
AI.result: 摘要表明，研究观察到了评测者偏差和不同任务之间明显的难度差距，并分析了上下文类型及协议特征对LLM表现的影响。但摘要没有给出具体模型、准确率、一致性分数、统计显著性或不同设置下的定量结果，因此无法据此判断LLM在各项任务中的绝对性能或最佳配置。
AI.conclusion: LLM对协议规范的FSM理解并不能默认视为完美或可信。将LLM用于网络安全、协议测试和形式化建模时，需要通过人工真实模型、任务化评测和偏差分析进行验证。本文为判断LLM是否能够可靠执行协议FSM推理提供了初步方法和实证基础，但其结论的具体强弱仍需结合全文中的定量实验结果。

title: LabAgent: Customize Any Research Hubs for Scientific Discoveries Using AI Agents
summary: Scientific research is a continuous process that emphasizes inheritance. Methods developed by predecessors are often expanded upon by new researchers to explore more novel and in-depth scientific questions. However, the change of lab staff, such as student graduation, leads to a lack of personnel capable of replicating methods. Methods that have been developed with significant effort and resources cannot be continued. To address these limitations, we propose LabAgent, a reproduce and discovery harness tailored for a lab's continuous work. LabAgent employs two mechanisms to guarantee that all skills can be executed and verified and to record the corrective methods and experiences, allowing for direct correction or avoidance of similar errors. We applied LabAgent to drug property prediction, biomedical problem analysis, protein variant effect prediction, and statistical genetics in life science domains. LabAgent ranks first over commercial generalist agents in every domain, and demonstrates accurate reproduction of a published figure. Overall, these results demonstrate that LabAgent can effectively integrate and reasonably expand laboratory knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LabAgent，一种面向实验室持续科研工作的复现与发现框架。该系统通过技能执行与验证机制，以及纠错方法和经验记录机制，帮助实验室继承、复现并扩展既有研究知识。其在药物性质预测、生物医学问题分析、蛋白质变异效应预测和统计遗传学四类生命科学任务中均优于商业通用智能体，并成功复现已发表论文中的图表，表明其具备较强的科研知识整合与任务扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 科研方法具有继承性，但实验室人员流动，尤其是学生毕业，会导致掌握特定方法的人员离开，使高成本开发的方法难以复现和延续。现有实验室知识缺乏系统化保存、验证与传承机制，因此需要一种能够持续积累、复现和扩展实验室工作流程的智能系统。
AI.method: 作者提出LabAgent，一个针对实验室连续科研工作的复现与发现框架。其核心包括两类机制：第一，确保各项技能能够被执行并得到验证；第二，记录纠错过程、修正方法和实践经验，从而支持直接修正当前错误或避免重复出现类似错误。作者将该系统应用于药物性质预测、生物医学问题分析、蛋白质变异效应预测和统计遗传学等生命科学任务，并与商业通用智能体进行比较，同时测试其对已发表论文图表的复现能力。
AI.result: 在所测试的四个生命科学领域中，LabAgent均排名高于商业通用智能体；此外，它能够准确复现一篇已发表论文中的图表。结果说明，LabAgent不仅可以执行科研任务，还能够通过验证和经验记录提升任务可靠性，并支持既有研究结果的再现。摘要未提供具体数据集、评价指标或统计显著性信息。
AI.conclusion: LabAgent能够有效整合实验室知识，并在此基础上进行合理扩展，有望缓解人员变动造成的科研方法断层问题。该工作强调了科研智能体在技能验证、错误纠正、经验积累和研究复现方面的作用。不过，其泛化能力、长期运行稳定性、不同实验室工作流中的适用性，以及与人工研究者协作的效果仍需进一步验证。

title: EMCStereo: Attention-Enhanced Stereo Matching for Thin-Structure Depth Estimation with a Synthetic Tree-Branch Benchmark
summary: Thin structures such as tree branches are among the hardest cases for stereo matching: a branch is only a few pixels wide, the background is cluttered, and dense ground truth for real branches is nearly impossible to label by hand. We make three contributions. First, EMCStereo integrates three lightweight attention modules into a PSMNet-style cost-volume backbone: Efficient Multi-scale Attention (EMA) on deep semantic features, a Multi-Scale Fusion block (MSFblock) learning spatial pyramid weights instead of concatenating them, and Coordinate Attention (CoordAtt) on final matching features. Because MSFblock collapses four pyramid branches into one, the modules leave the network 2.0% smaller and add only 1.7% inference time overhead. Second, VirtualTree is a synthetic stereo dataset rendered in Unreal Engine 5 with a simulated ZED Mini rig, providing 5,520 pairs with exact disparity for thin branches. Third, an eight-way ablation establishes a run-to-run noise floor of 0.009 px end-point error (EPE). EMCStereo achieves 1.31 px EPE (5.96% D1-all) on the VirtualTree test split, 1.00 px on SceneFlow, and 0.80, 0.73, 0.62, and 3.19 px on KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, ETH3D, and Middlebury, with depth accuracy delta_1 from 92.6% to 98.7%. Evaluated against the noise floor, the attention stack is accuracy-neutral at a 100-epoch budget, while MSFblock and CoordAtt cost 0.03-0.05 px unless EMA is present.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对树枝等细长结构的立体匹配难题，提出轻量注意力增强网络EMCStereo，并构建带精确视差标注的VirtualTree合成数据集。实验显示其在多个基准上取得较好性能，但消融结果表明注意力模块整体收益有限，部分模块在有限训练预算下可能带来轻微性能损失。
AI.motivation: 细小树枝在双目立体匹配中容易被背景纹理干扰，且目标宽度仅有几个像素，导致视差估计困难。真实场景中为树枝获取密集、精确的人工视差标注成本极高，因此需要专门的数据集和兼顾精度、效率的匹配方法。
AI.method: 以PSMNet风格的代价体网络为骨干，加入三个轻量模块：在深层语义特征上使用Efficient Multi-scale Attention（EMA），通过Multi-Scale Fusion block（MSFblock）学习空间金字塔权重并替代直接拼接，在最终匹配特征上使用Coordinate Attention（CoordAtt）。同时在Unreal Engine 5中模拟ZED Mini双目相机，生成包含5520对立体图像且具有精确视差的VirtualTree数据集。论文还进行八种配置的消融实验，用于估计运行间噪声下限。
AI.result: EMCStereo在VirtualTree测试集上达到1.31 px EPE和5.96% D1-all，在SceneFlow、KITTI 2012、KITTI 2015、ETH3D和Middlebury上分别达到1.00、0.80、0.73、0.62和3.19 px EPE，深度delta_1为92.6%至98.7%。网络规模减少2.0%，推理时间仅增加1.7%。八路消融显示运行间噪声下限为0.009 px；在100轮训练预算下，完整注意力组合总体精度基本不变，而MSFblock和CoordAtt在缺少EMA时会造成0.03至0.05 px的性能代价。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要价值在于面向细长结构建立了专门的合成评测资源，并提出了计算开销较低的特征增强方案。结果证明该方法具有较好的跨数据集性能和工程效率，但消融实验削弱了“注意力堆叠必然提升精度”的结论：模块收益依赖组合方式和训练预算，EMCStereo的优势可能更多来自结构设计、数据集适配或训练设置，而非三个注意力模块的独立贡献。

title: Polarforming-Enabled Power-Splitting SWIPT: A GNN-Based Optimization Approach
summary: Simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) is a critical technology for the future of the Internet of Things (IoT). However, ensuring a stable power supply in such networks remains a significant challenge. This work introduces dynamic polarization control as an additional degree of freedom (DoF) in SWIPT systems. We propose a system where both the base station (BS) and the users can adjust their antenna polarization, a technique known as polarforming. In addition, each user device is capable of splitting the incident signal to perform simultaneous information decoding (ID) and energy harvesting (EH). The resulting non-convex optimization, with many coupled variables, is solved using a graph neural network (GNN) that learns the sub-optimal beamforming, polarization, and power-splitting variables. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed GNN-based dynamic polarforming optimization significantly outperforms fixed-polarization schemes, particularly under imperfect channel state information (CSI). Moreover, joint polarforming and GNN-based optimization maintain robust SWIPT performance under both polarization mismatch and imperfect CSI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向物联网的同时无线信息与能量传输（SWIPT）系统，引入动态极化控制和图神经网络（GNN）联合优化，以提升在极化失配和信道状态信息（CSI）不完美条件下的通信与能量传输性能。
AI.motivation: SWIPT是物联网中支持无线设备持续运行的重要技术，但现有方案通常采用固定天线极化，容易受到极化失配和不完美CSI影响，导致信息解码与能量采集性能下降。此外，联合优化波束成形、极化参数和功率分割变量会形成高度耦合的非凸优化问题，传统方法求解复杂度较高。因此，论文旨在利用动态极化控制增加系统自由度，并设计高效的数据驱动优化方法。
AI.method: 系统允许基站和用户动态调整天线极化，即采用极化成形（polarforming）；用户设备通过功率分割同时执行信息解码（ID）和能量采集（EH）。针对波束成形、极化控制及功率分割变量构成的耦合非凸优化问题，论文采用图神经网络学习次优决策变量，从而实现联合优化。性能评估通过仿真进行，并重点考察固定极化与动态极化、理想与不完美CSI以及存在极化失配时的系统表现。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，基于GNN的动态极化成形优化方案整体显著优于固定极化方案，尤其是在CSI不完美时优势更加明显。联合极化成形与GNN优化能够在极化失配和不完美CSI两类不利条件下保持较稳健的SWIPT性能。摘要未给出具体的数值增益、数据集规模或计算复杂度指标。
AI.conclusion: 动态极化控制可以作为SWIPT系统的重要额外自由度，与GNN驱动的联合优化结合后，能够有效缓解极化失配和CSI不完美带来的性能损失，并提升信息传输与能量采集的鲁棒性。该方法适合复杂、变量高度耦合的物联网无线网络，但其实际泛化能力、训练开销、理论最优性及硬件实现成本仍需进一步验证。

title: CVSS-X: A Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation Corpus for 28 Languages
summary: We introduce CVSS-X, a large-scale synthetic speech-to-speech translation corpus that extends CVSS by reversing the translation direction. While CVSS translates from 21 languages into English, CVSS-X enables translation from English into 28 target languages spanning 12 language families. The corpus comprises approximately 240,000 parallel speech pairs per language, totaling over 16,000 hours, eight times larger than CVSS. We provide two variants: CVSS-X-C with two canonical voices per language, and CVSS-X-T with cross-lingual voice cloning, both fully generated. Evaluation shows comparable translation quality to CVSS with consistent performance across typologically diverse languages. Combined with CVSS, this enables research on bidirectional and multilingual speech-to-speech translation. The code is available at https://github.com/ErmisAI/XVSS-X and the dataset under CC-BY-NC 4.0 license at https://huggingface.co/datasets/lgris/XVSS-X.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CVSS-X，一个大规模合成语音到语音翻译语料库，将 CVSS 的英语输出方向扩展为英语到 28 种目标语言，并提供标准语音与跨语言语音克隆两个版本。数据集约含 16,000 小时语音、每种语言约 240,000 个平行语音对；实验表明其翻译质量与 CVSS 相当，且在不同类型语言间表现稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有 CVSS 主要支持从 21 种语言翻译到英语，限制了英语作为源语言的语音到语音翻译研究，也不利于开展双向、多语言及跨语言语音克隆研究。因此，论文旨在构建一个规模更大、覆盖语言更多、方向相反且可与 CVSS 配合使用的合成语音语料库。
AI.method: 作者构建 CVSS-X，将英语语音翻译为 28 种目标语言，覆盖 12 个语系。数据全部通过合成方式生成，每种语言约包含 240,000 个平行语音对，总规模超过 16,000 小时。论文提供两个版本：CVSS-X-C，为每种语言使用两个规范化说话人声音；CVSS-X-T，采用跨语言语音克隆以保持源说话人的声音特征。随后通过语音到语音翻译系统进行评测，并将结果与 CVSS 进行比较。
AI.result: CVSS-X 的翻译质量与 CVSS 总体相当，在语言类型差异较大的多种语言之间表现较为稳定。数据规模约为 CVSS 的 8 倍，并通过两个版本支持规范语音和跨语言说话人声音保持等研究设定。
AI.conclusion: CVSS-X 补充了 CVSS 的反向翻译方向，形成从英语到多语言的、大规模合成语音到语音翻译资源。结合 CVSS 后，该资源能够支持双向翻译、多语言建模以及跨语言语音克隆研究。代码和数据集已公开，但数据集采用 CC-BY-NC 4.0 许可，商业使用受到限制。

title: TimeThink: Eliciting Compositional Reasoning in Timeseries Large Language Models
summary: Timeseries multimodal large language models (TS-MLLMs) have recently begun leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) for question-answering tasks. However, these models often fail to capture dynamic temporal patterns, providing only implicit reasoning that lacks the underlying explanations critical for high-stakes applications like healthcare. While reinforcement learning (RL)-based timeseries language models aim to address this, they often fall short because they are trained on narrow, in-distribution data and struggle with out-of-distribution compositional questions. To address these challenges, we present TimeThink, a synthetic framework for eliciting compositional timeseries reasoning. Core timeseries primitives (e.g., trend, seasonality) are domain-independent and can be deterministically generated. Guided by this premise, TimeThink first designs a synthetic data generator that produces atomic and composite question-answer pairs, providing objective ground truth with reasoning traces. Building on this framework, TimeThink employs a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) training strategy that encourages explicit reasoning. Unlike template-reliant methods, this approach enables the model to learn the underlying logic of composition rather than simply imitating traces. Extensive experiments show that TimeThink, trained only on synthetic data, significantly outperforms strong baselines on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TimeThink：一个通过合成时间序列数据与带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练，提升时间序列多模态大语言模型组合式推理能力的方法。该方法仅使用合成数据训练，却在合成和真实世界基准上显著优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列多模态大语言模型虽然能够利用大语言模型进行问答，但难以捕捉动态时间模式，推理过程通常是隐式的，缺乏医疗等高风险场景所需的可解释依据。基于强化学习的方法又往往依赖狭窄的分布内数据，在面对分布外的组合式问题时泛化能力不足。因此，论文旨在构建可控、可验证且能够学习时间序列组合逻辑的训练框架。
AI.method: TimeThink首先利用时间序列的领域无关基本原语（如趋势、季节性）可被确定性生成这一特点，设计合成数据生成器，生成原子问题和复合问题，并提供客观答案及推理轨迹。随后采用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行训练，通过可验证结果鼓励模型进行显式推理。与依赖固定模板并模仿推理轨迹的方法不同，TimeThink旨在让模型学习不同时间序列原语之间的组合逻辑。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅使用合成数据训练的 TimeThink 在合成数据集和真实世界基准上均显著超过强基线，说明该方法能够有效提升时间序列推理能力，并具备较好的跨分布组合式问题泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TimeThink证明了合成时间序列推理数据结合RLVR可以有效训练TS-MLLM，使其从隐式回答转向具有明确推理过程的组合式推理。该框架减少了对人工标注和模板化轨迹的依赖，为时间序列模型在需要可解释性的应用中的发展提供了可行方向。

title: Occlusal Geometry in Closed Form for Orthodontic Report Generation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Third-place system in the ODIN 2026 Bite2Text test phase. Code and data processing resources: https://github.com/GIND123/ODIN_toothfairy4
summary: Orthodontic report generation from intraoral data is normally cast as multimodal captioning, yet the released Bite2Text scan pairs are supplied already registered in occlusion, which makes several core occlusal quantities directly measurable rather than inferable. The system reported here exploits that property: an anatomical frame is recovered per case from arch taper and arch closure instead of the stated RAS convention, which does not hold across the release, and each arch is reduced to an occlusal ridge profile in arch-angle coordinates yielding overbite, overjet, midline deviation, transverse overlap, crossbite extent, cusp interdigitation lag, and the occlusal curves in closed form. Gradient boosting maps 31 such measurements onto 13 template fields, a field being predicted only where patient-level cross-validation beats its own majority baseline, and a deterministic renderer emits the corpus six-part narrative; a ConvNeXt-Tiny classifier over the five standardised photographic views is fused per field, raising mean field accuracy from 0.601 to 0.683. Reimplementation of the challenge evaluator shows that its BLEU-4 and METEOR are local variants whose F-mean weights recall nine to one, that two clinicians agree on 47 percent of findings for the same patient, and that a constant report consequently outscores a genuine second clinician report by 0.165 captioning. Held-out scores reach BLEU-4 0.458 and METEOR 0.677 against intraoral scan references and 0.278 and 0.507 against photograph references, and the submitted system placed third in the ODIN 2026 Bite2Text test phase at 0.2680 and 0.4629, within 0.022 BLEU-4 of first, running on CPU in under ten seconds per case. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/GIND123/ODIN_toothfairy4

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向已完成咬合配准的口内扫描与口腔照片的正畸报告生成系统：先从扫描数据直接计算咬合测量值，再用梯度提升模型预测模板字段，并结合照片分类器进行字段级融合，最后通过确定性渲染生成六部分报告。系统在扫描参考上取得BLEU-4 0.458、METEOR 0.677，在照片参考上取得0.278和0.507，并在ODIN 2026 Bite2Text测试阶段排名第三。
AI.motivation: 现有正畸报告生成通常被建模为多模态图像描述任务，但Bite2Text数据中的扫描样本已在咬合状态下完成配准，因此许多关键咬合指标可以直接测量，而无需通过神经网络从数据中推断。此外，原始RAS坐标约定在该数据发布中并不稳定，且评测指标与临床观察者之间存在一致性问题，需要构建更具几何解释性、可复现性和评测透明度的方法。
AI.method: 方法包括：1）根据牙弓收缩/扩张趋势与牙弓闭合关系，为每个病例恢复解剖坐标系，而不是直接采用RAS约定；2）将上下牙弓表示为咬合脊线，并在牙弓角度坐标中计算覆牙合、覆盖、正中线偏移、横向覆盖、反牙合范围、牙尖交错滞后及咬合曲线等指标；3）使用31个几何测量值，通过梯度提升模型预测13个报告模板字段，仅保留在患者级交叉验证中优于该字段多数类基线的预测任务；4）使用ConvNeXt-Tiny处理五个标准化口腔照片视图，并按字段与扫描预测融合；5）利用确定性渲染器生成数据集规定的六部分叙述报告；6）复现挑战评测器，分析其BLEU-4、METEOR及一致性表现。
AI.result: 加入照片分类器后，平均字段准确率由0.601提升至0.683。扫描参考上的留出测试结果为BLEU-4 0.458、METEOR 0.677；照片参考上为0.278和0.507。系统在ODIN 2026 Bite2Text测试阶段得分为0.2680和0.4629，排名第三，与第一名的BLEU-4差距不超过0.022；单病例在CPU上运行时间低于10秒。评测分析发现，挑战指标为局部变体，且F均值中召回率权重为精确率的9倍；同一患者的两名临床医生在47%的发现上达成一致，导致恒定报告的自动评分反而比另一名真实临床医生报告高0.165。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，对于已完成咬合配准的口内扫描，将可解释的几何测量作为报告生成基础，比把任务完全视为自由形式多模态描述更合理。扫描几何与照片分类的字段级融合能够提升预测性能，同时保持较低计算成本和较强可复现性。不过，较低的临床观察者一致性以及偏重召回率的自动指标说明，当前评测分数不能完全代表临床报告质量，未来需要更可靠的临床一致性评价和更合理的语义评测。

title: Beam Squint and Aperture--Bandwidth Limitations in Wideband RIS-Assisted THz Links
comment: Accepted for 4th International Conference on Internet of Things and Cloud Computing Technology (IoTCCT 2026)
summary: This paper analyzes the ergodic rate of a wideband reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted terahertz link under beam squint and finite-resolution phase control. Independent Rayleigh fading on the two RIS-assisted hops produces double-Rayleigh cascaded amplitudes. Exact second- and fourth-order channel moments are derived by incorporating the frequency-dependent array response and phase-quantization errors. Moment matching then provides a Gamma approximation for the received power on each subcarrier and a tractable closed-form approximation for the wideband ergodic rate. A first-null bandwidth approximation characterizes the aperture--bandwidth limitation of frequency-flat RIS control. Monte Carlo simulations validate the analytical framework.

AI.tldr: 本文研究宽带可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助太赫兹链路在波束偏斜和有限分辨率相位控制下的遍历速率，并提出基于信道高阶矩与Gamma近似的可计算分析框架。
AI.motivation: 宽带太赫兹RIS系统同时受到波束偏斜、RIS孔径带宽限制以及有限精度相位控制的影响；双RIS级联信道还呈现双重Rayleigh衰落，使遍历速率分析较为困难。因此，有必要建立能够综合刻画频率相关阵列响应和相位量化误差的准确且 tractable 的性能分析方法。
AI.method: 首先，在两个RIS辅助跳段独立Rayleigh衰落的条件下，推导包含频率相关阵列响应和相位量化误差的级联信道二阶矩与四阶矩。随后，利用矩匹配方法，将每个子载波上的接收功率近似为Gamma分布，并据此得到宽带遍历速率的封闭形式近似。同时，通过第一零点带宽近似刻画频率平坦RIS控制下的孔径—带宽限制。
AI.result: 所提出的分析框架能够获得宽带遍历速率的 tractable 近似，并同时反映波束偏斜、有限分辨率相位控制和双重Rayleigh级联衰落的影响。蒙特卡洛仿真结果验证了理论分析的有效性。摘要未给出具体数值增益或误差范围。
AI.conclusion: 高阶矩推导结合Gamma矩匹配可以有效分析受波束偏斜和相位量化影响的宽带RIS太赫兹链路；第一零点带宽近似则为评估频率平坦RIS控制的有效带宽提供了简洁工具。该方法在保持分析可处理性的同时，能够较准确地预测宽带遍历速率。

title: Causal Analysis and Mitigation of Spurious Onsets in Full-Duplex Speech LLMs
summary: Speech-to-speech LLMs like Moshi, and its derivative PersonaPlex, can listen and speak concurrently through full-duplex generation. However, they can begin speaking inappropriately during prolonged user silence: under digital-zero input, Moshi and PersonaPlex initiate speech in 12/40 and 11/40 five-minute continuations, respectively. What causes this spurious speech? We investigate two hypotheses: either repeated sampling selects speech despite persistently low onset probabilities, or conditioning on the model's nonspeech outputs causes an abrupt spike in onset probability. We find that, at every observed onset, speech probability spikes by over nine orders of magnitude in one 80-ms frame, supporting the latter hypothesis. Then, to suppress these onsets without blocking genuine responses, we ask a causal counterfactual question: is the model responding to user speech, or would its next-token distribution remain similar if the preceding user input were muted? Accordingly, we suppress onsets whose distributions change little under this intervention. Across 40 held-out trials per model with realistic microphone noise, our method suppresses 13/13 Moshi and 9/9 PersonaPlex spurious onsets, while preserving 40/40 genuine responses per model. Our inference-time method requires no retraining and runs in real-time, with 95th-percentile decision time below 61 ms, within the 80-ms frame budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/KentoNishi/icassp27-spurious-onsets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全双工语音到语音大模型在用户长时间静默时错误启动语音的问题，并提出一种基于因果反事实干预的实时抑制方法。该方法判断模型的输出分布是否真正依赖用户语音，在不重新训练的情况下有效抑制虚假语音启动，同时保留真实响应。
AI.motivation: Moshi 和 PersonaPlex 等全双工语音到语音大模型能够边听边说，但在用户持续静默时可能无故开始说话，影响交互自然性与系统可靠性。论文旨在解释这种虚假启动的成因，并设计一种不会阻断真实响应、无需重新训练且能实时运行的抑制机制。
AI.method: 作者考察两种假设：一是长期低语音起始概率下的重复采样最终选中了语音；二是模型先前生成的非语音输出导致语音起始概率突然跃升。通过逐帧分析发现，每次启动时语音概率会在一个 80 毫秒帧内跃升超过九个数量级，支持第二种假设。随后提出因果反事实判别：比较正常输入与将前序用户输入静音后的下一词分布；若两者变化很小，说明模型并非真正响应用户语音，则抑制该次启动。该方法在推理时执行，无需训练，并满足实时延迟要求。
AI.result: 在每个模型 40 次留出试验、包含真实麦克风噪声的条件下，方法抑制了 Moshi 的 13/13 次虚假启动和 PersonaPlex 的 9/9 次虚假启动，同时保留了两个模型各自 40/40 次真实响应。第 95 百分位决策时间低于 61 毫秒，处于 80 毫秒帧预算内。
AI.conclusion: 虚假语音启动主要源于模型在生成非语音输出后，语音起始概率发生突发性跃升，而不是低概率下的重复采样。基于静音干预的因果反事实检测能够精准区分由用户语音驱动的真实响应与无依据的启动，并以较低延迟实时抑制前者之外的虚假语音。

title: Root-Cause Attribution Is a Search Problem: Continual Search for Long-Horizon Agent Failures
summary: The increasing deployment of AI agents in long-horizon tasks yields massive execution logs. Diagnosing failures within these records is crucial for reliability, as it transforms outcome-level signals into actionable interventions. The sheer scale of the data renders human review impractical, driving the need for automated root-cause attribution (RCA). However, automated RCA methods using LLMs suffer from low diagnostic accuracy, especially as execution traces grow larger. They struggle because relevant information is often sparse, distributed across distant actions, and disconnected from the visible failure, reducing root-cause attribution to a massive search problem. Existing RCA methods typically rely on one-shot LLM judgments to diagnose failures from execution traces. While effective for shorter trajectories, these judges tend to settle on a plausible diagnosis early, leaving critical evidence in longer traces unexamined. We introduce Continual Search, an iterative framework that nudges the judge, over successive turns, to keep searching for unresolved diagnostic evidence. We evaluate Continual Search across four existing RCA benchmarks. Recognizing the lack of massive execution traces in current benchmarks, we introduce MegaRCA-Mix to evaluate RCA at scale. MegaRCA-Mix provides a challenging testbed of 50 human-annotated failure trials spanning long-horizon, execution-heavy tasks. Across multiple benchmark suites and model families, Continual Search consistently improves attribution performance. On MegaRCA-Mix, for example, it improves GPT-5.5's F1 score by more than 40\%, from $0.349$ to $0.498$. More interestingly, within the same model family, lower-tier models can even surpass their higher-tier counterparts, demonstrating that effective search supersedes raw model scale.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Continual Search，一种通过多轮迭代搜索未解决证据来提升长轨迹 AI agent 执行日志根因分析（RCA）准确率的方法，并构建 MegaRCA-Mix 长轨迹基准。实验表明，该方法在多个基准和模型上稳定提升归因性能；在 MegaRCA-Mix 上，GPT-5.5 的 F1 从 0.349 提升至 0.498，增幅超过 40%，且较小模型在有效搜索机制下可超过同系列更大模型。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI agent 执行长周期任务，执行日志规模快速增长，人工排查失败根因变得不可行。现有基于 LLM 的自动化 RCA 在长轨迹上准确率下降，主要因为关键信息稀疏、分散在远距离动作中，并且可能与表面可见的失败现象脱节。传统方法通常依赖一次性判断，容易过早接受合理但不完整的诊断，忽略后续或远处的关键证据。因此，论文旨在设计一种能够持续搜索和验证诊断证据的 RCA 框架。
AI.method: 提出 Continual Search 迭代框架，通过连续多轮交互引导 LLM judge 持续检查尚未解决的诊断证据，而不是在首次生成一个看似合理的根因后立即停止。论文同时引入 MegaRCA-Mix，这是一个包含 50 个由人工标注的失败试验、面向长周期且执行密集型任务的 RCA 测试集，用于弥补现有基准缺少大规模执行轨迹的问题。方法在四个现有 RCA 基准及 MegaRCA-Mix 上，结合多个模型家族进行评估。
AI.result: Continual Search 在多个基准套件和模型家族上都稳定提升根因归因性能。在 MegaRCA-Mix 上，GPT-5.5 的 F1 从 0.349 提升到 0.498，提升超过 40%。更值得注意的是，在同一模型家族内，较低级别模型结合有效的持续搜索策略后，甚至能够超过更高级别模型，说明搜索过程对性能的贡献可能超过单纯扩大模型规模。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，长轨迹 RCA 的关键瓶颈不仅是模型能力不足，更是诊断过程中的搜索不充分和过早收敛。通过持续搜索未检查证据，Continual Search 能显著增强 LLM 对分散根因的发现与归因能力。结果支持一个重要结论：在复杂 agent 日志分析中，合理的推理与证据搜索机制可能比单纯使用更大模型更有效。不过，摘要未说明额外推理成本、迭代轮数敏感性、标注一致性以及在更广泛任务分布上的泛化能力，这些仍是评估该方法实际部署价值的重要因素。

title: Abstract-LoRA: Unlocking Single-Image Style Transfer through Targeted U-Net Block Training
summary: Diffusion models represent one of the most advanced paradigms in generative modeling. Leveraging their development, a growing number of style transfer methods based on diffusion models have been proposed. However, among these methods, multi-image style transfer approaches that require at least five to ten style examples tend to achieve more satisfactory results. Single-image methods, by contrast, often struggle with either insufficient content preservation or inadequate style fidelity. This greatly limits style extraction from scarce artworks and undermines their artistic value. To address this, we propose Abstract-LoRA, a method that pushes the boundaries of single-image style transfer through lightweight LoRA training on specific U-Net blocks in diffusion models. Specifically, our work is inspired by B-LoRA, a style transfer method that achieves basic style-content disentanglement by training specific U-Net blocks. However, it suffers from a critical limitation: the inability to capture complex backgrounds. Building upon B-LoRA, our method conducts a more refined analysis of U-Net blocks, employing additional U-Net blocks and clustering-based abstraction of style images to better disentangle and balance style and content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method not only generates visually more harmonious and satisfying artistic images but also quantitatively improves the preservation of both style and content in the final outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Abstract-LoRA，一种面向单幅风格图像的扩散模型风格迁移方法。该方法基于 B-LoRA，在特定 U-Net 模块上进行轻量级 LoRA 训练，并引入更多 U-Net 模块及基于聚类的风格图像抽象，以改善复杂背景建模以及风格与内容的解耦。实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、风格保持和内容保持方面均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型风格迁移方法中，多图风格迁移通常需要至少 5—10 张风格示例才能获得较好效果，而单图方法容易在内容保持与风格保真之间失衡：要么破坏原始内容结构，要么无法充分提取艺术风格。这限制了从稀缺艺术作品中学习风格。尤其是 B-LoRA 虽能通过训练特定 U-Net 模块实现初步的风格—内容解耦，但难以捕获复杂背景，因此需要更精细的模块选择与风格表示机制。
AI.method: 提出 Abstract-LoRA。方法以 B-LoRA 为基础，在扩散模型 U-Net 的特定模块上进行轻量级 LoRA 微调；相较于 B-LoRA，进一步分析并使用额外的 U-Net 模块，以增强复杂背景和风格特征的建模能力。同时，对风格图像进行基于聚类的抽象，从而获得更稳健的风格表示，并改善风格与内容之间的解耦和平衡。
