AI.result: 大量实验显示，Abstract-LoRA 能生成视觉上更协调、更具艺术表现力的结果。在定量评价方面，该方法同时提升了输出图像的风格保持能力和内容保持能力，说明其较好地缓解了单图风格迁移中的风格—内容冲突。
AI.conclusion: 通过对 U-Net 模块进行更细致的选择，并结合聚类式风格抽象，Abstract-LoRA 扩展了单图扩散模型风格迁移的能力。该方法在无需大量风格示例的情况下，能够更有效地捕获复杂艺术风格，同时保留输入内容，为稀缺艺术作品驱动的风格提取与迁移提供了轻量且有效的方案。

title: Successive Refinement Under Strong-Sense Perfect Perception
comment: Extended version of the ICASSP 2027 submission, including complete proofs
summary: We revisit a multiterminal lossy source coding problem named successive refinement and derive the rate-distortion-perception region under the strong-sense perfect perception constraint in the presence of unlimited common randomness. Specifically, in successive refinement, one aims to compress a source sequence and allows two distinct decoders to recover the source sequence at different distortion levels. By imposing the strong-sense perfect perception constraint, our results refine the previous result by analyzing the impact of the perceptual quality. Our achievability proof is inspired by output constrained lossy source coding and our converse proof adapts the proof steps of the standard successive refinement problem. Furthermore, we provide a numerical example of the Bernoulli source to illustrate our result and show that the Bernoulli source under Hamming distortion is successively refinable even with the strong-sense perfect perception constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带有强意义完美感知约束和无限公共随机性的连续可细化有损源编码问题，推导其率–失真–感知区域，并以伯努利源为例说明在汉明失真下仍可连续可细化。
AI.motivation: 传统连续可细化源编码主要关注不同解码器的失真性能，而较少刻画重构序列与原始源序列在分布层面的感知质量。本文旨在分析强意义完美感知约束对率–失真性能及连续可细化性质的影响，从而完善已有理论结果。
AI.method: 针对带有无限公共随机性的连续可细化有损源编码模型，推导满足强意义完美感知约束的率–失真–感知区域。可达性证明借鉴输出约束有损源编码方法；反向证明则基于标准连续可细化问题的证明步骤进行调整，以纳入感知约束的影响。
AI.result: 建立了该问题的率–失真–感知区域刻画，并通过伯努利源的数值算例展示具体性能。结果表明，伯努利源在汉明失真度量下，即使施加强意义完美感知约束，仍具有连续可细化性。
AI.conclusion: 强意义完美感知约束会细化连续可细化问题的理论区域，但并不必然破坏连续可细化性质。对于伯努利源与汉明失真这一典型情形，系统仍可在不同失真层级上实现连续可细化。

title: Hindsight Bias in Clinical Temporal Reasoning: How Future Data Exposure Affects Large Language Model Judgment
summary: Clinical decisions are prospective, but clinical language models are often evaluated on retrospective records that reveal the final diagnosis, treatment response, and outcome. Such evaluations may reward the use of future information rather than reasoning under the uncertainty present at the decision point. We introduce a paired benchmark for measuring outcome-conditioned shifts consistent with hindsight bias in clinical temporal reasoning. It contains 171 case reports from the PubMed Central Open Access Subset---40 sepsis and 131 GLP-1/diabetes cases---represented as both textual narratives and human-annotated and LLM-generated textual time series (TTS). For each case, questions are tied to a clinically meaningful cutoff and paired with a prospective reference answer and an outcome-consistent \emph{hindsight trap}. Models answer each question using either a TTS truncated at the cutoff or the complete timeline; additional conditions vary the narrative source (original or synthetic) and TTS annotation source (human or LLM). We evaluate accuracy (Acc), hindsight trap rate (HTR), answer instability rate (AIR), and hindsight bias rate (HBR), each of which captures different signals of hindsight bias. Across GPT 5.6 Sol, Gemma 4, GLM 5.2, and Opus 5, full timeline exposure produces consistent hindsight-sensitive shifts, while temporal masking reduces bias without lowering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于评估临床语言模型时间推理中回顾偏差的配对基准，并发现完整时间线会诱发与结局一致的后见之明偏移，而在决策截点进行时间遮蔽可降低偏差且不损害准确率。
AI.motivation: 临床决策是在信息不完整、结果尚未知的前瞻性条件下作出的，但现有临床语言模型评估通常使用包含最终诊断、治疗反应和结局的回顾性病历。这可能使模型利用未来信息，导致评估结果偏高，并掩盖其在真实决策时点进行不确定性推理的能力。因此，研究需要一个能够系统测量后见之明偏差及其来源的基准。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个配对式基准，包含PubMed Central开放获取子集中的171份病例报告，其中40例为脓毒症病例，131例为GLP-1/糖尿病病例。每个病例同时表示为原始文本叙事，以及由人工标注或大语言模型生成的文本时间序列（TTS）。研究将问题绑定到具有临床意义的时间截点，并为每个问题设置前瞻性参考答案和与最终结局一致的“后见之明陷阱”答案。模型分别在截断至决策截点的TTS和完整时间线条件下作答，同时改变叙事来源（原始或合成）与TTS标注来源（人工或LLM）。评价指标包括准确率（Acc）、后见之明陷阱率（HTR）、答案不稳定率（AIR）和后见之明偏差率（HBR）。
AI.result: 在GPT 5.6 Sol、Gemma 4、GLM 5.2和Opus 5上，暴露于完整时间线均产生一致的、对后见之明敏感的答案变化，表明模型会受到未来结局信息影响。将输入时间线遮蔽至临床决策截点后，后见之明偏差下降，同时准确率没有降低。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，临床语言模型在使用完整回顾性记录时可能表现出系统性后见之明偏差。基于临床时间截点的时间遮蔽是一种有效的评估和缓解方法，可在保持任务准确率的同时，更真实地衡量模型在结果未知条件下的临床时间推理能力。

title: Governing at Machine Speed: An Adaptive Intelligence Architecture for Real-Time AI Policy Enforcement
summary: Enterprise AI adoption has reached 78% of organizations globally, yet the infrastructure to govern that adoption has not kept pace. This paper identifies and characterizes the attestation deficit, a structural condition in which organizations maintain governance policies but cannot produce auditable, tamper-evident evidence of enforcement within regulatory timelines. Drawing on empirical data from the Stanford 2026 AI Index Report (362 documented incidents), the IBM/Ponemon 2026 Cost of a Data Breach study (USD 4.99M average cost, 92% lacking access controls), and the EY/AIUC-1 Consortium survey (38% end-to-end monitoring, 17% agent-to-agent coverage), this paper demonstrates that the governance failure is organizational and architectural rather than technical. To address this deficit, we propose AGIL (Adaptive Governance Intelligence Layer), a conceptual five-layer architecture designed to use machine learning for real-time AI governance enforcement. The proposed layers include: (1) Autonomous Discovery for shadow AI detection via behavioral fingerprinting, (2) Behavioral Risk Classification unifying security, hallucination, privacy, and accountability scoring, (3) a Policy Enforcement Gateway for inline permit/deny/modify decisions at sub-100ms latency, (4) a Continuous Attestation Engine generating tamper-evident audit trails as a byproduct of enforcement, and (5) Adaptive Policy Intelligence for ML-driven policy evolution across jurisdictions. AGIL is presented as a theoretical framework and architectural proposal; empirical validation through controlled deployment remains a direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGIL（自适应治理智能层）这一五层概念架构，旨在解决企业AI治理中的“证明缺口”：组织虽有治理政策，却无法在监管期限内提供可审计、防篡改且能证明政策实际执行的证据。该框架通过发现、风险分类、策略执行、持续证明和策略自适应，尝试将治理执行与审计证据生成整合起来，但目前仍属于理论与架构提案，缺乏受控部署下的实证验证。
AI.motivation: 企业AI采用率快速提升，但治理基础设施未同步发展。论文关注的核心问题不是治理政策是否存在，而是组织能否证明这些政策被持续、有效且可审计地执行，即所谓“attestation deficit（证明缺口）”。摘要引用多项行业数据，指出端到端监控、访问控制和代理间覆盖不足，因此认为治理失效主要源于组织与架构问题，而非单纯技术能力不足。
AI.method: 论文基于多来源行业与事件数据进行问题刻画，包括Stanford 2026 AI Index Report记录的362起事件、IBM/Ponemon 2026数据泄露成本研究，以及EY/AIUC-1 Consortium调查。在此基础上提出AGIL五层概念架构：1）通过行为指纹识别影子AI的自主发现层；2）统一安全、幻觉、隐私和问责评分的行为风险分类层；3）支持实时允许、拒绝或修改决策的策略执行网关；4）在执行过程中生成防篡改审计轨迹的持续证明引擎；5）利用机器学习跨司法辖区演化治理策略的自适应策略智能层。
AI.result: 论文的主要产出是对“证明缺口”的概念化、结构性刻画，以及AGIL架构的提出。摘要声称该架构目标是在低于100毫秒的延迟下执行内联治理决策，并将审计证据作为治理执行的副产品持续生成。但这些性能目标、检测效果、风险评分准确性和跨辖区适应能力尚未通过受控部署验证，因此目前不能视为经过实证证实的结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为企业AI治理需要从静态政策管理转向可执行、可观测、可证明的持续治理体系。AGIL提供了一个将影子AI发现、风险评估、实时策略执行和审计证明统一起来的架构方向。不过，论文的结论主要是概念性和规范性的，后续需要通过真实环境或受控实验验证其安全性、延迟、可扩展性、误报率、审计有效性及跨法域策略迁移能力。

title: ArtSociety: Multi-Agent Multimodal Collaboration for Art Emotion Understanding
comment: Accepted at the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge (AffectiveArt). 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/swordlidev/ArtSociety
summary: The AffectiveArt Multidimensional Art Emotion Understanding task asks to jointly predict an artwork's fine-grained emotion (12 classes, 1549:1 head-to-tail ratio), binary valence/arousal, and five attribute-grounded descriptions -- sub-tasks that exhibit strong empirical trade-offs, so the single-model solutions we tried do not jointly optimize all of them well. We present ArtSociety, a multi-agent framework that assembles heterogeneous multimodal experts -- a DINOv2-Giant vision agent (A1), a scene-grounded CoT fine-tuned MLLM (A2), and three closed-source reasoning agents (A3-A5) -- and coordinates them with two training-free controllers: (i) a rare-class-aware voting arbiter that lowers the agreement threshold for tail emotions, exploiting decorrelated error patterns across agent families; and (ii) a description-first reasoning agent whose DESCRIBE-then-CLASSIFY chain of thought forces visual evidence before label commitment, yielding near-perfect grounded descriptions. A task-routing policy directs the hard emotion task to the full five-agent ensemble while assigning the near-saturated valence/arousal and generative description tasks to the single strongest reasoning agent. On the official test set (1,000 artworks), ArtSociety achieves an Overall Score of 0.8870 (Classification 0.7789, Description 0.9952). An eleven-variant ablation study reveals that, once method and scale saturate at around 0.76, the decisive gains come from agent collaboration and data-side supervision -- a 30B MoE model trained on older data does not outperform an 8B model trained on better data. Code is available at https://github.com/swordlidev/ArtSociety

AI.tldr: ArtSociety 是一个面向多维艺术情感理解的多智能体、多模态框架，通过异构视觉/推理专家协作、稀有类别感知投票、描述优先推理和任务路由，联合提升细粒度情感分类、效价/唤醒度预测及属性描述生成；在官方测试集上取得 0.8870 的总体得分。
AI.motivation: AffectiveArt 任务同时要求细粒度艺术情感分类、二元效价/唤醒度预测和五类属性描述生成。这些子任务之间存在明显的经验性权衡，且情感类别极度长尾（头尾类别比例为 1549:1），导致单一模型难以兼顾分类性能、稀有类别识别和描述质量。因此，论文旨在利用不同模型的互补能力与去相关错误模式，构建能够按任务特性进行协作的多智能体系统。
AI.method: ArtSociety 组装异构多模态专家：DINOv2-Giant 视觉智能体（A1）、经过场景 grounding 与思维链微调的多模态大语言模型（A2），以及三个闭源推理智能体（A3-A5）。系统包含两个无需额外训练的控制器：1）稀有类别感知投票仲裁器，针对尾部情感类别降低一致性阈值，以缓解类别不平衡并利用不同智能体族群的互补错误；2）描述优先推理智能体，采用“先描述、后分类”的链式流程，要求模型先提供视觉证据，再确定情感标签。另设计任务路由策略：将困难的情感分类交给五智能体集成，而将已接近饱和的效价/唤醒度预测和描述生成交给单个最强推理智能体。
AI.result: 在包含 1,000 件艺术作品的官方测试集上，ArtSociety 获得 0.8870 的 Overall Score，其中 Classification 为 0.7789，Description 为 0.9952。11 个变体的消融实验表明，当方法与模型规模带来的性能约在 0.76 左右趋于饱和后，主要增益来自智能体协作和数据侧监督。具体而言，使用旧数据训练的 30B MoE 模型并未超过使用更优数据训练的 8B 模型，说明数据质量和协作机制可能比单纯扩大参数规模更关键。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，多维艺术情感理解不宜依赖单一模型进行统一优化；通过异构专家协作、长尾感知决策、描述优先推理和任务级路由，可以有效处理不同子任务之间的性能冲突，并显著提升整体表现。实验还强调了高质量训练数据与有效协作机制的重要性。不过，从摘要看，分类得分仍明显低于描述得分，细粒度、长尾情感识别仍是系统的主要瓶颈。

title: Dependency, Compression, and Synergy: A Unified Information-Theoretic View of Multimodal Learning
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have intensified the need to understand how different modalities share, preserve, and complement information. Mutual Information (MI), the Information Bottleneck (IB), and Partial Information Decomposition (PID) provide complementary perspectives, yet existing studies often treat them as isolated tools. This survey presents an information-theoretic perspective connecting these principles as progressively refined views of multimodal information processing: MI characterizes inter-modal dependency, IB explains task-oriented information preservation under compression, and PID decomposes preserved information into redundancy, uniqueness, and synergy. We review 170 recent studies (2018--2026) and 12 foundational works, organizing multimodal learning around four challenges: cross-modal alignment, information-efficient fusion, interaction-type characterization, and scaling to multimodal foundation models. Rather than using application domains as primary taxonomy axes, we interpret healthcare, robotics, recommendation systems, affective computing, and wireless communications as empirical validations of these information principles. Beyond taxonomy, we organize existing multimodal paradigms within a single information-theoretic coordinate system -- the Generalized Multimodal Information Lagrangian -- in which they occupy exact or approximate parameter corners, and whose unoccupied regions name candidate method families the literature has not yet built. We further discuss how emerging multimodal foundation models instantiate these principles at scale and identify open challenges including scalable information estimation in high-dimensional settings, standardized evaluation across information-theoretic methods, combinatorial complexity of multimodal PID, and the transition from post-hoc information analysis toward information-aware multimodal learning.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，试图用统一的信息论框架串联互信息（MI）、信息瓶颈（IB）与部分信息分解（PID），系统分析多模态学习中的依赖、压缩保真、冗余/独特/协同信息及其在多模态基础模型中的扩展。文章综述2018—2026年170篇研究和12篇奠基性工作，并提出“广义多模态信息拉格朗日”坐标系，用于统一定位现有方法并发现潜在的未探索方法空间。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型快速发展，使得理解不同模态如何共享、保留和互补信息成为关键问题。现有研究通常将MI、IB和PID作为相互孤立的分析工具，缺少统一视角，也缺乏对跨模态对齐、信息高效融合、交互类型以及大规模扩展之间关系的系统梳理。因此，本文旨在建立连接三类信息论原则的统一综述框架，并解释其对多模态学习和基础模型设计的意义。
AI.method: 本文采用信息论综述与统一框架构建的方法：首先梳理2018—2026年170篇相关研究及12篇基础文献；其次将MI、IB和PID分别对应于跨模态依赖、任务导向的信息保留与压缩、以及冗余/独特/协同信息分解；随后围绕跨模态对齐、信息高效融合、交互类型刻画和多模态基础模型扩展四项挑战组织文献；最后提出“广义多模态信息拉格朗日”坐标系，将现有多模态范式映射到其中的精确或近似参数区域，并据此识别尚未充分探索的方法族。
AI.result: 综述表明，MI、IB和PID可以被视为逐步细化的多模态信息处理视角：MI描述模态间依赖，IB刻画压缩条件下与任务相关的信息保留，PID进一步区分冗余、独特和协同信息。文章将医疗、机器人、推荐、情感计算和无线通信等领域视为这些信息原则的经验验证，而非主要分类轴。统一坐标系揭示了现有方法的覆盖区域及潜在空白，并分析了多模态基础模型在大规模场景下对这些原则的实例化。
AI.conclusion: 本文认为，信息论能够为多模态学习提供跨方法、跨任务的统一分析语言，但当前仍面临高维场景下可扩展的信息估计、不同信息论方法之间缺乏标准化评测、多模态PID组合复杂度高，以及从事后信息分析转向信息感知型多模态学习等挑战。未来研究应将信息论原则进一步融入模型训练、融合机制和架构设计，而不仅限于事后解释。

title: A Hybrid Hierarchical 1D-CNN-BiLSTM Framework for Extractive Summarization of Biomedical and Clinical Text
summary: Large language models have made abstractive summarization remarkably fluent, but generated summaries can hallucinate facts, posing serious risks in biomedical and clinical domains. We address this by removing generation from the pipeline and framing summarization as extractive sentence selection. Our Hybrid Hierarchical CNN-LSTM Summarizer uses stacked multi-kernel convolutions to compose sentence-level embeddings into richer inter-sentence representations, followed by a bidirectional LSTM to model long-range dependencies across the document. A lightweight scoring head assigns per-sentence importance scores and is trained end-to-end with binary cross-entropy against oracle extractive labels. At inference, a dynamic mean-plus-standard-deviation threshold with a top-3 fallback selects sentences directly from the source and chronologically reorders them into the final summary. Since every output sentence is copied from the input, the model avoids generation-induced factual drift. On PubMed, our architecture outperforms isolated CNN and LSTM baselines, while ablations show that wider convolutional receptive fields improve sentence scoring. On MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV BHC, the model performs well on unstructured narratives but defaults toward positional baselines on highly templated reports. These results suggest that structural constraints can provide a reliable path toward factually grounded summarization systems that are trustworthy by design rather than by correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不依赖文本生成的抽取式医学摘要模型，通过分层卷积与双向LSTM进行句子重要性评分，并直接复制源文句子形成摘要，以降低事实幻觉风险。模型在PubMed上优于单独CNN和LSTM基线；在MIMIC数据集上，对非结构化叙事表现较好，但在高度模板化报告上接近位置基线。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型生成的摘要虽然流畅，但可能产生事实幻觉。在生物医学和临床场景中，这类错误具有较高风险。因此，本文希望通过移除生成环节、采用抽取式句子选择，构建天然具有事实约束的可靠摘要系统。
AI.method: 提出Hybrid Hierarchical CNN-LSTM Summarizer。模型首先使用堆叠的多核卷积，将句子级表示组合为更丰富的跨句表示；随后使用双向LSTM建模文档中的长程依赖；轻量级评分头为每个句子分配重要性分数，并利用二元交叉熵和Oracle抽取标签进行端到端训练。推理阶段采用“均值加标准差”的动态阈值选择句子，并设置Top-3回退机制，最后按原文时间顺序重排。输出句子全部直接复制自输入文本。
AI.result: 在PubMed数据集上，该模型优于独立CNN和LSTM基线。消融实验表明，更宽的卷积感受野能够改善句子重要性评分。在MIMIC-CXR和MIMIC-IV BHC数据集上，模型对非结构化叙事文本表现良好；但在高度模板化的报告中，其性能趋近于基于位置的基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构约束能够为事实一致性摘要提供可靠路径。抽取式框架通过避免新文本生成，降低了生成导致的事实漂移风险，体现出“由设计保证可信度”而非事后纠错的系统设计理念。不过，模型对模板化文本的优势有限，说明其有效性依赖于文档结构和内容组织形式。

title: OrchSLM: Probing the Dynamics of Small Language Model Orchestration
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their reliance on cloud-scale infrastructure poses fundamental challenges for deployment in agentic pipelines, including latency, privacy, connectivity, and substantial computational cost. Small language models (SLMs) offer a compelling alternative: recent studies suggest that many repetitive and narrowly scoped subtasks in agentic workloads may be better served by specialized SLMs than by monolithic LLMs. However, the limited capacity and context windows of SLMs can constrain long-horizon reasoning and interaction-heavy orchestration strategies such as iterative verification and debate. This motivates a complementary, non-interactive paradigm in which heterogeneous SLMs independently generate candidate solutions and a router orchestrates their cached samples without further model interaction. To further understand the mechanisms of such orchestration, we introduce OrchSLM, a routing framework that unifies existing non-interactive orchestration methods and exposes their underlying design choices as controllable parameters. Using OrchSLM as a systematic probe, we reveal how orchestration behavior emerges from diverse knobs, including the task structure, model-pool composition, and multi-agent consensus.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OrchSLM，一种面向智能体工作流的非交互式小语言模型编排与路由框架。多个异构 SLM 独立生成候选答案，路由器基于缓存样本进行选择或聚合，无需进一步模型交互；框架将既有非交互式编排方法统一起来，并系统分析任务结构、模型池组成和多智能体共识等因素对编排效果的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型依赖云端基础设施，在智能体流水线部署中面临高延迟、隐私风险、网络连接依赖和高计算成本。小语言模型更适合处理重复、范围明确的子任务，但其模型容量和上下文窗口有限，难以支持长程推理以及迭代验证、辩论等交互密集型编排。因此，论文旨在探索一种不依赖持续模型交互、同时能够利用多个异构小模型优势的编排范式，并进一步理解其性能形成机制。
AI.method: 提出 OrchSLM 路由框架，将现有非交互式编排方法统一到同一体系中。具体而言，多个异构 SLM 独立生成候选解，路由器对缓存的候选样本进行编排、选择或聚合，而不再触发额外的模型间交互。框架把任务结构、模型池组成以及多智能体共识等设计因素显式化为可控参数，用于系统性探测不同编排策略的行为。
AI.result: 摘要明确报告的结果是：OrchSLM 揭示了非交互式编排行为并非由单一模型能力决定，而是由任务结构、模型池构成和多智能体共识等多种可调因素共同产生。摘要未提供具体数据集、基线、性能数值或统计显著性结果。
AI.conclusion: 非交互式异构 SLM 编排为降低智能体系统对云端 LLM 的依赖提供了可行方向。通过 OrchSLM，可以统一比较不同编排方法，并分析关键设计旋钮如何影响系统行为，为低延迟、注重隐私和计算高效的智能体流水线部署提供研究基础。

title: SJD-SV: Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Semantics Verification for Autoregressive Image Generation
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Speculative Jacobi Decoding (SJD) is an important approach for accelerating autoregressive image generation. Although SJD has shown superior performance, recent studies point out that it usually suffers from a token ambiguity issue during token verification but its reason can not be well explained. To figure out this reason, in this paper, we conduct a visualization analysis on vision token and find that different from text tokens, vision tokens generally corresponds to some local, small, and unclear vision details, which means only using single token is difficult to accurately express a certain semantic, thereby causing token ambiguity issue. To this end, we propose a novel Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Semantics Verification (called SJD-SV), for accelerating autoregressive image generation. The key idea is that leveraging the strong correction characters between tokens to recognize semantic-aware token subsequence and then instead of perform token-by-token verification, turning to perform verification on semantic-aware token subsequence level for accelerating image generation. In particular, our method is plug-in, which can be directly integrated into existing SJD and its variants. Extensive experiments on various datasets show that existing SJD methods achieve significant performance improvement after integrating our SJD-SV method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SJD-SV，通过利用视觉token之间的语义关联，将逐token验证改为语义感知token子序列验证，从而缓解token歧义并加速自回归图像生成。该方法是可插拔的，可集成到现有SJD及其变体中；实验表明，集成后现有SJD方法均获得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有Speculative Jacobi Decoding（SJD）虽能加速自回归图像生成，但在token验证阶段通常存在token歧义问题，其成因尚未得到充分解释。作者通过可视化分析发现，视觉token不同于文本token，通常对应局部、细小且不清晰的视觉细节，单个token难以准确表达完整语义，因此容易产生歧义并降低验证效率。
AI.method: 提出Speculative Jacobi Decoding with Semantics Verification（SJD-SV）。核心思想是利用token之间较强的纠错关系，识别具有语义一致性的token子序列，并将传统的逐token验证改为在语义感知token子序列层面进行验证。该方法具有插件式设计，可直接集成到已有SJD及其变体中，无需改变整体生成框架。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，将SJD-SV集成到现有SJD方法后，可以带来显著的性能提升，说明语义感知的子序列验证能够有效缓解视觉token歧义并提升图像生成加速效果。摘要未提供具体数据集、加速倍数或质量指标。
AI.conclusion: 视觉token的局部性、细粒度和语义表达不完整性是SJD中token歧义的重要原因。通过从逐token验证转向语义感知token子序列验证，SJD-SV能够有效改善现有SJD方法的性能，并以插件方式适配不同SJD变体。

title: Hermitian Duality and Syndrome Structure of CSS-Type Codes over the ring $\mathbb{Z}_q[i]$
summary:
We study the algebraic structure of principal ideal codes and CSS-type stabilizer constructions over the ring $
R_q=\mathbb Z_q[i],$ where every prime divisor of $q$ is congruent to $1$ modulo $4$. Although such ring-based constructions have recently been considered in the context of classical and quantum error correction, the precise relationship among principal ideal cardinalities, Hermitian duality, algebraic cosets, and stabilizer syndromes requires further structural analysis.
  We obtain cardinality formulas for principal ideals and their annihilators. For a length-one principal ideal code $C=\langleα\rangle$, we show that its Hermitian dual is $
C^{\perp_H}=\operatorname{Ann}(σ(α)). $ For nested codes satisfying $
C_2^{\perp_H}\subseteq C_1\subseteq C_2, $
we determine the corresponding CSS-type stabilizer and prove that the kernel of the physical $X$-error syndrome map is $
\ker(\operatorname{Syn}_X)=C_2. $
Consequently, $C_2/C_1$ parametrizes logical $X$-operator classes and $R_q^n/C_2$ parametrizes physical $X$-error syndrome classes. Using this syndrome quotient, we construct a transversal of $C_2$ in $R_q^n$ whose elements have pairwise distinct physical $X$-error syndromes. The corresponding $X$-type error family is correctable by stabilizer syndrome measurement, yielding a syndrome-based recovery procedure that is consistent with the stabilizer structure. Explicit examples illustrate the resulting duality, cardinality, and syndrome structure.

AI.tldr: 论文研究满足所有素因子均为4k+1的环R_q=Z_q[i]上的主理想码与CSS型稳定子构造，建立主理想、厄米对偶、代数商空间和稳定子综合征之间的结构联系，并给出基于综合征的纠错方法。
AI.motivation: 现有环上经典码和量子纠错构造缺乏对主理想基数、湮灭子、厄米对偶、代数陪集及稳定子综合征之间精确关系的系统刻画，尤其需要明确嵌套码如何决定稳定子结构和可纠正误差类别。
AI.method: 在R_q=Z_q[i]上分析主理想及其湮灭子的基数；对长度一主理想码C=<α>利用共轭自同态σ刻画厄米对偶C^{⊥H}=Ann(σ(α))；对满足C_2^{⊥H}⊆C_1⊆C_2的嵌套码构造CSS型稳定子，研究物理X误差综合征映射的核，并通过商空间R_q^n/C_2构造C_2的陪集代表元。
AI.result: 得到主理想及湮灭子的基数公式；证明长度一主理想码的厄米对偶公式；证明ker(Syn_X)=C_2。由此，C_2/C_1刻画逻辑X算符类，R_q^n/C_2刻画物理X误差综合征类。构造了具有两两不同物理X误差综合征的C_2横截面，其对应的X型误差族可通过稳定子综合征测量纠正。
AI.conclusion: 论文统一了R_q上的主理想码、厄米对偶与CSS稳定子综合征的代数结构，说明嵌套码商空间分别承担逻辑算符分类和物理误差综合征分类功能，并建立了与稳定子结构一致的综合征恢复程序；示例验证了这些结论。

title: From Token Probabilities to Semantic Constraints: Towards Declarative Probabilistic Evaluation of Language Models
summary: While Large Language Models have improved rapidly, many fundamental questions remain about how to evaluate the knowledge and reasoning abilities they acquire, and how such evaluations relate to the learning signals used in pre-training. In this paper, we propose ModelLog, a declarative probabilistic framework for pre-training evaluation that makes the semantic structure of model behavior explicit and provides new formal tools for relating evaluation to learning. ModelLog specifies evaluation targets as symbolic constraints over token-level predictions and measures how strongly a model's distribution satisfies those constraints. We explore the framework through a new suite of tasks targeting negation, mutual exclusivity, and consistency, finding systematic failures that are difficult to characterize through token likelihood or answer accuracy alone. We further show that these evaluation scores can also be interpreted as losses, whose gradients reflect logical strength, informativeness, and variable-level sensitivity. This links evaluation and learning through a shared semantics, suggesting evaluation methods that diagnose model behavior while also helping to clarify the semantic structure of learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ModelLog，一种用于预训练评估的声明式概率框架，将模型行为表示为关于 token 级预测的符号约束，并用约束满足程度评估模型的否定、互斥和一致性能力；同时将评估分数解释为损失，使评估梯度能够揭示逻辑强度、信息量和变量敏感性，从而统一模型评估与学习分析。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要依赖 token likelihood 或答案准确率，难以刻画大语言模型对否定、互斥关系和逻辑一致性的细粒度掌握，也缺少将评估结果与预训练学习信号联系起来的形式化方法。论文旨在提供具有明确语义结构的评估框架，以回答模型究竟学到了什么，以及评估指标如何反映学习过程。
AI.method: 构建 ModelLog 声明式概率框架：使用符号约束描述评估目标，将约束施加于 token 级预测分布，并计算模型分布满足这些约束的程度。论文设计针对否定、互斥和一致性的任务套件，并进一步把评估分数解释为可优化的损失，通过梯度分析逻辑强度、信息量和变量级敏感性。
AI.result: 实验发现，模型在否定、互斥和一致性方面存在系统性失败，而这些问题难以仅通过 token likelihood 或答案准确率识别。ModelLog 能够提供更细粒度的行为诊断；其评估分数对应的梯度还能反映不同逻辑约束的强弱、信息量及对具体变量的敏感程度。
AI.conclusion: ModelLog 通过共享语义连接了模型评估与学习，使评估不仅能够诊断模型行为，也有助于解释学习信号中的语义结构。该框架为分析预训练模型的逻辑能力及设计更具诊断性、潜在可用于学习的评估方法提供了形式化基础。

title: Grounded Adjudication of Variations across Extracted TimeLines (GAVEL): Comparing Clinical Timelines Against Their Case Reports
summary: Existing pipelines for clinical timeline extraction from case reports are evaluated using an expert reference and are limited by imperfect reference annotations and imprecise event alignment. We developed GAVEL, an LLM judge protocol that compares two timelines with the case report and returns a discrepancy type, verdict, and report passage for each difference. We evaluated the event matcher, reviewed 2,738 findings from GPT5.6sol and DeepSeek V3.2, ranked six LLM extractors and two human annotators, and tested GAVEL guided merging. True match rates were 60% immediately below and 48% immediately above the 0.10 cutoff. Manual review confirmed 89.4% and 88.6% of findings. Across 126 reports, merged timelines were preferred in 77.0% of comparisons (95% CI, 69.8 to 84.1%) and reduced discrepancies attributed to the evaluated timeline from 7.63 to 0.85 per report. GAVEL supports report-based comparison and revision without treating either timeline as ground truth.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GAVEL，一种基于大语言模型的临床时间线评审协议，通过直接对照病例报告比较两条时间线，识别差异、给出判定并定位原文证据；实验表明其评审准确性较高，并能有效指导时间线合并与修订。
AI.motivation: 现有病例报告临床时间线抽取流程通常依赖专家参考时间线，但参考标注本身可能不完整或有误，且事件对齐不精确。这会使系统评估偏离病例报告真实内容，也难以可靠判断哪条时间线更好。因此，需要一种不把任一时间线视为绝对真值、而是回到原始报告进行差异核验的方法。
AI.method: 作者开发 GAVEL（LLM judge protocol），输入病例报告和两条待比较的时间线，对每个差异输出差异类型、判定结果及病例报告中的支持段落。研究评估了事件匹配器，人工复核了来自 GPT5.6sol 和 DeepSeek V3.2 的 2,738 条发现，比较六种大语言模型抽取器与两名人工标注者，并测试由 GAVEL 指导的时间线合并方法。
AI.result: 事件匹配器在 0.10 阈值下方和上方的真实匹配率分别为 60% 和 48%。人工复核显示，GAVEL 发现的正确率分别为 89.4% 和 88.6%。在 126 份病例报告中，合并后的时间线在 77.0% 的比较中更受偏好（95% CI：69.8%–84.1%），并将归因于被评估时间线的差异从每份报告 7.63 条降至 0.85 条。
AI.conclusion: GAVEL 能够基于病例报告对临床时间线进行证据驱动的比较和修订，减少对不完美专家参考标注的依赖。其指导的合并策略显著降低了时间线差异，说明该协议可用于临床文本信息抽取系统的评估、纠错和质量提升。不过，研究结果仍依赖 LLM 判定质量、人工复核标准及病例报告样本，后续需要在更广泛数据和真实临床任务中验证。

title: Pixel-wise Planarity for High-Precision Monocular Plane Segmentation
comment: To appear at ECCV 2026. Code available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/PixelwisePlanarity
summary: Plane segmentation from a single RGB image remains challenging due to imprecise region grouping and geometrically inconsistent supervision, often leading to over-segmentation and false planar detections. We propose instead a pixel-wise planarity prediction framework for robust monocular plane segmentation. Building on a pretrained monocular geometric backbone predicting depth and surface normals, we introduce a dedicated planarity head that estimates per-pixel planarity confidence. During inference, predicted depth, normals, and planarity are combined in a lightweight region-growing procedure that enforces geometric consistency when forming plane segments. We further analyze existing plane ground-truth annotations and demonstrate substantial geometric inconsistencies under strict distance thresholds. Across multiple datasets, our method achieves improved geometric precision and segmentation quality compared to prior state-of-the-art approaches, while improving computational efficiency. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/PixelwisePlanarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于像素级平面性预测的单目平面分割框架：利用预训练单目几何骨干网络预测深度和表面法向，并增加平面性预测头估计每个像素属于平面的置信度；推理时结合深度、法向与平面性，通过轻量级区域生长生成几何一致的平面区域。该方法缓解了传统方法中的区域误分组、监督标注几何不一致、过分割和虚假平面检测问题，在多个数据集上取得更高的几何精度和分割质量，同时具有更高的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 单幅RGB图像中的平面分割受到两个关键问题限制：一是区域分组不精确，容易产生过分割和错误的平面检测；二是现有平面真值标注在严格距离阈值下存在明显几何不一致，导致监督信号不可靠。因此，本文旨在构建一种更稳健、几何一致性更强且计算高效的单目平面分割方法。
AI.method: 方法以预训练的单目几何骨干网络为基础，同时预测深度和表面法向。在此基础上，设计专门的平面性预测头，为每个像素估计平面性置信度。推理阶段将深度、法向和平面性信息输入轻量级区域生长过程，通过几何一致性约束形成平面片段。此外，作者分析了现有平面真值标注，并评估其在严格距离阈值下的几何一致性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法相较于已有先进方法取得了更高的几何精度和更好的平面分割质量，同时降低了计算开销。结果说明，像素级平面性预测与深度、法向联合使用，能够有效提升平面区域形成的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了将平面分割建模为像素级平面性预测，并在后处理中结合深度和法向进行几何一致的区域生长，是解决单目平面分割问题的有效方案。该框架能够减少过分割和虚假平面检测，并兼顾精度与效率；同时，现有真值标注的几何不一致性应在相关数据集和评测协议中受到重视。

title: Channel-Aware Selection of Folded Bloom Filters for Distributed Systems
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Internet of Things and Intelligence System (IoTaIS 2026)
summary:
Periodic Bloom-filter transmission can impose substantial overhead in communication-constrained distributed systems. Lossless compression preserves membership behavior but provides a single transmission size, whereas established OR folding produces smaller representations with higher false-positive rates (FPRs) while preserving the no-false-negative property.
  This paper investigates channel-aware selection among OR-folded representations. The sender retains an unchanged canonical filter, constructs a catalog satisfying a maximum FPR, and selects the FPR-qualified representation with the largest retained length supported by the communication resources available at each reporting opportunity. Unlike folding driven principally by cardinality and false-positive constraints, selection is driven by time-varying communication conditions.
  Using two phishing URL datasets, the framework is evaluated under Five-State Markov Capacity, Gilbert--Elliott burst-error, and Rayleigh block-fading models. Channel-aware folding improves communication efficiency and receiver freshness relative to complete-filter and lossless-compression baselines when communication opportunities vary substantially. Under the more favorable Gilbert--Elliott model, it remains competitive in efficiency while maintaining the freshest receiver state. These results show that FPR-qualified folded views provide useful transmission operating points when a recent lower-fidelity update is preferable to delaying a larger representation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在通信资源随时间变化的分布式系统中，如何从满足最大误报率约束的多种OR折叠Bloom过滤器表示中，选择当前可传输的最长表示，以在通信效率与接收端信息新鲜度之间取得平衡。实验表明，该方法在多种信道模型下优于或接近完整过滤器与无损压缩基线，尤其适用于传输机会不稳定的场景。
AI.motivation: 周期性传输Bloom过滤器会在通信受限的分布式系统中产生显著开销。无损压缩虽然保持成员判定行为，但只能提供单一传输大小；传统OR折叠能够缩短表示，却会提高误报率。因此，本文的动机是利用不同折叠程度形成多个满足误报率上限的候选表示，并根据时变通信条件动态选择合适的表示，从而避免因等待大表示而延迟更新。
AI.method: 发送端保留未改变的规范Bloom过滤器，预先构建一个满足最大误报率约束的OR折叠表示目录。在每次报告机会到来时，根据当前可用通信资源，从误报率合格的候选表示中选择保留长度最大的表示进行传输。该框架在五状态Markov容量模型、Gilbert--Elliott突发错误模型和Rayleigh块衰落模型下进行评估，并与完整过滤器传输和无损压缩进行比较。
AI.result: 在通信机会波动较大的条件下，信道感知折叠相较于完整过滤器和无损压缩基线，提高了通信效率以及接收端状态新鲜度。在较有利的Gilbert--Elliott模型下，该方法在通信效率方面仍具有竞争力，同时保持最优或更高的接收端新鲜度。
AI.conclusion: 满足误报率约束的多种折叠视图可以作为有价值的传输运行点。当近期获得一个精度较低但及时的更新优于等待更大的高精度表示时，基于信道状态进行动态选择能够有效改善Bloom过滤器更新的时效性与通信利用率。

title: Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics: Layer-wise Trajectories of Adversarial Intent in Large Language Models
comment: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) Workshop on Mechanistic Interpretability in 2026, accepted in South Korea. https://openreview.net/pdf?id=SGnAkwZ3VV
summary: We identify \textbf{Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics (HPD)}: for harmful prompts, the projection of the last-token hidden state onto a learned harm direction rises monotonically with transformer depth, whereas benign prompts remain flat or oscillatory. This cross-layer signature reflects harmful intent as a \emph{progressively resolved} semantic property: surface form appears early, while pragmatic intent consolidates later, making the \emph{trajectory shape} more informative than any single-layer snapshot. Moreover, LDA-based harm directions, learned per layer, remain stable across random splits (pairwise cosine similarity $>0.97$), supporting the projection sequence as a reproducible structured signal. Building on HPD, we introduce \textbf{\herald{}} (\textbf{H}armful \textbf{E}ncoding \textbf{R}ecognition via \textbf{A}ctivation \textbf{L}ayer \textbf{D}ynamics). This lightweight input moderator extracts a seven-dimensional feature record, slope, curvature, monotonicity, onset layer, and related statistics from the cross-layer projection sequence and classifies it with a 288-parameter MLP. \herald{} stores one $d$-dimensional direction per layer ($262$\,KB for a 32-layer, $d{=}4096$ model), requires no gradient computation during training, and adds only $2.6{\times}10^{-6}$ prefill FLOPs at inference. Across eight prompt-harmfulness benchmarks and four model families, \herald{} achieves an average F1 of $89.3$ on OLMo2-7B, surpassing all tested guard models on adversarial jailbreak detection ($98.4$ vs.\ $96.9$ F1) and outperforming prior latent-based methods by $2.3$-$4.1$ F1 points on every backbone. Per-instance trajectories provide machine-readable audit records that reveal \emph{when} and \emph{how} harmfulness emerges, offering an interpretability advantage over single-layer approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics（HPD）与基于该动态信号的轻量级输入审核器HERALD。核心发现是：有害提示词在Transformer各层的最后Token隐藏状态沿逐层学习的有害方向投影呈单调上升，而良性提示词通常平坦或振荡；因此，跨层轨迹比单层表示更能刻画有害意图的逐步形成。HERALD从投影序列提取7维动态特征，并用288参数MLP分类，在多个基准和模型族上取得较强效果，同时提供可审计的逐实例轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有有害内容检测方法通常依赖单层隐藏状态或较重的防护模型，难以捕捉有害意图在Transformer深度方向上的逐步语义形成过程，也缺少低成本、可解释且可复现的输入审核机制。因此，论文希望利用跨层激活变化来识别有害性，并降低训练与推理开销。
AI.method: 首先，在每一层使用LDA学习有害方向，并计算最后Token隐藏状态在该方向上的投影，分析其随Transformer深度变化的轨迹，提出Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics（HPD）作为判别信号。随后，HERALD从投影序列中提取7维统计特征，包括斜率、曲率、单调性和起始层等，再输入一个288参数的MLP进行分类。系统为每层存储一个d维方向，不需要训练期间的梯度计算，推理时仅增加极少的prefill FLOPs。
AI.result: HPD表现为有害提示的投影随层数单调上升，而良性提示通常保持平坦或出现振荡。各层LDA有害方向在随机数据划分下具有较高稳定性，成对余弦相似度超过0.97。HERALD在8个有害提示基准和4类模型上进行评估：在OLMo2-7B上平均F1达到89.3；在对抗性越狱检测上取得98.4 F1，高于测试的防护模型最高96.9 F1；相较已有潜在表示方法，在每个骨干模型上提升2.3—4.1个F1点。存储开销为32层、4096维模型约262 KB，推理额外prefill计算量为2.6×10^-6。
AI.conclusion: 论文说明有害意图可以通过跨层激活轨迹进行识别，轨迹形状比单层快照包含更丰富、更稳定的判别信息。HERALD以极低参数量和计算成本实现了具有竞争力的审核性能，并通过逐实例轨迹提供有害性形成时机与过程的机器可读审计记录。不过，摘要未说明跨模型、跨任务分布外场景的鲁棒性，也未详细讨论阈值选择、类别不平衡及对自适应攻击的抵抗能力。

title: Token Efficient Task Execution via Application Behavior Modeling for Web Agents
summary: The strong performance of AI Agents across an impressive variety of tasks is driving an unprecedented investment in agentic infrastructures, however the cost of processing tokens is fast increasing. Web agents automate the execution of web-application tasks described in natural language, by analyzing the web-application's user interface (UI) and interacting with it. This work introduces OdoBot, a novel web-agent architecture that completes tasks at a fraction of the cost when compared to conventional web agents. This is achieved by leveraging a behavioral model of the underlying application constructed by analyzing successful task-execution demonstrations. Our experiments with 45 tasks on the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS) demonstrate that OdoBot uses 44% and 80% fewer tokens than two state-of-the-art competitor agents (Agent-E and WebVoyager), while also surpassing WebVoyager in terms of task success rate.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OdoBot，一种面向网页任务的低成本智能体架构。它通过分析成功任务演示，构建目标网页应用的行为模型，从而减少在线交互所需的 token。 在 Canvas LMS 的45项任务实验中，OdoBot较 Agent-E 和 WebVoyager 分别减少44%和80%的 token，并在任务成功率上超过 WebVoyager。
AI.motivation: 现有网页智能体依赖大规模语言模型持续分析用户界面并生成操作，随着智能体应用扩大，token处理成本快速上升。论文旨在降低网页任务自动化的推理与交互成本，同时保持或提升任务完成能力。
AI.method: 提出 OdoBot 网页智能体架构。核心思路是利用成功任务执行的演示数据，分析底层网页应用的交互规律并构建行为模型；执行新任务时，智能体借助该模型完成网页界面分析和操作，减少对高成本在线 token 推理的依赖。实验以 Canvas Learning Management System 为应用环境，设置45项任务，并与 Agent-E、WebVoyager 两个先进网页智能体进行比较。
AI.result: 在45项 Canvas LMS 任务上，OdoBot 相比 Agent-E 减少44%的 token 使用量，相比 WebVoyager 减少80%的 token 使用量；同时，OdoBot 的任务成功率高于 WebVoyager。摘要未给出 OdoBot 与 Agent-E 的具体成功率差异，也未报告绝对 token 数、统计显著性或不同任务类型下的细分结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过从成功执行演示中学习网页应用的行为模型，网页智能体可以显著降低 token 成本，并维持较强的任务完成能力。OdoBot 说明，面向特定应用构建结构化行为知识，可能是提升网页智能体效率的重要方向；但其泛化到其他网页应用和任务分布的能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Evaluation of MLLM-Agnostic Plug-and-Play Keyframe Selection Methods for Long Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot process every frame of a long video because of limitations in visual-token and computational budgets. Three primary approaches have been proposed to enhance their long-video understanding capabilities: (i) Retraining an MLLM on a large video corpus and/or extending its input length; (ii) Training an adapter for a specific MLLM that takes the entire video and the query as input and selects the most relevant video frames; and (iii) Developing a training-free, plug-and-play (PaP) adapter that is MLLM-agnostic. We refer to the third approach as PaP keyframe selection. A PaP method may use only candidate video frames without considering the query, or it may use both candidate video frames and the query. The first approach is prohibitively expensive. The second approach requires substantial training time and computational resources, but it is accessible to many because an adapter contains significantly fewer trainable parameters than an entire MLLM. The third approach has the lowest computational cost and is therefore broadly accessible. To the best of our knowledge, only five PaP methods have been reported within the past year. All of these methods have been evaluated on one or more video question-answering benchmarks and have demonstrated improvements in long-video understanding. However, the methods were evaluated on different benchmarks using different MLLMs. We present a comprehensive evaluation of these five methods using three MLLMs across three long-video understanding benchmarks. Our results show that QAaF achieves the best performance in 13 of the 15 aggregate evaluation settings, while FOCUS ranks second overall. These results provide a common experimental reference for comparing training-free keyframe-selection methods for MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了五种面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的免训练、即插即用（PaP）长视频关键帧选择方法。作者在三个MLLM和三个长视频理解基准上进行统一评测，发现QAaF在15个汇总评测设置中的13个取得最佳性能，FOCUS总体排名第二，为相关方法提供了统一实验参考。
AI.motivation: 长视频包含大量视频帧，而MLLM受视觉令牌数量和计算预算限制，无法处理每一帧。现有解决方案包括重新训练或扩展MLLM、训练特定模型的帧选择适配器，以及无需训练且与MLLM无关的PaP关键帧选择方法。由于已有五种PaP方法分别在不同基准和不同MLLM上评测，缺乏公平、统一的横向比较，因此本文旨在建立共同实验基线，明确各方法的实际效果。
AI.method: 作者选取过去一年提出的五种PaP关键帧选择方法进行综合评估，并在三种MLLM和三个长视频理解/视频问答基准上进行实验。比较对象包括仅依据候选帧进行选择的方法，以及同时利用候选帧和用户查询的方法。评测重点是不同方法在统一模型、数据集和汇总设置下的性能表现。
AI.result: QAaF在15个汇总评测设置中的13个取得最佳性能，表现出最强且最稳定的总体效果；FOCUS总体排名第二。实验结果表明，不同训练免费的关键帧选择方法之间存在明显性能差异，并且统一评测对于可靠比较至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 在计算资源有限、无法重新训练大型MLLM的场景下，PaP关键帧选择是具有可访问性的长视频理解方案。本文通过跨三个MLLM和三个基准的统一实验，为五种方法提供了共同参考，并表明QAaF和FOCUS是当前评测方法中整体表现最优的代表。

title: On the Generalized Packing and Covering Radii of Codes
summary:
The minimum distance and the covering radius are two fundamental properties of the code. Both have been extended: the former to the generalized Hamming weights hierarchy, and the latter to the generalized covering radii hierarchy. In both cases, the lowest level of the hierarchies corresponds to the classical minimum distance and covering radius, respectively. From a geometric point of view, the minimum distance of the code determines the packing radius, which is upper bounded by the covering radius. It was conjectured this relation extends to all other orders of the hierarchy, namely, that the generalized packing radii are upper bounded by the generalized covering radii of the same order.
  In this paper we prove this conjecture is true for the second order radii. We also prove the conjecture holds for all orders when the code rate is at most $3/5$. Finally, we show that for any code rate in $(0,1)$, for all sufficiently long codes the conjecture holds for all orders.

AI.tldr: 本文研究广义打包半径与广义覆盖半径之间的关系，证明了二阶情形、码率不超过3/5时的所有阶情形，以及任意固定码率下足够长代码的所有阶情形中的相应上界猜想。
AI.motivation: 最小距离和覆盖半径是编码理论中的基本参数，并分别推广为广义汉明重量层次和广义覆盖半径层次。经典情形中，打包半径不超过覆盖半径。论文旨在验证这一几何关系是否能够推广到层次结构的各个阶数，即广义打包半径是否始终不超过同阶广义覆盖半径。
AI.method: 围绕广义打包半径与广义覆盖半径的定义及其层次结构建立比较关系，并分别针对二阶半径、码率不超过3/5的代码，以及任意固定码率下码长充分大的代码进行理论证明。摘要未说明具体使用的技术工具。
AI.result: 证明了三项结果：1）广义打包半径与广义覆盖半径的猜想在二阶情形成立；2）当代码码率不超过3/5时，该猜想对所有阶数成立；3）对任意码率区间(0,1)内的固定码率，当代码足够长时，该猜想对所有阶数成立。
AI.conclusion: 论文逐步确认了广义打包半径不超过同阶广义覆盖半径的猜想：该关系不仅在二阶成立，也在低码率代码和渐近长码情形下对所有阶成立，显著扩展了经典打包半径与覆盖半径之间的几何关系。

title: Domain-Specific Jargon in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis between General-Purpose and Specialist Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable proficiency on general-purpose tasks, yet their performance often degrades in highly-specialized technical domains. Moreover, little is known about how parametric knowledge of domain-specific terms is encoded within these models. We address this gap by contributing two novel medical jargon evaluation benchmarks and evaluate a general-purpose Llama-3.1 model against a variant fine-tuned on medical-domain data. Surprisingly, the general-purpose model outperforms the medically fine-tuned model on both tasks. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, we find systematic patterns of miscalibration for the medically fine-tuned model. Instead of reorganizing parametric knowledge, the fine-tuned model places greater emphasis on a small subset of model components associated with jargon-favoring predictions. We find that applying component reweighting strategies against the benchmark tasks successfully suppresses these components and closes the gap with the general-purpose baseline. We also observe that some jargon-sensitive components transfer knowledge to the same tasks involving materials science jargon, suggesting they encode a partially domain-agnostic notion of specialized terminology. Our results provide a case study in which a medically fine-tuned checkpoint does not improve jargon comprehension over its general-purpose counterpart, highlighting that domain adaptation should not be assumed to yield better performance on specialized terminology.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：在医学术语理解任务上，通用 Llama-3.1 反而优于医学微调模型。机制解释表明，医学微调模型并未有效重组领域知识，而是过度依赖少量偏向术语预测的模型组件；通过重新加权这些组件，可抑制误校准并缩小性能差距，且部分组件对材料科学术语也具有迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型虽擅长通用任务，但在高度专业化技术领域的表现可能下降；尤其是领域术语的参数化知识如何编码、医学领域微调是否真正提升术语理解，仍缺乏系统研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，并检验领域适配对专业术语性能的实际影响。
AI.method: 构建两个新的医学术语评测基准，比较通用 Llama-3.1 模型与医学领域微调版本的表现。随后使用机制可解释性方法分析模型组件、术语偏好预测和校准模式之间的关系，并采用组件重新加权策略干预模型。在材料科学术语任务上进一步测试相关组件的跨领域迁移性。
AI.result: 通用模型在两个医学术语任务上均优于医学微调模型。机制分析显示，医学微调没有重新组织参数化知识，而是增强了对少量与术语偏好预测相关组件的依赖，导致系统性误校准。重新加权并抑制这些组件后，医学微调模型与通用基线之间的性能差距得到弥合。部分术语敏感组件还能迁移到材料科学术语任务，表明其可能编码了部分领域无关的专业术语表征。
AI.conclusion: 领域微调并不必然提升模型对专业术语的理解，甚至可能因过度依赖少数偏置组件而损害性能。专业术语知识可能部分由跨领域、领域无关的机制支持。本文说明，机制可解释性分析和组件级干预可用于诊断及缓解领域适配造成的误校准问题。

title: Fraglingo: Molecular Design via Attachment-Aware Autoregressive Fragment Generation
summary: Molecular design is most effective when generation mirrors the edits chemists actually make: extending a scaffold, replacing a substituent, or decorating a scaffold at a specified attachment site while optimizing molecular properties. Fragment-based molecular design naturally supports this workflow, yet existing approaches often separate fragment selection from attachment prediction, first choosing a fragment from a fixed vocabulary and then predicting how it should be connected. This decoupling restricts generation to a closed fragment vocabulary and treats attachment as a separate prediction problem. We introduce Fraglingo, an autoregressive fragment-based molecular generator that jointly models fragment identity and attachment in a continuous latent space. Fraglingo predicts an attachment-aware fragment embedding and retrieves the next fragment through latent-space nearest-neighbor search. To encode attachment context, we introduce a wildcard-anchored readout that represents the growing molecule from the perspective of its active attachment site, enabling the predicted embedding to capture both the molecular context and the required attachment. Because generation operates in a continuous embedding space rather than over fixed fragment identifiers, new fragments can be added to the inference-time vocabulary without retraining, provided their embeddings can be computed by the trained fragment encoder. This retrieval-based formulation provides a unified generation primitive for molecule generation, scaffold generation, scaffold decoration, and molecular optimization. On controlled property-conditional benchmarks, Fraglingo achieves stronger joint property control than comparably trained baselines while maintaining competitive validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Furthermore, Fraglingo generalizes to fragment libraries up to 4x larger than those used during training without retraining.

AI.tldr: Fraglingo是一种自回归片段式分子生成模型，在连续潜空间中联合预测下一片段及其连接位点。模型通过以通配符锚定的读出机制编码当前分子的活性连接位点，并用潜空间近邻检索选择片段，因此无需固定片段词表或重新训练即可扩展推理时片段库。在受控属性基准上，Fraglingo表现出更强的联合属性控制能力，同时保持具有竞争力的有效性、唯一性和新颖性；其可泛化到训练片段库规模4倍的库。
AI.motivation: 现有片段式分子生成方法通常将片段选择与连接方式预测解耦：先从固定词表选择片段，再单独预测连接关系。这种流程与化学家实际进行的骨架延伸、取代基替换和定点骨架修饰不一致，且受限于封闭片段词表，难以在不重新训练的情况下利用新片段。论文旨在建立一种能够同时考虑分子上下文和指定连接位点、并支持开放式片段库扩展的统一生成方法。
AI.method: 提出Fraglingo自回归片段式分子生成器。模型在连续潜空间中联合建模片段身份和连接信息：首先利用通配符锚定的读出机制，从当前活性连接位点视角表示正在生成的分子，使表示同时包含分子上下文与目标连接需求；随后预测具有连接感知能力的片段嵌入，并通过潜空间近邻搜索检索下一片段。由于生成不是在固定片段标识符上进行，只要新片段能够由训练好的片段编码器计算嵌入，就可在推理时加入片段库而无需重新训练。该框架可统一支持分子生成、骨架生成、骨架修饰和分子优化。
AI.result: 在受控属性条件基准上，Fraglingo相较于训练条件相近的基线取得更强的联合属性控制效果，同时保持有竞争力的分子有效性、唯一性和新颖性。模型还可在不重新训练的情况下泛化到规模达到训练片段库4倍的片段库，说明其具有较好的开放词表扩展能力。摘要未提供具体数值、数据集名称或统计显著性信息。
AI.conclusion: Fraglingo通过在连续潜空间中联合表示片段身份与连接位点，缓解了片段选择和连接预测解耦的问题，并使片段库能够在推理阶段灵活扩展。结果表明，该方法在属性控制和生成质量之间取得了良好平衡，适合作为多类片段驱动分子设计任务的统一生成原语。

title: Preserving Subject-Clarity in Image Outpainting with Multiscale Wavelet Supervision
summary: Commercial and advertising images are frequently affected by poor framing, partially cropped subjects, truncated text or logos, and insufficient context, all of which can reduce subject clarity, i.e., the ability of an image to clearly communicate its primary subject. Image outpainting offers a scalable solution by extending image boundaries and recovering missing content and context. However, existing diffusion-based outpainting methods often produce visually plausible completions while degrading subject fidelity through structural inconsistencies, semantic drift, or loss of fine-grained detail. To address this limitation, we propose a subject clarity outpainting framework that combines vision-language model (VLM)-guided semantic conditioning with multiscale wavelet supervision for subject-localized detail preservation. To support training, we develop a subject-centric data curation pipeline that constructs subject-intersecting outpainting pairs from advertising and natural images. The resulting objective introduces no additional inference cost and is designed to be compatible with diffusion-based backbones. Across four advertising and natural-image benchmarks, our method improves subject clarity, reducing subject-centered DreamSim error and FID on average by 3.0% and 2.4% over matched supervised fine-tuning, and by 10.8% and 7.7% over the strongest state-of-the-art approach per dataset, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向主体清晰度的图像扩展框架，通过视觉语言模型语义引导和多尺度小波监督，在扩展图像边界的同时提升主体结构、语义和细节保真度；在四个广告与自然图像基准上优于监督微调和现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 商业与广告图像常存在构图不佳、主体被裁切、文字或标志截断、上下文不足等问题。现有基于扩散模型的图像扩展虽能生成视觉上合理的内容，但容易造成主体结构不一致、语义漂移和细节丢失，降低图像对核心主体的表达清晰度。因此，需要一种专门保护主体信息的扩展方法。
AI.method: 提出主体清晰度图像扩展框架，结合视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的语义条件与多尺度小波监督，以实现主体定位的细节保持；同时构建以主体为中心的数据整理流程，从广告图像和自然图像中生成与主体相交的扩展图像对。训练目标无需增加推理成本，并可兼容基于扩散模型的骨干网络。
AI.result: 在四个广告与自然图像基准上，相比匹配的监督微调方法，主体中心DreamSim误差和FID平均分别降低3.0%和2.4%；相比各数据集上最强的现有方法，平均分别降低10.8%和7.7%。结果表明，该方法在主体相似性与整体生成质量方面均有改进。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，将VLM语义条件、多尺度小波监督和主体中心数据构建结合起来，能够有效缓解图像扩展中的主体保真度下降问题，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升主体清晰度，并具备适配多种扩散式扩展模型的潜力。

title: Universal Estimation of the Fisher Information for Processes with Memory
summary: The Fisher information matrix (FIM) determines the accuracy attainable in an estimation problem. For a parametric process with memory, it has a closed form only for narrow classes of models, and it cannot be computed when the model is available only as a simulator. This paper estimates the Fisher information rate of such a process, the per-observation limit of its FIM, from simulator output alone and without knowledge of the memory length. The construction uses the identity between the FIM and the local curvature of the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence. Directional divergence rates are estimated by context-tree weighting (CTW), and the matrix is recovered from them by least squares. We establish strong consistency in an iterated limit and a finite-sample bound, uniform over every working depth at least as large as the true memory length, which gives a mean error of order $n^{-1/3}$. The analysis also delivers a finite-sample rate for CTW-based estimation of the KL divergence rate. Experiments confirm the predicted exponents, show that the accuracy does not degrade as the working depth grows, and use the estimate to plan a sampling budget that attains a prescribed precision. The estimator stays accurate on a hidden-state source that has no finite memory length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖模拟器输出、无需已知记忆长度的 Fisher 信息率估计方法：利用 FIM 与 KL 散度局部曲率的关系，通过 CTW 估计方向性 KL 散度率，再用最小二乘恢复信息矩阵。理论上证明迭代极限下强一致性，并给出均方误差阶约为 n^{-1/3} 的有限样本界；实验验证收敛速率、深度鲁棒性、采样预算规划能力及对无有限记忆隐状态源的适用性。
AI.motivation: Fisher 信息矩阵刻画参数估计所能达到的精度，但对于具有记忆的参数过程，只有少数模型存在闭式表达；当模型仅以模拟器形式提供时，传统方法无法直接计算 FIM。此外，过程的记忆长度可能未知，因而需要一种仅从模拟输出中估计 Fisher 信息率、同时对记忆深度具有鲁棒性的通用方法。
AI.method: 核心依据是 Fisher 信息率等于 KL 散度率在参数邻域的局部二阶曲率。首先沿多个参数方向，对模拟器生成的数据使用 context-tree weighting（CTW）估计方向性 KL 散度率；随后将这些方向上的曲率估计组织成线性关系，通过最小二乘法恢复 Fisher 信息矩阵。理论分析覆盖未知记忆长度情形，并考察工作深度不小于真实记忆长度时的有限样本误差。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，估计器在迭代极限下强一致；有限样本分析给出均匀适用于所有不小于真实记忆长度的工作深度的误差界，平均误差量级为 n^{-1/3}。论文还给出了基于 CTW 的 KL 散度率估计有限样本收敛速率。实验验证了理论预测的指数，显示增加工作深度不会明显降低精度，并利用估计结果设计出达到目标精度所需的采样预算。对于不具有有限记忆长度的隐状态源，估计器仍保持良好准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一套从模拟器输出直接估计 Fisher 信息率的实用框架，克服了显式模型不可得和记忆长度未知这两个主要障碍。方法兼具一致性、有限样本理论保证和较强的模型适用性，可用于基于模拟的统计推断与实验采样预算设计。其主要局限是误差收敛速度为 n^{-1/3}，且实际性能可能依赖方向选择、参数维度和 CTW 的计算成本。

title: Toward Complete Hospital Discharge Summarization with Abstract Meaning Representation
comment: Published in the 2026 IEEE 14th International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI). 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: Discharge summaries are lengthy medical documents that summarize a hospital in-patient visit. Automatically generating them can reduce documentation burden and return clinician time to patient care. Whereas Large Language Model (LLMs) could be used for this task, their Achilles heel is hallucinations, which can have drastic consequences for clinical documentation. We present an evidence-driven alignment framework for discharge summarization at the clinical encounter level, that treats provenance as a first-class constraint, using semantic graphs and deep learning models. Each summary sentence is selected and organized via cross-document semantic alignment and is accompanied by explicit evidence links to its source spans. We show our results on two corpora: a publicly available corpus (MIMIC-III) and clinical notes written by physicians at the University of Illinois Hospital (UIC Health). Additionally, we make source code and trained models available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向临床就诊级别出院摘要生成的证据驱动对齐框架，通过跨文档语义对齐选择、组织摘要句子，并为每句话提供明确的源文本证据链接；在MIMIC-III和UIC Health两个语料库上进行了评估，同时公开代码和训练模型。
AI.motivation: 出院摘要是冗长的住院记录，人工撰写耗时。虽然大语言模型有潜力自动生成摘要，但其幻觉问题可能导致临床文档出现严重错误。因此，研究需要一种将事实可追溯性和来源约束作为核心目标的生成方法，以降低幻觉风险并减轻临床文档负担。
AI.method: 提出临床就诊级别的证据驱动对齐框架，将来源可追溯性作为一等约束。该框架结合语义图和深度学习模型，通过跨文档语义对齐选择并组织摘要句子；每个生成的摘要句子都附带指向原始临床文本片段的显式证据链接。研究在公开的MIMIC-III语料库和伊利诺伊大学医院UIC Health医生撰写的临床笔记上进行实验，并公开源代码和训练模型。
AI.result: 实验覆盖两个不同来源的临床语料库：MIMIC-III和UIC Health。摘要明确表明该方法取得了有效结果，但未提供具体的自动评价指标、基线比较、统计显著性或幻觉率等定量细节。因此，可以确认方法具有跨数据集验证和可复现性支持，但无法仅依据该摘要判断其相对性能提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 证据驱动的跨文档语义对齐能够为临床出院摘要生成提供可追溯的事实依据，有望降低大语言模型幻觉带来的临床风险，并减少医生的文档工作量。该工作的主要贡献是将句子级证据链接和来源约束系统性地融入摘要生成流程；公开代码与模型进一步提升了研究的可复现性。

title: From Legal Text to AI-specific Risk Sources: A Systematic Analysis of the EU AI Act's High-Risk Requirements
summary: The EU AI Act introduces mandatory requirements for high-risk AI systems with the explicit goal of ensuring the development and operation of trustworthy AI. At the same time, AI risk management practices rely on structured risk taxonomies to systematically identify and treat AI-specific risk sources. As both the AI Act and established risk taxonomies aim to address AI-induced risks, a natural question is whether they align in the risk sources they cover. However, no clear mapping exists between the risks implicitly addressed by the Act's high-risk requirements and established taxonomies, leaving practitioners without a structured basis for aligning regulatory obligations with AI risk management practice. This paper presents a systematic classification of the requirements extracted from the EU AI Act Section 2 (Requirements for high-risk AI systems), revealing that only a minority directly address AI-specific risk sources, while the majority impose organizational process and documentation obligations. From the AI risk-related requirements, a consolidated list of distinct AI-specific risk sources is derived. The resulting EU AI Act Risk Source List takes an important step towards bridging the gap between legal obligation and AI risk management practice, providing a structured reference for explicit comparison between existing AI risk taxonomies and the risk sources implicitly addressed by the EU AI Act. Important Note: This is the authors' preprint. The paper was presented at the 4th International Conference on Frontiers of Artificial Intelligence, Ethics, and Multidisciplinary Applications. A link to the conference's official proceedings will be provided upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理欧盟《人工智能法案》第二节关于高风险人工智能系统的要求，区分其中直接针对人工智能特有风险来源的要求与组织流程、文档类义务，并据此构建“欧盟人工智能法案风险来源清单”，以促进法规要求与人工智能风险分类体系之间的对接。
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》与现有人工智能风险分类体系都旨在识别和治理人工智能风险，但二者之间缺乏清晰、结构化的映射关系。由于法案中的高风险系统要求同时包含技术风险控制和组织管理义务，实践者难以判断哪些条款对应具体的人工智能风险来源。因此，本文旨在填补法规义务与人工智能风险管理实践之间的衔接空白。
AI.method: 作者对《人工智能法案》第二节“高风险人工智能系统的要求”进行系统性分类，将相关要求区分为直接针对人工智能特有风险来源的要求，以及组织流程和文档记录等管理性义务。随后，从与人工智能风险相关的要求中提取并整合不同的风险来源，形成“欧盟人工智能法案风险来源清单”，作为与现有人工智能风险分类体系进行显式比较的结构化参照。
AI.result: 分析显示，法案第二节中的要求只有少数直接涉及人工智能特有风险来源，多数要求主要规定组织流程、治理机制和文档义务。基于其中的风险相关要求，作者形成了一份整合后的人工智能特定风险来源清单，为识别法案隐含覆盖的风险范围提供了系统化结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的风险来源清单初步弥合了法律合规要求与人工智能风险管理实践之间的鸿沟。该清单可用于将欧盟《人工智能法案》隐含涉及的风险来源与既有人工智能风险分类体系进行结构化对比，并支持后续的合规映射、风险治理和分类体系整合。

title: (How) Do MLLMs Report Bistable Images Like Humans?
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 31 pages, 46 figures, 2 tables
summary: Bistable images such as the duck-rabbit are classic stimuli in which one image supports multiple mutually incompatible interpretations, typically reported one at a time in humans. We ask whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show similar report behavior and what internal computations support it. Using the LLaVA family, we study two tractable dimensions: modulability, whether reports can be biased by bottom-up visual cues and top-down linguistic priors, and exclusivity, whether responses commit to a single interpretation. We test both on the canonical duck-rabbit and on synthetic Visual Anagrams to mitigate memorization confounds. Behaviorally, both visual and linguistic manipulations systematically shift reports in human-consistent ways, while responses remain predominantly exclusive. Mechanistically, these effects arise from competing image-token representations, distinct pathways for bottom-up and top-down modulation, and a link between exclusive reporting and object-count encoding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/rtakatsky/mllm-bistable-images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态大语言模型是否像人类一样处理双稳态图像：在视觉线索和语言先验影响下改变报告，同时通常只报告一种解释。以LLaVA为代表的模型在鸭兔图和合成Visual Anagrams上均表现出与人类一致的可调制性和较高排他性；机制分析显示，这源于相互竞争的图像标记表征、分离的自下而上与自上而下调制通路，以及排他性报告与物体数量编码之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 双稳态图像允许多个互不相容的解释，人类通常一次只报告其中一种。已有研究主要关注人类知觉，尚不清楚多模态大语言模型是否具有类似的报告特征，以及视觉线索和语言先验如何共同影响其判断。本文还试图区分模型真正的视觉推理能力与训练数据记忆，因此引入合成Visual Anagrams作为补充测试。
AI.method: 以LLaVA系列多模态大语言模型为对象，围绕两个维度开展实验：1）可调制性，操纵自下而上的视觉线索和自上而下的语言先验，观察模型报告是否发生系统性变化；2）排他性，测量模型是否承诺单一解释而非同时报告多种解释。实验材料包括经典鸭兔图和用于降低记忆混淆的合成Visual Anagrams。进一步通过机制分析考察图像标记表征、视觉与语言调制路径，以及物体数量编码与排他性报告的关系。
AI.result: 视觉操纵和语言操纵都能系统性改变模型的解释报告，且变化方向与人类行为相一致，说明模型具有视觉和语言层面的可调制性。与此同时，模型输出大多保持排他性，即主要选择并报告一种解释，而非并列报告多种解释。机制层面发现：不同解释对应相互竞争的图像标记表征；自下而上视觉影响和自上而下语言影响通过不同路径实现；排他性报告与物体数量编码存在关联。鸭兔图与合成Visual Anagrams上的结果共同支持这些结论。
AI.conclusion: LLaVA类多模态大语言模型在双稳态图像任务中呈现出与人类相似的核心报告行为：解释可被视觉证据和语言先验调节，同时通常保持单一解释。该行为并非单纯由表面输出造成，而与竞争性图像表征、分离的调制通路和物体数量编码有关。研究表明，双稳态视觉任务可用于分析多模态模型中的知觉竞争、跨模态调制与决策排他性。

title: Fast-Slow Communication with Endogenous Transport
summary: A communication system may convey urgent information through a fast physical stream and more specific information through a slower material stream. In several biological and engineered settings, however, the fast process also changes the transport law of the slow one. We study this architecture under a shared resource constraint, with a strictly increasing concave fast-channel capacity--cost function and a deadline-constrained slow molecular channel. We first characterize the capacity region under separated message routing and message-independent operating-point schedules, and identify the marginal criterion for complementarity rather than competition between the streams. For one-dimensional drift diffusion, we prove that arrival probability before a deadline is strictly log-concave in Péclet number. For a distinguishable-token deadline-erasure channel, any increasing concave transport-actuation law then yields an exact single-crossing theorem: complementarity exists if and only if an initial transport-assistance elasticity exceeds one, the transition is unique when it exists, and the decreasing allocation branch remains the Pareto boundary after convexification. For positive baseline drift and sufficiently strong coupling, a unique critical normalized deadline determines when complementarity disappears. Short- and long-deadline limits clarify the associated temporal regimes. Numerical examples for a finite-frame LTI-Poisson slow channel exhibit analogous allocation behavior with counting noise and intersymbol interference.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一种由快速物理信息流与慢速物质/分子信息流组成的双通道通信架构。在共享资源约束下，快速通道的操作会改变慢速通道的传输规律。论文刻画容量区域，给出两通道互补而非竞争的判据，并证明在多种模型中互补分配具有单次交叉和唯一转变结构。
AI.motivation: 许多生物和工程通信系统同时包含快速但信息较粗略的通道，以及慢速但信息更具体的通道。现实中，快速过程还可能通过改变漂移、输运或到达概率来影响慢速通道，因此两个通道并非独立。论文旨在回答：在共享资源和时限约束下，快速通道何时会促进而非挤占慢速通道，以及最优资源分配如何随截止时间和耦合强度变化。
AI.method: 首先，在消息分离路由和与消息无关的操作点调度假设下，刻画双通道的容量区域，并利用边际条件识别互补与竞争。随后针对一维漂移扩散过程，证明截止时间内到达概率关于佩克莱数严格对数凹。对可区分令牌的截止时间擦除信道，结合任意递增凹型输运—驱动函数，建立精确的单次交叉定理：通过初始输运辅助弹性判断是否存在互补，并分析转变的唯一性及凸化后的帕累托边界。进一步研究正基线漂移和强耦合情形，定义决定互补消失的唯一临界归一化截止时间。最后考察短、长截止时间极限，并用有限帧LTI-Poisson慢通道的数值实验检验含计数噪声和码间干扰时的类似分配行为。
AI.result: 理论上，互补性当且仅当初始输运辅助弹性大于1；若互补存在，其状态转变是唯一的。即使进行凸化，递减分配分支仍构成帕累托边界。在正基线漂移且耦合足够强时，存在唯一临界归一化截止时间，超过该阈值后互补性消失。漂移扩散到达概率关于佩克莱数严格对数凹，为上述结论提供关键数学基础。数值结果显示，有限帧LTI-Poisson模型在计数噪声和码间干扰下仍呈现相近的资源分配规律。
AI.conclusion: 快速通道与慢速分子通道之间并不必然是零和竞争关系；当快速通道对慢速输运的初始促进作用足够强时，两者可以形成互补。互补性受输运辅助弹性、截止时间、基线漂移和耦合强度共同决定，并具有清晰的单次转变结构。该结果为具有资源共享和跨通道耦合的生物通信及工程通信系统提供了统一的容量与资源分配分析框架。

title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code, run records and the rerun harness: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/clinical-agent-action-reliability ; github: https://github.com/rohithreddybc/clinical-agent-action-reliability
summary: A clinical agent benchmark can report the same verdict on identical inputs while the agent files a materially different order on each run. Such agents order tests, request medications and place referrals, yet benchmarks typically score one run per task and rarely ask whether identical inputs produce identical actions; MedAgentBench, the benchmark we use, scores a single attempt and says so. To measure this gap we introduce "same-input rerun", which replays a task with every input held fixed and compares the orders rather than the score, with six reliability metrics, and apply it to 1000 MedAgentBench runs across 50 tasks from its five write-capable families, two open-weight models below ten billion parameters quantised to four bits, and two temperatures. The study establishes that action-level divergence exists and can pass unrecorded by the score, not that any rate generalises. Under the 8B model at temperature 0.7, all 43 ordering groups emit a different set of orders across five identical runs, 26 emit the order on some runs and not others, and 28 record a different coded value, dose or analyte. In 22 of those 43 the benchmark reports the same failing verdict for materially different behaviour, as it does for all 10 divergent groups of the 4B model at 0.7. Orders also reach different endpoints across runs, one of which the record server rejects while the agent is told it succeeded. These findings motivate repeated-run evaluation, action-level stability reporting and execution-faithful environment feedback in clinical-agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“同输入重跑”评估方法，研究临床智能体在完全相同输入下是否会产生一致的医疗订单，并揭示单次评分无法充分反映行动层面的不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有临床智能体基准通常只执行一次任务并依据最终得分判定表现，因而可能忽略同一输入下反复运行时订单内容、参数和执行结果的变化。对于能够开具检查、请求药物和提交转诊的智能体，这种行动层面的不一致具有实际评估意义，因此需要一种直接比较重复运行订单的可靠性评估框架。
AI.method: 引入“同输入重跑”（same-input rerun）：固定任务的全部输入，重复执行并比较各次产生的订单，而非仅比较基准得分。研究使用MedAgentBench的5个可写入任务类别中的50个任务，进行1000次运行；测试两个参数量低于10B、采用4-bit量化的开放权重模型，并设置两个温度。研究设计了6项可靠性指标，用于衡量订单集合、订单出现与否、编码值、剂量、分析物及执行端点等方面的差异。
AI.result: 研究证实行动层面的发散确实存在，且可能不被基准分数记录。在8B模型、温度0.7条件下，43个订单组均在5次相同输入运行中产生不同订单集合；其中26组在部分运行中产生订单、另一些运行中不产生，28组出现不同编码值、剂量或分析物。在这43组中，有22组虽然行为存在实质差异，却得到相同的失败 verdict；4B模型温度0.7下的10个发散订单组也全部出现相同失败 verdict。不同运行还可能将订单发送到不同端点，其中一个端点拒绝记录，但智能体仍被告知操作成功。结果仅证明该现象存在，不主张这些比例可推广至其他模型或任务。
AI.conclusion: 单次运行和单一任务得分不足以评估临床智能体的可靠性。临床智能体基准应采用重复运行，报告订单级稳定性，并提供忠实反映执行状态的环境反馈，避免智能体在实际未成功写入时误判为成功。

title: Asclepius: An Adaptive Harness for Long-Horizon Clinical Agents
summary: LLM agents are predominantly benchmarked on short, single-task trajectories, yet real deployments run for hours under contention, surfacing a different class of failures. We use the Clinical Environment Simulator (CES), in which an agent manages an entire emergency-department shift under continuous time and resource pressure, as a testbed: long-horizon execution failures manifest measurably in a single rollout under structured, multi-dimensional grading. On CES, current agents reach the correct diagnosis in most cases yet fail to deliver complete and timely critical actions, revealing an execution gap. We attribute this gap to three long-horizon failure modes, each operationalized as a per-trace counter: instruction-adherence drift, treatment incompleteness, and a severity-equity gap in timeliness. We then introduce Asclepius, an adaptive agent scaffolding with a self-evolving harness that rewrites the operating manual between shifts from trace-level feedback, an externalized clinical skills library for high-stakes regimen knowledge, and three isolated subagents that partition per-turn decisions across the patient queue. On held-out batches never observed during harness evolution, Asclepius improves critical-action correctness by 22% (p = 0.024) over a strong baseline agent framework while preserving diagnostic accuracy, with consistent gains across five LLM judges from three model families; on the full ten-batch set, improvements reach 25% on critical actions and 13% on timeliness. The three failure modes form a coupled bottleneck: decisive reductions appear only when all three components act together.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Asclepius 自适应智能体框架，用于解决医疗急诊环境中长时程任务的执行失败问题。基于 Clinical Environment Simulator（CES）的实验表明，智能体虽然通常能够作出正确诊断，但在关键行动的完整性和及时性方面存在明显缺陷。Asclepius 通过可自演化操作手册、外部临床技能库和按患者队列分工的三个隔离子智能体，显著提升关键行动正确率与及时性；结果显示，三类失败模式必须协同处理，才能形成稳定改进。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体主要在短时、单任务轨迹上进行评测，难以反映真实部署中持续数小时、资源受限且存在任务竞争的复杂场景。论文关注一个关键执行鸿沟：智能体可能能够正确诊断，但无法在规定时间内完整执行所有关键医疗行动。作者希望建立能够量化长时程执行失败的测试环境，识别主要失败模式，并设计针对性的智能体架构以提升连续任务执行能力。
AI.method: 论文使用 Clinical Environment Simulator（CES）模拟完整急诊班次，在连续时间压力、资源竞争和多患者队列条件下评估智能体。研究将长时程失败具体化为三类可按轨迹计数的指标：指令遵循漂移、治疗不完整性，以及与病情严重程度相关的及时性公平差距。提出 Asclepius 框架，包括：1）根据轨迹反馈在班次之间重写操作手册的自演化 harness；2）用于高风险治疗方案知识的外部临床技能库；3）三个相互隔离、分别处理患者队列中每轮决策的子智能体。实验在未参与 harness 演化的留出批次上进行，并由来自三个模型家族的五个 LLM 评审器进行评估。
AI.result: 在留出批次上，相较于强基线智能体框架，Asclepius 将关键行动正确率提升 22%，且具有统计显著性（p = 0.024），同时保持诊断准确率不下降。五个来自三个模型家族的评审器均观察到一致收益。在完整的十批次数据上，关键行动表现提升达到 25%，及时性提升 13%。消融或组合分析表明，三类失败模式构成耦合瓶颈，只有三个组件协同作用时，才能获得决定性的改进。
AI.conclusion: 长时程医疗智能体的主要问题并非单纯诊断能力不足，而是持续执行过程中的指令漂移、治疗遗漏和时间分配不均。CES 能够在单次完整轨迹中系统暴露并量化这些问题。Asclepius 通过自适应流程、外部知识支持和任务分解，有效弥合了诊断与关键行动执行之间的差距。研究说明，面向真实部署的智能体评测应超越短任务准确率，重点考察长时程、资源受限和多目标协同条件下的执行可靠性。

title: A Comprehensive Review of Multimodal Facial State Analysis: Tasks, Methods, and Resources
summary: Facial state analysis plays a crucial role in understanding human expressions, psychological modeling, and human computer interaction. Traditional unimodal vision-based methods are often limited by environmental sensitivity and weak interpretability. Multimodal facial state analysis addresses these issues by integrating complementary cues from visual, audio, textual, physiological, and other related modalities. This survey emphasizes two key aspects: on one hand, multimodal learning enables contextual semantic understanding for improved facial state reasoning and leverages interpretable language generation to enhance model explainability; on the other hand, multi-task learning allows simultaneous analysis of expressions, action units (AUs), and face-based soft biometrics (e.g., age, gender), effectively capturing fine-grained expressions and improving cross-scene generalization. This survey reviews core tasks, representative methods, and datasets in multimodal facial state analysis, focusing on facial expression recognition, AU detection, and face-based soft biometric estimation, and emphasizing the unique value of language in providing contextual semantics, enhancing reasoning, and generating explanations. The survey aims to provide an up-to-date overview of the literature and to highlight future research directions for multimodal, interpretable, and multi-task adaptive facial state analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于多模态面部状态分析的综述，系统总结视觉、音频、文本和生理信号等模态的融合方法，重点讨论表情识别、动作单元检测和面部软生物特征估计，并强调语言模态在语境理解、推理和可解释性生成中的作用。同时，文章关注多任务学习对细粒度分析和跨场景泛化能力的提升。
AI.motivation: 传统单模态视觉方法容易受到环境变化影响，且模型推理过程和结果解释能力有限。为提升面部状态分析的鲁棒性、语义理解能力和可解释性，有必要整合视觉、音频、文本及生理等互补信息，并联合建模表情、动作单元和软生物特征等相关任务。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，围绕多模态面部状态分析的核心任务、代表性方法和数据集进行归纳，重点分析多模态学习与多任务学习的作用。其中，多模态学习用于融合互补线索、引入上下文语义并生成解释；多任务学习用于联合进行面部表情识别、动作单元检测以及年龄、性别等面部软生物特征估计。
AI.result: 综述表明，多模态融合能够增强面部状态的上下文理解、推理能力和环境适应性，语言模态尤其有助于语义补充和可解释文本生成。多任务学习能够利用任务间的相关性捕捉更细粒度的面部状态，并有望提升跨场景泛化性能。文章同时梳理了相关任务、方法和数据集。
AI.conclusion: 多模态、可解释和多任务自适应将是面部状态分析的重要发展方向。未来研究应进一步探索高质量跨模态对齐、语言辅助推理、可靠解释、任务协同学习以及复杂场景下的泛化能力，从而构建更鲁棒、更细粒度且更具可解释性的面部状态分析系统。

title: Task-Aware Beamforming for Semantic Wireless Localization
summary: Many semantic localization tasks require determining a contextually meaningful region or state rather than minimizing the error of a full Cartesian position estimate. In such settings, aggregate localization accuracy need not align with the accuracy of the semantic decision. This paper develops a Cramér--Rao bound (CRB)-based framework that uses the local geometry of a known semantic map to guide uplink receive beamforming. Using local boundary crossing as a surrogate for semantic misclassification, we derive normal information maximization (NIM), which minimizes the CRB of the position component along the local semantic boundary normal. Under the considered single-path line-of-sight model, an optimal receive codebook can be restricted to the subspace spanned by the matched steering vector and its angular derivative, reducing the design to an allocation of measurement resources between matched and derivative spatial modes. We derive the resulting allocation for a general smooth boundary, with geofencing and intrusion detection arising as radial and tangential limiting cases. The framework is further extended to multi-region semantic maps through a distance-normalized minimax criterion and to uncertain prior locations through worst-case and prior-weighted robust formulations. Numerical results with finite-slot implementations and observation-level Monte Carlo simulations using profile maximum-likelihood (ML) estimation show that NIM allocates measurements according to the task-relevant boundary geometry and can substantially reduce semantic error relative to the classic squared position error bound (SPEB) design in the considered scenarios. The empirical results also closely follow the local CRB-based boundary-crossing approximation in the studied operating regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向语义定位任务的CRB波束成形框架：利用语义边界的局部几何结构，最大化边界法向信息，从而直接降低语义误分类概率，而非单纯优化笛卡尔位置均方误差。该方法称为法向信息最大化（NIM），并给出码本设计、资源分配及多区域和位置先验不确定场景下的鲁棒扩展。数值与蒙特卡洛结果表明，NIM在所研究场景中能显著降低语义错误。
AI.motivation: 传统定位设计通常以平方位置误差界（SPEB）或整体笛卡尔位置精度为目标，但语义定位真正关心的是是否跨越具有任务含义的区域边界，例如地理围栏或入侵检测边界。整体位置误差不一定与语义判决准确率一致，因此需要一种能够利用语义地图局部几何、直接优化任务相关位置分量的波束成形准则。
AI.method: 在已知语义地图和单径视距信道模型下，作者以局部语义边界穿越近似语义误分类，构造并最小化位置估计在边界法向方向上的Cramér--Rao下界，提出法向信息最大化（NIM）。理论上，最优接收码本可限制在匹配导向矢量及其角度导数张成的二维子空间中，因而将波束设计转化为匹配空间模态与导数空间模态之间的测量资源分配。作者进一步推导一般光滑边界下的分配方案，并将地理围栏和入侵检测视为径向、切向极限情形；同时针对多区域地图提出距离归一化的极小极大准则，并针对位置先验不确定性给出最坏情形和先验加权鲁棒设计。
AI.result: 有限时隙实现和基于观测的蒙特卡洛实验表明，NIM能够依据任务相关的语义边界几何分配测量资源。在所考察的场景中，相比经典SPEB设计，NIM可显著降低语义错误率。实验结果还与基于局部CRB的边界穿越近似保持较好一致，说明该近似在研究的工作区间内有效。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：语义定位的波束成形目标应从整体位置精度转向与语义边界判决直接相关的法向信息。NIM通过聚焦边界法向位置不确定性，在相同测量资源下有望获得优于SPEB的语义决策性能，并具备向多区域地图及不确定先验场景扩展的能力。

title: In the Blind: Building Pseudo-References for MT Evaluation
comment: Accepted at Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT) @ EMNLP 2026
summary: The WMT26 General MT task evaluates systems on 10 language pairs that have no human references (neither translated from scratch nor post-edited from MT output by humans). We describe how we built the pseudo-references for these pairs and six other language pairs (in which some forms of human references are available): seven models translate the 3,277 official documents under up to five prompt conditions, giving a total of 26 system-prompt combinations; then three reference-free quality estimation (QE) models score every candidate; and a per-document selector picks one translation, which GPT-5.5 post-edits where needed. Working without references exposed a failure mode of QE-guided selection: the metrics rank fluent output in the wrong language above correct translations. Adding a confidence-scaled language identification penalty to the score fusion drives the wrong-language count to zero, and the resulting selector still scores better on MetricX than the rank-fusion baseline it replaces. Since no references were available for these pairs while we were building them, we calibrate every selection decision on last year's WMT25 human judgments. The human evaluation, released after construction, shows the cost of getting selection wrong: our references stand with the strongest participating systems when the selector kept a frontier-model candidate, and fall up to 17 ESA points below them when it did not. We release the selection method and the provenance of every reference (https://github.com/surrey-nlp/PseudoRef)

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种为无人工参考译文语言对构建伪参考译文的方法：结合多模型、多提示翻译、无参考质量估计、语言识别惩罚和文档级选择，并使用后编辑修正候选译文。该方法解决了QE模型将流畅但错误语言的输出排在正确译文之前的问题；语言识别惩罚将此类错误降为零，且MetricX得分优于原有排序融合基线。人工评估表明，保留前沿模型候选时伪参考质量接近最强系统，否则质量最多下降17个ESA点。
AI.motivation: WMT26通用机器翻译任务中的10个语言对没有任何人工参考译文，传统依赖参考译文的系统评测和伪参考构建方法无法直接使用。因此，研究需要设计一种无需人工参考的候选生成与选择流程，同时降低无参考质量估计模型可能产生的错误排序，尤其是把流畅但使用错误语言的译文误判为高质量输出。
AI.method: 首先让7个模型在最多5种提示条件下翻译3,277份官方文档，形成26种模型—提示组合。随后使用3个无参考质量估计模型对所有候选进行打分，并进行文档级候选选择；必要时由GPT-5.5进行后编辑。针对QE模型偏好错误语言输出的问题，将带置信度缩放的语言识别惩罚加入分数融合。由于构建阶段没有当年人工参考，研究使用WMT25人工评审结果校准选择决策，并发布选择方法及每条参考译文的来源信息。
AI.result: 加入语言识别惩罚后，错误语言输出数量降为零；改进后的选择器在MetricX上的表现优于被替代的排序融合基线。事后发布的人工评估显示，当选择器保留前沿模型候选时，生成的伪参考译文质量可与最强参赛系统相当；当未保留此类候选时，质量最多低于这些系统17个ESA点。
AI.conclusion: 多模型候选、无参考QE、语言识别约束和必要的LLM后编辑可以有效构建无人工参考语言对的伪参考译文。研究同时证明，选择阶段是决定伪参考质量的关键环节，单纯依赖QE会产生严重的语言识别错误；引入显式语言惩罚能够显著提升可靠性，但选择器是否保留高质量前沿模型候选仍会对最终人工评价造成较大影响。

title: AutoTailor: Automatic, User-Aligned Capability Selection and Adaptation for Web Agents
summary: Web agents can utilize reusable tools to reduce the cost and latency of low-level browser interaction, but automatically discovered tool collections can be large, redundant, and poorly aligned with user demand. We present AutoTailor, a meta-agentic framework for constructing and maintaining a compact set of trajectory-derived Model Context Protocol (MCP) APIs. Offline, AutoTailor converts web trajectories into parameterized browser-automation programs, applies a Quality Filter to remove APIs with unsuitable granularity and redundant functionality, and applies a Usage Likelihood Filter to prioritize broadly useful capabilities while preserving semantic coverage. Online, Dynamic Reselection monitors task outcomes and API usage, identifies recurring coverage gaps, adds relevant candidates, and prunes persistently unused capabilities. We evaluate AutoTailor on 106 WebArena Postmill tasks. Offline filtering reduces the initial 1,283 unrefined APIs to 87, and Dynamic Reselection produces a 33-API set. With reasoning and acting (ReAct) fallback, this set achieves 90.6% correctness, compared with 87.5% for ReAct alone, while reducing average total request-token cost by 57.8% and latency by 29.4%. Without ReAct, it achieves 60.1% correctness, marginally matching the performance of unrefined set, while reducing request-token usage by 94.9%. Together, these results show that static filtering produces a compact inventory of APIs expected to support core, high-likelihood tasks, while dynamic reselection further tailors that inventory to observed user needs. This combination improves accuracy and latency while sharply reducing token usage and end-to-end cost, demonstrating the value of user-aligned capability management for efficient web agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AutoTailor，一种面向网页智能体的元智能体框架：从网页交互轨迹中自动构建、筛选并动态维护紧凑的 MCP API 集合。离线阶段将 1,283 个初始 API 压缩至 87 个，在线动态重选后形成 33 个 API；在 WebArena Postmill 的 106 个任务上，结合 ReAct 后达到 90.6% 正确率，同时请求 token 成本降低 57.8%、延迟降低 29.4%。
AI.motivation: 网页智能体可以通过可复用工具降低浏览器底层交互的成本与延迟，但自动发现的工具集合通常规模过大、功能冗余，并且与用户实际需求不匹配。这会增加模型选择工具和调用工具的负担，导致更高的 token 消耗、延迟和端到端成本。因此，本文旨在构建一个规模紧凑、功能覆盖合理、能够随用户需求动态调整的网页自动化 API 集合。
AI.method: AutoTailor 采用离线筛选与在线动态重选相结合的框架。离线阶段：1）将网页交互轨迹转换为参数化浏览器自动化程序，并生成 MCP API；2）通过 Quality Filter 删除粒度不合适及功能冗余的 API；3）通过 Usage Likelihood Filter 优先保留具有广泛实用性、同时维持语义覆盖的能力。在线阶段：Dynamic Reselection 监控任务结果与 API 使用情况，识别反复出现的能力缺口，加入相关候选 API，并删除长期未使用的 API，从而使工具集合适应实际用户需求。实验同时比较了带 ReAct 回退机制和不带 ReAct 的设置。
AI.result: 在 106 个 WebArena Postmill 任务上，离线筛选将初始的 1,283 个未精炼 API 减少至 87 个，动态重选进一步得到 33 个 API。结合 ReAct 回退时，AutoTailor 达到 90.6% 的正确率，高于仅使用 ReAct 的 87.5%；平均总请求 token 成本降低 57.8%，延迟降低 29.4%。不使用 ReAct 时，正确率为 60.1%，基本匹配未精炼 API 集合，同时请求 token 使用量减少 94.9%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，静态筛选能够构建覆盖核心及高概率任务的紧凑 API 库，动态重选则可以依据真实使用情况进一步调整能力集合。二者结合能够在保持或提升任务正确率的同时，显著降低 token 使用、延迟和整体成本，说明面向用户需求的能力管理是提升网页智能体效率的有效途径。

title: Sampling headroom is not selection gain: a compute-value audit of test-time scaling for video world models
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) can improve generation only when additional compute produces better candidates and the system can reliably identify them. This distinction is especially important for video world models, where a wider sample pool may contain stronger rollouts without improving the output that is ultimately selected. We introduce the Compute-Value Audit (CVA), a sequential framework that asks whether extra sampling creates opportunity, observable signals provide a reliable state, that state supports a beneficial action, and the resulting gain exceeds the full entry fee of generation and verification. On 192 Physics-IQ scenes, expanding the pool from 4 to 16 candidates increases oracle quality by +9.23 IQ (95% CI [+7.44, +11.14]), but Flow, Cycle, and VideoReward fail to recover this headroom reliably. Across three generators, none of twelve adaptive-depth policies outperforms uniform compute; they recover only 42-69% of the measured entry fee. A matched-60-NFE Predict-and-Perturb intervention on VideoPhy2 is likewise negative across three fresh-seed replicas. These negative results are not universal: anchor-explorer passes all four stages in a sparse PRM800K setting, MMLU-Pro exposes the gap between predictive state and useful action, and a privileged paired future establishes a positive video upper bound. Together, these results show that sampling headroom has deployment value only when it can be converted into a reliable decision whose benefit survives the complete compute charge. Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/sampling-headroom-is-not-selection-gain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Compute-Value Audit（CVA），系统审计测试时扩展计算是否真正带来部署收益。结果显示，增加候选样本确实提升了理论最优质量，但现有评分器和自适应计算策略难以可靠选出更优候选，且收益通常无法覆盖生成与验证的完整计算成本。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展计算的有效性不仅取决于能否生成更好的候选，还取决于系统能否识别并选择这些候选。对于视频世界模型，扩大采样池可能提升候选集合中的最优质量，却未必改善最终输出。因此，本文旨在区分“采样带来的潜在质量上限”和“可实际兑现的选择增益”，并评估额外计算是否值得其成本。
AI.method: 提出顺序式 Compute-Value Audit（CVA）框架，从四个阶段审查测试时扩展：额外采样是否创造机会、可观测信号是否形成可靠状态、该状态是否支持有益行动，以及最终收益是否超过生成和验证的完整成本。实验覆盖 192 个 Physics-IQ 场景、三种生成器、十二种自适应深度策略，并比较 Flow、Cycle、VideoReward 等评分方法；同时在 VideoPhy2 上进行匹配 60-NFE 的 Predict-and-Perturb 实验，在 PRM800K、MMLU-Pro 和特权配对未来设置中进行补充诊断。
AI.result: 将候选数从 4 增至 16 时，oracle 质量提高 9.23 IQ，95% 置信区间为 [7.44, 11.14]；但 Flow、Cycle 和 VideoReward 均无法稳定回收这部分潜在收益。三种生成器上的十二种自适应深度策略没有超过均匀分配计算量，实际仅回收测得进入成本的 42%–69%。VideoPhy2 上三组新随机种子的匹配 60-NFE Predict-and-Perturb 实验均为负结果。结果并非对所有任务都为负：稀疏 PRM800K 中的 anchor-explorer 通过了四个阶段，MMLU-Pro 显示预测状态与有用行动之间存在差距，特权配对未来则证明视频任务存在正向上界。
AI.conclusion: 测试时采样的潜在提升不能直接等同于部署收益。只有当额外样本能够被可靠评估、转化为有效决策，并且决策带来的质量增益超过生成与验证的全部计算成本时，测试时扩展才具有实际价值。本文因此主张在评价 TTS 方法时，应同时报告 oracle headroom、选择可靠性、行动收益和全成本净收益，而不能仅依据候选池质量或理论上限。

title: Zero-SNR Analyticity of the Scalar MMSE Is Equivalent to Gaussianity
summary:
Let $Y_s=\sqrt{s}X+Z$, where $Z$ is standard Gaussian and independent of the real random variable $X$. We prove that, under the square-exponential moment condition $\mathbb{E}e^{βX^2}<\infty$ for some $β>0$, the scalar minimum mean-square error $\operatorname{mmse}_X(s)$ is analytic at zero signal-to-noise ratio if and only if $X$ is Gaussian, with constant random variables included as degenerate Gaussians.
  The proof converts estimation in the Gaussian channel into a backward heat flow acting on the moment-generating function $M(z)=\mathbb{E}e^{zX}$. Under the stated tail condition, every non-Gaussian input forces $M$ to have a nonzero complex zero. We show that each zero cluster produces a finite singularity in its localized Borel transform at the action $ξ=z_0^2/2$. After removing the action scale, the Borel coefficients have a nonzero $n^{-1/2}$ prefactor for a simple zero. A zero of multiplicity $m\geq 2$ splits according to the roots of a Hermite polynomial and instead contributes a prefactor $n^{-m/2}e^{r_m\sqrt{2n}}$. A finite-disc localization and relative-cycle continuation argument then show that at least one such singularity survives in the full Borel transform. Thus, for every non-Gaussian input in the stated class, the formal zero-SNR expansion is Gevrey-1 but divergent. Rational-MMSE rigidity and the analogous analyticity criterion for mutual information follow as corollaries.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：在具有平方指数矩条件的输入中，标量高斯信道的 MMSE 在零信噪比处解析，当且仅当输入变量是高斯变量（包括常数这一退化情形）。对任意非高斯输入，零信噪比形式展开虽为 Gevrey-1，但必然发散。论文还将结论推广到有理型 MMSE 及互信息的解析性判据。
AI.motivation: 研究高斯信道中低信噪比展开何时真正收敛，以及解析性是否能够刻画输入分布的结构。此前相关展开通常只能形式化处理，论文试图揭示非高斯输入导致发散的复分析机制，并建立 MMSE 解析性与高斯性的刚性联系。
AI.method: 将高斯信道估计问题转化为作用于矩母函数 M(z)=E exp(zX) 的反向热流问题。在平方指数矩条件下，证明任意非高斯输入的矩母函数在复平面上存在非零零点。围绕这些零点进行局部化 Borel 变换分析：简单零点产生作用量 ξ=z_0^2/2 处的有限奇点，并伴随 n^{-1/2} 系数因子；m 重零点通过 Hermite 多项式根发生分裂，产生 n^{-m/2}exp(r_m√(2n)) 型因子。最后利用有限圆盘局部化和相对循环延拓，证明至少一个局部奇点不会在完整 Borel 变换中抵消。
AI.result: 证明了 MMSE 在零信噪比处解析当且仅当 X 为高斯变量，常数变量视为退化高斯。对非高斯输入，形式零信噪比展开是 Gevrey-1 的，但必然发散。论文还得到有理型 MMSE 刚性结论，并给出互信息解析性的相应判据。
AI.conclusion: 零信噪比处的解析性是高斯输入的特征性性质，而不是一般轻尾输入的普遍现象。矩母函数的复零点会在 Borel 平面中留下不可消除的有限奇点，从而导致非高斯情形的渐近展开发散。该结果建立了概率分布结构、估计理论和 Borel 奇异性之间的联系。

title: The University of Melbourne WMT 2026 CreoleMT Submission: A Domain-Balanced Approach to Low-Resource Pacific Creole Machine Translation
summary: For our submission to the WMT26 Creole Language Translation Shared Task, we focus on machine translation (MT) models for Pacific creoles: Tok Pisin, Bislama, and Solomon Pijin, with particular attention to broad domain performance. After pre-training on a large collection of domain-imbalanced data, we continue fine-tuning on a diverse mix of domain-balanced data.
