Existing top-K methods typically evaluate tokens independently and apply a uniform budget to all inputs, overlooking both selection-dependent interactions and variations in visual complexity across samples. In contrast, we propose StepPrune, which formulates visual-token pruning as an adaptive sequential decision process. Conditioned on previously selected tokens and textual context, StepPrune progressively constructs the retained subset and automatically determines its size through a learned STOP action. During training, a variance-preserving noise gate provides a differentiable surrogate for the discrete selection process, whereas during inference, unselected tokens are physically removed before language-model prefill. A grouped selection mechanism further extends StepPrune to high-resolution inputs. Experiments across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen2.5-VL, and InternVL3 show that StepPrune achieves the best average normalized performance retention across all evaluated pruning rates on LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and InternVL3, while remaining competitive on the substantially longer AnyRes prefixes of LLaVA-NeXT. On LLaVA-1.5, StepPrune retains 94.6% of the full-prefix normalized performance while pruning 88.9% of the visual tokens. At a mean retained count of 64, StepPrune reduces prefill latency from 59.95 ms to 40.05 ms, corresponding to a 1.50x prefill speed-up.

AI.tldr: StepPrune提出一种面向多模态大语言模型的自适应视觉Token剪枝方法，将剪枝建模为条件序列决策过程，并通过学习到的STOP动作动态决定保留Token数量。该方法在多个视觉语言模型上实现了较高的性能保持率与推理加速：在LLaVA-1.5上剪枝88.9%的视觉Token后仍保留94.6%的归一化性能，并在平均保留64个Token时实现1.50倍prefill加速。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉Token剪枝方法通常采用独立的Top-K评分，并对所有输入使用统一预算，无法建模Token之间的选择依赖关系，也无法适应不同样本的视觉复杂度差异。因此，需要一种能够基于已选Token和文本上下文进行逐步选择、并动态确定剪枝规模的方法，以在效率和性能之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.method: StepPrune将视觉Token剪枝形式化为自适应序列决策过程：模型在文本上下文和已选Token条件下逐步构建保留子集，并通过学习的STOP动作自动决定停止选择。训练阶段使用保持方差的噪声门控机制，为离散选择提供可微近似；推理阶段则在语言模型prefill前物理移除未选Token。针对高分辨率输入，方法进一步采用分组选择机制以扩展处理能力。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、Qwen2.5-VL和InternVL3上的实验表明，StepPrune在LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL和InternVL3的各剪枝率下取得最佳平均归一化性能保持率，在具有更长AnyRes前缀的LLaVA-NeXT上也保持竞争力。在LLaVA-1.5上，剪枝88.9%的视觉Token后仍保留94.6%的完整前缀归一化性能；平均保留64个Token时，prefill延迟由59.95 ms降至40.05 ms，实现1.50倍加速。
AI.conclusion: StepPrune证明了将视觉Token剪枝从静态、独立评分转化为条件式、序列化且可动态停止的决策过程，能够更有效地适配输入复杂度，并在较少视觉Token的情况下维持模型性能，同时带来实际的prefill延迟降低。

title: Neyshekar: An Open Persian Read-Speech Corpus for Automatic Speech Recognition
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures; dataset and code available at https://github.com/amirivojdan/neyshekar
summary: Neyshekar is presented as an open Persian read-speech corpus designed for coverage of both formal and informal language, named entities, and longer utterances. In version 6, 62,279 validated recordings totalling 99.02 hours are provided from 190 contributors, with 34,541 distinct recorded prompts. The prompt pool was assembled from human-written material, contextualised homographs, and reviewed language-model-generated text. Text entries were normalised with the shekar library, which supports both formal and informal Persian, and every submitted recording was reviewed against a common validation rubric. About 24% of released clips are classified as informal by an automatic classifier; these register labels are not human-validated. Item-level rater labels are provided for reproducible agreement estimation, opaque per-clip contributor identifiers make the speaker-disjoint partitioning auditable and support contributor-clustered uncertainty estimates, and a text-disjoint test subset is included for evaluation beyond previously seen prompts. Per-contributor recording load and reference-free signal quality are characterised for every released clip. Corpus characteristics are compared with Persian Common Voice under shared processing. Utility is assessed through two ASR architectures, three optimisation seeds, WER and CER, and independent evaluation on the public PSRB sample. Against duration-matched Common Voice training at approximately 32 hours, in-domain WER is reduced by 9.5 points for Whisper and 11.6 points for XLS-R, and by approximately eight points for both architectures on the independent PSRB sample. Transfer and mixture benefits are not consistently observed across architectures and training budgets. The corpus is released under CC0; code and data are made available through the project repository at https://github.com/amirivojdan/neyshekar.

AI.tldr: Neyshekar v6 是一个开放的波斯语朗读语音语料库，覆盖正式与非正式语体、专名和较长语句。它包含 62,279 条、约 99.02 小时的录音，来自 190 名贡献者，并通过严格验证、可审计的数据划分和多模型实验，证明其相较于时长匹配的 Persian Common Voice 具有更好的 ASR 训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有波斯语语音资源可能在语体覆盖、命名实体、长句、数据质量控制以及可复现实验设计方面存在不足。该工作旨在构建一个更全面、开放且经过系统验证的波斯语朗读语音语料库，同时提供 speaker-disjoint 和 text-disjoint 评测条件，以减少说话人或文本重叠造成的评估偏差，并检验语料库对自动语音识别的实际价值。
AI.method: 作者构建 Neyshekar v6，汇集人工撰写文本、带上下文的同形词以及经审核的语言模型生成文本；使用 shekar 库对文本进行规范化，以支持正式和非正式波斯语。所有录音依据统一标准进行人工审核，并提供逐条评分标签、匿名化贡献者标识、说话人不相交划分、文本不相交测试集、贡献者录音量统计和无参考信号质量指标。研究将其与 Persian Common Voice 进行统一处理后的比较，并采用 Whisper 与 XLS-R 两种 ASR 架构、三个优化随机种子、WER/CER 指标及独立 PSRB 测试集进行评估。
AI.result: 语料库包含 62,279 条有效录音、99.02 小时音频、190 名贡献者和 34,541 个不同提示文本；约 24% 的片段被自动分类为非正式语体，但该标签未经人工确认。与约 32 小时、时长匹配的 Common Voice 训练集相比，Neyshekar 在域内测试中使 Whisper 的 WER 降低 9.5 个百分点、XLS-R 降低 11.6 个百分点；在独立 PSRB 数据上，两种架构的 WER 均约降低 8 个百分点。跨域迁移和混合训练收益则受模型架构与训练规模影响，并未稳定出现。
AI.conclusion: Neyshekar v6 为波斯语 ASR 提供了规模较大、覆盖面更广、质量控制更透明且具有较强可复现性的开放语料库。实验结果表明，它在域内和独立测试中均明显优于时长匹配的 Persian Common Voice，尤其适合评估更稳健的波斯语语音识别系统。不过，自动语体标签的可靠性仍有限，且数据混合与迁移效果不稳定，后续工作可进一步进行人工语体标注、分析数据质量与模型架构的交互作用。

title: Dynamic Learning Solutions: A System for Personalized Educational Video Generation
summary: We present an automated pipeline that converts NCERT textbooks into interactive video explanations that respond directly to user queries. A user uploads a PDF and asks a question; the system then generates a video-based explanation as output, handling both text and visual elements from the PDF for multi-modal retrieval and response generation. The pipeline combines a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model with generative multimedia components. The RAG stage is optimized for the structure of NCERT textbooks and performs best on content from those books. Given a user query, the RAG model retrieves relevant content from the PDF and generates a multi-scene script containing narrative explanations and structured visual prompts aligned with the textbook's explanatory style. These prompts are passed to a Stable Diffusion module, implemented layer by layer for interpretability and control, which generates contextually relevant images. The images are then processed by DynamiCrafter to produce animated sequences. Finally, a Google Text-to-Speech module generates synchronized narration, aligning speech with the visual scenes through time-based control. The result is a coherent video explanation integrating animation, narration, and textbook-aligned visuals, transforming static educational material into an engaging learning experience. By combining multi-modal document retrieval, generative visual models, animation frameworks, and speech synthesis, this pipeline demonstrates a scalable approach to delivering interactive, personalized digital education content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个将NCERT教材PDF自动转换为可交互视频讲解的多模态生成流水线。系统通过RAG检索教材内容并生成分场景脚本，再结合Stable Diffusion生成图像、DynamiCrafter生成动画、Google Text-to-Speech生成同步旁白，最终输出与教材内容一致的视频解释，以提升数字化学习的互动性和个性化程度。
AI.motivation: 传统教材以静态文本和图像为主，难以针对学习者问题提供直观、动态且个性化的解释。本文旨在将教材内容自动转化为包含叙述、视觉展示、动画和语音的视频，降低人工制作教育视频的成本，并增强学习体验。
AI.method: 系统接收用户上传的NCERT教材PDF及问题。首先，针对NCERT教材结构优化的RAG模块执行文本与视觉内容的多模态检索，并生成包含叙述说明和结构化视觉提示的多场景脚本。随后，逐层实现Stable Diffusion以生成可解释、可控且符合教材语境的图像；利用DynamiCrafter将图像转化为动画序列；最后通过Google Text-to-Speech生成旁白，并利用时间控制机制实现语音与场景同步，整合为完整视频。
AI.result: 系统能够根据用户问题，从PDF中检索相关内容并生成教材风格一致的多场景视频解释，整合了动画、旁白和教材相关视觉素材。摘要表明，该RAG模块在NCERT教材内容上表现最佳，并展示了多模态检索、图像生成、动画生成和语音合成协同工作的可行性；但未提供定量指标、基线比较或用户实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线证明了将静态教材自动转化为交互式、个性化视频教育内容的可扩展性。其主要贡献在于打通教材检索、脚本生成、视觉生成、动画制作和语音同步流程。不过，论文结论的实证强度仍受限于摘要中缺乏具体性能评估、泛化能力分析和教育效果验证。

title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation
summary:
Natural interaction in digital and physical environments requires continuous perception and timely responses. Spoken dialogue relies on acoustic and linguistic cues, while video interaction also requires grounding the conversation in evolving visual context. We present Realtime-Venus, a proactive full-duplex interaction system with two separately trained 9B models: Realtime-Venus-Omni for audio-visual interaction and Realtime-Venus-Audio for spoken interaction. Each model serves as a complete conversational frontend, integrating continuous perception, conversational control, and native speech generation through a shared causal timeline for user inputs, model outputs, and delegation events.
  A dual-loop runtime coordinates live interaction with background reasoning and tool execution. Foreground interaction continues while Realtime-Venus-Harness executes tasks asynchronously and returns results for integration into the ongoing dialogue.
  Both models follow a common post-training recipe combining offline understanding, proactive full-duplex trajectories, and delegation workflows.
  Among the evaluated online models, Realtime-Venus-Omni achieves the highest scores on six of eight video benchmarks, including StreamingBench (70.2%), OVO-Bench (64.7%), and Daily-Omni (81.3%). Across eight audio understanding and spoken question answering benchmarks, Realtime-Venus-Audio leads the compared models on MMAU (78.0%), MMAU-Pro (63.2%), Llama Questions (83.8%), and Speech CMMLU (67.8%), while matching the best VoiceBench AlpacaEval score of 4.81. On Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5, Realtime-Venus-Audio responds to 75% of user interruptions and achieves continuation rates of 97%, 88%, and 86% under backchannels, other-directed speech, and background speech, respectively, exceeding Gemini 3.1 Live and GPT-4o on all three continuation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Realtime-Venus，一个面向实时、主动式、全双工交互的系统，分别通过 9B 音频视觉模型和音频模型实现持续感知、对话控制、原生语音生成及异步任务委派；实验显示其在多项视频、音频理解和全双工交互基准上达到领先或竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统通常以轮次式交互为主，难以持续感知环境、处理用户打断、结合动态视觉上下文，并在对话不中断的情况下执行后台任务。本文旨在构建能够同时支持实时感知、自然对话、主动响应和异步工具调用的统一交互系统。
AI.method: 系统包含两个分别训练的 9B 模型：Realtime-Venus-Omni 用于音频视觉交互，Realtime-Venus-Audio 用于语音交互。两者均整合持续感知、对话控制和原生语音生成，并通过共享因果时间线统一用户输入、模型输出与任务委派事件。运行时采用双循环架构：前台维持实时交互，后台由 Realtime-Venus-Harness 异步执行推理和工具任务，再将结果融入当前对话。训练采用统一后训练流程，结合离线理解、主动式全双工轨迹和任务委派流程。
AI.result: Realtime-Venus-Omni 在 8 个视频基准中的 6 个取得最高分，例如 StreamingBench 70.2%、OVO-Bench 64.7%、Daily-Omni 81.3%。Realtime-Venus-Audio 在 8 个音频理解与语音问答基准中的 MMAU、MMAU-Pro、Llama Questions 和 Speech CMMLU 上领先，得分分别为 78.0%、63.2%、83.8% 和 67.8%，并在 VoiceBench AlpacaEval 上以 4.81 分追平最佳结果。在 Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5 中，该模型响应 75% 的用户打断；面对附和语、对他人讲话和背景讲话时，继续对话率分别为 97%、88% 和 86%，三项指标均超过 Gemini 3.1 Live 和 GPT-4o。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，Realtime-Venus 能够有效融合连续多模态感知、全双工对话和异步任务执行，在视频理解、音频理解及抗打断交互方面具有较强竞争力。其双循环运行机制和统一时间线为构建更自然、持续且具任务执行能力的实时交互系统提供了可行方案。

title: TATK: Triple-Aware Top-K Learning with Knowledge-Grounded Verification for LLM-based Sequential Recommendation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 23 pages, including references and appendix
summary: LLM-based sequential recommenders usually cast next-item prediction as text generation, but this interface is poorly matched to full-catalog top-K ranking. We propose TATK, a Triple-Aware framework that couples Top-K Learning (TKL) with Knowledge-Grounded Verification (KGV) for LLM-based sequential recommendation. Top-K Learning combines context-aware metadata-KG prompt grounding with position-aware top-K rewards, aligning training with ranking utility; Knowledge-Grounded Verification then applies structure-aware reranking over the top-M candidates after a single LLM forward pass, using the same metadata-derived item graph. We evaluate TATK on Musical Instruments, CDs and Vinyl, and Video Games from Amazon Reviews 2023 under a matched R2ec-style full-catalog protocol. Experiments use Gemma-2-2B-It and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct backbones, compare against sequential, generative, KG-augmented, and reasoning-enhanced baselines, and include component, reward-shape, sequence-perturbation, reranking, relation-quality, and candidate-pool diagnostics. TATK improves over the matched R2ec reproduction on all 36 reported metrics. On NDCG@10, it improves Qwen by 8.05%, 4.26%, and 3.78% on the three datasets, and improves Gemma by 27.03%, 10.52%, and 10.23%, while keeping inference within 1.17x of Base RecPO latency. The diagnostics show that structural evidence is most useful for recoverable top-M candidates with reliable KG support, and should be gated when metadata relations are sparse or noisy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TATK，用于改善基于大语言模型的序列推荐在全目录Top-K排序上的适配性。方法由Top-K Learning和Knowledge-Grounded Verification组成：前者通过元数据知识图谱提示与位置感知奖励优化训练，后者在一次LLM前向计算后利用同一项目图对Top-M候选进行结构感知重排序。实验表明，TATK在三个Amazon Reviews 2023数据集、两种LLM骨干和36项指标上均优于匹配的R2ec复现基线，同时推理延迟仅为Base RecPO的1.17倍以内。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的序列推荐通常将下一物品预测建模为文本生成，但文本生成接口与全目录Top-K排序目标不匹配，可能导致训练目标和实际排序效用之间存在偏差。此外，知识图谱信息虽可辅助推荐，但元数据关系可能稀疏或含噪，需要一种能够利用可靠结构证据并进行条件控制的方法。
AI.method: TATK包含两个协同模块。第一，Top-K Learning（TKL）将上下文感知的元数据知识图谱提示与位置感知的Top-K奖励结合，使训练过程更直接地优化排序位置和Top-K效用。第二，Knowledge-Grounded Verification（KGV）在单次LLM前向传播得到Top-M候选后，基于同一元数据派生的项目图执行结构感知重排序，从而利用候选之间的知识关系进行验证与调整。实验采用Musical Instruments、CDs and Vinyl、Video Games三个Amazon Reviews 2023数据集，以Gemma-2-2B-It和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct为骨干，并在匹配的R2ec式全目录协议下，与序列式、生成式、知识图谱增强式和推理增强式基线比较；同时开展组件、奖励形状、序列扰动、重排序、关系质量及候选池诊断实验。
AI.result: TATK在全部36项报告指标上均超过匹配的R2ec复现结果。NDCG@10方面，Qwen在三个数据集上的提升分别为8.05%、4.26%和3.78%；Gemma的提升分别为27.03%、10.52%和10.23%。推理延迟控制在Base RecPO的1.17倍以内。诊断实验表明，结构证据对那些原本可恢复且具有可靠知识图谱支持的Top-M候选最有效；当元数据关系稀疏或噪声较大时，应采用门控机制限制其影响。
AI.conclusion: TATK证明，将面向Top-K排序的训练目标与知识图谱驱动的候选验证结合，能够有效弥合LLM文本生成与全目录推荐排序之间的接口错配，并在较小推理开销下提升推荐质量。其效果依赖知识图谱关系的可靠性，因此实际部署中应根据结构证据质量进行选择性重排序或门控。

title: Question's Gambit: The First Move Matters in Agentic Deep Search
summary: Deep research agents answer complex questions through iterative loops of searching, reading, and reasoning. Recent work on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as BrowseComp-Plus shows that well-configured lexical retrieval can surface high-quality evidence, yet agents may still fail to connect documents carrying evidence to the gold documents. We identify a deep research agent's first retrieval move as an important design decision for this setting. We introduce Question's Gambit, a first-move retrieval module that decomposes the question into a set of clues, reformulates them into complementary searches, consolidates the retrieved results, and reranks the candidate pool before the agent begins its iterative search-and-reasoning process. This produces an opening context designed to support both clue aggregation and final-answer verification. We further evaluate on MultiHop-RAG to test whether these benefits transfer beyond BrowseComp-Plus to a more conventional multi-hop question structure. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus show that Question's Gambit improves retrieval recall and downstream agent accuracy over strong baselines, improving answer accuracy from 83.1% to 90.5% with gpt-5.5 over Pi-Serini, the strongest reported agentic baseline. Our results confirm that effective agentic deep research depends not only on the tools available inside the loop, but also on the quality of the first move. We published our implementation publicly at https://github.com/radinhamidi/Question-s-Gambit.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Question's Gambit：在深度研究智能体开始迭代检索前，先将问题拆解为多个线索，生成互补查询，汇总并重排序检索结果，以构造更适合线索聚合和答案验证的初始上下文。该方法在 BrowseComp-Plus 上将使用 gpt-5.5 的答案准确率从 Pi-Serini 的 83.1% 提升至 90.5%，并在 MultiHop-RAG 上检验跨任务迁移性。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体通常依赖搜索、阅读和推理的迭代循环。现有研究表明，即使词法检索能够找到高质量证据，智能体仍可能无法把包含局部证据的文档与最终答案所需的关键文档连接起来。论文因此关注智能体的第一次检索行动，认为初始检索结果的质量会显著影响后续证据整合和答案验证。
AI.method: 提出 Question's Gambit，作为智能体进入迭代搜索与推理前的首步检索模块。该模块首先将复杂问题分解为多个线索，然后将线索改写为互补的搜索查询；接着汇总各查询得到的检索结果，构建候选文档池，并进行重排序，形成支持线索聚合与最终答案核验的初始上下文。方法在 BrowseComp-Plus 上进行主要评估，并在 MultiHop-RAG 上测试其对常规多跳问答结构的迁移能力。
AI.result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，Question's Gambit 相较强基线提升了检索召回率和下游智能体准确率。使用 gpt-5.5 时，其答案准确率由最强已报告的智能体基线 Pi-Serini 的 83.1% 提升至 90.5%，绝对提升 7.4 个百分点。论文还报告了在 MultiHop-RAG 上的评估，以考察方法是否能超越 BrowseComp-Plus 的任务分布。摘要未提供 MultiHop-RAG 的具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 深度研究智能体的性能不仅取决于迭代循环中的工具和推理能力，也取决于第一步检索是否能够建立覆盖多条线索、便于后续验证的高质量初始上下文。Question's Gambit 说明，优化首步检索是提升复杂问题回答效果的重要设计方向。

title: Beyond OCR Accuracy: Text-Centric VQA Under Image Degradation with Modular and End-to-End
summary: Text-centric Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reading and reasoning over text embedded in images, a task made substantially harder when images suffer from real-world degradation such as motion blur, low resolution, or compression artifacts. While modular OCR-based pipelines and end-to-end vision-language models are both widely used for this task, their comparative robustness under degraded conditions remains underexplored. We present an empirical study comparing two modular pipelines with SA-DBNet, a custom detector architecture combining ResNet-18 with self-attention spatial modeling and deformable convolutions against an end-to-end vision-language baseline, evaluated on 4013 degraded images with 7000 question-answer pairs. Fine-tuned modular pipelines achieve up to 57.50% exact-match accuracy versus 38.00% for the end-to-end baseline, with domain-specific fine-tuning yielding a gain of up to 29.50 percentage points. Critically, we find that conventional OCR error metrics like Character Error Rate and Word Error Rate are unreliable predictors of downstream VQA performance, as semantic reasoning can compensate for recognition failures when contextual cues are present. These findings highlight the importance of task-aware evaluation for text-centric VQA systems under realistic visual conditions. Codes are available here

AI.tldr: 本文研究退化图像条件下文本中心视觉问答（Text-centric VQA）的系统鲁棒性，比较基于OCR的模块化流程与端到端视觉语言模型，发现经过领域微调的模块化方法整体表现更优，且传统OCR指标不能可靠预测VQA效果。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中的图像常受到运动模糊、低分辨率和压缩伪影等退化影响，使文本检测、识别及后续问答推理均更困难。现有研究虽然广泛采用模块化OCR流程和端到端视觉语言模型，但对二者在退化条件下的相对鲁棒性缺乏系统比较；同时，字符错误率（CER）和词错误率（WER）是否能够反映最终VQA性能也尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者开展实证比较研究，构建并使用包含4013张退化图像和7000组问答对的评测数据。实验比较两种模块化OCR流程与一个端到端视觉语言基线。模块化流程采用定制的SA-DBNet文本检测器，该架构结合ResNet-18、自注意力空间建模和可变形卷积，并进一步考察领域特定微调的影响。评价指标包括VQA精确匹配准确率，以及CER、WER等OCR指标与下游问答性能之间的关系。
AI.result: 经过微调的模块化流程最高达到57.50%的精确匹配准确率，而端到端基线为38.00%。领域特定微调带来最高29.50个百分点的性能提升。研究还发现，CER和WER与下游VQA表现之间缺乏可靠对应关系：即使OCR存在识别错误，模型仍可能利用上下文线索完成语义推理并正确回答。
AI.conclusion: 在真实退化视觉条件下，经过任务或领域适配的模块化OCR-VQA流程可能比端到端基线更具鲁棒性。文本识别质量不应仅依据CER或WER评估，VQA系统需要采用面向任务的综合评价方式，直接考察识别结果对最终语义问答性能的贡献。

title: Disentangling Topology and Diversity in Multi-Agent LLMs for Multilingual Low-Resource Emotion Detection
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 25 tables. Accepted at the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/eracoding/topologyxdiversity
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems combine multiple inference calls, but prior work often confounds how calls are connected with how they are diversified. We study these factors independently: inference topology and source of inter-agent diversity. In a controlled $2 \times 3$ matrix, we cross parallel aggregation and sequential refinement with stochastic sampling, role prompting, and learned QLoRA specialization, under a fixed three-call budget and output protocol within each backbone. Using Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we evaluate all six configurations on multilingual low-resource emotion detection across nine languages. Parallel learned specialization is strongest on Qwen at 52.83 Macro-F1 and reaches 52.94 on Llama. On Qwen it also exceeds same-backbone zero-shot, few-shot, CoT, and seven-call self-consistency baselines. The preferred topology depends on diversity source: sequential refinement helps stochastic and prompted settings, while the learned Width advantage shrinks from 2.83 points on Qwen to 0.17 on Llama. Depth-wise analysis suggests that later learned specialists can overwrite correct early predictions, although the aggregate effect is backbone-dependent. Overall, how agents are differentiated produces larger performance shifts than topology, which should be evaluated jointly with specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文在固定三次调用预算下，系统比较多智能体LLM的两类推理拓扑（并行聚合、顺序精炼）与三类智能体多样性来源（随机采样、角色提示、QLoRA学习专门化），并在九种语言的低资源情感检测任务上进行2×3实验。结果表明，智能体如何实现差异化通常比调用拓扑带来更大的性能变化；并行学习专门化在两个骨干模型上表现最佳，但拓扑优劣取决于多样性来源和模型骨干。
AI.motivation: 以往多智能体LLM研究往往将“智能体如何连接”（推理拓扑）与“智能体如何产生差异”（多样性来源）混为一谈，因此难以判断性能提升究竟来自协作结构还是智能体专门化方式。本文旨在控制调用次数和输出协议，独立分析这两个因素及其交互作用，并检验结论在不同模型骨干和多语言低资源场景中的稳定性。
AI.method: 构建2×3受控实验矩阵：推理拓扑包括并行聚合与顺序精炼；多样性来源包括随机采样、角色提示和基于QLoRA的学习式专门化。每种配置均使用固定三次推理调用预算和统一输出协议，并在Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上测试。任务为九种语言的低资源情感检测，同时与同骨干零样本、少样本、思维链及七次调用的自一致性基线比较；此外开展深度方向分析，以考察后续智能体对早期预测的影响。
AI.result: 并行学习式专门化表现最强：Qwen上的Macro-F1为52.83，Llama上达到52.94。在Qwen上，该方法还超过同骨干的零样本、少样本、思维链和七次调用自一致性基线。拓扑效果依赖多样性来源：随机采样和角色提示更适合顺序精炼；学习式专门化更偏向并行聚合。并行学习式专门化相对另一拓扑的优势在Qwen上为2.83个百分点，在Llama上仅为0.17个百分点。深度分析显示，后加入的学习式专门化智能体可能覆盖早期的正确预测，但总体影响受骨干模型影响。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统中，智能体差异化方式通常比推理拓扑造成更大的性能波动，因此二者不应被孤立评估。并行学习式专门化在本文设置下具有较强表现，但不存在对所有多样性来源和骨干模型都普遍最优的拓扑；后续研究应联合考察拓扑、专门化机制、模型骨干及误差传播。

title: Safety Signals to Verify NetOps Agents with Action-Level Granularity
summary: Agentic Network Operations (NetOps) are an emerging paradigm promising to enable workload-aware, self-adjustable, and reliable autonomous networks. While agents have proven their value in incident summarization and telemetry signal extraction, their effectiveness as autonomous control-loop engines heavily relies on their long-horizon reliability. One such setting is the datacenter fabric, where an agent must respond to alarms and operator intents while abstaining from high-risk actions that may cause or extend downtime. Abstention, however, presupposes that an action's impact is known pre-execution, which necessitates a per-action ground truth that NetOps agent benchmarks do not provide. We construct such a ground truth for the network repair task of NetArena. A symbolic replay of the emulated network, validated against the environment at every turn, yields the exact value of every action. From the action-level value, we derive two pre-execution targets, namely whether an action reduces the repair distance (progress) and whether it increases it (harm). We show across 10 agent models, that agent verifiers leveraging internal signals predict both harm and progress more reliably than a baseline using observable signals only. Perspectively, we aim to use these signals as safety feedback to an agent harness to abstain from risky actions and protect the target system.

AI.tldr: 本文面向数据中心网络运维中的自主修复，构建动作级真实标签，并验证基于代理内部信号的验证器能否在执行前预测动作是有益还是有害，从而支持高风险动作的主动拒绝。
AI.motivation: Agentic NetOps 要实现可靠的自主控制，关键在于长时程决策的安全性。数据中心网络修复代理需要响应告警和运维意图，同时避免可能引发或延长宕机的高风险操作。然而，动作拒绝机制要求在执行前预知动作影响，而现有 NetOps 代理基准缺少逐动作的真实价值标签，因此难以系统评估代理是否能够识别进展与风险。
AI.method: 针对 NetArena 的网络修复任务，作者对仿真网络进行符号回放，并在每一步与环境状态进行校验，从而获得每个动作的精确价值。基于动作级价值，定义两个执行前预测目标：动作是否缩短修复距离（progress），以及是否增加修复距离（harm）。随后在 10 个代理模型上评估代理验证器，比较使用代理内部信号的方法与仅使用可观测信号的基线方法在预测进展和危害方面的表现。
AI.result: 在 10 个代理模型上，利用代理内部信号的验证器对动作危害和修复进展的预测可靠性均优于仅依赖可观测信号的基线。摘要未提供具体数值、置信区间或统计显著性结果。
AI.conclusion: 逐动作真实标签能够为 NetOps 自主修复的安全评估提供基础。代理内部信号具有较强的执行前风险识别能力，未来可将其作为安全反馈接入代理控制框架，使代理在采取高风险操作前主动拒绝，从而降低对目标网络系统的潜在损害。

title: Semantic Privacy Protection with Utility Preservation for 3D Point Clouds
summary: Point cloud data face serious semantic privacy risks during acquisition, transmission, and cross-institutional sharing. Existing methods mostly rely on geometric perturbation or destructive encryption, which can reduce the recognizability of the original class but often impair downstream usability. This paper proposes a class-transfer-based semantic encryption framework for point clouds, aiming to conceal original class information while preserving task utility and supporting authorized recovery. Specifically, we construct a unified latent space with a shared-backbone Normalizing Flow, and combine LoRA and FiLM to achieve parameter-efficient class-conditional adaptation. We further introduce diffusion-guided flow alignment to regularize the latent distribution, construct an energy-based category transition graph, and obtain an optimal class-transfer table through global matching. Then, a latent-space Neural ODE continuously evolves source-class latents into target-class latents, which are decoded into target-class point clouds through the inverse flow. We adopt attacker-oriented metrics, including New-Class Recognition Rate (NCRR), Original-Class Leakage Rate (OCLR), and Original Label Recovery Rate (OLRR), to evaluate privacy and utility. Experiments on classification and segmentation benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves controllable semantic transformation, effectively reduces original-class semantic leakage, preserves downstream learnability in the protected domain, and supports reliable authorized reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向点云的基于类别迁移的语义加密框架，在隐藏原始类别信息的同时保持下游任务可用性，并支持授权恢复。方法通过共享骨干的归一化流构建统一潜空间，结合LoRA与FiLM进行参数高效的类别条件适配，引入扩散引导的流对齐、基于能量的类别迁移图、全局匹配得到类别迁移表，再利用潜空间Neural ODE完成源类别到目标类别的连续迁移，最后通过逆流解码生成目标类别点云。实验表明，该方法可降低原类别泄漏，保持受保护域中的分类与分割能力，并支持可靠重建。
AI.motivation: 点云在采集、传输和跨机构共享过程中存在严重的语义隐私风险。现有几何扰动或破坏性加密方法虽然能够削弱原始类别的可识别性，但通常会损害数据质量和下游任务性能，且难以兼顾隐私保护、任务可用性与授权恢复。因此，论文旨在设计一种可控的语义变换式加密方法，在隐藏原始类别的同时保留点云的任务价值，并允许合法用户恢复原始语义。
AI.method: 首先，使用共享骨干的Normalizing Flow构建统一潜空间，并结合LoRA和FiLM实现参数高效的类别条件适配。其次，引入扩散模型引导的流对齐机制，以约束和规整潜变量分布；构建基于能量的类别迁移图，并通过全局匹配获得最优类别迁移表。随后，利用潜空间Neural ODE将源类别潜变量连续演化到目标类别潜变量，再通过逆向流解码为目标类别点云。评估方面采用攻击者视角指标，包括新类别识别率（NCRR）、原类别泄漏率（OCLR）和原标签恢复率（OLRR），分别衡量保护域可识别性、原语义泄漏和标签恢复风险，同时结合分类与分割任务评估实用性。
AI.result: 在分类和分割基准上的实验显示，该方法能够实现可控的点云语义类别变换，有效降低原始类别语义泄漏，并保持保护域中的下游学习能力。此外，方法支持较为可靠的授权重建，说明其在隐私性、可用性和可恢复性之间取得了较好的平衡。摘要未提供具体数据集、数值结果或与各基线方法的定量对比，因此无法进一步判断提升幅度和统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 本文将点云隐私保护从几何扰动和破坏性加密拓展到潜空间语义类别迁移，形成了兼顾隐私保护、下游可用性和授权恢复的统一框架。核心贡献在于将归一化流、参数高效适配、扩散引导对齐、类别匹配和Neural ODE迁移结合起来，并使用攻击者导向指标进行评估。总体而言，该方法具有较强的可控性和应用潜力，但其安全性仍需通过更强攻击者、跨数据集泛化、计算开销及授权密钥管理等实验进一步验证。

title: Domain-specific Pretraining Profile and Transformer Performance: Evidence from Modeling Digital Pragmatics in Arabic-English Code-switching
summary: This study highlights the role of domain-specific pretraining profile (DSPP) in Transformer performance for modeling digital pragmatics in Arabic-English code-switched discourse. It evaluates MARBERT and XLM-R(oBERTa), with BERT serving as a general-purpose baseline. The models were evaluated on their ability to classify context-sensitive pragmatic functions in code-switched social-media discourse. 11695 unique X posts were collected via Python and utilized for the study. The study employs a quantitative and qualitative NLP approach, following a supervised pipeline. Findings unveil that MARBERT consistently surpasses XLM-R with validation Macro F1 increasing from 0.39 to 0.84 and validation loss decreasing from 0.55 to 0.19. On an independent test set, it achieved 0.96 accuracy, 0.83 macro precision, 0.87 macro recall, and 0.85 Macro F1, while XLM-R achieved 0.92 test accuracy but a substantially lower Macro F1 of 0.52. This was also supported by class-level performance where MARBERT outperforms XLM-R considerably with F1 improvements ranging from +0.33 to +0.60, demonstrating a clear advantage in modeling Arabic digital pragmatics. The study concludes that Transformer performance depends more on DSPP than multilingual coverage alone, as the latter does not guarantee optimal performance on a highly specialized pragmatic classification task.

AI.tldr: 研究比较MARBERT、XLM-R和BERT在阿拉伯语—英语代码转换社交媒体语篇数字语用功能分类中的表现。结果显示，具有阿拉伯语领域特定预训练特征的MARBERT显著优于XLM-R，说明领域特定预训练比单纯扩大多语言覆盖更关键。
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往强调多语言模型的语言覆盖范围，但在阿拉伯语—英语代码转换的数字语用任务中，通用多语言能力未必能充分捕捉语境依赖、文化相关和领域特定的语用现象。因此，本文旨在检验领域特定预训练配置（DSPP）是否比多语言覆盖更能决定Transformer模型在该任务上的性能。
AI.method: 研究收集了11,695条独立的X平台帖子，采用定量与定性结合的自然语言处理方法，并构建监督式分类流程。模型包括面向阿拉伯语预训练的MARBERT、多语言模型XLM-R，以及作为通用基线的BERT；研究根据验证集和独立测试集上的准确率、宏平均精确率、宏平均召回率、Macro F1和损失等指标，评估模型对代码转换社交媒体语篇中语境敏感语用功能的分类能力。
AI.result: MARBERT在验证集上的Macro F1由0.39提升至0.84，验证损失由0.55降至0.19。独立测试集上，MARBERT取得0.96准确率、0.83宏平均精确率、0.87宏平均召回率和0.85 Macro F1；XLM-R虽达到0.92准确率，但Macro F1仅为0.52。类别层面，MARBERT相较XLM-R的F1提升幅度为0.33至0.60，显示出更稳定且更均衡的分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在阿拉伯语数字语用这一高度专业化的代码转换任务中，领域特定预训练比单纯的多语言覆盖更能决定Transformer的有效性。多语言能力本身并不保证优异表现，模型是否针对目标语言、语域和任务特征进行预训练同样关键。

title: When does a scaling result justify a different allocation? A critical review of resource-allocation evidence for AI systems
summary: AI scaling studies increasingly evaluate systems that combine a pretrained model with retrieval, search, verification, tools, and interaction. Yet a higher score under a larger budget does not by itself show where additional resources are best spent. This critical integrative review asks when a reported scaling result supports a resource-allocation decision. It compares evidence across pretraining, test-time computation, retrieval, and agent evaluation, distinguishing the performance of a tested procedure from the best performance achievable under a resource limit. The synthesis shows that three mismatches recur across this evidence: success counted before an answer is chosen, information a deployed system will not have, and costs left out of the comparison. A capability surface expresses performance as a function of budgets, mechanisms, and available information. Worked analytical examples show how the evaluation metric, deployment volume, selection rule, and stopping policy can alter an allocation conclusion. A resource envelope provides a structured record of the task, development and run-time resources, information access, and procedure behind a reported score. Its application to a published comparison illustrates which conclusions the evidence supports and which deployment questions remain unresolved. The resulting framework specifies the comparisons needed to choose among feasible systems and motivates experiments on the transfer of allocation rules across tasks and operating conditions. It does not propose a universal scaling law or infer general intelligence from benchmark gains.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于AI扩展研究与资源分配决策的批判性综合综述。文章指出，单纯观察更大资源预算带来的更高得分，无法说明额外资源应投入预训练、测试时计算、检索、工具调用还是智能体交互。作者提出“能力曲面”和“资源包络”框架，用于明确性能、资源、信息可得性及执行程序之间的关系，并判断现有证据究竟支持哪些部署结论。
AI.motivation: 现有AI扩展研究通常报告资源增加与性能提升之间的关系，但这些结果未必能直接指导实际系统中的资源配置。核心问题包括：评测是否在最终答案选定前就统计成功；评测过程中是否使用了部署阶段不可获得的信息；不同方案的真实成本是否被完整纳入比较。因此，本文旨在弥合“性能扩展结果”与“资源分配决策”之间的证据缺口。
AI.method: 本文采用批判性整合综述方法，比较预训练、测试时计算、检索和智能体评测等方向的证据。分析区分了两类概念：在特定资源下已测试程序的表现，以及给定资源限制下理论上可达到的最优表现。作者提出能力曲面，将性能表示为预算、机制和可用信息的函数；同时提出资源包络，用结构化方式记录任务、开发资源、运行时资源、信息访问权限和具体执行程序。文章还通过分析性示例考察评测指标、部署规模、答案选择规则和停止策略如何改变资源配置结论，并以一项已发表的比较研究展示该框架的应用。
AI.result: 综述发现，现有证据中反复出现三类不匹配：在答案确定前统计成功，导致评测结果与实际决策流程不一致；使用部署系统无法获得的信息，造成不现实的性能估计；遗漏或不完整计算成本，使资源方案之间的比较失真。分析示例表明，评测指标、部署数量、选择机制和停止策略均可能改变“应将资源投入何处”的结论。资源包络能够帮助识别已发表结果能够支持的结论，以及尚未解决的部署问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文认为，可靠的资源分配决策需要在相同任务、信息条件、选择规则、停止策略和完整成本口径下比较可行系统，而不能仅依据更大预算对应的更高基准分数。能力曲面和资源包络为此提供了统一分析框架。文章不提出普适性扩展定律，也不试图从基准性能提升推断一般智能；其后续方向是研究资源分配规则能否跨任务和运行条件迁移。

title: DiVA: Enabling Interactive Digital Life Simulation via Video Models
summary: We present DiVA, a deeply interactive digital life simulator pioneering a new paradigm for long-term, open-ended interactive experiences within digital character worlds. DiVA's architecture pairs a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as a router with a meticulously designed stacked video pipeline for seamless, multi-turn interactions with action and audio response. To maintain continuity and avoid degradation, we model generation as a three-part coupled system: waiting video, action video, and the transitions between them. These transitions are critically handled by our Anchored Video Continuation (AVC) module, which returns the character to stable states to prevent degradation. By encoding information from the preceding action video segment, AVC ensures smooth transitions, significantly reducing camera jitter and inconsistencies common in current video transition methods. This design also enables complex pose changes (e.g., sitting to standing) typically difficult for audio-driven models. These system designs together ensure high-fidelity identity, coherence, and dynamics for extended experiences. To validate our pipeline design, we comprehensively compare our system against alternatives by replacing our core generation module with mainstream long-video, continuation, and interpolation methods. We further analyze the necessity of the three-stage design, anchor-state selection, transition naturalness, spatial grounding, and the quality-latency trade-off, and we expand the comparison to additional long-form audio-driven avatar models. Results confirm DiVA is markedly superior in maintaining long-term visual quality and realism, validating its effectiveness as a sustainable, interactive simulation.

AI.tldr: DiVA提出一种面向长期、开放式交互数字角色世界的数字生命模拟系统：利用多模态大语言模型进行交互路由，并通过等待视频、动作视频和过渡视频组成的三阶段耦合生成架构，结合锚定视频延续模块（AVC）维持角色身份、视觉连贯性与动作稳定性。实验表明，DiVA在长期视觉质量、真实感、过渡自然性和复杂姿态变化方面优于多种主流替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动角色和长视频生成方法在长时间交互中容易出现身份漂移、画面退化、镜头抖动、空间不一致以及动作过渡不自然等问题，尤其难以处理复杂姿态变化。论文旨在构建一种可持续运行、支持多轮交互且能保持长期视觉一致性的数字角色模拟系统。
AI.method: 系统采用MLLM作为交互与动作路由器，并将视频生成建模为等待视频、动作视频及二者之间过渡的三部分耦合过程。核心AVC模块利用前一段动作视频的信息，将角色恢复到稳定的锚定状态，从而生成平滑过渡并抑制镜头抖动和内容退化。论文还通过替换核心生成模块，与长视频生成、视频延续、视频插值及长时音频驱动虚拟角色方法进行比较，并开展三阶段设计、锚定状态选择、过渡自然性、空间定位和质量—延迟权衡等消融与分析。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，DiVA在长期视觉质量、角色身份保持、时序连贯性、动态表现和真实感方面明显优于对比方法。AVC能够减少过渡阶段的镜头抖动与不一致，并支持坐下到站立等音频驱动模型通常难以完成的复杂姿态转换。分析还验证了三阶段架构、锚定状态机制和空间定位设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DiVA证明了通过MLLM路由与三阶段视频耦合生成相结合，可以实现更稳定、连贯且可长期运行的交互式数字角色模拟。AVC是维持跨动作片段连续性和降低长期生成退化的关键组件，使系统具备更好的开放式交互和可持续体验能力。

title: CompCQR: Compositional Query Generation for Training-Free Conversational Search
summary: Multi-turn interactions with LLMs are becoming increasingly common in information-seeking scenarios. However, user queries are often ambiguous and context-dependent, making them ill-suited for direct use as retriever queries. Conversational query reformulation (CQR) addresses this issue by rewriting the current utterance into a stand-alone query grounded in the dialogue history. Recent LLM-based CQR approaches achieve strong performance; however, their repeated LLM invocations and misalignment with downstream retrievers remain challenges. In this work, we begin from the observation that retrievers are highly sensitive to content ordering: simply reordering the same content can lead to changes in retrieval coverage and performance. Based on this, we propose a novel training-free method that generates a very large number of queries with minimal LLM usage by compositionally combining a small set of atomic components. We further apply LLM reasoning to construct a high-quality document set that balances precision and recall while capturing the user's core intent. Our framework generalizes across both open- and closed-source LLMs as well as dense and sparse retrievers. It achieves strong performance on four widely used conversational benchmarks, with up to 22.5% relative MRR improvement over the previous state-of-the-art baseline with far fewer LLM calls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的对话式查询重构框架：利用少量原子组件组合生成大量查询，并借助大语言模型构建兼顾精确率与召回率的高质量文档集合，从而以更少的LLM调用提升对话检索性能。该方法在四个对话检索基准上取得了显著效果，最高较此前最优基线实现22.5%的相对MRR提升。
AI.motivation: 多轮信息检索中的用户话语通常存在歧义且依赖上下文，不能直接作为检索器查询，因此需要对话式查询重构。现有基于大语言模型的方法虽然性能较强，但存在重复调用成本高、与下游检索器不匹配等问题。此外，检索器对查询内容的排列顺序高度敏感，即使内容相同，仅改变顺序也可能影响检索覆盖率和性能。
AI.method: 提出一种训练免费的方法。首先，将少量原子组件进行组合，以极少的LLM调用生成大量不同的查询，利用内容顺序变化提升检索覆盖范围。其次，使用LLM进行推理，构建能够平衡精确率与召回率、同时保留用户核心意图的高质量文档集合。该框架可兼容开源和闭源LLM，以及稠密和稀疏检索器。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的对话检索基准上取得强劲表现；相较此前最优基线，MRR最高提升22.5%，且所需LLM调用次数显著更少。方法在不同类型的LLM和检索器上均具有较好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用检索器对内容顺序的敏感性，并结合组合式查询生成与LLM辅助文档构建，可以在不进行额外训练的情况下，以更低的LLM调用成本有效提升对话式检索性能。该结果表明，查询多样性和高质量候选文档集合是缓解CQR与下游检索器错配的重要途径。

title: Beyond Scene Description: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Non-visual Access to Virtual Worlds
summary: Virtual worlds now host classrooms, meetings, conferences, shops, and social venues, and nearly every interaction they expose assumes a user who can scan a three-dimensional scene, follow avatars, and read floating panels. Blind and visually impaired (BVI) users are left with assistive tools that each solve one task in isolation: naming an object, reading text, describing a scene, or planning a route. A live virtual room defeats that model: obstacles, speakers, gestures, chat, slides, and notifications arrive together, and a tool that narrates all of them trades a visual barrier for an auditory one. This paper presents MetaBlind, an architecture that distributes nonvisual access across eight specialized agents, spanning perception, navigation, social and object interaction, communication, safety and trust, memory, and personalization, and that places an Accessibility Orchestrator between those agents and the user. Agents publish candidate information into a shared accessibility context instead of speaking to the user directly. The orchestrator scores each candidate on safety relevance, goal relevance, urgency, confidence, user relevance, and estimated listening load, then releases only the items it judges relevant at that moment through speech, structured audio, or haptic output. We give the selection step a formal statement, specify the orchestration cycle as an algorithm, and define an evaluation protocol against a single-agent assistant. MetaBlind is reported at the design stage, with no prototype measurement or user study, and the protocol states which outcomes would support the design and which would refute it.

AI.tldr: MetaBlind提出一种面向虚拟世界盲人及视障用户的多智能体无障碍访问架构。系统由八类专职智能体和一个无障碍编排器组成，通过共享无障碍上下文汇聚候选信息，再依据安全性、目标相关性、紧迫性、置信度、用户相关性与听觉负载进行筛选，以语音、结构化音频或触觉方式输出。论文目前停留在设计阶段，尚无原型测量或用户研究，主要贡献是架构、形式化选择机制、编排算法及可证伪的评估方案。
AI.motivation: 现有辅助工具通常只解决单一任务，例如物体识别、文字朗读、场景描述或路径规划，难以应对虚拟房间中障碍物、发言者、手势、聊天、演示文稿和通知同时出现的复杂情境。若将所有信息连续播报，又会造成听觉过载。因此，需要一种能够整合多源信息、根据用户当前目标和风险动态筛选信息的无障碍访问机制。
AI.method: 提出MetaBlind多智能体架构，包含覆盖感知、导航、社交与物体交互、通信、安全与信任、记忆、个性化等功能的八类专职智能体。各智能体不直接向用户播报，而是将候选信息发布到共享无障碍上下文中。无障碍编排器按照安全相关性、目标相关性、紧迫性、置信度、用户相关性和预计听觉负载对候选信息评分，并决定通过语音、结构化音频或触觉反馈输出哪些内容。论文还形式化了选择步骤，给出了编排循环算法，并设计了与单智能体助手对比的评估协议。
AI.result: 论文报告的是设计结果，而非实证结果。当前没有原型测试、性能测量或用户研究，因此尚不能证明MetaBlind能够降低认知或听觉负担、提升导航与交互效率，或优于单智能体方案。其主要产出是系统架构、信息选择模型、算法描述和评估指标/实验协议；同时明确列出支持或证伪该设计的预期结果。
AI.conclusion: MetaBlind试图以多智能体协作和集中式信息编排，解决虚拟世界中非视觉信息过载问题。其核心价值在于把“信息生成”与“信息呈现”分离，并让输出受用户目标、风险和听觉负载约束。不过，由于尚未实现原型和开展用户研究，论文结论应限定为概念性设计主张，架构的有效性、可用性、实时性、公平性以及对不同视障用户的适应能力仍需通过后续实证评估验证。

title: TotalSynth: Robust Whole-Body Synthetic CT from MRI and CBCT
summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate TotalSynth, a reusable pretrained framework for whole-body synthetic CT (sCT) generation from MRI and cone-beam CT (CBCT) images. Materials and Methods: In this retrospective technical study, the dataset was assembled between 2020 and 2026 from SynthRAD challenge data, four prostate cohorts, and BIC-MAC. After registration quality control, 1450 of 1800 public challenge pairs were retained; 350 were excluded for insufficient registration quality or major source/CT mismatch. The corpus also included 84 additional prostate MRI/CT and 60 external BIC-MAC MRI/CT cases. Three 5-fold model families were evaluated with image-domain, anatomy-aware, registration-based, and uncertainty metrics. Age and sex were not consistently available across public datasets. Results: The released MRI-to-CT model achieved an overall MAE of 67.49 HU, SSIM of 0.920, and PSNR of 29.28 dB. The CBCT-to-CT model achieved an overall MAE of 53.55 HU, SSIM of 0.939, and PSNR of 32.09 dB. The unified model maintained similar performance on MRI inputs (MAE, 67.68 HU) and CBCT inputs (MAE, 54.22 HU). On external BIC-MAC data, MRI-to-CT MAE was 100.91 HU without fine-tuning and 62.21 HU after fine-tuning. Conclusion: TotalSynth provides reusable MRI- and CBCT-based CT synthesis models with broad anatomical coverage, while external evaluation highlights the need for local validation and optional fine-tuning under domain shift.

AI.tldr: TotalSynth是一个面向全身MRI/CBCT到CT合成的可复用预训练框架，覆盖多解剖部位并结合图像、解剖、配准和不确定性指标进行评估。MRI-to-CT与CBCT-to-CT均取得较好内部性能，但外部数据上的性能下降显著，微调后明显改善，说明域偏移和本地验证是临床应用的关键问题。
AI.motivation: 现有合成CT方法通常针对单一解剖部位或单一输入模态，泛化能力、跨数据集复用性以及对MRI和CBCT的统一支持有限。本文旨在建立一个具有广泛解剖覆盖范围的预训练框架，并系统评估其在不同数据来源、输入模态和外部域上的稳定性。
AI.method: 研究汇集SynthRAD挑战赛数据、4个前列腺队列和BIC-MAC外部数据。经过配准质量控制后，保留1450/1800个公共挑战赛配对样本，并加入84例额外前列腺MRI/CT病例和60例BIC-MAC MRI/CT病例。研究评估了三类5折模型族，包括MRI-to-CT、CBCT-to-CT及统一模型，并采用图像域指标（MAE、SSIM、PSNR）、解剖感知指标、配准指标和不确定性指标进行评价，同时测试外部数据上的直接迁移与微调效果。
AI.result: MRI-to-CT模型总体MAE为67.49 HU、SSIM为0.920、PSNR为29.28 dB；CBCT-to-CT模型MAE为53.55 HU、SSIM为0.939、PSNR为32.09 dB。统一模型在MRI输入上的MAE为67.68 HU，在CBCT输入上的MAE为54.22 HU，接近专用模型。外部BIC-MAC数据上，MRI-to-CT的MAE由未微调时的100.91 HU降至微调后的62.21 HU，显示明显的域偏移及微调收益。数据还存在年龄和性别信息不完整的问题。
AI.conclusion: TotalSynth实现了面向MRI和CBCT输入、具有较广解剖覆盖范围的可复用CT合成框架。其内部测试性能较好，统一模型未明显牺牲两种输入模态的表现；但外部数据上的性能下降表明模型对数据分布、扫描协议和配准质量较为敏感。临床部署前应进行本地验证，并根据需要开展域适配或微调。

title: Optimizing Sparse Outcomes Through Dense Behavioral Signals via Value-Guided Preference Distillation
summary: Aligning multi-turn dialogue agents is usually framed as matching turn-level human preferences, yet direct optimization of long-term outcomes is often ineffective and prone to reward hacking. We formulate long-horizon dialogue optimization as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and train a multi-head value model that predicts a vector of observed user behaviors across multiple look-ahead horizons. Our findings demonstrate that a scalarized composite of dense auxiliary behavioral signals enables effective credit assignment and optimization of sparse outcomes. However, optimizing unconstrained single-objective proxies might induce policy degradations that are harmful when the agent is exposed to real users. To identify these failure modes prior to deployment, we establish a safety framework combining counterfactual user simulation with a validated dialogue-level outcome model to evaluate preference weightings and policy optimization methods. Finally, we demonstrate that distilling multi-objective value preferences into the policy via reference-anchored preference optimization matches on-policy online RL at a small fraction of its compute budget. Live A/B testing confirms that our distilled policy significantly improves long-term user retention, while simultaneously enhancing the positive behaviors and therapeutic-process markers.

AI.tldr: 本文将多轮对话的长期优化建模为多目标强化学习问题，利用多头价值模型预测不同前瞻时域的用户行为，并通过辅助行为信号改善稀疏长期结果的信用分配。研究还提出结合反事实用户模拟和经验证的对话结果模型的安全评估框架，用于部署前识别策略退化与奖励投机风险；最终将多目标价值偏好蒸馏到策略中，在显著降低计算成本的同时取得接近在线强化学习的效果，并提升长期用户留存及积极行为指标。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮对话智能体通常优化单轮人类偏好，难以直接有效地优化长期用户结果，且容易出现奖励投机。直接优化长期稀疏奖励还可能导致策略在真实用户环境中退化，因此需要同时解决长期信用分配、代理目标失真和部署前安全评估问题。
AI.method: 1. 将长期对话优化形式化为多目标强化学习。2. 训练多头价值模型，预测多个前瞻时域上的用户行为向量。3. 将密集的辅助行为信号标量化组合，以支持稀疏长期结果的信用分配与优化。4. 通过反事实用户模拟和经过验证的对话级结果模型，评估偏好权重及策略优化方法的潜在失败模式。5. 使用参考策略锚定的偏好优化，将多目标价值偏好蒸馏到策略中，并与在线强化学习进行比较。
AI.result: 标量化的多目标辅助行为信号能够有效支持长期稀疏结果的优化。安全框架可以在部署前识别无约束单目标代理可能造成的策略退化。策略蒸馏方法以较低计算成本达到接近在线强化学习的效果。在线A/B测试显示，蒸馏策略显著提升长期用户留存，同时改善积极行为和对话过程相关指标。
AI.conclusion: 多目标价值建模、反事实安全评估与参考锚定偏好蒸馏相结合，为多轮对话智能体的长期对齐提供了一种兼顾效果、效率和安全性的方案。研究表明，合理设计并约束辅助目标，比直接优化单一长期代理目标更可靠；蒸馏还可显著降低在线强化学习的计算开销。

title: OptoAgent: A Trustworthy Multi-Agent Framework for Opportunistic Vision Micro-Screening in Classroom Environments
summary: A child with reduced distance vision often does not know that anything is wrong. Children adapt, move closer, and rarely report the difficulty, so the problem can survive years of schooling before an adult notices. School screening addresses part of this, but it runs on a schedule, depends on staffing, and is separated from the classroom moments where the difficulty appears. Smartphone and web-based acuity tests have widened access, yet every one of them still needs somebody to start a test. We present SightSentinel, an architecture that turns a wall display a child already reads from into a recurring screening site. Ordinary educational content carries short calibrated optotype probes, and eight specialized agents divide the work. Perception agents recover viewing distance, recognition accuracy, approach behavior, gaze stability, response latency, and interocular difference from each encounter. A quality agent discards observations taken under bad geometry, poor lighting, or inattention. A longitudinal agent accumulates only the surviving evidence against the child's own baseline, and an orchestrator reports a Vision Concern Score routed through a safety gate whose output range excludes diagnosis, refraction, prescription, and reassurance. The design question is whether many cheap, noisy, well-gated encounters can reach a referral decision that one scheduled test reaches late or misses. We state the formulation, the architecture, a four-stage validation protocol against clinical reference standards, and the conditions under which the approach should be rejected.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SightSentinel：将教室中的墙面显示设备转化为持续、被动触发的儿童视力筛查场景，通过日常教育内容中嵌入校准视标，并由八类智能代理分析观看距离、识别准确率、接近行为、注视稳定性、反应延迟和双眼差异等信息。系统经过质量控制和纵向基线比较后输出 Vision Concern Score，仅用于转介提示，不进行诊断、验光、处方或排除性 reassurance。摘要主要提出系统架构、验证方案和拒绝使用条件，尚未报告实证结果。
AI.motivation: 儿童远视力下降往往缺乏自我察觉和主动报告，可能在多年学习后才被发现。传统学校筛查具有定期开展、依赖人员和场景脱离课堂等局限；现有手机及网页视力测试虽然提高了可及性，但仍需要成人主动启动。因此，本文旨在探索能否利用儿童日常观看的教室显示屏，通过多次、低成本、低干扰且经过质量控制的观察，较早识别需要转介的视力异常风险。
AI.method: 提出 SightSentinel 多智能体架构。系统将短时、校准的视标探测嵌入普通教育内容；八类专门代理分别估计观看距离、识别准确率、接近屏幕行为、注视稳定性、反应延迟和双眼差异等特征。质量代理排除几何条件不佳、光照不足或注意力不集中的观测；纵向代理仅将合格数据与儿童自身基线进行累积比较；编排器生成 Vision Concern Score，并通过安全门限制输出范围，明确禁止诊断、屈光测量、配镜处方和 reassurance。摘要还规划了一个分四阶段、以临床参考标准为对照的验证协议，并预设系统应被拒绝或停止使用的条件。
AI.result: 摘要未提供实际实验结果、样本量、统计指标、灵敏度、特异度或与临床标准比较的具体数值。当前可确认的成果是完成了问题形式化、系统架构设计、验证流程设计及适用边界定义。因缺少验证数据，尚不能判断该方法是否真正达到或超过一次性定期筛查的转介性能。
AI.conclusion: SightSentinel 的核心贡献是把视力筛查从定期、主动启动的单次事件，转化为嵌入课堂显示环境的持续纵向风险监测。其安全设计强调质量控制、个体基线和不作诊断性结论，理论上有助于降低漏检并提前触发转介。但该摘要目前更接近系统设计与验证计划，而非已完成的临床验证研究；其有效性、误报与漏报风险、不同年龄和环境下的泛化能力，以及隐私、可接受性和运营成本，都需要后续实证确认。

title: Event-Level Emotion Recognition in the Wild Using Deep Facial Expression Analysis
comment: The paper has been submitted to IEEE conference
summary: Facial emotion recognition (FER) in real-world environments remains challenging due to unconstrained imaging conditions, including multiple faces, occlusions, pose variations, and complex lighting. Most existing studies focus on individual facial emotion classification and do not address the analysis of collective emotional states at the event level. This paper proposes an end-to-end pipeline for event-level emotion recognition from photographs. The approach detects faces in each image, classifies facial expressions using a deep convolutional neural network, and aggregates face-level emotion probabilities to estimate the overall emotional distribution of a public event. A comparative evaluation of several CNN architectures on the FER- 2013 and RAF-DB datasets demonstrates that transfer learning with EfficientNet-B2 trained on RAF-DB is more suitable for real-world RGB data. The proposed method is evaluated on a real-world event dataset containing 1658 images. Experimental results show stable emotion distributions across event subsets, confirming the effectiveness of event-level aggregation for emotion analysis in the wild.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向真实场景公共事件照片的端到端群体情绪识别流程：先检测人脸，再利用深度卷积神经网络分类面部表情，最后聚合个体情绪概率，估计事件整体情绪分布。实验表明，在FER-2013和RAF-DB上进行迁移学习的EfficientNet-B2更适合真实世界RGB图像；在包含1658张图像的事件数据集上，所得情绪分布在不同子集间较稳定，验证了事件级聚合方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现实环境中的面部情绪识别受到多人同框、遮挡、姿态变化和复杂光照等非受控成像条件影响。现有研究主要关注单个人脸的情绪分类，较少分析公共事件层面的群体整体情绪状态，因此需要一种能够从真实活动照片中推断事件级情绪分布的方法。
AI.method: 构建端到端事件级情绪识别流程：1）在每张图像中检测人脸；2）使用深度卷积神经网络进行面部表情分类；3）聚合所有人脸的情绪概率，估计公共事件的整体情绪分布。比较多种CNN架构在FER-2013和RAF-DB数据集上的表现，并采用在RAF-DB上迁移学习训练的EfficientNet-B2处理真实世界RGB图像；随后在包含1658张图像的真实事件数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 架构比较结果显示，基于RAF-DB迁移学习的EfficientNet-B2更适合真实场景RGB数据。事件数据集实验表明，不同事件子集得到的情绪分布较为稳定，说明个体情绪概率聚合能够有效支持野外场景下的事件级情绪分析。摘要未报告具体分类指标、基线数值或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，将人脸检测、表情分类与概率聚合结合起来，可以从复杂真实环境的照片中进行事件级群体情绪识别。该方法弥补了单人脸情绪分类与公共事件整体情绪分析之间的空缺，并表现出一定的稳健性和实际应用潜力。

title: The Garden of Forking Prompts: How Users Explore Narrative Space in Story Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have changed the way people engage with stories. Drawing on public chatbot logs, we can see that when users generate stories, they iteratively edit their prompts to explore narrative possibilities, adjusting characters, redirecting plots, and swapping fictional universes. As aggregated data, these prompts represent rich traces of creative preference at scale. Yet story generation evaluation benchmarks rely on static, one-shot prompts that cannot capture this exploratory behavior. In this work, we study how users revise consecutive story prompts in the wild. Using a dataset of naturally occurring user-chatbot conversations, we construct WildStories, a sample of 275,635 story generation prompts (labeled with story format, prompt components, and explicitness), and WildEdits, a collection of 24,291 edit trees that model how users iteratively edit base story prompts and explore branching story possibilities. From these trees we develop a framework of edit types crossing four directions (adding, removing, changing, and extending) with fourteen targets (e.g., plot, character, genre). We then use our datasets and this framework to analyze user behavior in navigating narrative space via LLMs. Finally, we show how automated permutations based on the framework can be used for story generation benchmarking. Content Warning: This paper works with "wild" chatbot logs, which often include toxic and sexually explicit themes.

title: AI Deployment Accountability Engineering: A Vision for Accountable AI in Safety-Critical Socio-Technical Systems
comment: Appeared in ACM AI Summit 26, Atlanta, GA as a vision paper
summary:
Artificial intelligence systems are rapidly becoming critical components in healthcare, finance, public services, and other safety-critical domains. Yet the engineering practices used to evaluate these systems remain predominantly model-centric, emphasizing properties such as accuracy, robustness, fairness, and interpretability before deployment. These properties are necessary but insufficient once an AI system operates within an ever changing socio-technical environment characterized by distribution shifts, institutional constraints, human feedback loops, privacy requirements, and interactions among multiple AI agents.
  This vision paper introduces AI Deployment Accountability Engineering (ADAE), a proposed AI engineering subdiscipline concerned with establishing measurable, continuous, and actionable accountability for deployed AI systems. ADAE treats accountability as a deployment-layer property rather than solely as a property of an individual model. It seeks to determine whether an AI-enabled system continues to operate within acceptable risk limits, identify the contexts in which failures emerge, attribute failures across interacting technical and human components, translate technical failures into downstream consequences, and support timely intervention.
  We articulate a research agenda built around four interconnected pillars: structured discovery of context-dependent failure modes, privacy-preserving accountability measurement, system-level risk analysis for agentic AI, and translation of technical failures into operational, and institutional risks. The broader goal is to establish foundational principles, mathematical tools, and system architectures for accountable AI deployment across safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“AI部署问责工程”（AI Deployment Accountability Engineering, ADAE）这一新的AI工程子领域，主张将问责性从单一模型属性提升为部署层面的系统属性，并围绕持续监测、失效归因、风险传导和及时干预建立研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估主要以模型为中心，关注准确率、鲁棒性、公平性和可解释性等部署前属性，但在真实的安全关键场景中，AI系统会受到数据分布变化、制度约束、隐私要求、人类反馈回路以及多智能体交互的共同影响。单独评估模型无法回答系统部署后是否仍处于可接受风险范围、失败发生于何种情境、责任如何在技术与人为组件间分配，以及技术故障如何演变为运营和制度风险。因此，本文旨在填补部署后、系统级、持续性问责工程的研究空白。
AI.method: 本文是一篇愿景/研究议程论文，提出ADAE的概念框架，并将其研究内容组织为四个相互关联的支柱：1）结构化发现依赖具体情境的失效模式；2）隐私保护的问责性测量；3）面向具有自主行动能力AI的系统级风险分析；4）将技术失效转化并连接到运营风险和制度风险。论文进一步主张发展相应的基础原则、数学工具与系统架构，以支持部署中的持续评估、失效归因、后果分析和干预决策。
AI.result: 作为愿景论文，本文不报告具体实验、数据集、基准或定量结果。其主要产出是提出ADAE这一概念性研究方向，明确了部署层问责的核心问题、分析对象和四项优先研究任务。预期成果包括可测量且持续的问责指标、跨技术与人为组件的失效归因方法、隐私保护机制，以及面向多智能体和安全关键应用的系统级风险分析框架。
AI.conclusion: 本文认为，安全关键领域的AI治理不能停留在部署前的模型属性评估，而应建立面向真实运行环境的持续、可操作、系统级问责机制。ADAE通过关注情境化失效、隐私保护测量、多智能体系统风险以及技术风险向运营和制度后果的传导，为构建可监测、可归因、可干预的AI部署工程提供了总体研究方向。

title: Physically Typed and Geometry-Aware Representations for Earth Foundation Models
summary: Earth-observation (EO) foundation models have become exceptionally effective at learning se mantic, high-dimensional geospatial embeddings, while modern weather and climate models have demonstrated that Earth-specific geometry, spherical operators, meshes, and hybrid physical solvers can materially improve prediction. Yet these two advances are not equivalent. A conventional latent embedding has no inherent physical transformation law, whereas scalar fields, tangent polar-vector fields, axial/pseudovector quantities, covectors, and higher-order tensors transform differently under rotations, reflections, and changes of local coordinate frame. This proposal asks whether a general purpose Earth foundation model should preserve those distinctions explicitly, or whether standard embeddings plus augmentation already learn everything that matters. The central contribution is therefore not a more complicated architecture by assumption, but a staged falsification program. A compute-conscious ERA5 dry run first compares conventional, augmentation-matched, typed equivariant, and Hodge/Helmholtz variants under spatial, temporal, orientation, and low-data shifts. Only if explicit geometric typing yields reproducible improvements does the program advance toward a multimodal Earth foundation model in which semantic embeddings coexist with physically typed fields. The proposed gap is narrower and more defensible than claiming that current models ignore geometry entirely: several systems already respect spherical domain geometry, and emerging work explicitly learns scalar/vector fields on spheres. The unresolved question is whether foundation-scale, multimodal, parity-aware field typing produces practical gains beyond those existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该提案研究地球观测基础模型是否应显式区分标量场、极向量场、轴向/伪向量、协向量及高阶张量等几何类型，而不是仅依赖普通嵌入与数据增强。研究采用分阶段、可证伪且注重计算成本的方案：先在ERA5上比较常规模型、增强匹配模型、类型等变模型和Hodge/Helmholtz模型，若显式几何类型在多种分布偏移和低数据场景下带来可重复收益，再扩展到多模态地球基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有地球观测基础模型擅长学习语义和高维地理嵌入，但普通潜在嵌入没有固有的物理变换规律；不同物理量在旋转、反射和局部坐标变换下具有不同的变换性质。与此同时，天气与气候模型已表明球面算子、网格和物理求解器能够改善预测。因此，核心动机是检验显式几何类型是否能为基础模型带来超越普通嵌入、数据增强及已有球面几何方法的实际收益。
AI.method: 开展分阶段消融与证伪实验。第一阶段使用ERA5进行计算成本可控的对照实验，比较四类方案：常规模型、与其增强策略严格匹配的基线、显式类型等变模型，以及结合Hodge/Helmholtz分解的模型。评估空间分布偏移、时间分布偏移、方向变化、低数据条件等场景。只有当显式几何类型带来稳定且可复现的改进时，才进入第二阶段，构建融合语义嵌入与物理类型场的多模态地球基础模型。
AI.result: 摘要未报告已完成的定量结果，因为这是一项研究提案。预期结果是明确判断显式几何类型在不同任务和分布偏移下是否具有可重复的增益，并区分其收益究竟来自几何建模本身，还是来自数据增强、模型规模或其他因素。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将研究问题限定为一个较窄且可检验的科学问题：在已有球面几何和球面场建模工作的基础上，面向基础模型规模的、多模态且考虑宇称的场类型建模，是否能产生实际性能收益。其主要贡献在于严谨的阶段式验证框架，而非预设更复杂架构必然更优。

title: One Feedback System Does Not Fit All: Localising Data-to-Text Driver Coaching for the United Kingdom and Nigeria
summary: Data-to-text driver coaching is often presented as a generic pipeline from telematics events to advice. This paper argues that its content requires localisation because usefulness and credibility depend on drivers' knowledge, prevalent risks, regulation, infrastructure, and available data. Two independently developed systems in the United Kingdom and Nigeria are compared by tracing requirements through content selection, generation, and field evaluation. The UK system prioritises post-trip reflection, explanations tied to road and place context, and tone-sensitive wording. The Nigerian system combines legally grounded, once-daily Tips based on detected events with weekly persuasive Reports; it foregrounds safety education and alcohol-related risk in response to reported gaps in formal training and traffic-rule knowledge, as well as local road-safety priorities. Reliable speed-limit metadata supported speeding feedback in the UK, whereas its scarcity led the Nigerian evaluation to exclude speeding from its outcome metric. Both interventions were associated with reduced distance-normalised unsafe-event rates in their own field studies, although their designs and metrics preclude an effect-size comparison. The analysis yields a requirements-to-content design process for localising safety-critical NLG without treating a high-income deployment as the default.

AI.tldr: 本文比较英国与尼日利亚两套数据到文本驾驶辅导系统，论证安全关键型自然语言生成（NLG）必须依据本地知识、风险、法规、基础设施和数据条件进行本地化，而不能默认采用高收入国家方案。两项干预在各自实地研究中均与单位距离不安全事件率下降相关，但由于研究设计和指标不同，无法直接比较效果量。
AI.motivation: 现有数据到文本驾驶辅导常被视为从车联网事件到建议的通用流程，但驾驶建议的有效性与可信度受当地驾驶者知识、主要交通风险、法规、道路基础设施及可用数据显著影响。论文旨在填补对跨地域内容本地化要求缺乏系统分析的空白，并避免将高收入国家部署经验视为普适默认方案。
AI.method: 对英国和尼日利亚两个独立开发的驾驶辅导系统进行比较分析，追踪其从需求识别到内容选择、文本生成及实地评估的完整链路。重点考察反馈时机与类型、情境化解释、措辞语气、法律依据、教育重点、风险选择，以及速度限制元数据等数据条件如何影响系统设计和评价指标。
AI.result: 英国系统侧重行程结束后的反思、结合道路和地点情境的解释以及对语气敏感的措辞。尼日利亚系统针对检测到的事件提供具有法律依据的每日一次Tips，并提供每周一次的劝导性Reports，突出安全教育和酒精相关风险。英国拥有可靠的限速元数据，因此能够支持超速反馈；尼日利亚限速数据稀缺，评估结果排除了超速指标。两项干预均显示单位距离不安全事件率下降，但因研究设计和指标不同，不能比较效果量。
AI.conclusion: 驾驶安全NLG应采用“需求—内容”的本地化设计流程：先识别当地知识缺口、风险重点、法规、基础设施和数据可得性，再决定反馈内容、生成方式和评估指标。安全关键型系统的跨地域迁移不能只复制高收入国家的内容或假设，而应将本地条件作为系统设计的核心约束。

title: A note on goal-based hierarchical RL
summary:
The agent-centric general value function (ACGVF) construction of
  \citet{tasse2026goal} lets the agent make two decisions that are
  normally imposed by the environment or agent designer: which goal to
  pursue and when to declare a goal as finished (in addition to
  choosing the action). This is a very general framework that
  subsumes almost all prior work on reinforcement learning, control
  and planning, as well as more general formalisms proposed in the
  cognitive sciences. However, it assumes the environment is fully
  observed, i.e., that the observation is a sufficient statistic. In
  \citet{murphy2025rl}, a general agent design was proposed where the
  policy is based on an internal belief state $z_t$ and an internal
  goal; however, the goals were assumed to be externally provided. In
  this note, we unify and extend these two approaches using the
  formalism of hierarchical hidden Markov models (HHMM) \citep{murphy2001hhmm}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一框架：将能够自主选择目标及目标终止时机的智能体中心一般价值函数（ACGVF）扩展到部分可观测环境，并与基于内部信念状态和内部目标的智能体设计相结合，使用分层隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM）形式化。
AI.motivation: 现有ACGVF框架假设环境完全可观测，观测本身是充分统计量；另一类通用智能体设计允许基于内部信念状态进行决策，但其目标仍由外部提供。本文旨在同时解决部分可观测性和目标外部给定的问题，构建能够自主管理信念、目标与目标完成判断的统一模型。
AI.method: 采用分层隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM）作为统一形式化工具，将ACGVF中的三类决策——行动选择、目标选择和目标完成时机判断——与基于内部信念状态 z_t 的策略结合，从而扩展到部分可观测环境，并统一强化学习、控制、规划及相关认知科学形式化方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体实验、理论定理或定量结果。其主要结果是概念和形式化层面的统一：将ACGVF与基于信念状态、内部目标的智能体设计整合到HHMM框架中。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一个更一般的智能体建模框架，使智能体能够在部分可观测环境中同时维护内部信念、自主选择目标、选择行动，并决定何时宣告目标完成。摘要没有提供关于性能改进、实验验证或理论保证的进一步结论。

title: SkyAnchor: Updating Metric-scale Aerial 3D Gaussian Scenes from Unposed Ground-View Sequences
summary: We study how to update a pre-built aerial scene with a newly captured, unposed ground-view sequence. The aerial scene already contains a reliable metric Structure-from-Motion (SfM) reconstruction and a pre-trained 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model, whereas the ground-view sequence is collected later to add street-level appearance but has unknown camera poses and global scale. Registering this sequence to the aerial SfM reconstruction is challenging because single-image cross-view localization is brittle and long trajectories are prone to drift. To address these challenges, we present SkyAnchor, which treats the existing aerial scene as a fixed scaffold for ground-view registration and scene update instead of jointly reconstructing aerial and ground imagery from scratch. It first localizes short groups of consecutive ground frames against geometrically verified aerial support, producing sparse anchor poses. It then recovers the full ground trajectory with anchor-constrained submaps, fixing the front and rear anchor poses during incremental registration and bundle adjustment. Finally, it inserts filtered ground Gaussians while preserving the aerial view, followed by lightweight joint refinement. Experiments on seven real aerial--ground scenes show accurate metric ground trajectories and updated 3D Gaussian scenes with strong aerial- and ground-view rendering quality.

AI.tldr: SkyAnchor利用已有的航拍SfM重建和3DGS模型作为固定度量骨架，将后采集、无位姿且尺度未知的地面序列配准到航拍场景，并增量更新三维高斯场景。方法通过短序列锚点定位、锚点约束子地图恢复完整轨迹，再融合筛选后的地面高斯并进行轻量联合优化。在7个真实航拍—地面场景上取得了准确的度量轨迹和良好的双视角渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有航拍场景已有可靠的度量SfM重建和预训练3DGS，但新增地面序列通常缺少相机位姿与全局尺度。直接依赖单图跨视角定位容易失败，而长序列进行独立估计又容易产生累计漂移；若从航拍和地面图像联合重建，计算和优化代价较高，也可能破坏已有航拍场景。因此，论文旨在以既有航拍模型为固定参照，稳定地完成地面序列配准与场景更新。
AI.method: 方法名为SkyAnchor。第一步，利用经过几何验证的航拍图像支持，对连续的短地面帧组进行定位，得到稀疏锚点位姿。第二步，以锚点为约束构建子地图，在增量配准和束调整过程中固定前后锚点位姿，从而恢复完整地面轨迹并抑制长序列漂移。第三步，筛选地面观测产生的高斯，插入已有3DGS场景，同时保持航拍视图质量，最后进行轻量级联合优化。整体核心是将已有航拍场景作为固定骨架，而不是重新联合重建全部数据。
AI.result: 在7个真实航拍—地面场景上，SkyAnchor获得了准确的度量地面轨迹，并生成了更新后的3D高斯场景。结果表明，更新后的模型同时具备较强的航拍视角和地面视角渲染质量。摘要未提供具体的定位误差、轨迹误差或渲染指标数值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明，基于稀疏锚点和锚点约束子地图，可以有效解决无位姿、未知尺度地面序列与已有航拍场景之间的配准问题，并在不显著损害航拍表现的前提下完成3DGS场景增量更新。其主要贡献在于兼顾了全局度量一致性、长轨迹稳定性和双视角渲染质量。

title: Building Legal Reward Models for Grounding and Abstention
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in high-stakes domains such as law, where systems must ground their reasoning in retrieved evidence and abstain when that evidence is insufficient. However, existing reward models are largely optimised for general preferences rather than contextual grounding, limiting their ability to evaluate these behaviours in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) settings. We introduce a framework for transforming existing legal QA datasets into contextual preference data and use it to construct LegalRewardBench (LRB), a benchmark for evaluating grounded legal generation under noisy and insufficient retrieval conditions. Across general and legal contextual evaluation, we find that contextual DPO improves grounded evaluation, but performance is sensitive to preference-data construction. Length-balanced augmentation substantially improves grounded legal evaluation, with the strongest configuration combining length-balanced legal and general contextual preference data and improving performance by up to $\mathbf{+25.6}$pp over baseline. We further find evidence of cross-jurisdiction transfer: models contextually refined primarily on Victorian criminal-law data improve grounded evaluation on external US legal benchmarks, including a $\mathbf{+16.2}$pp improvement on \textsc{Housing Statute QA}. Together, these results provide a reproducible foundation for constructing and evaluating grounded legal reward models in retrieval-augmented settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LegalRewardBench（LRB）及上下文偏好数据构建框架，用于评估和改进检索增强生成（RAG）场景下法律生成的证据依托性与适时拒答能力。结果表明，经过长度平衡的法律与通用上下文偏好数据进行 contextual DPO，可使 grounded legal evaluation 相比基线最高提升 25.6 个百分点，并在跨法域美国法律基准上最高提升 16.2 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励模型主要针对通用偏好进行优化，难以判断法律 RAG 系统是否真正依据检索证据进行推理，也难以评估在证据噪声大或证据不足时是否应当拒答。研究因此需要可复现的上下文偏好数据构建方法，以及专门衡量 grounded legal generation 的基准。
AI.method: 研究首先提出将现有法律问答数据集转换为上下文偏好数据的框架；随后构建 LegalRewardBench（LRB），在通用和法律上下文评估中测试奖励模型。方法核心是采用 contextual DPO，并比较不同偏好数据构造策略，特别考察长度平衡增强，以及法律数据、通用数据及二者组合的效果。研究还使用主要来自维多利亚州刑法的数据进行上下文优化，并在外部美国法律基准上测试跨法域迁移。
AI.result: contextual DPO 能够提升模型对上下文依托性的评估能力，但效果明显依赖偏好数据的构造方式。长度平衡增强显著改善 grounded legal evaluation；结合长度平衡的法律与通用上下文偏好数据时，较基线最高提升 25.6 个百分点。此外，主要基于维多利亚州刑法数据优化的模型能够迁移到美国法律任务，在 Housing Statute QA 上提升 16.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了面向 RAG 法律生成奖励模型的可复现数据构建与评估基础。核心结论是：上下文偏好优化有效，但必须重视偏好数据中的长度偏差与领域构成；合理结合长度平衡的法律和通用数据，不仅能提升本域 grounded evaluation，也可能带来跨法域迁移能力。

title: DynSTEER: Dynamic Stage-wise Trajectory Evaluation and Execution-time Review for Agents
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon task execution. However, current evaluation paradigms face three major limitations: terminal-only assessment ignores intermediate processes and struggles to localize errors efficiently and accurately, single-reference matching penalizes valid alternative solution paths, and post-hoc trajectory judging incurs high costs without the ability to halt failed runs early. To address these issues, we propose DynSTEER, a dynamic stage-wise trajectory evaluation framework for agents. DynSTEER segments rollouts into stages anchored by key completed actions, focusing evaluation on essential milestones with adequate context while enabling targeted strategy adjustments. It compiles a path-tolerant milestone graph from public task views to respect diverse legitimate strategies without leaking ground truth. Furthermore, it adaptively routes evaluation queries across multi-tier judges and halts unrecoverable executions online to curb resource waste. Experiments demonstrate that DynSTEER improves evaluation discriminability across LLM agents by 85.2\% over native evaluation, separates all model pairs with statistical significance, and saves 34.51\% of execution steps on failed rollouts.

AI.tldr: DynSTEER 是一种面向长时程智能体任务的动态分阶段轨迹评估框架，通过关键动作划分阶段、构建容忍多路径的里程碑图、分层调用评审器并在线终止不可恢复执行，从而提升评估区分度并减少失败运行的资源浪费。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估存在三项主要局限：仅评估最终结果，难以观察中间过程和快速定位错误；依赖单一参考路径，会误判合理的替代解法；运行结束后再进行轨迹评审，成本高且无法及时终止已经失败的执行。因此，需要一种能够关注关键中间里程碑、兼容多种有效路径并支持在线干预的评估方法。
AI.method: DynSTEER 将任务执行轨迹依据关键完成动作划分为多个阶段，在保留必要上下文的同时，围绕核心里程碑进行局部评估和针对性策略调整。方法从公开任务视图中构建允许路径差异的里程碑图，以避免泄露真实标准答案；同时根据评估需求在多层级评审器之间自适应路由查询，并在线识别不可恢复的失败执行、提前停止任务以节省资源。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较于原生评估方式，DynSTEER 将不同大语言模型智能体之间的评估区分度提升了85.2%，能够以统计显著性区分所有模型对；对于失败轨迹，平均节省34.51%的执行步骤。
AI.conclusion: DynSTEER 通过阶段化、路径容忍和在线自适应评估，缓解了终点导向、单参考路径及事后评审的不足，在提升模型比较可靠性的同时降低了失败执行的计算开销，适合用于长时程智能体的过程评估与早期失败检测。

title: BLInD: Learning Driver Intent as a Distribution over Future Ego Trajectories
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
summary: We present BLInD (Blind Learned Intent Distribution), a compact network that maps recent vehicle-state history (e.g. speed, curvature, indicator, and vehicle type) to a top-k distribution of future ego trajectories, with no camera, LiDAR, map, or object-track inputs. We find that vehiclestate history alone is sufficient to learn a useful multimodal distribution over near-term ego trajectories, and its low-latency nature makes it well-suited for safety-critical deployment. We investigate two distribution architectures, autoregressive (AR) and flow-matching, and train on both mixed-platform opensource and Wayve datasets. Both generalize without datasetspecific adaptation; the flow-matching model achieves best topk ADE/FDE of 0.15/0.37 m on Wayve, 0.15/0.36 m on Waymo, and 0.28/0.59 m on nuScenes, with the AR model reaching comparable coverage. Integrating the distributions into an AEB trigger task, a strict all-candidates policy reduces false positives from 1.51% to 0.11% with AR (13.7x reduction, 94.9% TP) and to 0.06% with flow-matching (25.1x reduction, 98.7% TP) compared to a 1-CTRV policy with 100% true positive score. BLInD runs in 0.87 ms with the AR head and 2.9 ms with the flow-matching head on an NVIDIA DRIVE Orin ECU making it compatible with real-time deployment on automotive ECUs. While existing learned distribution models rely on scene context and blind vehicle-state models typically collapse to a single path, BLInD is learned, blind, and cross-domain simultaneously, a combination not demonstrated by prior work. These results show that such a distribution provides a controllable and plausible intent sampling interface for downstream systems, with AEB as one instantiation.

AI.tldr: BLInD 是一种仅利用近期车辆状态历史、无需视觉/激光雷达/地图/目标跟踪输入的轻量级多模态自车轨迹预测网络。它比较了自回归与流匹配两种分布建模方式，在多个数据集上实现跨域泛化，并在 AEB 触发任务中显著降低误报，同时满足车载实时部署要求。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式轨迹分布模型通常依赖场景上下文，传统的盲预测模型又往往退化为单一路径，难以同时满足低延迟、跨域泛化、多模态意图表达和安全关键部署需求。因此，论文旨在验证仅凭车辆自身状态历史是否足以学习有用的未来自车轨迹分布，并构建可供下游安全系统使用的轻量接口。
AI.method: 提出 BLInD，将近期速度、曲率、转向灯、车辆类型等车辆状态历史映射为未来自车轨迹的 top-k 概率分布，不使用摄像头、激光雷达、地图或目标轨迹。分别采用自回归（AR）和流匹配（flow-matching）两种分布架构，在混合平台开源数据及 Wayve 数据集上训练，并在 Wayve、Waymo、nuScenes 上评估跨域泛化。进一步将预测分布用于 AEB 触发，通过严格的 all-candidates 策略评估误报率、真阳性率和实时推理延迟。
AI.result: 流匹配模型取得最佳 top-k ADE/FDE：Wayve 为 0.15/0.37 m，Waymo 为 0.15/0.36 m，nuScenes 为 0.28/0.59 m；AR 模型的覆盖率相近。用于 AEB 时，相比具有 100% 真阳性率但误报率为 1.51% 的单一 CTRV 策略，AR 将误报率降至 0.11%，降低 13.7 倍，同时保持 94.9% 真阳性率；流匹配将误报率降至 0.06%，降低 25.1 倍，真阳性率为 98.7%。AR 和流匹配头分别在 NVIDIA DRIVE Orin ECU 上达到 0.87 ms 和 2.9 ms 推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 车辆状态历史本身可以支持学习有用、可泛化且多模态的近未来自车轨迹分布。BLInD 同时具备 learned、blind 和 cross-domain 特性，并为 AEB 等下游系统提供可控、合理的意图采样接口，在降低误报和满足实时车载部署方面具有应用价值。但其结论主要围绕短期自车轨迹和 AEB 场景，不能直接推断其对更复杂场景理解或更长期预测的能力。

title: Quantifying the Generation Modality Gap in Speech-Text Language Models
comment: Accepted to SLT 2026, extended version with appendix
summary: Pure speech language models often lag behind text and speech-text language models in generating coherent content, but this gap is difficult to quantify because speech and text systems are typically evaluated with different metrics and trained on different data. We study the speech-text modality gap in a family of spoken language models, based on flow matching for continuous acoustic feature generation. We construct a unified generation-based evaluation suite that compares speech-only, text-only, and speech-text language models trained on matched data distributions and evaluated in matched generation settings. We evaluate generated continuations along multiple dimensions: semantic coherence, measured by transcribing generated speech and scoring it with a reference language model; local phonetic structure, measured by phone n-gram distributional statistics; speaker consistency and acoustic quality; and emotion-based distributional metrics. Across datasets, we find that joint speech-text modeling substantially improves semantic coherence. However, the improvement is not uniform across metrics: phone-level metrics change only modestly, speaker similarity and predicted quality are lower for speech-text continuations, while emotion-based distributional metrics improve. Compared with larger-scale speech-only models, our speech-text model closes much of the scaling gap in transcript-based semantic coherence, suggesting that text provides an efficient semantic training signal for spoken language modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统量化纯语音、纯文本和语音-文本语言模型之间的模态差距，发现联合语音-文本建模显著提升语义连贯性，但对音系结构、说话人一致性和声学质量的改善有限，部分指标甚至下降；文本可作为提升语音语言建模语义能力的高效训练信号。
AI.motivation: 纯语音语言模型在内容连贯性方面通常落后于文本模型和语音-文本模型，但现有比较受到评测指标、训练数据和生成设置不一致的影响，难以准确量化语音-文本模态差距。因此，论文旨在建立公平、统一的比较框架，分析不同建模方式在语义、音系、说话人特征、声学质量和情感分布等方面的差异。
AI.method: 研究对象是一系列基于流匹配、用于连续声学特征生成的口语语言模型。作者在匹配的数据分布和生成设置下，构建统一的生成式评测套件，对纯语音、纯文本及语音-文本模型进行比较。评测维度包括：将生成语音转写后使用参考语言模型评分的语义连贯性；基于音素n-gram分布统计的局部音系结构；说话人一致性；声学质量；以及基于情感预测的分布性指标。同时，将语音-文本模型与更大规模的纯语音模型进行扩展性比较。
AI.result: 跨多个数据集，联合语音-文本建模显著提升了语义连贯性。该提升并未在所有指标上保持一致：音素级指标仅有小幅变化；语音-文本续写的说话人相似度和预测声学质量较低；情感分布指标则得到改善。与更大规模的纯语音模型相比，语音-文本模型在基于转写的语义连贯性方面缩小了相当一部分规模差距。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，文本模态能够为口语语言建模提供高效的语义训练信号，联合建模尤其有助于提升高层语义连贯性。然而，语义能力的提升可能伴随说话人保持能力和声学质量下降，且不会自动转化为局部音系结构的全面改善。因此，语音语言模型的评测应采用多维指标，而不能仅依赖语义或转写质量。

title: Diffusion-Based Generation of Gait Trajectories
comment: International Conference on NeuroRehabilitation (ICNR2026), September 29-October 2, 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Generation of musculoskeletal gait trajectories conditioned on patient-specific parameters remains a key challenge for wearable robotics and rehabilitation. Assistive systems such as lower-limb exoskeletons require reference trajectories that adapt to individual morphology and therapeutic goals while preserving biomechanical realism. Traditional approaches rely on hand-crafted gait templates or optimization procedures that scale poorly across subjects and walking conditions. In this work, we explore conditional diffusion models for generating lower-limb joint-angle trajectories conditioned on gait parameters such as step length. We compare a baseline transformer diffusion model with a controllable diffusion transformer variant incorporating adaptive normalization and classifier-free guidance. Experiments on a dataset of 4,590 gait cycles show that diffusion models can generate realistic periodic gait trajectories while enabling some controllability variation in gait characteristics, highlighting their potential for personalized gait synthesis in assistive robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用条件扩散模型，根据步长等步态参数生成个体化、具有生物力学合理性的下肢关节角轨迹，用于外骨骼和康复机器人。作者比较了基础Transformer扩散模型与加入自适应归一化和无分类器引导的可控扩散Transformer。基于4590个步态周期的实验表明，两类模型均能生成逼真的周期性步态，并对部分步态特征实现一定程度的控制，但个体化控制能力仍有限。
AI.motivation: 面向可穿戴机器人和康复系统，外骨骼需要能够适应患者的身体形态、步态特征和治疗目标的参考轨迹。传统手工步态模板及优化方法泛化性和可扩展性不足，难以覆盖不同受试者与行走条件，因此需要一种能够生成真实且可控的个体化步态轨迹的方法。
AI.method: 作者探索条件扩散模型用于生成下肢关节角时间序列，并将步长等步态参数作为条件输入。实验比较两种模型：基础Transformer扩散模型，以及结合自适应归一化和无分类器引导的可控扩散Transformer变体。模型在包含4590个步态周期的数据集上进行训练和评估，重点考察生成轨迹的周期性、生物力学真实性以及条件控制能力。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，扩散模型能够生成具有现实感和周期性的下肢关节角轨迹；引入可控扩散机制后，模型能够对部分步态特征产生一定程度的变化和调节。摘要未提供具体定量指标、统计显著性、不同模型的详细性能差异，也未明确说明控制精度在不同步态参数上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 条件扩散模型在个体化步态合成方面具有应用潜力，尤其适合为外骨骼和康复机器人提供参考轨迹。可控扩散Transformer能够改善步态特征调节能力，但当前结果主要表明“具备一定可控性”，距离稳定、精确地满足患者形态和治疗目标仍有差距，未来需要进一步验证跨受试者泛化性、临床有效性、实时性和安全性。

title: SGWIB:Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein Information Bottleneck for Video Highlight Detection
summary: Video highlight detection aims to identify temporally important segments that capture the most informative or engaging events in a video. Reliable prediction therefore requires not only discriminative segment representations but also preservation of the temporal relationships among neighboring and distant segments. The information bottleneck principle has proven effective for learning compact and task-relevant representations, yet it has not been explored for video highlight detection, and applying conventional formulations directly would overlook inter-segment relational structure and distort highlight relevant temporal organization during compression. We therefore introduce the Sliced Gromov-Monge Gap (SGMG), a structure aware regularizer that measures the excess relational distortion induced by a prescribed source-to-bottleneck mapping relative to an optimal sliced structural correspondence. Building on SGMG, we develop SGWIB, an information-bottleneck framework for single-modal video highlight detection that learns compact bottleneck representations while preserving inter-segment temporal structure. We further introduce Home-Away-Related Contextual Pseudo-Labels and a contextual disentanglement module that reduce sports-specific contextual bias by separating highlight oriented information from contextual patterns. Experiments on MrHiSum and MoSu show that SGWIB attains the best Kendall's tau, Spearman's rho, mAP@50, and mAP@30 among the compared single-modal methods on both datasets. On MrHiSum, the visual model improves the strongest previous results by 0.031, 0.031, 0.87, and 0.75 on these four metrics, respectively. These results show that structure-aware information-bottleneck regularization combined with contextual disentanglement improves segment-level highlight prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SGWIB，一种面向单模态视频精彩片段检测的结构感知信息瓶颈框架。其核心是Sliced Gromov-Monge Gap（SGMG）正则项，用于在压缩表示时保留片段间的时间与结构关系；同时结合主客场相关上下文伪标签和上下文解耦模块，降低体育场景中的上下文偏置。实验表明，该方法在MrHiSum和MoSu数据集上的Kendall's tau、Spearman's rho、mAP@50和mAP@30均优于对比的单模态方法。
AI.motivation: 视频精彩片段检测不仅需要学习具有区分性的片段表示，还需要保持相邻及远距离片段之间的时间关系。传统信息瓶颈方法强调表示压缩和任务相关性，但直接应用于该任务可能忽略片段间的关系结构，并在压缩过程中破坏与精彩片段相关的时间组织。此外，体育视频中的主客场等上下文模式可能带来场景偏置，使模型错误依赖上下文而非真正的精彩内容。
AI.method: 提出Sliced Gromov-Monge Gap（SGMG）结构感知正则项，用于衡量给定源表示到瓶颈表示映射所造成的关系失真，并将其与最优的切片结构对应进行比较。在此基础上构建SGWIB信息瓶颈框架，学习紧凑且任务相关的瓶颈表示，同时保留视频片段间的时间结构。进一步提出主客场相关上下文伪标签（Home-Away-Related Contextual Pseudo-Labels）和上下文解耦模块，将面向精彩片段的信息与上下文模式分离，以减弱体育场景偏置。
AI.result: 在MrHiSum和MoSu两个数据集上，SGWIB在Kendall's tau、Spearman's rho、mAP@50和mAP@30四项指标上均取得对比单模态方法中的最佳结果。在MrHiSum上，视觉模型相较于此前最优结果分别提升0.031、0.031、0.87和0.75。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的信息瓶颈正则化能够在压缩视频片段表示的同时保留关键的跨片段时间关系；结合上下文解耦后，可有效缓解体育视频中的上下文偏置，并提升片段级精彩程度预测性能。该研究验证了结构保持与偏置抑制对于视频精彩片段检测的重要性。

title: How broad is that claim? Mapping Generalisation in NLP Research
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main; the dataset and code are available at https://github.com/cx-diao/nlpgen
summary: Generalisations are common in scientific communication, even though they are semantically ambiguous. An automated method is needed to identify and categorise claims according to their level of generalisation, in order help detect an over-reliance on generalisations and possible misrepresentations of scientific findings. We introduce a comprehensive taxonomy of generalisations in the scientific domain, NLPGenX, which labels claims according to their level of generality and framing within the text. We operationalise this taxonomy with an LLM-powered framework, NLPGenA, that automatically classifies sentences from scientific articles into 5 different generalisation classes. We validate our framework with human annotators and use the framework to construct a large-scale dataset of NLP papers annotated according to generality, with auxiliary labels for hedging and vague descriptors (NLPGens). We use NLPGens to analyse the use of generalisations in NLP papers across multiple venues and subdomains, and to examine associations with citation counts, hedging, and vague descriptors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个用于识别和分类科学文本中“概括性论断”的完整框架：构建五类概括性分类体系NLPGenX，开发基于大语言模型的自动分类框架NLPGenA，并据此建立带有概括性、模糊限定词和模糊描述语标注的大规模NLP论文数据集NLPGens，进一步分析不同会议、子领域中的概括性使用及其与引用量等因素的关系。
AI.motivation: 科学传播中广泛存在概括性表述，但其语义边界模糊，可能导致对研究发现的过度推广或不准确呈现。现有方法缺少系统的概括性分类标准和可扩展的自动识别工具，因此有必要建立统一 taxonomy 与自动化分析框架，以评估科学文本中的概括性使用及其潜在影响。
AI.method: 首先提出科学领域概括性的综合分类体系NLPGenX，依据论断的概括程度及其在文本中的框架方式进行标注。随后实现基于大语言模型的分类框架NLPGenA，将科学论文句子自动划分为五类概括性类别。研究通过人工标注者进行验证，并利用该框架构建大规模NLP论文数据集NLPGens，同时加入模糊限定语和模糊描述语等辅助标签。最后使用该数据集，对不同发表场所和NLP子领域中的概括性使用进行统计分析，并考察其与引用次数、模糊限定语及模糊描述语之间的关联。
AI.result: 研究产出包括：一套五类别的科学文本概括性 taxonomy（NLPGenX）；一个基于大语言模型的自动分类框架（NLPGenA）；以及带有多种语言现象标注的大规模NLP论文数据集（NLPGens）。摘要表明，该框架已通过人工标注验证，并被用于跨会议、跨子领域分析概括性使用模式及其与引用量、模糊表达之间的关系，但未提供具体的分类性能、统计显著性或关联方向。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为科学文本中的概括性论断提供了系统化、可自动化和可规模化的分析方案，有助于识别科学传播中的过度概括及潜在误述。其主要贡献在于统一分类标准、自动识别工具和可复用数据资源；不过，摘要未明确说明概括性与引用量之间的因果关系，因此相关发现更适宜解释为统计关联。

title: Lightning Weave: Improving the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier of Reasoning Models through Capability Composition
summary: A core goal of efficient reasoning is to improve the accuracy-efficiency frontier. However, jointly improving reasoning accuracy and inference efficiency can be challenging, as the two objectives can favor different reasoning behaviors. Independently post-trained models already offer distinct strengths in accuracy and efficiency. We introduce Lightning Weave, a post-training framework that extracts and composes these independently learned capabilities in a single student through on-policy distillation. Each acquired capability is represented by the policy shift from the model before post-training to the resulting specialist. Lightning Weave combines aligned log-ratio shifts at shared student token states and uses Tilted-Target DOPD to convert the cached signals into a stable learning target. Each anchor pair scores the cached trajectories once, enabling subsequent student training without serving multiple live anchor models concurrently. Across diverse student models and benchmarks in mathematics and code, Lightning Weave substantially improves upon the base students and achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency frontier. On Qwen3.5-4B, it raises HMMT 2025 accuracy from 59.2% to 64.0% with 10.7% fewer response tokens, and LiveCodeBench v5 accuracy from 41.7% to 54.2% with 9.6% fewer response tokens. Adjusting the relative strengths of the anchor signals yields a strong empirical accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier. These results establish Lightning Weave as a new practical route to efficient reasoning through capability composition. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Lightning Weave，一种通过在策略层面组合独立后训练模型能力的在线策略蒸馏框架，在单个学生模型中同时提升推理准确率与效率，并在数学和代码基准上取得更优的准确率—效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 高效推理的核心目标是改善准确率—效率前沿，但准确率与推理效率往往偏好不同的推理行为，难以联合优化。现有独立后训练模型分别具备准确率或效率优势，因此论文旨在提取并组合这些互补能力，避免同时部署多个在线锚模型带来的计算与工程成本。
