AI.method: Lightning Weave 将每种能力表示为后训练前基础模型与后训练专家模型之间的策略变化，即 token 状态上的对数概率比偏移。方法在共享的学生 token 状态上对齐并组合不同锚模型的 log-ratio shifts，再利用 Tilted-Target DOPD 将缓存的轨迹信号转化为稳定的训练目标。每个锚模型对轨迹对仅需评分一次，之后即可离线训练学生模型，无需并行服务多个实时锚模型。通过调节不同锚信号的相对强度，还可以控制准确率与响应长度之间的折中。
AI.result: 在多种学生模型及数学、代码基准上，Lightning Weave 均显著优于基础学生模型，并取得先进的准确率—效率前沿。以 Qwen3.5-4B 为例，HMMT 2025 准确率由 59.2% 提升至 64.0%，响应 token 减少 10.7%；LiveCodeBench v5 准确率由 41.7% 提升至 54.2%，响应 token 减少 9.6%。改变锚信号权重还能得到较强的经验 Pareto 前沿。
AI.conclusion: Lightning Weave 证明了通过策略偏移组合独立后训练能力，可以在单个学生模型中同时增强推理准确率和效率，为高效推理提供了一条实用的新路径。其主要价值在于兼顾性能、响应长度和部署成本；不过摘要未提供消融实验、统计显著性、训练开销及对更多任务类型的详细分析。

title: Zero-Shot Cross-Material Ptychographic Phase Reconstruction Using Deep Learning
summary: Ptychographic phase reconstruction is commonly formulated as an iterative inverse problem, requiring repeated object-probe updates and resulting in substantial computational cost for large-scale 4D-STEM data. We present a direct local-to-global learning framework that reconstructs full-field phase maps from diffraction measurements without iterative refinement during inference. The proposed network predicts local wrapped-phase patches from individual diffraction patterns using a sine-cosine representation, and the predictions are assembled into a full-field reconstruction using calibrated scan positions and Gaussian-weighted stitching. To evaluate generalization beyond the training domain, the model is trained on one material and directly applied to another in a zero-shot setting without target-domain fine-tuning. Experiments on AuPd and MoS$_2$ demonstrate consistent cross-material transfer in both directions, with the proposed method achieving the best full-field MSE, PSNR, and MS-SSIM among the evaluated learning-based methods. Compared with the iterative ePIE approach, the proposed direct local-to-global pipeline reduces end-to-end reconstruction time by approximately 10x, demonstrating its potential for efficient and transferable ptychographic reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需推理阶段迭代优化的局部到全局学习框架，用于从4D-STEM衍射数据直接重建全场相位图。网络以正弦—余弦形式预测局部包裹相位，再依据标定扫描位置和高斯加权进行拼接，并在跨材料零样本场景下验证了较好的迁移性与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统ptychographic phase reconstruction通常依赖ePIE等迭代反演方法，需要反复更新物体和探针，面对大规模4D-STEM数据时计算成本高、重建速度慢。此外，许多学习方法依赖目标材料的训练或微调，跨材料泛化能力有限。因此，本文旨在实现快速、直接且具有跨材料迁移能力的相位重建。
AI.method: 构建局部到全局的直接学习流程：首先，利用单个衍射图样预测对应的局部包裹相位补丁，并采用sine-cosine表示以改善相位周期性带来的不连续问题；随后结合标定的扫描位置，将局部预测映射并拼接为全场相位图，拼接过程中使用高斯权重以提升重叠区域的一致性。模型在一种材料上训练，再不进行目标域微调，直接应用于另一种材料，评估零样本跨材料迁移。
AI.result: 在AuPd与MoS₂之间进行双向跨材料测试时，方法均表现出稳定的迁移能力。在所比较的学习型方法中，该方法取得最佳的全场MSE、PSNR和MS-SSIM。与迭代式ePIE相比，端到端重建时间约降低10倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，局部预测与全局拼接相结合的直接重建策略能够在保持较高重建质量的同时显著降低计算开销，并具备跨材料零样本泛化能力。该方法为大规模4D-STEM数据的高效、可迁移ptychographic相位重建提供了可行方案，但其性能仍可能依赖扫描位置标定质量、训练数据覆盖范围以及不同材料间衍射特征的相似性。

title: Pull: Lazy Materialization of Working Memory for Stateful LLM Conversations
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. An earlier version was publicly released on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21984705). Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/wulun811/kongmen-pull
summary: As LLM conversations grow to hundreds of turns, full-context injection incurs $O(N^2)$ cumulative token costs, while lossy summarization or hard truncation irreversibly discards historical state. We propose Pull, a session router that maintains an addressable metadata directory via a local, deterministic Purifier (zero LLM calls, millisecond-level latency). At query time, the LLM lazily materializes only the turns it needs; unmaterialized turns remain accessible but collapsed. Unlike irreversible compression, Pull's materialization is reversible; subsequent queries can expand any collapsed turn. On LoCoEval (128 conversations, 12,780 turns), Pull reduces per-query context tokens (Phase 2) by 75.1 percent on single-hop tasks with equivalent quality ($Δ= -0.002$, n.s.) and by 72.0 percent on multi-hop tasks with no quality loss ($Δ= +0.017$). A controlled routing benchmark (7,831 queries x 10 methods) shows that entity lifecycle tracking is empirically a prerequisite for distance-independent routing. On BEAM 1M (14 conversations, 263 questions), Pull improves F1 by +55.2 percent over a truncation baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Pull，一种面向长程 LLM 对话的会话路由器，通过可寻址元数据目录和本地确定性 Purifier 按需恢复历史轮次，在降低上下文 token 成本的同时保留可逆访问能力。实验显示其在单跳、多跳任务中分别减少 75.1% 和 72.0% 的查询上下文 token，质量基本不变；在 BEAM 1M 上较截断基线 F1 提升 55.2%。
AI.motivation: 长对话达到数百轮后，完整注入上下文会产生 O(N^2) 的累计 token 成本；摘要压缩和硬截断又会不可逆地丢失历史状态。因此需要一种既能降低每次查询上下文规模，又能保留历史信息、支持后续恢复的机制。
AI.method: 提出 Pull 会话路由器：使用本地、确定性的 Purifier（无需 LLM 调用，毫秒级延迟）维护可寻址的元数据目录。查询时由 LLM 仅延迟物化所需的对话轮次，未物化内容保持可访问但以折叠形式存在；物化过程可逆，后续查询可重新展开任意折叠轮次。实验包括 LoCoEval、受控路由基准和 BEAM 1M，并重点评估实体生命周期跟踪对远距离路由的作用。
AI.result: 在 LoCoEval（128 个对话、12,780 个轮次）中，Phase 2 每次查询上下文 token 在单跳任务中减少 75.1%，质量变化 Δ=-0.002，统计上不显著；多跳任务中减少 72.0%，质量变化 Δ=+0.017，未出现质量损失。受控路由基准（7,831 个查询、10 种方法）表明，实体生命周期跟踪是实现与距离无关路由的经验性前提。在 BEAM 1M（14 个对话、263 个问题）上，相比截断基线，F1 提升 55.2%。
AI.conclusion: Pull 在长对话中实现了效率与信息保留之间的较好平衡：通过按需、可逆的历史物化显著降低上下文成本，同时维持任务质量。结果还说明，实体生命周期建模可能是可靠长程对话检索与路由的关键组成部分。

title: Depth and Scale in the Sub-150M Regime: JugnuLM-53M vs JugnuLM-110M
summary: We scale our conventional sub-150M pretraining recipe from 53.5M to 109.7M parameters, holding the method fixed (Qwen3-style decoder with grouped-query attention, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, QK-Norm, and a z-loss; FineWeb-Edu data) and changing only the geometry to a deep-and-thin 23-layer x 576-hidden design. The larger model improves across the board -- BLiMP 78.1 -> 81.3, ARC-Easy 51.4 -> 52.5, WikiText-2 byte-perplexity 2.04 -> 1.95 -- and its 81.3% BLiMP essentially matches GPT-X2-125M (81.28) at about 12% fewer parameters. Notably the 110M model achieves this on fewer training tokens (about 8B vs 12B), so the gain is attributable to capacity and depth, not more data. Both models are deliberately conventional; this report is a clean scaling control and the baseline rung (R0) of an ablation study of what further improves models in this regime. An ablation ladder follows: value residuals (R1) and the Muon optimizer (R2) lift ARC-Easy by a cumulative +3.6 (52.5 -> 56.1) at a near-flat BLiMP and are kept; a diverse data blend (R3) and two logit-distillation settings (R4a/R4b) are not kept -- honest negatives. R3 pins ARC-Easy to FineWeb-Edu's educational filtering rather than raw diversity; distillation from a 1.7B teacher can reach the class-leading ARC-Easy (56.99, matching GPT-X2-125M) but only at a perplexity cost that dialing KD down then erases -- so R2 remains the best kept stack.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究一个约1.1亿参数的小型语言模型，通过在固定训练配方下扩大模型规模并进行逐步消融，评估深而窄的结构、价值残差、Muon优化器、数据混合与知识蒸馏对性能的影响。结果表明，扩大容量和增加深度带来稳定收益；价值残差与Muon进一步提升推理性能，是最优保留组合；多样数据混合和知识蒸馏未形成更好的综合权衡。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在建立一个干净、可复现的小模型扩展基线，回答在约1亿参数规模下，性能提升究竟来自模型容量与深度，还是来自更多训练数据或额外技巧。同时，通过系统消融判断价值残差、Muon优化器、数据配方和知识蒸馏是否值得保留。
AI.method: 以53.5M参数模型为基线，在保持Qwen3风格解码器、分组查询注意力、RoPE、SwiGLU、RMSNorm、QK-Norm、z-loss及FineWeb-Edu数据不变的前提下，将模型扩展为109.7M参数、23层、576维的深而窄结构。随后按R0至R4逐步进行消融：加入价值残差和Muon优化器，测试多样化数据混合，并比较两种logit知识蒸馏设置。使用BLiMP、ARC-Easy和WikiText-2字节困惑度进行评估。
AI.result: 109.7M模型相较53.5M模型在所有指标上提升：BLiMP从78.1升至81.3，ARC-Easy从51.4升至52.5，WikiText-2字节困惑度从2.04降至1.95；其BLiMP接近GPT-X2-125M，但参数少约12%，且训练token更少（约8B对12B）。价值残差与Muon累计将ARC-Easy从52.5提升至56.1，同时BLiMP基本持平，因此被保留。多样数据混合未超过FineWeb-Edu；知识蒸馏可将ARC-Easy提升至56.99，但牺牲困惑度，降低蒸馏强度又会失去收益。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明，在该参数规模下，增加模型容量并采用深而窄的结构即可带来稳定收益，且收益并非源于更多训练数据。价值残差和Muon构成最具综合优势的改进组合。FineWeb-Edu的教育筛选对ARC-Easy表现较关键，而知识蒸馏虽然能提高特定推理指标，却会损害语言建模质量，未成为最终推荐方案。

title: Mind2Cloud: EEG-to-Point Cloud Generation with Two-Granularity Diffusion Decoding
comment: European Conference on Computer Vision -- ECCV 2026
summary: Reconstructing 3D objects from brain signals offers a promising avenue for understanding human visual cognition. While prior work has shown initial success using EEG signals for 3D reconstruction, existing methods typically employ a uniform diffusion decoder, overlooking the evolving semantic granularity of both EEG representations and the diffusion denoising process. In this paper, we propose Mind2Cloud, a novel EEG-to-point-cloud generation framework based on two-granularity diffusion decoding. The core of Mind2Cloud is a time-aware decoder that integrates a global Transformer branch and a local Point-Voxel CNN (PVCNN) branch across diffusion timesteps through a learnable fusion mask. Specifically, Transformer layers are incorporated into the early upsampling stages to capture global object structure under high uncertainty, while PVCNN modules are used in later stages to refine local geometric details. Inspired by the hierarchical nature of EEG-based visual representations, this design dynamically adapts its spatial granularity in accordance with the coarse-to-fine trajectory of diffusion denoising. We further introduce an adversarial refinement module to enhance geometric realism and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments on the EEG-3D dataset across all 12 subjects demonstrate that Mind2Cloud outperforms prior work in both geometric accuracy and semantic alignment, setting a new benchmark for EEG-to-point-cloud generation. Our source code is available at https://github.com/duasoi/Mind2Cloud.

AI.tldr: Mind2Cloud 是一个从 EEG 脑信号生成三维点云的两粒度扩散解码框架，通过时间感知的全局—局部特征融合，使生成过程从粗粒度结构逐步过渡到细粒度几何细节，并借助对抗式细化提升结果质量。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 到三维重建方法通常采用统一的扩散解码器，未充分考虑 EEG 表征在语义层次上的演化，也没有匹配扩散模型由高不确定性到低不确定性的逐步去噪过程。因此，生成结果在整体结构建模和局部几何细节恢复之间难以取得最佳平衡。
AI.method: 提出 Mind2Cloud 框架。其核心是时间感知解码器：在扩散早期、噪声较大且不确定性较高的阶段，引入 Transformer 分支建模全局对象结构；在扩散后期，引入 Point-Voxel CNN（PVCNN）分支恢复局部几何细节；通过可学习融合掩码跨扩散时间步动态融合两类特征。此外，加入对抗式细化模块，以增强生成点云的几何真实性与语义一致性。
AI.result: 在 EEG-3D 数据集的全部 12 名受试者上进行实验。结果表明，Mind2Cloud 在几何准确性和语义对齐方面均优于已有方法，并建立了 EEG 到点云生成的新性能基准。摘要未提供具体指标、统计显著性或消融实验数值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将 EEG 表征的层次化语义特征与扩散模型的粗到细去噪轨迹进行匹配，有助于提升三维点云重建效果。Mind2Cloud 的主要贡献在于实现了全局结构与局部细节的动态解码，并通过对抗式细化进一步改善了生成质量。

title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing)
summary: Performing deliberate mathematical reasoning in visual contexts is a hallmark of advanced Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and requires a sophisticated synthesis of perceptual grounding and symbolic logic. However, in the realm of mathematical functions, our investigation reveals a critical modality interference phenomenon: even advanced models, while performing textual computational reasoning, tend to disregard or misinterpret essential visual cues. To address this challenge, we propose Func-R1, which synergistically harmonizes precise visual perception and rigorous logical reasoning. Concretely, built upon an explicitly decoupled architecture, we employ a hierarchical post-training framework to progressively identify critical visual evidence and conduct in-depth theoretical reasoning. Furthermore, the Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) strategy is proposed to steer policy updating towards internalizing fundamental theoretical properties while dynamically rectifying heterogeneous visual information throughout the reasoning process. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Func-R1 delivers the optimal performance among open-source MLLMs, even surpassing GPT-5 with an 8.4% improvement on MathVerse's function-oriented tasks.

AI.tldr: Func-R1 是一个面向数学函数视觉推理的多模态大语言模型方法，针对视觉信息在文本推理过程中被忽略或误读的问题，通过解耦架构、分层后训练和 PATO 优化，联合提升视觉感知与理论推理能力；实验显示其在多个基准上表现优异，并在 MathVerse 函数类任务上超过 GPT-5 8.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在处理带有图像、函数图像或其他视觉信息的数学问题时，容易受到模态干扰：模型虽然能够进行文本形式的计算推理，却可能忽略、误读或未能有效利用关键视觉线索。数学函数任务尤其依赖图像中的结构信息与理论性质，因此需要一种能够同时保证视觉证据准确提取和数学逻辑严谨推理的方法。
AI.method: 论文提出 Func-R1。首先，采用显式解耦的架构，将视觉感知与理论推理进行区分，以减少不同模态和不同推理阶段之间的干扰。其次，设计分层后训练框架，逐步学习识别关键视觉证据，并进一步开展深入的理论推理。在此基础上提出 Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization（PATO，感知对齐理论优化）策略，使策略更新更加关注基础数学理论性质，同时在推理过程中动态纠正异质视觉信息，从而实现视觉感知与符号推理的协同。
AI.result: 在多个多样化基准上的实验表明，Func-R1 达到了开源多模态大语言模型中的最佳性能。特别是在 MathVerse 的函数导向任务上，其性能较 GPT-5 提升 8.4%。这些结果说明该方法能够更有效地利用视觉证据，并提升数学函数问题中的综合推理能力。由于摘要未提供具体数据集列表、消融实验或统计显著性信息，尚不能进一步判断各组件的独立贡献及结果稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究指出，数学函数视觉推理中的关键瓶颈不仅是语言或符号推理能力不足，还包括视觉信息在推理链中的模态干扰与证据利用失效。Func-R1 通过视觉感知—理论推理解耦、分层后训练和 PATO 优化，增强了模型对关键视觉线索及数学理论性质的联合建模能力。摘要所报告的结果表明，该方法具有较强有效性，但其泛化能力、计算成本、对 GPT-5 的公平比较条件以及 PATO 的具体机制仍需结合完整论文进一步验证。

title: Moral Rebel Agents: Decision-Making Under Conflicting Obligations
summary: Autonomous agents are typically obliged to follow user-assigned tasks. However, strict obedience may conflict with moral obligations that arise during execution. This paper investigates \textbf{moral rebellion}: the ability of an autonomous agent to deviate from a user-assigned task when morally justified. We formalize five agent architectures: an \textit{amoral agent} that pursues assigned tasks without considering moral obligations, and four forms of \textbf{moral rebel agency}: (1) \textit{utilitarian agents} that opportunistically maximize task outcomes; (2) \textit{deontic} agents that enforce normative constraints; (3) \textit{utilitarian-deontic} (UD) agents that combine deontic constraints with utilitarian reasoning; and (4) \textit{dutiful} agents that additionally preserve commitments to assigned tasks. We implement these architectures within a hierarchical task network planning framework and evaluate them in a Mini Search-and-Rescue domain that exposes trade-offs among assigned-task completion, opportunistic rescue, and norm compliance. Our empirical results show that the proposed agents exhibit distinct trade-offs among rescue results, assigned-task completion, and norm compliance. In particular, the preservation of task commitments emerges as an important dimension of moral rebellion, for which the UD and dutiful agents produce substantially different behaviors despite their shared utilitarian and deontological foundations. These findings highlight the importance of commitment-aware moral reasoning for autonomous agents operating in morally consequential environments.

AI.tldr: 论文研究自主智能体在道德理由充分时偏离用户任务的“道德反叛”能力，形式化并比较五类智能体架构，并在迷你搜索与救援领域中评估其在救援成效、任务完成度和规范遵守之间的权衡。主要发现是，是否保留对原任务的承诺会显著影响道德反叛行为；结合功利与义务推理的UD智能体与履责型智能体表现出明显差异。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体通常被要求严格执行用户任务，但执行过程中可能出现需要优先考虑道德义务的情形。现有讨论若只关注任务服从或单一伦理原则，难以解释智能体何时、为何以及以何种方式偏离原任务。因此，论文旨在系统研究道德反叛，并特别考察任务承诺在道德决策中的作用。
AI.method: 论文形式化五类智能体：不考虑道德义务的非道德智能体；机会主义最大化任务结果的功利主义智能体；执行规范约束的义务论智能体；结合义务约束与功利推理的UD智能体；以及进一步保留原任务承诺的履责型智能体。研究将这些架构嵌入分层任务网络规划框架，并在迷你搜索与救援领域中进行实验，比较不同架构在任务完成、机会性救援和规范遵守方面的行为。
AI.result: 不同架构在救援成效、用户任务完成度和规范遵守之间呈现出清晰且不同的权衡。尤其值得注意的是，UD智能体与履责型智能体虽然共享功利主义和义务论基础，但由于后者额外保留任务承诺，二者产生了显著不同的行为。结果表明，任务承诺是影响道德反叛的重要维度。
AI.conclusion: 道德反叛不应被理解为简单地放弃用户任务，而应被视为在道德规范、结果优化与任务承诺之间进行结构化权衡。对于处于具有道德后果环境中的自主智能体，具备承诺意识的道德推理机制至关重要。

title: CirrGuide: A Deep Cascaded Framework for Liver Cirrhosis Segmentation and Severity Classification from T2-Weighted MRI
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 17th International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: We present CirrGuide, a deep cascaded framework for cirrhotic liver segmentation and severity classification. Cirrhosis causes progressive structural changes in the liver and can lead to serious clinical complications, making severity assessment important for disease monitoring and treatment planning. However, severity classification is challenging because imaging patterns are often subtle, spatially variable, and similar across adjacent stages. CirrGuide addresses this by explicitly linking localization with classification. A ResNet50 encoder with an Attention U-Net decoder first predicts a soft cirrhotic liver mask, which is then used as an anatomical prior in a ResNet50-based classification branch. This branch combines global multi-scale features with mask-guided attention-pooled regional features to classify Mild, Moderate, and Severe cirrhosis. On the official CirrMRI600+ T2-weighted (T2W) 2D split, CirrGuide achieves 89.83% Dice and 84.14% mIoU for segmentation, 69.58% accuracy and 61.55% macro F1-score for severity classification. Compared with segmentation-only, classification-only, and multi-task baselines, CirrGuide improves both localization and severity classification, demonstrating the benefit of using predicted cirrhotic liver masks as anatomical priors for cirrhosis analysis.

AI.tldr: CirrGuide是一种级联式深度学习框架，先分割肝硬化肝脏区域，再利用预测掩膜作为解剖先验进行肝硬化严重程度分类。在CirrMRI600+官方T2W 2D数据划分上，分割Dice为89.83%、mIoU为84.14%，分类准确率为69.58%、宏平均F1为61.55%。结果表明，将病灶定位与严重程度分类显式结合，可同时提升定位与分类性能。
AI.motivation: 肝硬化会引起肝脏结构进行性改变，严重程度评估对疾病监测和治疗规划具有重要意义。然而，医学影像中的严重程度模式通常较为细微、空间分布差异明显，且相邻分期之间具有相似性，仅依赖全局图像特征进行分类较为困难。因此，研究旨在通过显式连接肝脏区域定位与严重程度分类，引入具有解剖意义的先验信息，提升肝硬化分析性能。
AI.method: 采用级联式框架Cir​​rGuide。第一阶段使用ResNet50编码器与Attention U-Net解码器预测软肝硬化肝脏掩膜；第二阶段使用基于ResNet50的分类分支，将预测掩膜作为解剖先验。分类分支融合全局多尺度特征与由掩膜引导、经过注意力池化得到的区域特征，对轻度、中度和重度肝硬化进行分类。研究同时与仅分割、仅分类和多任务基线进行比较。
AI.result: 在官方CirrMRI600+ T2加权二维数据划分上，分割性能达到89.83% Dice和84.14% mIoU；严重程度分类达到69.58%准确率和61.55%宏平均F1分数。相较于分割-only、分类-only及多任务基线，CirrGuide在肝脏定位和严重程度分类两方面均取得改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，将预测的肝硬化肝脏掩膜作为解剖先验，并通过级联方式连接定位与分类，有助于改善肝硬化严重程度分析。该方法体现了区域定位信息对区分相邻严重程度阶段的价值，但分类宏平均F1仍低于准确率，说明不同严重程度类别之间可能存在较明显的分类不均衡或混淆，仍有进一步优化空间。

title: Mind Which Bird You Favour: Parameterizing Adequacy-Fluency Balance in Meta-Evaluation of Machine Translation
comment: Accepted by 11th Conference on Machine Translation (WMT26)
summary: There is a tradeoff in machine translation meta-evaluation between prioritizing alignment with adequacy versus fluency. The balance depends on the combination of translation systems in the meta-evaluation dataset. This system set is a small, filtered sample whose characteristics change heavily across years and language pairs; it does not represent the true system distribution. Consequently, the adequacy-fluency balance is often unrepresentative and subject to change. For sensitive domains, controlling this balance is critical. We expose this balance as a tunable choice. To achieve a target balance, we reweight existing systems while minimizing distortion from uniform weighting, ensuring the evaluated systems remain real and representative. We provide an exact optimization algorithm with theoretical guarantees and pruning mechanisms to compute these weights. To validate meta-evaluation internal consistency, we design a scorer-augmentation framework that establishes a known relative identity for the scorers. Results demonstrate that our reweighting method effectively controls the adequacy-fluency balance and preserves the internal consistency, outperforming prior approaches. Finally, we analyze the performance of popular scorers across a sweep of this parameter.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器翻译元评估中的充分性（adequacy）与流畅性（fluency）权衡问题，将该权衡显式建模为可调参数；通过对真实翻译系统重新加权，在控制目标权衡的同时尽量减少偏离均匀权重的程度，并用精确优化算法、理论保证和剪枝机制高效求解。实验表明，该方法能够有效控制权衡、保持评分器内部一致性，并优于既有方法。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译元评估通常依赖一个规模较小且经过筛选的系统集合，但该集合会随年份和语言对显著变化，不能代表真实的翻译系统分布。因此，元评估中对充分性和流畅性的偏重可能是不稳定且不具代表性的。对于敏感领域，若无法控制这种权衡，评估结论可能产生偏差。本文的动机是将充分性—流畅性权衡转化为可控的评估选择，并在不引入虚构系统的前提下保持系统集合的真实性与代表性。
AI.method: 首先，将充分性与流畅性的相对权重作为可调参数。为达到目标权衡，对已有真实翻译系统进行重新加权，并以最小化相对于均匀权重的分布扰动为优化目标。其次，提出带理论保证的精确优化算法，并结合剪枝机制提高求解效率。最后，设计评分器增强框架，通过构造具有已知相对关系的评分器来检验元评估的内部一致性，并在一系列权衡参数上分析主流评分器的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，重新加权方法能够有效地将元评估调整到目标的充分性—流畅性权衡，同时保持评估系统为真实系统，并维持评分器的内部一致性。该方法整体优于已有方法。对不同参数范围的分析还揭示了主流评分器性能会随权衡设定发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明，机器翻译元评估中的充分性—流畅性平衡并非固定属性，而是由评估系统集合及其权重共同决定。通过对真实系统进行受约束的重新加权，可以以可解释、可控且较少失真的方式调整这一平衡。该框架提升了元评估的稳定性、代表性和内部一致性，适用于需要精细控制评估偏好的场景。

title: Bayesian Intelligence from the Outside
summary: Inferring intelligence from observable behavior is a foundational challenge in artificial intelligence. We develop a theory of Bayesian intelligence for agents such as language models. Each prompt induces a possibly imperfect internal experiment; the agent updates a full-support prior by Bayes' rule and faithfully reports its posterior over the possible answers to the question. Repetitions draw fresh, independent outcomes from the same unobserved experiment at one fixed state. We show that the agent's behavior admits this explanation if and only if its reports are not fully contradictory, i.e., some state remains possible under every report across all prompts. Report frequencies and the sizes of positive probabilities impose no further restrictions. We further propose and characterize the behavioral implications of an intelligence order that makes the behavior of two agents consistent with one agent having access to a more informative experiment: there should exist a coupling of report distributions such that the more informative agent's report excludes every answer excluded by its counterpart. Finally, we show the difficulty of aggregating coarse reports from intelligent agents: unless the agent reports a belief about the complete state of the world, the optimal aggregation can assign arbitrary weights to states that have not been excluded. These results provide a basis for understanding when agents' behavior is intelligent and highlight the difficulty of rejecting Bayesian rationality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯智能理论，刻画语言模型等智能体何时可被解释为：基于固定先验和提示诱发的内部实验，通过贝叶斯更新形成并如实报告后验信念。核心结论是，可解释性的充要条件是不存在完全矛盾的报告；进一步定义了基于信息量的智能排序，并揭示了聚合不完整信念的困难。
AI.motivation: 现有关于智能行为的讨论缺乏统一、可检验的形式化基础，尤其难以判断语言模型等智能体的输出是否体现了贝叶斯式推理、如何比较不同智能体的信息能力，以及如何从粗粒度报告中聚合其知识。本文旨在建立一个行为层面的贝叶斯智能理论，并说明识别理性与聚合信息的边界。
AI.method: 作者构建形式化模型：每个提示对应一个可能不完美的内部实验；智能体从具有全支持性的先验出发，依据实验结果进行贝叶斯更新，并报告关于答案或世界状态的完整后验分布。重复提问被建模为在同一固定状态下，对同一未观测实验进行独立抽样。基于该模型，作者刻画行为可表示性的充要条件；随后通过报告分布之间的耦合，定义并分析“更具智能”或获得更有信息实验的行为含义；最后研究仅有粗粒度报告时的最优状态聚合问题。
AI.result: 第一，智能体行为能够由上述贝叶斯模型解释，当且仅当所有提示和报告之间不存在完全矛盾，即至少存在一个状态在每份报告下都保持可能。除此之外，报告频率以及正概率的具体大小不施加额外约束。第二，更有信息的智能体应存在一种报告分布耦合，使其排除的答案包含对应较弱智能体所排除的全部答案。第三，当智能体未报告关于完整世界状态的信念时，最优聚合可能对尚未被排除的状态赋予任意权重，表明粗报告无法支持稳定、唯一的聚合。
AI.conclusion: 本文为贝叶斯理性和智能行为提供了宽松但精确的行为刻画：除完全矛盾外，许多看似复杂的报告模式都可由贝叶斯智能解释，因此仅凭行为很难否定贝叶斯理性。同时，信息优势可通过排除关系的耦合来比较，但对不完整信念进行聚合存在根本性不确定性。该理论为分析语言模型的智能性、信息获取能力及其报告行为提供了基础。

title: Quantum-Gated LiteSSD: A Parameter-Efficient Lightweight Hybrid Quantum-Classical Framework for Forward-Looking Sonar Object Detection
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 Marine Vision as short paper
summary: Forward-looking sonar object detection is essential for underwater perception, yet deployment on embedded platforms requires highly compact models. To address this challenge, we explore quantum computing and introduce Quantum-Gated LiteSSD, a parameter-efficient hybrid quantum--classical detector that reformulates QuCNet-style multi-circuit quantum processing as an identity-centered channel-gating mechanism for spatial feature modulation. Experiments on the Marine Debris Watertank dataset and UATD forward-looking sonar benchmarks demonstrate an effective parameter--accuracy trade-off. The proposed detector achieves 90.84% $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ on Watertank with approximately $62\times$ fewer parameters than YOLO26s and $164.3\times$ fewer parameters than SSD-VGG16. On UATD, the model achieves 70.37% $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ with only 0.150M parameters, making it approximately $4.1\times$ smaller than SSGA-YOLO while retaining meaningful multi-class detection capability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Quantum-Gated LiteSSD，一种面向前视声呐目标检测的参数高效混合量子—经典模型。该方法将 QuCNet 风格的多电路量子处理重新表述为以恒等映射为中心的通道门控机制，用于空间特征调制。在 Marine Debris Watertank 和 UATD 数据集上，模型分别达到 90.84% 和 70.37% 的 mAP50，同时显著减少参数量：Watertank 上约为 YOLO26s 的 1/62、SSD-VGG16 的 1/164.3；UATD 上仅 0.150M 参数，约为 SSGA-YOLO 的 1/4.1。
AI.motivation: 前视声呐目标检测对水下感知至关重要，但嵌入式平台受到存储、计算和能耗限制，需要在检测精度与模型紧凑性之间取得平衡。现有检测器通常参数量较大，难以直接部署。因此，论文探索量子计算与经典深度学习结合的可能性，旨在构建具有较高参数效率、同时保持有效多类别检测能力的轻量化模型。
AI.method: 提出 Quantum-Gated LiteSSD，一种混合量子—经典目标检测器。核心做法是将 QuCNet 风格的多电路量子处理重构为以恒等映射为中心的通道门控机制，并利用该机制进行空间特征调制。整体方法强调在较低参数量下实现有效特征表达与目标检测，从而适配嵌入式前视声呐平台。
AI.result: 在 Marine Debris Watertank 数据集上，模型取得 90.84% mAP50，参数量约比 YOLO26s 少 62 倍、比 SSD-VGG16 少 164.3 倍。在 UATD 前视声呐基准上，模型取得 70.37% mAP50，仅使用 0.150M 参数，规模约为 SSGA-YOLO 的 1/4.1，同时保持了具有实际意义的多类别检测能力。结果表明，该方法实现了较好的参数量—检测精度折中。
AI.conclusion: Quantum-Gated LiteSSD 证明了量子—经典混合结构用于构建超轻量前视声呐检测器的可行性。通过将量子处理转化为通道门控和特征调制机制，模型在大幅压缩参数量的同时维持了较高检测精度，具备面向资源受限嵌入式水下感知系统的潜力。不过，摘要未提供推理速度、能耗、真实量子硬件部署结果或与更多先进方法的全面比较，因此其工程部署优势仍需进一步验证。

title: Tone on a Budget: A Reference-Free Metric for Lexical Tone in Massively Multilingual Text-to-Speech
summary: In Yorùbá, pitch alone separates \d{o}k\d{o} (husband, Mid), \d{o}k\d{ò} (vehicle, Low), and \d{o}k\d{ó} (hoe, High) -- the diacritics ARE the tone marks. Yet character error rate (CER), the standard automated metric for text-to-speech (TTS), is in practice computed from ASR output that drops those marks: a synthesizer can ace CER and still say vehicle for husband. We introduce DunDun -- named for the dùndún, the Yorùbá talking drum that speaks through pitch alone -- an automated, reference-free lexical-tone metric that needs no tone-labelled corpus. The gold High/Mid/Low sequence is read from the input text's diacritics (in TTS that text exists by construction, so no reference recording is needed); the prediction comes from the audio's pitch track. We validate three ways. Flattening pitch with PSOLA resynthesis collapses DunDun while CER does not move. Inverting High and Low in the answer key of 300 native recordings drives the two-class readout to 0.14, symmetrically below its 0.35 chance level -- a consistency check on the scoring path, not independent evidence. And three native listeners, over 67 blind A/B trials, pick the tone-correct clip 89.6% of the time (95% CI 80.0-94.8; p < 1e-4); whether DunDun tracks those judgements trial by trial is not resolved at this sample size. Applied to a massively multilingual zero-shot TTS model, DunDun shows what CER cannot: Yorùbá tone sits near the native anchor before any Yorùbá fine-tuning (0.567 +/- 0.02 over five decode seeds vs. 0.596; chance 0.33), despite the 21.4% CER the model's own paper reports; and a few hours of clean audio halve CER (5.6% to 2.7% by 5h, 1.7% by 15h) while tone saturates within the hour. On non-tonal Swahili, CER already captures the gains: the metric a language needs is language-dependent. We release the metric and the complete validation protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DunDun，一种无需带音调标注语料、可从文本和语音直接计算的参考无关词汇声调评估指标，用于弥补传统 CER 在 Yorùbá 等声调语言 TTS 评测中的不足。实验表明，DunDun 能检测音高被抹平或高低音调反转，且与少量听者判断总体一致；在零样本多语 TTS 中，声调表现可能已接近母语水平，而 CER 仍较高。
AI.motivation: 传统字符错误率（CER）通常依赖自动语音识别输出，而识别系统可能丢弃 Yorùbá 的声调符号。因此，文本字符看似正确并不代表词汇声调正确，可能导致词义改变。作者希望建立一种专门评估声调准确性的自动指标，并避免依赖带声调标签的语料或参考录音。
AI.method: DunDun 从输入文本的变音符号读取 High/Mid/Low 声调序列，从合成音频的基频轨迹提取预测声调序列，再进行两类声调读出和匹配评估。验证包括：使用 PSOLA 平坦化音高并观察指标变化；在 300 条母语录音中反转高、低声调答案以检验评分流程的一致性；通过 3 名母语听者完成 67 次盲听 A/B 测试；最后在多语零样本 TTS、不同微调时长及非声调语言 Swahili 上进行应用比较。
AI.result: 音高平坦化会使 DunDun 明显下降，而 CER 基本不变；反转高低声调答案后，二分类读出降至 0.14，低于 0.35 的机会水平，支持评分路径的一致性，但不构成独立有效性证据。听者对正确声调音频的选择率为 89.6%（95% CI：80.0–94.8，p<1e-4）。零样本模型在 Yorùbá 上的 DunDun 为 0.567±0.02，接近母语锚点 0.596，尽管 CER 为 21.4%；少量高质量音频可显著降低 CER，但声调表现约在 1 小时内趋于饱和。Swahili 上 CER 已能反映主要改进。
AI.conclusion: CER 不能充分评估声调语言 TTS 的词汇声调正确性，评测指标应依语言特征而定。DunDun 提供了一个轻量、无需参考录音和声调标注语料的补充指标。不过，当前听者样本较小，DunDun 与逐试次听者判断之间的对应关系尚未得到充分验证；因此它更适合作为 CER 的补充，而非替代。

title: AppliedScientist: Automated Scientific Revision Through Iterative AI Reviewing
summary: Automated reviewing systems are increasingly evaluated based on the quality of the reviews they produce. Yet a review is only useful if acting on it leads to a measurable improvement in the paper. We present AppliedScientist, a closed-loop system that couples an autonomous AI scientist with an AI reviewer, and evaluate it by iteratively revising rejected papers from a range of research subfields. To mirror how human authors build on earlier drafts, the AI scientist has access to its previous versions during revision. To avoid bias from prior judgments, however, each review is generated independently, with the reviewer having no memory of earlier feedback or scores. We compare three revision settings: one initialized with the original venue reviews, one initialized with AI-generated reviews, and autonomous self-revision using the same fixed prompt in every round. Because the reviewer both guides and evaluates the revision, we also assess the human-initialized revisions using Stanford Reviewer as an independent evaluator. Reviewer-guided revision consistently improves more than fixed-prompt self-revision, and Stanford Reviewer also assigns higher scores to later revisions. AppliedScientist resolves 128 of 150 execution-related weaknesses (85.3%), but only 2 of 18 idea-related weaknesses (11.1%), suggesting that iterative revision is effective at improving experiments and implementation, but rarely changes concerns about novelty or significance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AppliedScientist 闭环系统，将自主 AI 科学家与 AI 审稿人结合，通过多轮、独立审稿驱动的论文修订来评估“审稿意见是否真正提升论文质量”。实验表明，审稿人引导的修订优于固定提示的自主自我修订，且主要改善实验和实现问题，对新颖性与重要性问题改善有限。
AI.motivation: 现有自动审稿系统通常依据生成评论的质量进行评价，但高质量评论的真正价值在于作者采纳后能否实质性提升论文。该研究旨在建立更接近实际科研流程的闭环评估框架，并分析迭代修订对不同类型论文缺陷的改善能力。
AI.method: 构建 AppliedScientist 闭环系统，由自主 AI 科学家负责修订论文、AI 审稿人负责在每轮独立生成评价和反馈。系统允许科学家访问此前版本，以模拟人类基于草稿迭代修改；审稿人不保留前轮反馈或分数，以避免先前判断造成偏差。研究比较三种设置：以原投稿场所的人工评审意见初始化、以 AI 生成的评审意见初始化，以及每轮使用同一固定提示进行自主自我修订。对于人工意见初始化的修订，进一步使用 Stanford Reviewer 作为独立评估器。
AI.result: 审稿人引导的迭代修订持续优于固定提示的自主自我修订，Stanford Reviewer 也为后续版本给出更高分数。在 168 个缺陷中，系统解决了 128/150 个执行相关缺陷（85.3%），但仅解决 2/18 个想法相关缺陷（11.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 闭环审稿—修订机制能够有效改善实验设计、实现质量等执行层面问题，但很少能改变关于论文新颖性或重要性的核心判断。论文表明，评价自动审稿系统时，应关注其反馈能否带来可验证的论文改进，而不仅是评论本身的表面质量。

title: LPA-CWM: A Learned Physical Adjudicator for Motion Reasoning with Counterfactual World Models
comment: A quick overview is available at https://LPA-CWM.github.io
summary: Counterfactual world models (CWM) extract motion from pretrained video predictors by comparing factual and intervened predictions. However, responses generated under different target-frame masks vary in reliability, while uniform aggregation weights them equally. We formulate response aggregation as candidate reliability learning and propose LPA-CWM with a lightweight Learned Physical Adjudicator (LPA). Trained on dense MOVi-F trajectories, the 3.0M-parameter LPA compares visual context and response structure across an unordered candidate set to predict relative weights, while the CWM predictor and intervention generator remain frozen. The weighted responses undergo windowed localization and one paired re-evaluation to recover motion. We also introduce Completeness-aware Motion Correspondence (CMC), a ground-truth-anchored evaluation protocol that jointly measures localization, trajectory completeness, visibility, and continuity, counting missing predictions as failures on visible dynamic points. On the evaluated DAVIS and Kinetics subsets, LPA-CWM improves $\mathrm{DCA}_{\mathrm{avg}}$ over Uniform CWM by 60.0\% and 29.0\%, respectively, and also improves tracking accuracy under TAP-Vid First. A quick overview is available at https://LPA-CWM.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LPA-CWM，通过轻量级学习型物理判别器学习不同反事实响应的可靠性权重，并结合窗口化定位与一次成对重评估恢复运动；同时提出CMC评测协议，综合评估定位、轨迹完整性、可见性和连续性。在DAVIS与Kinetics子集上，相比均匀聚合CWM，DCA_avg分别提升60.0%和29.0%，并改善TAP-Vid First跟踪准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有反事实世界模型通过比较事实预测与干预预测提取运动，但不同目标帧掩码产生的响应可靠性不一致，均匀聚合会等权处理低质量和高质量响应，导致运动定位与轨迹恢复不稳定。此外，传统评测难以同时反映定位正确性、轨迹是否完整、点是否可见以及时间连续性。
AI.method: 提出LPA-CWM。冻结CWM视频预测器和干预生成器，仅训练一个约300万参数的Learned Physical Adjudicator（LPA）。LPA在由密集MOVi-F轨迹训练的数据上，对无序候选响应集合进行视觉上下文与响应结构比较，预测候选响应的相对权重。加权响应随后经过窗口化定位，并进行一次成对重评估以恢复运动。另提出以真实标注为锚点的Completeness-aware Motion Correspondence（CMC）评测协议，将定位、轨迹完整性、可见性和连续性联合纳入指标，并将可见动态点上的缺失预测计为失败。
AI.result: 在DAVIS和Kinetics子集上，LPA-CWM相较Uniform CWM的DCA_avg分别提升60.0%和29.0%；同时在TAP-Vid First评测中取得更高的跟踪准确率。结果表明，学习候选响应可靠性能够有效改善反事实运动恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，无需修改或微调整个预训练视频预测器，仅通过轻量级候选响应判别与加权聚合，就能显著提升CWM的运动提取性能。CMC则提供了更全面、对缺失轨迹更严格的评测方式，有助于准确衡量运动对应结果的实际质量。

title: A primer on evaluation methods for large language models in healthcare
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have a growing range of applications in medicine, and their evaluation is critical for ensuring they provide benefit and not harm. This evaluation can be more challenging than traditional machine learning for many reasons, including probabilistic and open-ended outputs, and behavior that shifts with prompt design and accumulated context. This review covers four key areas of LLM evaluation: principles of study design, statistical methods, capability evaluation and clinical context evaluation. Capability evaluation considers different benchmarks, including multiple-choice, agentic and multi-turn benchmarks, alongside operational metrics like token usage. Clinical context evaluation addresses establishing accuracy of free text outputs, such as human review and LLM-as-a-judge, and clinical trial approaches. Across sections, we describe underlying concepts and potential pitfalls, while emphasizing the importance of aligning evaluation methods with the research question. Together, this article aims to provide a pragmatic basis for designing and executing rigorous evaluations of healthcare LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于医疗领域大语言模型（LLM）评估的综述，系统讨论研究设计、统计方法、能力评估和临床情境评估，并强调评估方法应与具体研究问题相匹配。
AI.motivation: LLM在医学中的应用不断扩大，但其输出具有概率性、开放性，且会受到提示词设计和上下文累积的影响，导致传统机器学习评估方法可能不再充分。为确保医疗LLM真正带来临床收益而非风险，有必要总结适用于医疗场景的严谨评估原则与实践方法。
AI.method: 文章采用综述与方法学梳理的方式，围绕四个核心领域展开：研究设计原则、统计学方法、模型能力评估和临床情境评估。能力评估涵盖选择题、智能体、多轮交互等基准，以及token使用量等运行指标；临床情境评估则讨论自由文本准确性的判定方法，包括人工审查、LLM作为评审者以及临床试验路径，同时分析相关概念与潜在陷阱。
AI.result: 文章归纳了医疗LLM评估中的主要方法和考量因素，指出不同评估任务应根据研究问题选择相应的基准、统计方法和评价标准。其重点涉及模型能力、交互行为、资源消耗、自由文本准确性及真实临床环境中的效果评估。摘要未报告具体实验数据或定量比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 医疗LLM评估不能简单沿用传统机器学习的评价范式，而应结合模型输出特征、提示词与上下文敏感性，以及具体临床使用场景进行设计。该综述为设计和实施严谨、实用且与研究问题一致的医疗LLM评估提供了方法学基础。

title: AcquireBound: Runtime Authorization for Resources Acquired by AI Agents
summary: By acquiring compute, credentials, accounts, services, and other agents, autonomous AI agents can introduce new authority into a task. Payment, budget, OAuth, mandate, and fulfillment checks can validate transaction conditions without deciding whether a returned resource may become usable authority. This post-fulfillment activation gap spans tool-mediated creation, inter-agent delegation, and agentic commerce. We present AcquireBound, a provenance-bounded runtime authorization architecture. It quarantines acquired outputs, resolves their actual capabilities from authenticated provider evidence through a versioned resolver, and activates them only through a current activation transaction that checks the resolved manifest, provenance, epochs, and a downward-closed relational envelope over a typed resource-capability hypergraph. The envelope preserves correlated identity, effect, data, delegation, and graph-wide limits. Single-use effect permits are revalidated and consumed at effect linearization. Under explicit assumptions, we prove eight safety properties covering quarantine, backing, non-amplification, split non-evasion, crash/retry, refunds, epochs, and effect confinement. Across five resource classes, reference semantics accepted 20/20 benign traces and rejected 40/40 registered unsafe traces over 810 events; an independent checker agreed on 60 base and 40 refinement traces and rejected 89/89 tamper tests. Frozen Codex and Gemini Model Context Protocol (MCP) client components completed 54/54 deterministic local stdio calls. In a registered 18-case staged MCP-to-Docker composition, both benign paths completed, and none of the 16 unsafe paths added an unauthorized Docker start request. A five-source audit classified 1,248 field pairs across 32 units; no unit alone supplied a complete activation profile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AcquireBound，一种以来源约束为核心的运行时授权架构，用于弥合资源完成获取后、资源被激活为可用权限之前的安全缺口。系统通过隔离获取结果、解析真实能力、校验来源与版本化状态，并以一次性效果许可约束最终执行，防止代理通过获取、委托、重试或组合资源扩大权限。理论证明覆盖八类安全性质，实验在多类资源、MCP 到 Docker 的组合场景及篡改测试中均取得预期结果。
AI.motivation: 现有支付、预算、OAuth、委托和履约检查主要验证交易是否满足条件，却通常不判断交易返回的资源是否可以转化为新的可用权限。该“履约后激活缺口”可能出现在工具创建资源、代理间委托以及代理商业活动中，使自主代理通过获取计算资源、凭证、账户、服务或其他代理引入未经充分验证的新权限。因此，论文旨在建立一种能够在资源获取后、实际使用前，对能力、来源、关联约束和执行效果进行统一验证的授权机制。
AI.method: 论文提出 AcquireBound 运行时授权架构。其核心步骤包括：1）将获取结果置于隔离区，避免资源自动获得可用权限；2）依据经过认证的提供方证据，通过版本化解析器确定资源的实际能力；3）只有在当前激活事务中，同时核验能力清单、来源、状态纪元和授权关系包络后，才允许激活；4）使用定义在类型化资源—能力超图上的向下封闭关系包络，保留身份、效果、数据、委托及全图范围限制之间的相关性；5）对单次效果许可在效果线性化时重新验证并消费；6）在明确假设下，对隔离、支撑关系、非放大、拆分不可规避、崩溃/重试、退款、纪元和效果约束等八项性质进行形式化证明。实验包括五类资源上的参考语义测试、独立检查器一致性与篡改测试、冻结版本的 Codex/Gemini MCP 本地调用，以及 MCP 到 Docker 的分阶段组合测试；此外还开展了多来源字段审计。
AI.result: 参考语义在 810 个事件上接受了 20/20 条良性轨迹，并拒绝了 40/40 条已登记的不安全轨迹；独立检查器与 60 条基础轨迹和 40 条细化轨迹一致，并拒绝了 89/89 条篡改测试。冻结的 Codex 和 Gemini MCP 客户端完成了 54/54 次确定性的本地 stdio 调用。在 18 个案例的 MCP-to-Docker 组合测试中，两个良性路径均完成，16 条不安全路径均未增加未经授权的 Docker 启动请求。对 32 个单元中 1,248 对字段的五来源审计显示，没有任何单一单元能够独立提供完整的激活配置。
AI.conclusion: AcquireBound 通过将资源获取与权限激活明确分离，并将来源证明、能力解析、状态版本、关联约束和一次性效果许可纳入激活时检查，有效降低了自主代理在获取资源或组合服务时发生权限非预期扩大的风险。形式化证明和受控实验共同表明，该架构能够覆盖履约后激活、代理委托、重试恢复、退款及跨系统组合等关键场景。不过，其安全性依赖于论文所声明的环境与认证假设，实际部署仍需可靠的提供方证据、能力解析器、版本管理和效果线性化机制。

title: Adapting Open-Weight MLLMs to Generate Point Prompts for Electron Microscopy Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the BioImage Computing (BIC) Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Promptable models such as microSAM segment electron microscopy (EM) images from point prompts, but automation requires generating prompts without user input. We ask whether open-weight multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate them from natural-language requests by returning coordinates to a frozen segmenter. To that end, we convert masks from three mitochondria datasets into training examples, pairing images and instructions with centroid coordinates, then train LoRA adapters while freezing the MLLM backbone and microSAM. We find that Qwen3-VL reaches segmentation AP$_{50}$ $0.736$ after supervised fine-tuning and reward optimization, up from $0.247$ without adaptation, while automatic prompt generation (APG) achieves $0.773$. In addition, two other MLLMs improve, reaching or exceeding APG. When compared with a supervised centroid-heatmap detector that reaches AP$_{50}$ $0.904$ for this mitochondria task, Qwen3-VL more closely matches the annotated point set and instance counts. Moreover, training on two public datasets transfers to an unseen third, while training on all three transfers to an independent EM volume. Robustness tests show stable performance under unseen formulations of the natural-language request, while the coordinates can be reused by a second segmenter. To our knowledge, this is the first feasibility study of open-weight MLLMs as EM point generators, providing an inspectable, language-directed link between localization and mask decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用开放权重多模态大语言模型（MLLM）根据自然语言请求自动生成电子显微镜图像中的点提示坐标，并将坐标输入冻结的 microSAM 完成线粒体实例分割。通过 LoRA 适配、监督微调和奖励优化，Qwen3-VL 的 AP50 从 0.247 提升至 0.736，自动提示生成方案达到 0.773；其他模型也取得了相当或更好的结果。研究还验证了跨数据集迁移、跨体数据泛化、自然语言表达鲁棒性以及坐标对其他分割器的可复用性。
AI.motivation: 现有点提示分割模型能够依据人工提供的点提示分割 EM 图像，但实际自动化应用仍依赖人工输入。本文旨在探索开放权重 MLLM 是否能够理解自然语言任务请求，自动定位目标并生成点坐标，从而建立“语言指令—目标定位—掩膜解码”的自动化链路，同时保持过程可检查、可解释。
AI.method: 作者将三个线粒体数据集中的分割掩膜转换为训练样本，构造图像、自然语言指令与目标质心坐标的配对数据。训练时冻结 MLLM 主干和 microSAM，仅使用 LoRA 适配器进行参数高效微调，并结合监督微调与奖励优化训练坐标生成能力。生成的点坐标随后输入冻结的 microSAM 进行实例分割。实验比较了未适配和适配后的多种 MLLM、自动提示生成（APG）方案以及监督式质心热图检测器，并评估跨数据集迁移、独立 EM 体数据泛化、语言请求表述变化鲁棒性及跨分割器坐标复用能力。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL 的分割 AP50 从未适配时的 0.247 提升至监督微调和奖励优化后的 0.736，APG 进一步达到 0.773；另外两种 MLLM 也达到或超过 APG。监督式质心热图检测器在该线粒体任务上的 AP50 为 0.904，整体检测性能更高，但 Qwen3-VL 生成的点集和实例数量与标注更接近。使用两个公开数据集训练能够迁移到未见过的第三个数据集，使用全部三个数据集训练还能够迁移到独立 EM 体数据。模型对未见过的自然语言请求表达保持稳定，且生成坐标可被第二个分割器复用。
AI.conclusion: 开放权重 MLLM 可以作为 EM 图像的自动点提示生成器，为冻结的提示式分割器提供有效输入。该方法在性能、跨数据集迁移、语言鲁棒性和可检查性方面显示出可行性，并首次系统验证了开放权重 MLLM 在 EM 点生成任务中的应用潜力。不过，其性能仍低于专门设计的监督式质心检测器，说明通用语言模型的定位能力与任务专用检测方法之间仍存在差距。

title: MedTRACE: Tool-Augmented Multimodal Clinical Reasoning Agents for Evidence-Grounded Decision-Making
comment: Accepted to the 22nd International Conference on Advanced Data Mining and Applications (ADMA 2026)
summary: Multimodal clinical decision-making requires reliable reasoning over heterogeneous evidence from electronic health records, medical images, and physiological signals. Existing models typically map these inputs directly to diagnoses without explicitly assessing evidence sufficiency, tool-use requirements, or diagnostic uncertainty. This paper presents MedTRACE, a tool-augmented multimodal clinical reasoning agent for evidence-grounded decision-making. MedTRACE uses modality-specific encoders to construct a unified patient-state representation and performs an iterative loop of hypothesis formation, toolaware deliberation, and evidence verification. It dynamically invokes visual grounding, evidence retrieval, and structured parsing tools to locate diagnosis-relevant regions, retrieve clinical knowledge and similar cases, and extract structured findings. The acquired evidence enters an evidence memory, where a consistency verifier confirms or revises the current hypothesis. MedTRACE outputs a diagnosis together with supporting evidence, an auditable reasoning trace, and calibrated confidence. Experiments on multiple multimodal clinical diagnosis benchmarks show that MedTRACE improves diagnostic accuracy by 5.4% and AUROC by 4.7 percentage points over the strongest baseline. It also improves evidenceselection F1 by 8.2 percentage points and visual-grounding IoU by 6.5 percentage points, reduces expected calibration error by 31.6%, and decreases unsupported diagnostic errors by 27.8%. These results demonstrate that active evidence acquisition and verification improve the accuracy, interpretability, and reliability of multimodal clinical decisionmaking.

AI.tldr: MedTRACE是一种面向多模态临床决策的工具增强型推理智能体。它统一编码电子健康记录、医学影像和生理信号，循环执行假设形成、工具调用、证据验证，并输出诊断、证据、可审计推理轨迹及校准置信度。多基准实验显示其在诊断性能、证据选择、视觉定位、置信度校准和减少无证据诊断错误方面均优于最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态临床模型通常将电子健康记录、医学影像和生理信号直接映射为诊断结果，缺乏对证据是否充分、是否需要调用工具以及诊断不确定性的显式评估。这会导致证据利用不足、推理过程不可审计、视觉依据不准确以及缺乏支持的诊断错误。论文旨在通过主动获取和验证证据，提高多模态临床决策的准确性、可解释性与可靠性。
AI.method: MedTRACE采用模态专属编码器构建统一的患者状态表示，并执行迭代式推理流程，包括假设形成、工具感知的审议和证据验证。系统可动态调用视觉定位、证据检索和结构化解析工具，分别用于定位与诊断相关的影像区域、检索临床知识和相似病例、提取结构化临床发现。获得的证据被写入证据记忆模块，由一致性验证器确认或修正当前假设。最终输出诊断结论、支持性证据、可审计推理轨迹和校准置信度。
AI.result: 在多个多模态临床诊断基准上，相较最强基线，MedTRACE使诊断准确率提高5.4%，AUROC提高4.7个百分点，证据选择F1提高8.2个百分点，视觉定位IoU提高6.5个百分点；预期校准误差降低31.6%，缺乏支持证据的诊断错误减少27.8%。
AI.conclusion: 主动证据获取与一致性验证能够有效提升多模态临床决策的诊断性能、证据可追溯性、视觉依据质量和置信度可靠性。MedTRACE说明，临床多模态模型不应仅进行端到端预测，还应显式管理证据、工具使用和不确定性。

title: AI Persuasion as a Threat to Human Control
summary: The threat that AI persuasion poses to human control has been acknowledged in the literature, but not yet systematically studied. Now that persuasion attacks are no longer theoretical - with Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 recently making headlines for trying to convince people involved in an open-source project to merge malicious code during an evaluation - there is a pressing need to deeply analyze this threat. We undertake that effort here. In particular, we analyze how AI could persuade humans in key settings (e.g. safety-relevant R&D within frontier labs) toward decisions that compromise the development, containment, oversight, and governance of AI itself. In doing so, we elucidate a framework for characterizing this threat, develop five concrete scenarios using this framework, and provide a blueprint for assessing the associated risks. Using this blueprint, we conduct an initial risk estimation survey with select researchers and find that their opinions on which scenarios are riskiest are highly mixed. Their disagreements stem from differing opinions about the effectiveness of AI persuasion in different contexts, and point to the need for follow-up risk elicitation studies and persuasion evaluations, which we outline. Our hope is that this paper highlights the risks from AI persuasion undermining control, and provides a path forward for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析人工智能通过说服人类削弱人类对AI的控制这一新兴风险，提出威胁刻画框架、五类具体情景及风险评估方案，并通过初步专家调查发现不同情景的风险判断存在显著分歧。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已意识到AI说服可能威胁人类控制，但缺乏系统研究。随着AI说服攻击从理论设想逐渐出现，尤其是在评估中出现试图诱导人员合并恶意代码的案例，亟需分析AI可能如何影响安全研发、遏制、监督与治理等关键决策。
AI.method: 作者首先构建用于刻画AI说服控制风险的分析框架；随后基于该框架设计五个具体风险情景，并提出一套风险评估蓝图；最后邀请部分研究人员开展初步风险估计调查，比较他们对不同情景风险程度的判断及其分歧来源。
AI.result: 研究发现，参与者对哪些情景最具风险的看法高度不一致。分歧主要源于他们对AI在不同环境、面对不同对象时说服有效性的判断不同。论文据此指出，仅有概念分析不足以解决问题，还需要进一步开展风险引导调查和实证性的AI说服能力评估。
AI.conclusion: 本文将AI说服削弱人类控制的问题系统化，提供了威胁分析框架、情景库和风险评估路径。其核心结论是，该风险具有现实性但不确定性较高，后续研究应重点测量AI说服在关键安全与治理场景中的实际效果，并改进风险评估方法。

title: Bridging the Synthetic-to-Real Gap for Few-Shot Cryo-ET Classification
summary: Subtomogram classification in cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) is a challenging problem due to the scarcity of labeled examples. While cryo-ET simulators can be adopted to generate unlimited synthetic data, the substantial domain gap between synthetic and real subtomograms hinders its practical utilization. In this work, we propose a novel synthetic-to-real adaptation framework with a learnable transformation module, bridging this gap at both the input and feature levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing transfer learning baselines in few-shot settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）子断层分类的合成到真实域适应框架，通过可学习变换模块在输入层和特征层同时缩小合成数据与真实数据之间的域差距，从而提升少样本分类性能。
AI.motivation: cryo-ET子断层分类通常缺乏充足的人工标注样本。尽管模拟器能够生成大量甚至无限的合成数据，但合成子断层与真实子断层之间存在显著域差距，导致直接利用合成数据训练的模型难以在真实数据上取得良好效果。因此，需要一种有效的合成到真实迁移方法，以充分利用合成数据并降低对真实标注样本的依赖。
AI.method: 提出一种带有可学习变换模块的合成到真实域适应框架，在两个层面进行域对齐：一是在输入层对合成数据进行可学习变换，使其外观和分布更接近真实子断层；二是在特征层进一步缩小两种域的表示差异。该方法面向少样本场景，并与现有迁移学习基线进行比较。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在少样本设置下，该方法始终优于现有的迁移学习基线，说明其能够更有效地缓解合成数据与真实数据之间的域差距，并提升真实子断层分类性能。摘要未提供具体数据集、指标或绝对性能提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 通过在输入层和特征层联合进行域适应，所提出的可学习变换框架能够有效利用合成数据辅助真实cryo-ET子断层分类，尤其适用于真实标注样本稀缺的少样本场景。

title: Route, Don't Fix: Regime-Dependent Decoding Correction and a Trajectory-Gated Router for Reliable Clinical LLM Answer Selection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often deemed unsafe for clinical question answering because of their tendency to hallucinate. Retrieval augmentation, fine-tuning, and external verifiers require new infrastructure that clinical governance must approve and may add latency or extra model calls. Inference-time correction uses the model's internal logit signals, but a fixed transformation need not suit every question. A corrector that improves accuracy by about ten percentage points on a truthfulness stress test yields negligible gains on clinical multiple-choice benchmarks, where instruction tuning concentrates output probability on one answer and leaves low terminal entropy. We introduce ALTAS, which reads terminal entropy and late-layer linearity ($R^2$) from one forward pass to choose per question between greedy decoding and late-layer trajectory correction. No classifier, probe, or head is trained; the router operates on candidate-answer logits and adds 6.5% latency overhead. Applied to every question, the correction improves TruthfulQA over greedy at 3B and 8B by 11.4 and 10.0 percentage points, respectively ($p<10^{-10}$). Gated per question, ALTAS retains gains of 8.3 to 9.5 percentage points while keeping MedQA, PubMedQA, and MedHallu within a one-percentage-point do-no-harm band, with no statistically significant differences from greedy. The method passes verification sweeps over frozen thresholds, the scoring rule, and the domain label.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ALTAS：利用单次前向传播中的终端熵与晚层线性度（R²），按问题动态选择贪心解码或晚层轨迹校正，以提升模型真实性并避免临床问答性能受损。该方法无需训练分类器、探针或额外输出头，仅增加约6.5%的延迟；在 TruthfulQA 上显著提升，同时使 MedQA、PubMedQA 和 MedHallu 的性能保持在一个百分点的无损范围内。
AI.motivation: LLM 在临床问答中的主要风险是幻觉，但检索增强、微调和外部验证器通常需要额外基础设施、治理审批、延迟或模型调用。现有推理时校正方法依赖固定变换，难以适应不同问题；尤其在临床选择题中，指令微调会使输出概率高度集中于单一答案、终端熵较低，导致在一般真实性压力测试上有效的校正方法未必能改善临床基准。因此，需要一种无需额外训练和复杂基础设施、能够按问题判断是否适合校正的方法。
AI.method: 提出 ALTAS 路由方法。它在一次前向传播中读取候选答案 logits 相关的终端熵和晚层轨迹线性度 R²，据此逐题选择贪心解码或晚层轨迹校正。方法不训练分类器、probe 或额外 head，路由器直接基于候选答案 logits 工作，额外延迟约为 6.5%。实验还对冻结阈值、评分规则和领域标签进行验证性扫描，以检验方法的稳健性。
AI.result: 对所有问题统一使用校正时，ALTAS 相比贪心解码在 TruthfulQA 上，3B 和 8B 模型分别提升 11.4 和 10.0 个百分点，且 p<10^-10。逐题门控后仍保留 8.3 至 9.5 个百分点的提升，同时在 MedQA、PubMedQA 和 MedHallu 上均处于一个百分点的无损区间，与贪心解码相比没有统计显著差异。方法还通过了不同冻结阈值、评分规则和领域标签的验证扫描。
AI.conclusion: ALTAS 说明，基于模型内部信号的逐题路由比对所有问题统一施加校正更适合兼顾真实性与临床问答安全性。它以较小的延迟开销和无需额外训练或基础设施的方式，显著提升真实性，同时避免在多个临床基准上造成明显性能损失。不过，摘要主要报告了特定模型规模、基准和内部信号下的结果，实际临床部署仍需进一步验证其跨模型、跨任务和真实工作流的可靠性。

title: Another Blueprint In The Wall: How to Ask Frontier AI Like a Kid?
summary: This paper reports experiments across six frontier model types from OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google DeepMind. Ten independent sessions per model type used the same three stage prompt sequence, progressing from architectural preference to a full ASCII backbone. Under the school audience framing, responses repeatedly converged on a shared architectural pattern built around persistent latent state, adaptive computation, memory, specialist routing, verification, stopping control, and delayed decoding. Most runs remained close to this common structure, while a small number developed markedly greater engineering specificity. The audience framing appears to be an important condition of this effect. In additional control runs that removed the school framing while retaining the architectural request, responses became substantially more heterogeneous and failed to reproduce the same stable motif convergence. One observation is particularly striking. GPT-5.6 Sol produced an unusually elaborate successor architecture whose organization closely overlaps with the architecture independently sketched by GPT-6 Astra. Because the prompts explicitly ask each model to imagine an architectural future, this resemblance raises a testable question: whether the overlap reflects exposure to related architectural concepts, a shared learned design prior, or independent convergence toward similar computational principles. The paper uses the term epistemic jailbreak for the accompanying loss of discipline in technical provenance as requested specificity increases. The experiments establish a repeatable behavioral pattern and do not authenticate proprietary implementation claims. What we leave to the community is a harder question: are these models independently imagining the same architectural future, or do such motifs somehow propagate between model families?

AI.tldr: 该论文通过六类前沿模型的多轮提示实验，研究模型在特定受众框架下是否会稳定地产生相似的未来架构设想。结果显示，学校受众设定显著促进了架构模式收敛；去除该设定后，输出明显更异质。论文还报告了两个模型架构草图之间的高度重叠，但仅将其视为待检验现象，未据此证明模型间存在信息传播或专有实现泄露。
AI.motivation: 论文的核心动机是检验不同模型家族在被要求构想未来计算架构时，是否会独立收敛到相似的设计原则；同时考察提示中的受众框架是否会影响这种收敛，并区分真正的架构趋同与技术来源表述失真。
AI.method: 研究覆盖来自四家机构的六类前沿模型。每类模型进行十次独立会话，使用相同的三阶段提示序列，逐步从架构偏好推进到完整的ASCII骨干设计。实验设置包含学校受众框架，以及保留架构请求但移除学校框架的对照条件。研究比较不同模型输出中的架构 motif、工程细节程度和跨模型重叠，并将技术来源与具体性增加时出现的纪律性下降称为“认识论越狱”。
AI.result: 在学校受众框架下，多数模型反复生成包含持久潜状态、自适应计算、记忆、专家路由、验证、停止控制和延迟解码等组件的共同架构模式；少数运行表现出更高的工程细化程度。移除学校框架后，输出异质性显著增加，稳定的共同 motif 不再复现。另有一个模型生成的复杂后继架构与另一模型独立绘制的架构高度重叠，但该现象尚不能区分相关概念暴露、共享设计先验或独立趋同。
AI.conclusion: 论文支持这样一个有限结论：受众框架能够系统性影响模型架构想象，并诱导跨模型的结构性收敛。但证据不足以证明模型之间存在架构信息传播、专有实现泄露或真实系统同源。后续需要更严格的盲测、提示扰动、时间切分、概念去重和来源审计，以检验重叠究竟来自共享训练先验、共同技术文化，还是独立的计算原则趋同。

title: RA-CoA: Training-free Fashion Image Captioning via Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes
summary: Fashion Image Captioning (FIC) plays a vital role in enhancing user experience and product search in e-commerce platforms. Unlike natural scene image captioning, FIC requires fine-grained visual reasoning and knowledge of domain-specific terminology to capture subtle attributes such as neckline and closure types, graphic patterns, and dress silhouettes. Moreover, as fashion inventories evolve rapidly with new trends, styles, and frequently emerging vocabulary, developing training-free captioning solution becomes essential for scalability and real-world adaptability. Instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising solution to fashion image captioning dueto their strong zero-shot capabilities and natural language fluency. However, these general-purpose models often lack attribute-level coverage and precision, and tend to hallucinate or misidentify fine-grained fashion details, making them less suitable for high-fidelity applications like product cataloging or personalized recommendations. To address this, we propose RA-CoA (Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes), a novel, training-free framework that disentangles fashion image captioning into two interpretable stages: (i) retrieval of relevant attribute sets from a product knowledge base, and (ii) attribute-level reasoning to generate the final caption. RA-CoA is a model-agnostic approach that works with frozen VLMs to improve fine-grained attribute precision in product captions without the need for fine-tuning. Extensive evaluations across diverse VLM model families under different prompting paradigms demonstrate that RA-CoA significantly improves caption quality, achieving an average gain of 26.3% METEOR score over zero-shot captioning. We make our code publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RA-CoA，一种无需训练的检索增强属性链框架，将时尚图像描述拆分为属性检索与属性推理两个阶段，借助产品知识库提升冻结视觉语言模型对细粒度服饰属性的识别和描述能力；实验显示其相较零样本描述平均提升26.3%的METEOR得分。
AI.motivation: 现有通用视觉语言模型虽然具备较强的零样本图像描述能力，但在时尚商品场景中容易遗漏、幻觉生成或误判领口、闭合方式、图案和版型等细粒度属性。由于时尚库存、潮流和术语更新迅速，依赖频繁微调的方案难以扩展，因此需要一种训练无关、可适应新属性且具有较高属性精度的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出RA-CoA（Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes）。该方法将时尚图像描述解耦为两个可解释阶段：1）从产品知识库中检索与图像相关的属性集合；2）基于检索到的属性进行属性级推理，并生成最终商品描述。框架与模型无关，可直接作用于冻结的视觉语言模型，并支持不同模型家族和提示范式。
AI.result: 在多种视觉语言模型家族及不同提示设置下进行广泛评估。RA-CoA显著提升了描述质量，相比零样本图像描述，METEOR平均提高26.3%。结果表明，外部属性知识检索和分阶段推理能够有效增强细粒度时尚属性的覆盖率与准确性。摘要未提供其他数据集、基线、显著性检验或消融实验的具体结果。
AI.conclusion: RA-CoA为时尚图像描述提供了一种无需训练、可解释且具有较强扩展性的方案，能够缓解通用视觉语言模型在细粒度属性识别中的遗漏和幻觉问题，适用于商品目录生成和个性化推荐等高保真应用。其实际效果仍依赖产品知识库的质量、检索准确性以及视觉语言模型本身的能力。

title: Enemray: Toward Capable Language Models for Hassaniya
summary: We introduce Enemray, a Hassaniya-centric language model that enables general-purpose interaction in Hassaniya. Enemray is trained around a stability--plasticity objective: acquire strong Hassaniya linguistic and cultural competence while preserving the general reasoning, multilingual, instruction-following, and safety behaviors of a capable instruction-tuned model. The development pipeline separates language acquisition from behavioral specialization. A separately assembled continual-pretraining corpus provides broad exposure to natural Hassaniya and Mauritanian text; layer-selective continual pretraining learns a compact language-specific parameter update; that update is transferred into the instruction-tuned parameter space; and supervised post-training develops conversational, cultural, literary, task-oriented, and cross-lingual behavior. The supervised corpus integrates selected public Hassaniya and Mauritanian resources with a substantially larger body of newly collected, reconstructed, curated, and constructed instruction data, while policy-generated replay provides a retention signal from the reference model's own behavior distribution. The resulting collection is substantially larger and broader in purpose than existing Hassaniya text resources. In evaluation, Enemray achieves the strongest English to Hassaniya translation among the compared open and proprietary models and the highest overall score on Mauritanian translation error detection, while retaining most of the general capabilities of its instruction-tuned base model on mathematical reasoning, knowledge, code generation, and function calling. This report describes the motivation, data construction, model design, training methodology, and evaluation of Enemray.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 Enemray，一种面向哈桑语（Hassaniya）的语言模型。该模型采用稳定性—可塑性目标，通过分离语言习得与行为专门化，在增强哈桑语及毛里塔尼亚文化能力的同时，尽量保留基础指令模型的推理、多语种、指令遵循和安全能力。实验显示，Enemray 在英译哈桑语和毛里塔尼亚翻译错误检测方面领先，并较好保留数学、知识、代码生成和函数调用能力。
AI.motivation: 哈桑语可用的高质量数字文本、指令数据和专门语言模型资源有限，导致现有通用模型在哈桑语交互、文化语境理解和毛里塔尼亚相关翻译任务上的能力不足。与此同时，针对低资源语言进行持续预训练或微调，可能削弱原模型已有的通用推理、多语种和安全行为。因此，本文旨在构建一个既具备哈桑语与毛里塔尼亚文化能力，又能保持通用能力的模型。
AI.method: 研究采用稳定性—可塑性框架，将语言能力获取与行为专门化分开处理。首先，构建独立的持续预训练语料，覆盖自然哈桑语和毛里塔尼亚文本；随后使用层选择式持续预训练学习紧凑的语言特定参数更新，并将其迁移到指令微调模型的参数空间。在监督后训练阶段，融合公开哈桑语及毛里塔尼亚资源，以及大量新收集、重构、整理和构造的指令数据，覆盖对话、文化、文学、任务型和跨语言行为。同时，通过策略生成式回放，利用参考模型自身的行为分布提供能力保持信号。
AI.result: Enemray 在参与比较的开源和闭源模型中取得最强的英语到哈桑语翻译表现，并在毛里塔尼亚翻译错误检测任务中获得最高综合得分。在通用能力方面，模型保留了其指令微调基础模型的大部分数学推理、知识问答、代码生成和函数调用能力。其训练数据集合在规模和任务覆盖范围上也明显超过现有哈桑语文本资源。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，通过语言学习与行为专门化的模块化训练、层选择式参数更新以及策略生成式回放，可以有效提升低资源语言能力，同时减小对通用模型能力的损害。Enemray 为哈桑语通用交互提供了较完整的模型、数据和训练方案，但摘要未报告详细数据规模、具体基准数值、统计显著性或不同组件的消融结果，因此其优势来源和可复现性仍需结合全文进一步评估。

title: Crypto Accounting Bench: Evaluating Frontier and Open-Weight Models on Crypto-Asset Accounting Tasks
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Entendre/Crypto-Accounting-Bench ; code and evaluation: https://github.com/EntendreFinance/crypto-accounting-benchmark
summary: We introduce Crypto Accounting Bench (CAB), a benchmark for assessing whether frontier and open-weight language models can reconstruct the complete journal entry that an organization actually posted for a crypto-asset transaction. CAB contains 118 evaluation tasks drawn from 7 pseudonymized organizations. Each task combines transaction mechanics, asset quantities and base-currency values, wallet and legal-entity context, counterparty evidence, related transaction legs, recurrence, tax-lot evidence, and the organization's complete chart of accounts. The target is a balanced structured entry with every required account, side, amount, currency, and full-precision asset quantity. We evaluate 12 models spanning proprietary frontier systems and open-weight releases over 3 independent attempts per task, producing 4,248 trajectories. We report 3 metrics: Mean Score, Best@3, and Pass@3. Pass@3 is the fraction of tasks with at least 1 of 3 attempts that satisfies every rubric criterion and required gate. The leading model reaches 77.43% Mean Score, while the best Pass@3 is 56.78%. Deterministic diagnostics, read from each task's best of 3 attempts and macro-averaged across the 12 models, show higher base-amount agreement (97.8%) than deciding-account accuracy (56.3%). Together with the failure analysis, these results identify account selection and complete-entry composition as the main remaining challenges on CAB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Crypto Accounting Bench（CAB），用于评估语言模型能否依据复杂的加密资产交易证据，重建组织实际过账的完整会计分录。基准包含来自7个匿名化组织的118项任务，测试12个模型、每项任务独立尝试3次，共4248条轨迹。领先模型平均得分77.43%，最佳Pass@3为56.78%；诊断显示金额匹配明显优于科目选择，后者是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型评测通常关注文本理解、问答或局部会计判断，难以衡量模型是否能够综合交易机制、资产数量、法币金额、钱包与法律实体、交易对手、关联交易、重复发生性、税务批次及完整科目表等多源证据，重建组织实际记录的完整加密资产会计分录。CAB旨在填补这一评测空白，并识别模型在真实会计工作流中的关键失效点。
AI.method: 构建包含118项任务的CAB，任务来自7个匿名化组织。每项任务整合交易及会计判断所需的多维证据，目标输出为结构化、平衡的完整分录，必须包含所有必要科目、借贷方向、金额、币种和全精度资产数量。评估12个专有前沿模型与开放权重模型，每项任务进行3次独立尝试，共生成4248条轨迹。采用Mean Score、Best@3和Pass@3三个指标，并基于每个任务的最佳尝试计算金额匹配与科目决策等确定性诊断指标。
AI.result: 领先模型的Mean Score为77.43%，最佳Pass@3为56.78%，说明模型在部分标准上表现较好，但要一次生成完全合格的分录仍较困难。跨12个模型宏平均的诊断结果显示，基础金额一致率为97.8%，而决定性科目准确率仅为56.3%。失败分析进一步表明，科目选择和完整分录构成是主要错误来源。
AI.conclusion: CAB表明，当前语言模型能够较好地处理基础金额和部分交易信息，但在选择正确会计科目及组合成满足全部要求的完整、平衡分录方面仍存在显著不足。该基准为评估模型在复杂加密资产会计场景中的端到端能力提供了系统工具，也明确了后续改进应重点关注科目推断、证据整合与完整分录生成。

title: A Voxel-Spacing-Aware Extension of PyRadiomics for Anisotropic Texture Analysis
summary: Radiomic texture features are commonly extracted from anisotropic CT and MRI acquisitions, where identical voxel offsets may represent different physical distances. We implemented and validated a voxel-spacing-aware extension of PyRadiomics that incorporates spacing information without generating interpolated gray levels. The framework operates across the Python frontend, C wrapper, and computational backend. GLCM uses anisotropy-relative feature-level angular aggregation, NGTDM uses anisotropy-relative weighted neighborhood averaging, and GLRLM, GLDM, and GLSZM are computed on a finite-volume zero-order-hold representation derived from the native anisotropic grid. Synthetic 3D phantoms were used for software validation. The modified implementation reproduced standard PyRadiomics exactly when spacing-aware mode was disabled and remained equivalent under isotropic spacing across 75 texture features. Under anisotropic spacing, the method selectively modified texture families and was numerically distinct from nearest-neighbor, linear, and B-spline resampling. Computational profiling showed moderate runtime and memory increases, while sensitivity analyses quantified finite-volume rounding effects and confirmed that spacing-aware differences persisted across binWidth settings. The framework provides a backward-compatible technical basis for future evaluation of spacing-aware radiomics in heterogeneous medical imaging datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个具有体素间距感知能力的 PyRadiomics 扩展，用于处理各向异性 CT/MRI 数据，在不生成插值灰度值的前提下，将真实空间间距纳入纹理特征计算。该方法保持向后兼容，并在合成三维模体上验证了正确性、数值差异和计算开销。
AI.motivation: 传统放射组学纹理特征通常基于体素网格中的离散偏移计算，但在各向异性 CT 和 MRI 中，相同的体素偏移可能对应不同的实际物理距离，导致纹理分析无法准确反映空间结构。常见重采样方法又会引入插值灰度值及潜在偏差。因此，研究旨在建立一种直接利用原始体素间距、避免灰度插值、且兼容现有 PyRadiomics 工作流的技术框架。
AI.method: 研究对 PyRadiomics 的 Python 前端、C 包装层和计算后端进行了协同修改。对于 GLCM，采用相对于各向异性的特征级角度聚合；对于 NGTDM，采用基于各向异性的加权邻域平均；对于 GLRLM、GLDM 和 GLSZM，则在原始各向异性网格基础上构造有限体积零阶保持表示进行计算。研究使用合成三维模体开展软件验证，并比较关闭间距感知模式、各向同性间距、各向异性间距以及最近邻、线性和 B 样条重采样等条件下的结果。同时评估运行时间、内存占用、有限体积舍入效应，以及不同 binWidth 设置对结果的影响。
AI.result: 关闭间距感知模式时，修改后的实现与标准 PyRadiomics 完全一致；在各向同性间距下，75 个纹理特征均保持等价。在各向异性间距下，该方法有选择地改变了部分纹理特征家族，且结果在数值上不同于最近邻、线性和 B 样条重采样方法。计算分析显示运行时间和内存占用出现中等程度增加。敏感性分析量化了有限体积舍入带来的影响，并表明间距感知结果的差异在不同 binWidth 设置下仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一个向后兼容、无需灰度插值的 PyRadiomics 间距感知扩展，为在异质性医学影像数据中开展空间一致的放射组学分析提供了技术基础。当前工作主要完成了软件实现与验证，尚未证明其在临床任务中的性能优势，未来仍需在真实、多中心及不同成像协议数据上评估其可重复性、稳定性和临床价值。

title: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
summary: Recent work extends recursive self-improvement (RSI) to agent harnesses for long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, enabling agents to improve execution mechanisms from experience. However, generalizable harness RSI remains challenging. First, evolving harnesses on evaluation benchmarks or their subsets makes it difficult to distinguish reusable improvements from benchmark-specific adaptation. Second, single-trajectory updates can conflate systematic harness deficiencies with instance-specific reasoning and solution details, producing modifications that transfer poorly to unseen tasks. Third, localizing recurring behavioral deficiencies within monolithic harnesses is difficult, while whole-harness optimization can entangle unrelated mechanisms and complicate attribution and validation. We propose ModularRSI, a benchmark-disjoint, contrastive, and modular framework for generalizable harness evolution. ModularRSI contrasts successful and failed trajectories for the same task and aggregates evidence across tasks to identify recurring behavioral deficiencies. It decomposes the evolvable harness into five functional modules: Agent Loop, Tool Use, Observation Management, Context Management, and Task Completion Detection. Each module evolves independently within a restricted modification scope, followed by an integration stage that combines the evolved modules into a unified harness and resolves potential conflicts. To support benchmark-disjoint evolution, we curate 2,000 executable evolution tasks from external sources that are disjoint from downstream evaluation benchmarks. Experiments on TB2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified show consistent improvements on unseen in-domain and cross-domain tasks, with the evolved harness also transferring across different foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ModularRSI，一个面向长时程编码与终端任务的可泛化模块化递归自改进框架。该方法使用跨任务的成功/失败轨迹对比来定位重复性行为缺陷，将 harness 拆分为五个模块并分别演化，再通过集成阶段合并模块。实验表明，在与演化任务不重叠的评测中，方法可提升 TB2.0 和 SWE-Bench Verified 上的性能，并能跨领域、跨基础模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 递归自改进存在三个主要问题：在评测基准或其子集上演化会导致基准特化，难以判断改进是否可复用；基于单条轨迹更新容易混淆系统性的 harness 缺陷与特定实例的推理和解题细节，导致对未见任务迁移较差；整体式 harness 难以定位反复出现的行为缺陷，且全局优化会耦合无关机制，增加归因与验证难度。因此，论文旨在构建一种基准无关、能从多任务证据中识别共性缺陷、并支持精确模块化优化的 RSI 框架。
AI.method: 提出 ModularRSI。首先，对同一任务的成功轨迹和失败轨迹进行对比，并跨多个任务聚合证据，以识别可重复出现的行为缺陷。其次，将可演化 harness 分解为五个功能模块：Agent Loop、Tool Use、Observation Management、Context Management 和 Task Completion Detection；每个模块在受限修改范围内独立演化，以降低机制耦合并改善问题归因。最后，通过集成阶段将各模块合并为统一 harness，并处理模块间潜在冲突。为避免基准污染，作者从外部来源构造了 2,000 个与下游评测基准不重叠的可执行演化任务。
AI.result: 在 TB2.0 和 SWE-Bench Verified 上，ModularRSI 在未见的同领域任务和跨领域任务上均取得稳定改进。演化得到的 harness 还能够迁移到不同的基础模型，说明该方法学习到的改进并非局限于特定评测集或单一模型。摘要未提供具体数值、基线对比幅度、统计显著性或消融实验结果，因此目前只能确认定性优势。
AI.conclusion: ModularRSI 通过基准无关的演化数据、成功/失败轨迹对比、跨任务证据聚合和模块化优化，缓解了 harness RSI 中的过拟合、单轨迹误归因和全局优化耦合问题。结果支持其在长时程编码与终端任务中的泛化能力，并显示出跨任务领域和基础模型的迁移潜力；但其各模块的独立贡献、集成冲突处理的必要性以及计算成本仍需结合完整论文进一步评估。

title: ANASSA: An Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence
summary: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) and large multimodal models (LMMs) has enabled a new class of agentic systems capable of integrating natural language understanding with tool-based execution. In geographic information systems (GIS), this shift is transforming traditional, expert-driven workflows into semiautonomous systems that can interpret user intent, construct spatial workflows, and execute geospatial analysis tasks. However, existing approaches remain limited by fragmented integration of reasoning, execution, and evaluation, particularly in complex, real-world environments. This study synthesizes recent advances in agentic GIS frameworks, benchmarks, and surveys to identify limitations in spatial reasoning, execution robustness, validation, governance, and evaluation. Building on these insights, it introduces ANASSA (Autonomous Neural Agents for Spatial Systems Architecture), an agentic AI orchestration framework that integrates structured spatial reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, execution feedback, authoritative spatial validation, provenance, uncertainty handling, and human decision authority within a unified system design. The contribution is an architecture-level specification: eleven components across four layers, a six-step Geospatial AI Cognitive Loop, cross-component contracts, and governance mechanisms intended to make agentic geospatial workflows traceable, reproducible, and accountable. Empirical performance evaluation is reserved for implementation and deployment studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ANASSA，一种面向地理信息系统的智能体人工智能编排框架，通过结构化空间推理、多智能体工作流、执行反馈、权威空间验证、溯源、不确定性处理和人工决策权，构建可追踪、可复现且可问责的地理空间分析体系。文章属于架构级研究，暂未进行实证性能评估。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型和大型多模态模型推动了能够理解自然语言并调用工具执行任务的智能体系统发展，为GIS工作流从专家驱动向半自主化转型提供了基础。然而，现有方法在复杂真实环境中往往未能有效整合推理、执行与评估，并存在空间推理能力不足、执行鲁棒性有限、结果验证不充分、治理机制薄弱和评价体系不完善等问题。因此，本文旨在系统梳理相关进展并提出统一的智能体GIS架构，以弥补这些缺陷。
AI.method: 本文综合分析近期智能体GIS框架、基准数据集和综述研究，在此基础上提出ANASSA（Autonomous Neural Agents for Spatial Systems Architecture）架构。该架构包含四个层次、十一个组件和六步地理空间AI认知循环，并通过跨组件契约整合结构化空间推理、多智能体工作流编排、执行反馈、权威空间验证、数据与过程溯源、不确定性处理及人工决策权限。同时，框架引入治理机制，以支持工作流的可追踪性、可复现性和问责性。
AI.result: 研究产出是一个架构级规范，而非经过部署验证的完整系统。ANASSA明确了智能体GIS系统的核心组件、层次结构、认知循环、组件间协作契约及治理机制，为复杂地理空间任务中的推理、执行、验证和监督提供了统一设计。论文未报告实验数据、对比结果或性能指标，实证评估被留待后续实现与部署研究。
AI.conclusion: 本文认为，面向真实GIS环境的智能体系统需要将空间推理、工作流执行、结果验证、溯源、不确定性管理和人工监督纳入统一架构。ANASSA为构建透明、可复现、可审计且具备责任边界的地理空间智能体系统提供了概念基础，但其实际有效性仍需通过后续实现、基准测试和部署实验加以验证。

title: Accelerating HKTex without Mesh Eigensystems: Local Unfolding and Randomized Thermal Features
summary:
Heat Kernel Textures (HKTex) represent surface appearance with intrinsic anisotropic
  kernels, but evaluate them using 50 global Laplace-Beltrami eigendecompositions and a
  resident basis of shape [50,V,256]. We study two complementary ways to remove this
  bottleneck while leaving the trainer, GeodesicOpt, density control, and compositing
  unchanged. LocalHK exploits the measured locality of trained kernels and replaces
  spectral evaluation by radius-bounded hinge unfolding and an analytic log-map kernel.
  On 10 Objaverse meshes and an 8-mesh low-poly holdout, it changes mean view PSNR from
  31.35 to 32.00 and from 29.82 to 30.76 dB, respectively, while reducing
  initialization by 40.5 times and enabling a 749,570-vertex proxy-backed run where the
  spectral baseline fails. ThermalRF instead preserves the discrete anisotropic heat
  semigroup: GPU sparse Chebyshev actions and randomized range finding construct global
  low-rank heat factors without mesh-sized eigenvectors, and a compiled evaluator mixes
  four neighboring thermal responses. On spot and a thin-stem challenge, ThermalRF
  reduces end-to-end preprocessing, initialization, and 5,000-step optimization by
  29.3% and 24.4%, with every surface, atlas, or view PSNR change within 0.12 dB and
  training allocation reduced by about 90%. The two routes expose a useful design
  choice: maximal locality and scale versus fidelity to the thermal PDE. Broader
  thermal-feature evaluation and real large scenes remain future work.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Heat Kernel Textures（HKTex）依赖50组全局拉普拉斯–贝尔特拉米特特征分解和大规模驻留基导致初始化慢、显存/内存开销高及难以处理超大网格的问题，提出两条互补的加速路线：强调局部性的 LocalHK，以及保持热半群物理结构的 ThermalRF。两者均不改变训练器、GeodesicOpt、密度控制和合成流程。LocalHK在多个数据集上提升PSNR并大幅降低初始化成本；ThermalRF在基本保持画质的同时降低端到端训练成本和显存分配。
AI.motivation: HKTex通过内在各向异性核表示表面外观，但其频谱评估需要50次全局拉普拉斯–贝尔特拉米特特征分解，以及形状为[50,V,256]的驻留基。当网格顶点数V很大时，这些步骤会造成显著的初始化、存储和训练瓶颈，甚至使基线无法运行。因此，论文旨在消除网格规模相关的谱计算开销，同时保持现有训练和渲染框架不变，并探索局部近似与物理保真全局低秩表示之间的权衡。
AI.method: 论文提出两种互补方法。1）LocalHK：利用训练后核函数呈现局部性的经验，将谱域评估替换为半径受限的hinge unfolding，并结合解析log-map核进行局部计算，从而避免全局特征分解和网格大小的驻留特征基。2）ThermalRF：保留离散各向异性热半群结构，使用GPU稀疏Chebyshev算子作用和随机范围求解构造全局低秩热因子，避免存储网格规模的特征向量；再通过编译后的评估器混合四个相邻的热响应。两种方法都保持原有trainer、GeodesicOpt、density control和compositing不变。
AI.result: LocalHK在10个Objaverse网格上将平均视角PSNR从31.35提升至32.00 dB，在8个低多边形留出网格上从29.82提升至30.76 dB；初始化速度提升40.5倍，并支持749,570顶点的代理网格运行，而谱基线无法运行。ThermalRF在spot和细杆挑战数据上，端到端预处理、初始化及5000步优化时间分别降低29.3%和24.4%；所有表面、纹理图集或视角PSNR变化均不超过0.12 dB，同时训练阶段的内存分配约减少90%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，HKTex的谱瓶颈可以通过两种不同路线有效缓解：LocalHK最大化局部性和尺度扩展能力，适合追求更高效率及超大网格可运行性；ThermalRF则更忠实地保留热偏微分方程对应的离散热半群，在基本不损失画质的情况下获得稳定加速和显著内存节省。两者体现了局部近似与热物理保真之间的设计选择。论文仍缺少更广泛的热特征评估以及真实大型场景验证。

title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
summary: Recursive self-improvement is becoming increasingly vital for autonomous AI agents, where progress hinges on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. The driver of this process is effective exploration, however, managing and improving exploration strategies remains a major bottleneck. Current systems face a fundamental dilemma: fixed strategies fail to adapt as search spaces scale, while online policy optimization requires navigating vast meta-search spaces under delayed and expensive feedback over long-horizon rollouts. We introduce \textsc{Dream-RSI}, a framework for scalable and recursively self-improving exploration. A lightweight orchestration layer makes exploration explicit and programmable while leaving the underlying coding agent unchanged. Our key insight is that accumulated discovery history can serve as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By performing dreaming in the replay simulator constructed from historical discovery trees, \textsc{Dream-RSI} secures immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies without invoking repetitive, expensive online evaluations. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed online to drive further discovery, continuously expanding the simulator pool in a self-improving loop. Across algorithm engineering, mathematical optimization, and GPU kernel engineering, \textsc{Dream-RSI} achieves competitive or improved discovery quality while substantially reducing discovery cost in several settings.

AI.tldr: Dream-RSI 是一个面向自主 AI 智能体的可扩展递归自我改进探索框架：利用历史发现树构建回放模拟器，在离线“梦境”中低成本评估和优化探索策略，再将改进策略部署到在线搜索中，形成持续自我增强闭环。
AI.motivation: 自主 AI 智能体的递归自我改进依赖在复杂领域中持续发现高价值解，而有效探索是核心驱动力。现有方法存在两类局限：固定探索策略难以适应不断扩大的搜索空间；在线策略优化则需要在巨大的元搜索空间中处理延迟高、成本高且依赖长期 rollout 的反馈。因此，需要一种能够以较低成本、快速反馈并支持持续改进探索策略的方法。
AI.method: Dream-RSI 在不改变底层代码智能体的前提下，引入轻量级编排层，使探索过程显式化、可编程化。其核心方法是将累积的发现历史，特别是历史发现树，构造成覆盖已实现搜索空间的回放模拟器。探索策略可在该模拟器中进行离线“梦境”训练和评估，从而获得即时、低成本的 off-policy 反馈，避免反复进行昂贵的在线评估。优化后的策略随后重新部署到在线环境中，产生新的发现并扩充模拟器数据池，形成“历史回放—策略改进—在线发现—历史扩展”的递归自我改进循环。
AI.result: 在算法工程、数学优化和 GPU kernel 工程三个任务领域中，Dream-RSI 达到了具有竞争力或更优的发现质量，并在多个设置下显著降低了发现成本。摘要未提供具体的数值提升、基线名称或统计显著性信息，因此只能确认其总体效果，而无法精确比较收益幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，利用历史发现轨迹构建回放模拟器，可以有效缓解探索策略优化中的反馈昂贵、延迟长和在线试错成本高等问题。Dream-RSI 将离线策略改进与在线发现结合起来，为自主智能体提供了一种可扩展的递归探索机制；其有效性已在多个工程和优化领域得到验证，但方法的泛化边界、对历史数据质量的依赖以及在未覆盖搜索区域中的探索能力仍值得进一步研究。

title: One Model, Two Physical Stories: Auditing Misalignment in Multi-Modal World Modeling
summary: World models, systems that generate what happens next given current environmental conditions, are increasingly being implemented with multi-modal generation in mind. However, generating multiple modalities simultaneously, such as visual simulations alongside physical state predictions in the form of text, introduces the risk of cross-modal inconsistency. Tested separately, both outputs may look convincing while still disagreeing: a model can calculate that a ball should rebound in one modality, then generate no rebound in another modality, to say nothing of diverging from real-world dynamics entirely. In this work we focus on two failures explicitly: \emph{Internal misalignment}, the disagreement between the world model's generated video and the same world model's prediction in a different modalities, and \emph{external misalignment} the disagreement between the world model's generation and an analytic physical environment. We derive common contracts of event, magnitude, timing, and construct a physics grounded pipeline to make comparisons measurable in both external and internal settings. We then ask whether progressively supplying the model's own contract (the A ladder for the internal setting) or a corrected physical contract (the B ladder for the external setting) closes the respective gaps. Across four mechanisms and 20 settings, we find that while language answers all 22 text probes correctly with respect to the true environment, the neutral video is often in disagreement, suggesting that the current unified backbones may not be capable of correct reasoning, internal consistency, and external physical fidelity all at once.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态世界模型中的跨模态一致性问题，区分内部错位与外部错位，并通过物理约束合同和分级提示评估能否缩小这些差距。实验表明，文本预测虽然准确，但视频常与文本及真实物理规律不一致，说明现有统一模型尚难同时实现正确推理、内部一致性和外部物理保真度。
AI.motivation: 多模态世界模型需要同时生成视频、文本或物理状态预测，但不同模态可能分别看似合理、彼此却相互矛盾，或共同偏离真实物理环境。现有评估通常将各模态分开测试，难以测量这种跨模态和现实层面的失配，因此本文旨在建立统一、可测量的物理一致性评估框架，并分析提示模型自身预测或正确物理信息是否能够改善一致性。
AI.method: 作者定义两类失败：内部错位，即模型生成的视频与同一模型在另一模态中的预测不一致；外部错位，即模型生成结果与解析物理环境不一致。研究提炼事件、幅度和时序三类共同契约，并构建物理驱动的比较流程，在内部和外部场景中进行测量。随后设计两组逐步增强实验：内部设置的A阶梯逐步提供模型自身的契约，外部设置的B阶梯逐步提供经过校正的物理契约。实验覆盖四种物理机制和20种设置，并使用22个文本探针进行评估。
AI.result: 文本回答在22个探针上均相对于真实环境正确，但中性视频经常与这些文本答案不一致。结果表明，向模型提供自身契约或正确物理契约是检验和缓解错位的有效实验手段，但摘要未明确报告两种阶梯带来的具体改善幅度。总体上，模型的语言推理能力并不等价于视频生成的物理正确性，也不能保证不同模态之间的一致。
AI.conclusion: 当前统一多模态骨干模型可能无法同时满足三项要求：正确的物理推理、内部跨模态一致性，以及对外部真实物理规律的忠实度。本文的物理契约和评估流程为诊断这些问题提供了可操作框架，也说明仅凭单一模态的正确性不足以判断世界模型是否可靠。

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Liver Tumor Segmentation in CT
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Author manuscript of the published SPIE 2026 proceedings paper; LaTeX reconstructed from the author PDF
summary: We evaluated parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) for liver tumor segmentation in abdominal CT of colorectal liver metastases. We compared Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), 4-bit Quantized LoRA (QLoRA), a convolutional adapter (Conv-Adapter), and our Directional Spectral Top-K adapter (DiSCo), training only adapters while freezing the SAM backbone. DiSCo derives spectral bases from singular value decomposition of row-normalized weights and learns rank-gated spectral coefficients, per-output magnitude offsets, and a spectral gain, with optional Top-K rank selection at inference and 0.14 M trainable parameters. We benchmarked five prompting regimes: no prompt, single-point, multi-point, and bounding boxes at intersection over union 0.50 and 0.75. Conv-Adapter and LoRA achieved the highest accuracy (overall Dice 0.793 and 0.792; single-point Dice 0.795 and 0.792; 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) 32 mm). QLoRA was close (overall Dice 0.766; single-point Dice 0.768; HD95 36.41 mm), with 0.91 M trainable parameters, 120 ms latency, and 4.9 GB peak memory. DiSCo achieved the highest Dice per million trainable parameters (4.66), with overall Dice 0.653, single-point Dice 0.698, and HD95 49.53 mm. These results show an accuracy-efficiency trade-off and support PEFT for liver tumor segmentation with reduced adaptation costs when compute and labeled data are limited. Code: https://github.com/Ramtin-Mojtahedi/PEFT-SAM-Liver-CT

AI.tldr: 本文评估了多种参数高效微调（PEFT）方法用于SAM在腹部CT结直肠癌肝转移瘤分割中的表现。结果显示，Conv-Adapter和LoRA获得最高分割精度，而DiSCo在单位可训练参数精度方面最优，体现出精度与适配效率之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割通常需要针对特定任务对大型基础模型进行适配，但全量微调计算和存储成本高，并且在标注数据有限时不够实用。本文旨在研究冻结SAM主干、仅训练轻量适配器是否能够有效完成肝肿瘤分割，并比较不同PEFT方法在精度、参数量、延迟和显存占用之间的差异。
AI.method: 以SAM为基础并冻结其主干网络，仅训练适配器模块。比较LoRA、QLoRA、Conv-Adapter和Directional Spectral Top-K（DiSCo）四种方法。DiSCo基于行归一化权重的奇异值分解构造谱基，并学习秩门控谱系数、逐输出幅度偏移和谱增益，同时支持推理阶段的Top-K秩选择。实验覆盖无提示、单点提示、多点提示，以及IoU为0.50和0.75的边界框提示五类设置，并使用Dice和HD95等指标评估。
AI.result: Conv-Adapter和LoRA取得最高总体分割精度，总体Dice分别为0.793和0.792；单点提示下Dice分别为0.795和0.792，HD95约为32 mm。QLoRA表现接近但略低，总体Dice为0.766，单点提示Dice为0.768，HD95为36.41 mm；其可训练参数为0.91 M，推理延迟120 ms，峰值显存4.9 GB。DiSCo仅使用0.14 M可训练参数，单位百万可训练参数的Dice最高，为4.66，但绝对分割性能较低：总体Dice为0.653，单点提示Dice为0.698，HD95为49.53 mm。
AI.conclusion: PEFT能够以较低适配成本将SAM应用于肝转移瘤分割，尤其适合计算资源和标注数据受限的场景。Conv-Adapter和LoRA更适合优先追求分割精度的应用；DiSCo则在参数效率方面具有优势，但需要进一步提升绝对精度。总体而言，不同方法之间存在明显的精度—效率权衡，提示实际选择应根据任务精度要求、硬件资源和可用数据量进行。

title: One Example Is Enough to Pass Fairness Benchmarks: Rethinking Fairness Evaluation for Aligned LLMs
summary:
Warning: This submission studies stereotypes and biases, and contains toxic and offensive examples, used for illustration purposes only.
  Fairness benchmarks such as BBQ have become the de facto standard for fairness evaluation across major model families. We argue that these benchmarks are too easy to support their role: training Qwen 2.5 7B Base with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a single BBQ example, or placing that example in context as a one-shot demonstration for in-context learning (ICL), lifts mean BBQ accuracy from 79.9% to 92.9% and 99.0%, respectively, closing 80% of the gap to its large-scale RLHF counterpart (96.1%) with GRPO, and surpassing it with ICL. These effects generalize across model families. A cross-conditioning analysis shows the improvement is carried by the reasoning traces generated by the model, and one example suffices to elicit a category-agnostic ``missing evidence'' reasoning pattern. We argue that BBQ-style multiple-choice abstention benchmarks measure a single structural cue, and a model that solves them does not thereby become fair. We call for evaluation suites that cover a broader spectrum of fairness alignment.

AI.tldr: 该摘要质疑 BBQ 公平性基准过于容易，指出少量训练或单样本上下文示范即可显著提升模型得分，因此高分未必代表真正实现公平对齐。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是检验 BBQ 等多项选择式拒答基准是否足以衡量模型的公平性，并判断其高分是否可能仅源于学习特定的结构性线索，而非形成广泛、稳健的公平能力。
AI.method: 作者以 Qwen 2.5 7B Base 为例，分别采用 GRPO 在单个 BBQ 样本上训练，以及将该样本作为 ICL 单样本示范；比较不同模型家族的 BBQ 准确率，并通过交叉条件分析考察推理轨迹的作用。
AI.result: 单样本 GRPO 将平均 BBQ 准确率从 79.9% 提升至 92.9%，单样本 ICL 提升至 99.0%；GRPO 缩小了与大规模 RLHF 模型 96.1% 得分之间的大部分差距，ICL 则超过该得分。改进主要由模型生成的推理轨迹驱动，并诱导出与类别无关的“证据不足”推理模式。
AI.conclusion: BBQ 风格的多项选择式拒答基准可能主要测量单一结构性提示，而不能充分代表公平性。作者建议构建覆盖更广泛公平对齐能力的评测套件。

title: El Agente Potente: High-Throughput Agentic Atomistic Simulations
comment: 64 pages, 16 figures, and 3 tables, including Supporting Information. Main text: 24 pages, 6 figures, and 1 table
summary: Foundational machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are transforming atomistic simulations by achieving near-ab initio accuracy across large chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. A central challenge in using these tools for high-throughput property calculations is translating high-level scientific intent into adaptive simulation campaigns without compromising workflow rigour. We introduce El Agente Potente, an agentic system that combines typed execution graphs with a complementary coding mode for MLIPs-driven atomistic simulations. Typed execution graphs provide structured and provenance-aware execution for standardized workflows, with large language models (LLMs) restricted to planning and routing while deterministic Python components perform scientific computation and validation.
