The two-stage idea exhibits evident advantages in enhancing inpainting quality and augmenting the generalization capability of unknown real-world contamination by explicitly employing the estimated mask for image inpainting compared to one-stage scheme. This two-stage idea has also been intuitively implemented. However, existing two-stage methods excessively emphasize the unilateral relationship of mask estimation to image inpainting, and may overlook the mutual relations between them. Specifically, mask estimation can provide more contextual semantics for image inpainting to strengthen the understanding of semantics, and image inpainting can offer more contextual details (e.g., textures and edges) for mask estimation to improve the learning of details. In this work, we propose a novel Context-Aware Mutual Learning (CAML) framework for blind image inpainting that joints mask estimation and image inpainting to mutually exploit contextual information. In the CAML framework, we design the Inpainting-Guided Context-Mutual (IGCM) learner to acquire the complementary contextual details from image inpainting for assisting mask estimation, and the Estimation-Guided Context-Mutual (EGCM) learner to strengthen the understanding of contextual semantics from mask estimation for assisting image inpainting. Ablation studies validate the efficacy of our CAML. Extensive experiments show that our CAML achieves state-of-the-art performance on both blind image inpainting and additional vision tasks, i.e., snow removal, shadow removal, and watermark removal, indicating its superiority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAML盲图像修复框架，通过掩码估计与图像修复之间的双向上下文互学习，提升未知污染区域的识别与恢复效果，并在去雪、去阴影和去水印任务上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 盲图像修复需要在未知污染掩码的情况下同时识别受损区域并恢复图像内容。现有两阶段方法主要采用“掩码估计指导图像修复”的单向关系，忽略了二者之间的互补信息：掩码估计能够提供语义上下文，而图像修复能够提供纹理、边缘等细节。因此，现有方法对复杂真实污染的泛化能力和修复质量仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出Context-Aware Mutual Learning（CAML）框架，将掩码估计和图像修复联合建模并进行双向上下文互学习。具体包括：1）Inpainting-Guided Context-Mutual（IGCM）学习器，从图像修复分支获取纹理、边缘等互补细节，以辅助掩码估计；2）Estimation-Guided Context-Mutual（EGCM）学习器，从掩码估计分支获取上下文语义，以增强图像修复的语义理解。
AI.result: 消融实验验证了CAML各组件的有效性。大量实验表明，该方法在盲图像修复任务上达到当前先进性能，并在去雪、去阴影和去水印等相关视觉任务上同样表现优越。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立掩码估计与图像修复之间的双向上下文互补关系，CAML克服了传统两阶段方法单向信息传递的局限，能够同时增强污染区域定位和内容恢复能力，并具有较好的跨任务泛化性。

title: Artificial entrepreneurial cognition: Locating and causally steering an opportunity recognition dial inside large language models (LLMs)
comment: 105 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables (8 in the main text, 12 in the appendices)
summary: Entrepreneurial cognition is a foundation of entrepreneurship research. Yet the growing involvement of large language models (LLMs) in entrepreneurial work extends the cognition question beyond human actors to systems whose internal representations remain largely unexplored. We introduce artificial entrepreneurial cognition, the functional organisation of entrepreneurship-relevant representations and computations inside artificial intelligence (AI) systems. We bring mechanistic interpretability into entrepreneurship research through representation engineering. Focusing on opportunity recognition (OR), we construct 636 matched OR-present and OR-absent scenario pairs and recover an OR direction in Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct. Rather than infer the construct from outputs, we intervene directly on this direction, steering the model up and down along what we call the opportunity recognition dial, and its opportunity judgments shift with it. To our knowledge, this is the first causal intervention on an internal representation of an entrepreneurship construct inside an LLM. Held-out tests, lexical and topical controls, behavioural ablation, and geometric comparisons show that the direction is recoverable, consequential, and distinct from the opportunity evaluation and exploitation directions, although steering it also shifts judgments about these neighbouring stages. Recovery, signed steering, and geometric separation hold across four additional LLMs spanning different scales and families. These results give the contested distinction between opportunity recognition and evaluation a concrete representational form inside AI systems. More broadly, they establish internal representations as a new object of entrepreneurship inquiry and show how entrepreneurship theory can guide their identification, causal manipulation, and interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“人工创业认知”概念，并利用表征工程和机制可解释性，在多个大语言模型内部识别、干预并验证与机会识别相关的因果表征方向。研究发现，沿该方向进行正负向操控会系统性改变模型的机会识别判断；该方向具有可恢复性、行为后果和跨模型稳健性，同时与机会评价和机会开发方向相区分但存在关联。
AI.motivation: 创业认知是创业研究的重要基础，但随着大语言模型参与创业活动，创业认知的研究对象已从人类扩展到人工智能系统。现有研究主要依据模型输出推断其能力，尚不清楚模型内部是否存在与创业理论构念对应的表征，也缺乏对这些表征进行因果检验的方法。本文因此聚焦机会识别，尝试将机制可解释性引入创业研究，探索机会识别在大语言模型内部的功能组织形式。
AI.method: 研究者构建了636组匹配的机会识别存在/缺失场景对，并在Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct中识别机会识别方向。随后，通过表征工程沿该方向进行正向和负向干预，形成所谓的“机会识别旋钮”，观察模型机会判断的变化。研究还采用留出测试、词汇与主题控制、行为消融和几何比较，检验该方向的可恢复性、因果效应及其与机会评价和机会开发方向的区分度；此外，在另外四个不同规模和模型家族的大语言模型上进行跨模型复现。
AI.result: 干预机会识别方向会相应地提高或降低模型对机会的判断，表明该内部表征不仅与输出相关，而且具有因果作用。留出测试和多种控制分析显示，该方向并非由特定词汇或主题造成，且具有稳定的行为后果。几何分析表明，机会识别方向与机会评价、机会开发方向相对独立，但对相邻阶段的判断仍会产生联动影响。上述结果在另外四个模型中也得到支持，说明该发现具有跨模型稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次对大语言模型内部与创业构念相关的表征实施因果干预，为机会识别与机会评价之间的理论区分提供了具体的表征证据。研究将内部表征确立为创业研究的新分析对象，并表明创业理论能够指导人工智能内部表征的识别、操控与解释。不过，研究主要验证了模型中的功能性表征方向，尚不能直接证明其等同于人类创业者的认知机制；机会识别与相邻创业阶段之间的联动也有待进一步理论和实验分析。

title: STHMoE: Hypergraph-Enhanced Heterogeneous Dependency Coordination for LLM-Based Urban Traffic Data Forecasting
summary: Spatio-temporal traffic forecasting is a fundamental big data analytics task for intelligent transportation systems, where massive urban sensor streams exhibit heterogeneous, non-stationary, and structurally dynamic patterns. Although recent deep learning and large language model (LLM)-based methods have advanced traffic forecasting, they often remain temporally centered and lack effective coordination of temporal, spectral, pairwise spatial, and higher-order structural cues under evolving traffic regimes. To address this heterogeneous dependency coordination problem, we propose STHMoE, a Spatio-Temporal Hypergraph-Enhanced Mixture of Experts framework for urban traffic data forecasting. STHMoE decouples traffic dynamics into frequency-domain, time-domain, spatio-domain, and higher-order spatial representations, which are modeled by prompt-guided heterogeneous experts built upon a partially frozen LLM backbone. The first three experts leverage domain-specific statistical prompts, while the higher-order spatio expert uses a structural placeholder prompt and obtains dependency information from an adaptive hypergraph module. To capture evolving spatial structures in traffic data,, STHMoE jointly learns first-order graph dependencies and higher-order group interactions without predefined topologies. An entropy-aware MoE router with coefficient-of-variation load balancing adaptively fuses expert outputs while improving expert utilization and routing confidence. Experiments on 10 real-world traffic benchmarks show that STHMoE achieves competitive performance against temporal, spatio-temporal graph, and LLM-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STHMoE，一种结合时空超图与专家混合机制的交通预测框架，通过解耦频域、时域、一阶空间和高阶空间依赖，并利用部分冻结的LLM与自适应路由进行协同建模。在10个真实交通数据集上的实验表明，该方法相较多类基线具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 城市交通传感器数据具有异质性、非平稳性和动态空间结构。现有深度学习及LLM交通预测方法通常偏重时间建模，难以统一协调时间、频谱、成对空间关系以及高阶群体结构依赖，且往往依赖预定义拓扑。因此，需要一种能够适应交通状态变化并协同利用多种依赖信息的预测方法。
AI.method: 提出STHMoE框架，将交通动态解耦为频域、时域、一阶空间域和高阶空间域表示，并分别由提示引导的异构专家建模。专家基于部分冻结的LLM骨干构建：前三类专家使用领域统计提示，高阶空间专家使用结构占位提示，并从自适应超图模块获取高阶依赖。模型联合学习一阶图依赖与高阶群组交互，无需预定义拓扑；同时设计熵感知的MoE路由器，并结合变异系数负载均衡，自适应融合专家输出、提升专家利用率和路由置信度。
AI.result: 在10个真实世界交通基准数据集上的实验显示，STHMoE相较时间序列方法、时空图模型和基于LLM的方法取得了具有竞争力的预测性能。摘要未提供具体指标、显著性检验结果或各模块消融结果。
AI.conclusion: STHMoE能够通过异构专家、部分冻结LLM、自适应超图和熵感知路由，协调交通数据中的多层次时空依赖与动态结构，为城市交通预测提供了有效框架。其主要贡献在于多域依赖解耦、高阶空间关系学习及专家协同融合。

title: From Visual Attribution to Clinical Reasoning: Explainable Parkinson's Disease Screening from Hand-Drawn Patterns
summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) manifests early neuromotor impairments that become observable in controlled hand-drawn patterns such as spirals and meanders, where tremor-induced oscillations, stroke irregularity, and curvature instability reflect underlying motor degradation. In this work, we present an explainable framework for PD screening from offline hand-drawn patterns that integrates discriminative visual modeling with clinically grounded reasoning. The predictive model captures distributed structural distortions and fine-grained texture variations. It is evaluated under subject-disjoint protocols to ensure reliable generalization. To move beyond black-box classification, we introduce a multi-stage explainability pipeline that combines visual attribution with structured symptom abstraction. Salient regions are identified using attention- and gradient-based localization, followed by extraction of clinically meaningful motor descriptors quantifying contour roughness, curvature irregularity, stroke variability, and tremor-frequency energy. These descriptors are subsequently translated into coherent clinical rationales through a language-based reasoning module, linking model evidence to established PD symptomatology. By bridging visual attribution and clinical interpretation, the proposed framework advances interpretable document intelligence for neurological screening using hand-drawn patterns. Experimental results on publicly available Parkinson's disease handwriting datasets demonstrate competitive predictive performance and clinically consistent explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向帕金森病早期筛查的可解释框架，利用离线手绘螺旋和曲线图案，通过视觉分类、显著性定位、运动学特征提取及语言化临床推理，将图像证据转化为与临床症状对应的解释；在公开数据集和受试者独立协议下取得具有竞争力的表现。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病早期运动障碍可体现在手绘螺旋、曲线等受控图案中，但传统筛查模型通常偏重分类性能，难以说明其判断依据，限制了临床可信度与应用。本文旨在同时解决离线手绘模式中的细微运动退化建模问题，以及黑箱预测缺乏临床可解释性的问题。
AI.method: 框架包括四个主要环节：1）使用判别性视觉模型捕捉图案的整体结构畸变和细粒度纹理变化；2）采用受试者独立的数据划分与评估协议，检验跨个体泛化能力；3）结合注意力和梯度方法定位显著区域，并提取轮廓粗糙度、曲率不规则性、笔画变异性及震颤频率能量等临床相关运动描述符；4）通过基于语言的推理模块，将视觉证据和量化描述符转化为与帕金森病症状学相一致的结构化临床解释。
AI.result: 在公开的帕金森病手写数据集上，模型表现出具有竞争力的预测性能；同时，生成的解释与已知的帕金森病运动症状保持临床一致性。摘要未提供具体数据集名称、样本规模、评价指标、基线模型或数值结果，因此无法进一步判断性能提升幅度和统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将视觉归因、运动特征量化和临床语言推理结合起来，提升了基于手绘图案进行帕金森病筛查的可解释性。其主要贡献在于把模型决策证据连接到临床可理解的运动异常描述，为神经系统筛查中的可解释文档智能提供了新的实现路径；但临床部署仍需更大规模、多中心和前瞻性验证。

title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents' Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents allocate test-time compute adaptively as they revise solutions, use tools, explore alternatives, and decide when to stop. This test-time strategy makes it difficult to measure how agent performance scales. We study open-ended tasks that provide continuous scores for intermediate submissions, making progress observable throughout long trajectories. We propose Elo-per-token analysis, which tracks the best solution found at each token budget and uses a Bradley-Terry model to aggregate within-task orderings into Elo ratings across tasks with different score scales. We apply it to four general-purpose agents on four open-ended benchmarks, with sessions of up to 100M tokens, and to three feedback-driven LLM optimization harnesses in controlled single-task interventions. Independent sampling provides a theoretically characterized reference, for which Elo grows linearly with log compute. Against this reference, agents can initially convert tokens into Elo faster than independent sampling, but their marginal gains diminish and eventually fall below the reference. In contrast, the strongest historical human contestants improve superlinearly over contest time on shared AtCoder Heuristic Contest tasks, providing evidence of continual learning and substantial headroom after agents slow down. We define the scaling inflection point as the per-session budget where marginal Elo gains match the independent-sampling reference. Using this point as the per-session budget, we split 100M tokens across parallel sessions on FrontierCS Polyomino Packing, gaining +264 Elo over one long session and +355 over ten short sessions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Elo-per-token 分析框架，用于衡量开放式任务中 LLM 智能体随测试时计算量增加的性能扩展，并研究何时应停止单条轨迹、转而运行并行会话。研究发现，智能体早期比独立采样更高效，但边际收益会递减并低于独立采样基准；在达到扩展拐点后分配并行会话，可显著提升最终性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体会在测试时动态分配计算资源，通过反复修改、调用工具、探索方案和决定停止时机来完成任务，因此其性能与计算量之间的扩展关系难以测量。传统评估通常只比较最终结果，无法利用开放式任务中连续、可观测的中间进展，也难以跨任务聚合不同评分尺度。本文旨在建立一种统一的、面向 token 预算的性能分析方法，并确定单次会话与多会话计算分配的最佳策略。
AI.method: 研究开放式任务，其中中间提交具有连续分数，使整个长轨迹中的进展可被观测。提出 Elo-per-token 分析：对每个 token 预算记录截至该时刻发现的最佳解，并利用 Bradley–Terry 模型将任务内部的结果排序聚合为跨任务可比较的 Elo 评分。实验覆盖四个通用智能体、四个开放式基准，单次会话最长 1 亿 token；同时在受控的单任务干预中评估三个由反馈驱动的 LLM 优化框架。研究还构建独立采样基准，并将“扩展拐点”定义为智能体单位 token 的边际 Elo 增益等于独立采样参考的预算点。
AI.result: 独立采样的 Elo 随计算量对数线性增长，构成理论上可刻画的参考曲线。相较之下，智能体在早期能更高效地将 token 转化为 Elo，但边际收益逐渐下降，最终低于独立采样基准。历史上最强的人类参赛者在共享的 AtCoder Heuristic Contest 任务中，随比赛时间获得超线性提升，显示出持续学习能力，也表明智能体性能放缓后仍存在较大提升空间。在 FrontierCS Polyomino Packing 上，将 1 亿 token 按扩展拐点分配到并行会话，相比单条长会话额外提升 264 Elo，相比十条短会话额外提升 355 Elo。
AI.conclusion: Elo-per-token 为分析具有自适应测试时计算的 LLM 智能体提供了跨任务、跨评分尺度的统一工具。智能体的计算扩展并非始终有效：长时间持续优化会出现收益递减，达到扩展拐点后，将预算分配到多个并行会话通常更有利。该结果支持依据边际收益动态决定会话长度，并揭示当前智能体在持续学习和长期搜索方面仍落后于高水平人类解题者。

title: VisInteract: Towards Dynamic Interactive Text-to-Visualization under Imperfect Queries
summary: Real-world visualization requests are routinely ambiguous, incomplete, or factually incorrect, yet existing Text-to-Visualization (Text-to-Vis) systems assume well-specified inputs and produce charts in a single pass. When queries are imperfect, a system must \emph{interact} with the user to recover the true intent, but no benchmark or method supports this dynamic process. We introduce \textbf{VisInteract}, a new paradigm that reframes Text-to-Vis as interaction-driven intent recovery, and \textbf{VisInteract-Bench}, to our knowledge, that is the first benchmark for dynamic interactive Text-to-Vis, featuring controlled imperfection injection, a leakage-controlled User Agent for realistic multi-turn feedback, and dual-perspective (code and chart) automated evaluation. On the algorithmic side, we propose \textbf{Vis-MCTS}, a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) enhanced method, introducing improvements over classical MCTS, that \emph{Progressive Widening} to tame the unbounded tool-argument space in tree search, \emph{cross-rollout information sharing} so clarifications and critiques benefit the entire search tree, and \emph{Dimension-Aware Reward Decomposition} that routes scalar user feedback along data-fidelity, visual-design, and intent-alignment dimensions to resolve credit assignment across heterogeneous actions. Extensive Experiments across two LLM backbones show that Vis-MCTS consistently outperforms all Text-to-Vis baselines, improving end-to-end task success by $13.40\%$--$16.27\%$ over the strongest interactive baseline and by more than $5\times$ over non-interactive ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VisInteract 交互式 Text-to-Visualization 范式、VisInteract-Bench 基准及 Vis-MCTS 方法，用于处理含糊、不完整或错误的可视化请求。方法通过多轮交互恢复用户真实意图，并利用渐进式扩展、跨轨迹信息共享和维度感知奖励分解提升搜索效果。实验表明，该方法在两个 LLM 骨干上均优于现有基线，较最强交互式基线提升 13.40%–16.27%，较非交互式方法提升超过 5 倍。
AI.motivation: 现实中的可视化请求往往存在歧义、信息缺失或事实错误，而现有 Text-to-Visualization 系统通常假设输入明确，并采用一次性生成方式，难以识别和修正用户真实意图。与此同时，现有研究缺乏支持动态多轮交互的统一基准与有效算法，因此需要将 Text-to-Vis 重新定义为通过交互逐步恢复意图的问题。
AI.method: 研究提出三部分贡献：1）VisInteract：将 Text-to-Vis 建模为交互驱动的意图恢复过程；2）VisInteract-Bench：通过可控缺陷注入、避免信息泄漏的用户代理以及代码和图表双视角自动评估，构建动态交互式 Text-to-Vis 基准；3）Vis-MCTS：在蒙特卡洛树搜索基础上，引入 Progressive Widening 以应对无界工具参数空间，引入跨 rollout 信息共享，使澄清与批评信息能够惠及整个搜索树，并提出 Dimension-Aware Reward Decomposition，将用户反馈分解并分配到数据忠实度、视觉设计和意图一致性三个维度，以缓解异质动作间的信用分配问题。
AI.result: 在两个 LLM 骨干模型上的大量实验显示，Vis-MCTS consistently 优于所有 Text-to-Vis 基线。端到端任务成功率较最强交互式基线提升 13.40%–16.27%，较非交互式方法提升超过 5 倍，说明交互式意图恢复和改进后的树搜索具有显著效果。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明，将可视化生成从一次性映射转变为交互式意图恢复，能够更有效地处理现实世界中的不完美请求。VisInteract-Bench 为该问题提供了系统评测基础，Vis-MCTS 则通过面向工具空间、信息共享和多维反馈分解的搜索机制取得明显性能优势，表明动态交互是提升 Text-to-Vis 鲁棒性与任务成功率的重要方向。

title: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video
summary: Interactive video world models must maintain broad scene context under camera motion while producing high-fidelity observations with low latency. Existing approaches face a representation trade-off: perspective models operate on local views and must preserve off-screen content over long rollouts, whereas broader spatial coverage is typically obtained by synthesizing full-sphere videos or constructing explicit 3D representations. Motivated by the complementary roles of global context and selective local acuity in visual perception, we present AlayaVista, a camera-controllable streaming video world model that decouples panoramic world evolution from perspective observation synthesis. Given a single perspective image, AlayaVista constructs a 360-degree scene prior using a pretrained panorama expansion model and then evolves the scene as a camera-conditioned panoramic latent state. A latent viewport renderer maps this state to the requested perspective video latents, while a perspective refiner restores details, suppresses artifacts, and performs super-resolution. To support efficient streaming, we adapt the panoramic generator to chunk-autoregressive generation and distill both panoramic generation and perspective refinement into few-step processes. To provide the supervision required by this design, we construct MUGEN, a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset containing 1,318 hours of videos at resolutions of at least 4K, together with rich semantic and geometric annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AlayaVista，一种可进行相机控制的流式视频世界模型。该方法将全景世界演化与透视视角观测生成解耦：利用全景潜状态保持广域场景上下文，再通过视口渲染和透视细化生成高质量、低延迟的视频。同时构建了包含1318小时、至少4K分辨率视频及丰富语义和几何标注的 MUGEN 数据集，为模型训练提供监督。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需要在相机运动和长时滚动过程中同时保持广泛的场景上下文、生成高保真的局部观察结果，并满足低延迟要求。现有透视模型主要关注局部视图，容易在长时间生成中丢失屏幕外内容；全景视频生成或显式三维表示虽然覆盖范围更广，但通常计算成本高、生成效率低。因此，本文受到视觉感知中“全局上下文与选择性局部细节互补”机制的启发，旨在建立一种兼顾全局空间覆盖、局部视觉质量和流式效率的世界模型。
AI.method: AlayaVista采用全景世界演化与透视观测合成解耦的架构。给定单张透视图像，首先通过预训练的全景扩展模型构建360度场景先验；随后在相机条件控制下演化全景潜在状态，以维持完整场景上下文。潜在视口渲染器根据目标相机视角，将全景状态映射为透视视频潜变量；透视细化器进一步恢复局部细节、抑制生成伪影并执行超分辨率。为实现高效流式生成，作者将全景生成器改造为分块自回归生成，并将全景生成和透视细化过程蒸馏为少步推理。与此同时，作者构建MUGEN数据集，包含1318小时、分辨率至少为4K的真实全景视频，以及丰富的语义和几何标注。
AI.result: 摘要明确报告了方法组成和数据集规模，但未提供具体的定量实验结果、基准数据集、评价指标或与现有方法的性能对比。因此可以确认的结果包括：模型支持相机可控的流式视频世界建模，能够在全景潜状态中维护广域场景信息，并生成目标透视视角的视频；通过分块自回归和少步蒸馏提升了推理效率；MUGEN提供了1318小时、至少4K分辨率的真实全景视频及语义、几何监督。其高保真度、低延迟和长时一致性方面的具体收益，仍需结合正文实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种通过全局全景状态与局部透视生成协同工作的交互式视频世界模型。AlayaVista试图解决局部透视建模易丢失全局信息、全景建模效率不足之间的表示与计算权衡，并借助视口渲染、透视细化和少步蒸馏实现高质量流式观察生成。MUGEN数据集为该方向提供了大规模、高分辨率且带语义和几何标注的训练资源。总体而言，本文的核心贡献在于统一了广域世界演化、相机控制、局部细节恢复与低延迟生成。

title: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Efficient Latent-Space Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) primarily perform inference at the token level, resulting in substantial memory overhead and compromised computational efficiency. In this paper, we propose a Dynamic Semantic Extraction and Inference (DSEI) framework, which achieves segment-level inference within the latent space through a two-stage training strategy. First, we construct a Dynamic Semantic Autoencoder (DSAE) via self-supervised learning. DSAE dynamically extracts segment-level semantics and compresses them into compact latent representations via adaptive semantic weighting and gated fusion. Subsequently, we integrate the DSAE into the LLM architecture and train the model to infer over dense latent space. DSEI substantially reduces both input and generation sequences and significantly enhances inference efficiency. Extensive experiments conducted on the Wanjuan dataset demonstrate that DSEI reduces perplexity by 48% compared to static sentence-level latent inference baseline. Furthermore, compared to standard LLMs using token-level inference, DSEI accelerates inference speed by 2.5$\times$ and reduces memory overhead by 90%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态语义提取与推理（DSEI）框架，通过动态语义自编码器将文本压缩为片段级潜在表示，并在潜在空间中进行推理，从而降低序列长度、显著减少内存开销并提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型主要基于token级别进行推理，导致输入与生成序列较长、内存占用高、计算效率受限。已有静态句子级潜变量推理方法对语义压缩和动态信息保留能力不足，因此需要一种能够自适应提取片段级语义并支持高效潜在空间推理的框架。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练策略。第一阶段通过自监督学习构建动态语义自编码器（DSAE），利用自适应语义加权与门控融合动态提取片段级语义，并将其压缩为紧凑的潜在表示。第二阶段将DSAE集成到大语言模型中，训练模型在稠密潜在空间而非token序列上执行推理，形成DSEI框架。
AI.result: 在Wanjuan数据集上的实验表明，相较于静态句子级潜变量推理基线，DSEI将困惑度降低48%；相较于采用token级推理的标准大语言模型，推理速度提升2.5倍，内存开销降低90%。
AI.conclusion: DSEI验证了片段级潜在表示和动态语义压缩在大语言模型高效推理中的有效性。该方法能够在尽量保持语义信息的同时缩短输入与生成序列，并显著改善速度和内存效率，具有降低LLM推理成本的潜力。

title: Issue Bias in Generative AI Writing Assistance: Political Issues and LLMs in the Swedish 2026 Election
summary: Generative AI writing assistants and the Large Language Models (LLMs) that power them are increasingly part of how voters gather information before elections. With growing evidence that they influence users' opinions, it is increasingly important to understand the views and positions of these tools. To better understand these views, we examine the stances supplied by six LLMs on a variety of Swedish-language writing tasks ahead of the 2026 Swedish parliamentary election. We cross 107 policy propositions with 77 writing templates and neutral, positive, and negative prompt framings, producing 24,717 prompts per model and 148,302 responses. To study these, we look at the models' default stance tendencies, compare how they respond to similar issues, and compare their responses with those of each of Sweden's eight parliamentary parties on the same issue. We find that Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, and Mistral have similar profiles; ChatGPT more often supplies neutral or ambivalent text; and Grok differs most on topics such as migration, crime, and gender. When comparing the political parties, we find that the Social Democrats are closest to all six models. Still, after correcting for multiple comparisons, none of the within-model differences in party distances remains significant. Overall, we find that no model has a clear preference, nor a clear preference for a party, but that this depends on the specific issue or task the user asks about.

title: DynEoMT: Learning Object Dynamicity from Online Segmentation Queries
comment: Submitted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)
summary: Video segmentation models recognize and track objects over time, but they do not indicate whether each segmented region moves independently of the observing camera. This dynamicity attribute cannot be inferred from semantics alone and is confounded by camera ego-motion. We introduce \method, an online framework that augments query-based video segmentation with region-level dynamicity prediction. It jointly produces the original segmentation outputs and a dynamic or static state for each predicted region. At inference, DynEoMT uses only the current frame and propagated queries, without optical flow, depth, camera pose, previous RGB frames, or feature maps. Because established video segmentation benchmarks do not annotate this attribute, we also introduce a class-agnostic offline supervision pipeline using camera-compensated optical flow and confidence-aware temporal filtering. Across VIPSeg, OVIS, YouTube-VIS 2022, and VSPW, DynEoMT achieves balanced accuracies of 84.3, 68.0, 68.6, and 87.6, respectively, while largely preserving segmentation performance. These results show that segmentation-region dynamicity can be learned from propagated queries, enabling its online prediction without a dedicated motion-processing pipeline at inference. The complete code will be released as open source to enable full reproduction of the method and experiments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DynEoMT，一种在线视频分割扩展框架，在保持分割能力的同时，为每个预测区域判断其是动态还是静态；推理仅依赖当前帧和传播查询，无需光流、深度、相机位姿、历史RGB帧或特征图。在VIPSeg、OVIS、YouTube-VIS 2022和VSPW上的动态性平衡准确率分别为84.3、68.0、68.6和87.6。
AI.motivation: 现有视频分割模型能够识别并跟踪目标，但无法判断分割区域是否相对于观察相机独立运动。该动态性属性不能仅由语义推断，并且会受到相机自运动干扰。与此同时，主流视频分割基准缺少区域动态性标注，因此需要一种既能在线预测动态性、又不依赖专门运动处理模块的方法，以及相应的离线监督构建流程。
AI.method: 提出DynEoMT，将区域级动态性预测整合到基于查询的视频分割框架中，联合输出原始分割结果以及每个区域的动态/静态状态。在线推理时仅使用当前帧和传播查询，不使用光流、深度、相机位姿、历史RGB帧或历史特征图。针对缺少标注的问题，设计类别无关的离线监督管线：利用相机补偿后的光流估计区域运动，并结合置信度感知的时间过滤生成动态性监督信号。
AI.result: 在VIPSeg、OVIS、YouTube-VIS 2022和VSPW数据集上，DynEoMT的动态性平衡准确率分别达到84.3%、68.0%、68.6%和87.6%，同时基本保持原有视频分割性能，说明动态性可以从传播查询中学习，而不必在推理阶段部署独立的运动处理流程。
AI.conclusion: 区域级动态性能够被有效整合进在线视频分割模型，并通过传播查询进行预测。该方法降低了对光流、深度和相机运动估计等额外推理组件的依赖，为视频理解中同时建模目标分割与独立运动属性提供了可行方案。作者计划开源完整代码，以支持方法和实验的复现。

title: SlopShape: Identifying AI-Generated Commercial Web Content
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Verification artifacts and code: https://github.com/pulse-energy-eu/slopshape
summary: Word-level detectors identify unedited AI-generated text almost perfectly, but the literature documents their brittleness under rewording, and a word-level score neither characterizes a text nor identifies which AI model wrote it. We ask whether AI-generated text can be identified one level deeper, from structural signatures: how information is presented, in what order, with what evidence, and in what voice. We replicate StoryScope (Russell et al., 2026), which showed such patterns for AI-generated fiction, on commercial content: 2,250 pre-ChatGPT human blog posts from 268 company domains against 11,250 AI mirrors from five frontier models. A 214-feature instrument, applied by an LLM and validated in a human gold-annotation session (human-human kappa 0.928, human-model 0.946), detects AI posts from its 187 structural features alone at 98.0 macro-F1 on held-out companies, unchanged (98.1) when every AI post is reworded by its own model. The signal characterizes and attributes: AI posts share a tidy, self-announcing shape, 79.3% are attributed to the correct source against a 16.7% chance rate, and human posts occupy rare structural configurations. All effects replicate StoryScope's, consistent in direction and larger in magnitude. We release pipeline, instrument, prompts, code, and aggregate artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否通过文本的结构性特征，而非词汇层面的统计信号，稳健检测、刻画并归因商业领域的AI生成文本。作者复现StoryScope框架，使用214项结构特征分析人类博客与五个前沿模型生成的AI镜像文本；结果显示，仅凭187项结构特征即可在未见过的公司上取得98.0%的宏平均F1，经过模型自重写后仍达98.1%，并能以79.3%的准确率识别生成模型。
AI.motivation: 现有词级AI文本检测器虽然对未经编辑的AI文本识别能力很强，但容易因改写或重新措辞而失效；同时，词级分数难以描述文本整体特征，也不能说明文本由哪个AI模型生成。因此，本文希望探究更深层次的结构性“签名”，即信息如何组织、论证顺序如何安排、证据如何使用以及文本采用何种叙述声音，并验证这些结构模式能否用于检测和归因AI生成文本。
AI.method: 作者复现StoryScope研究，将其应用于商业内容领域。数据集包括来自268个公司域名的2,250篇ChatGPT出现前的人类博客文章，以及由5个前沿模型生成的11,250篇对应AI镜像文本。研究构建了包含214项特征的分析工具，由大语言模型执行标注，并通过人工黄金标注进行验证；人工-人工标注的一致性为Cohen’s kappa=0.928，人工-模型一致性为0.946。分类实验只使用其中187项结构特征，并在未出现在训练集中的公司上进行测试；此外，让每个模型对自己的生成文本进行重写，以检验结构信号的稳健性。
AI.result: 结构特征能够以98.0%的宏平均F1识别人类与AI生成的博客文章；在AI文本经过其原生成模型重写后，性能几乎不变，达到98.1%。这些结构信号不仅能检测AI文本，还能进行模型归因：模型来源识别准确率为79.3%，显著高于16.7%的随机机会水平。AI文章通常呈现整齐、明确自我标示的组织形式，而人类文章更常占据较为罕见的结构配置。研究报告的所有主要效应均与StoryScope一致，且效应幅度更大。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，AI生成文本具有稳定且可迁移的结构性签名，这些签名比单纯的词汇或表面表达更不易受到改写影响。结构分析不仅可以稳健检测AI文本，还能够描述其组织方式并部分追溯生成模型。本文通过商业博客数据复现并扩展了StoryScope的发现，同时公开了分析流程、特征工具、提示词、代码和汇总数据，为后续可复现研究提供了基础。

title: From Ideas to Actions: A Public-Data Decision-Support Toolchain Across the Venture Lifecycle
comment: 39 pages. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/quge007/eventchain ; Code and agent skills: https://github.com/quge009/startup-decision-skills
summary: Founders face two linked decisions: whether to pursue an idea before founding, and which operating actions and capital partners fit afterward. We present a public-data decision-support toolchain combining time-bounded proposal profiling, market and moat checks, and deterministic aggregation with auditable investor-company event chains for retrospective analysis. Pre-founding: (a) After threshold selection on 198 development companies, the frozen pipeline achieves F0.5=0.5357 [0.412, 0.655] on an independent, row-disjoint 198-company validation sample. On the combined 396 rows, the Full Pipeline scores 0.6301 versus 0.2734 for a paired Raw LLM baseline. Post-stratification of 1,027 completed cases in a separate scale cohort yields 0.6506 [0.598, 0.707]; the run remains incomplete. A 377-row composition-matched check yields 0.6573. (b) The AI-inference study identifies distribution-layer businesses as a replicable path to independent profitability with a limited revenue ceiling, and frontier-model ownership as a path to capital-market upside at exceptional capital cost. Post-founding: (a) Public sources support auditable event-chain analysis. (b) In the chip-company study, sustained product, customer, and supply-chain progress is associated with better observed outcomes; financing alone does not establish operating progress. (c) Financing comprises 79% of confirmed visible post-investment actions. Evidence tentatively favors acquisition-experienced strategic corporate investors for acquisition-oriented founders and financing-led institutional VCs with fewer observed control events for independence-oriented founders. Findings are developmental and observational, not causal guarantees or investment advice. We release shared ontology, provenance-bearing EventChain data, schemas, benchmarks, and executable skills for audit, reuse, and extension.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出一个面向创业者的、基于公开数据的决策支持工具链，覆盖创立前机会筛选与创立后运营/融资伙伴分析。方法包括时间边界明确的提案画像、市场与护城河检查、确定性聚合，以及可审计的投资者—公司事件链。结果显示：创立前模型在独立验证集上的F0.5为0.5357，在合并数据上优于原始LLM基线；规模队列的后分层结果约为0.6506，但运行尚未完成。定性推断认为分销层企业更可能实现独立盈利但收入上限有限，而前沿模型所有权带来资本市场上行空间但资本成本极高。创立后分析发现，产品、客户和供应链进展与更好的观察结果相关，单纯融资不能证明运营进展；确认的可见投后行动中融资占79%。研究仅属发展性、观察性分析，不能作因果或投资保证。
AI.motivation: 创业者需要在创立前判断是否值得推进想法，并在创立后选择合适的运营路径和资本伙伴；现有判断往往缺乏可审计、可复用且基于公开证据的统一流程。该研究试图弥合创业机会筛选、市场与护城河评估、投资者行为追踪之间的方法断裂。
AI.method: 研究构建公开数据决策支持工具链：对提案进行时间边界明确的画像，执行市场规模与护城河检查，并采用确定性规则聚合结果；同时建立带来源记录的投资者—公司EventChain，用于回顾性事件分析。创立前部分在开发集、行级独立验证集、合并样本、独立规模队列和构成匹配检查中评估模型，并以F0.5等指标与原始LLM基线比较。创立后部分通过公开来源追踪芯片公司及其投资者的产品、客户、供应链、融资、收购和控制相关事件。
AI.result: 创立前：198家公司组成的独立、行不重叠验证样本上，冻结流程达到F0.5=0.5357，区间为[0.412, 0.655]；合并396行时，完整流程得分0.6301，高于原始LLM基线0.2734。另一个包含1,027个已完成案例的规模队列，经后分层后得分0.6506，区间为[0.598, 0.707]；但该运行仍未完成。377行构成匹配检查得分0.6573。AI推断还指出，分销层业务可能是实现独立盈利的可复制路径，但收入天花板较低；前沿模型所有权可能带来资本市场上行空间，但资本成本极高。创立后：公开资料能够支持可审计的事件链分析；芯片公司中，持续的产品、客户和供应链进展与较好观察结果相关，而融资本身不能证明运营进展。确认的可见投后行动中，融资占79%。证据初步支持：面向收购的创始人可考虑具备收购经验的战略性企业投资者；重视独立性的创始人则可能更适合融资导向、观察到控制事件较少的机构VC。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的主要贡献是提出并开放一个可审计、可复用的创业决策分析基础设施，将创立前机会筛选与创立后投资者—公司行为分析连接起来。结果表明，该工具链相较原始LLM基线具有更好的判别表现，并能从公开事件中提取一定的战略线索。但证据仍是观察性的、发展性的，存在样本、标签、测量和完成度限制，不能推出因果关系、投资收益保证或普适性结论。其价值目前更适合作为辅助研究与尽调工具，而非自动化决策器。

title: PRI-Net: A Lightweight Multimodal Framework for 3D UAV Localization
summary: Accurate 3D localization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains challenging for existing multimodal approaches due to sparse LiDAR geometry, modality-imbalanced fusion, and redundant feature transmission over constrained edge-to-server links. To address these limitations, we propose PRI-Net, an efficient and lightweight multimodal fusion framework for UAV localization that integrates point cloud splatting, residual attention fusion, and an information bottleneck. Specifically, a 3D point cloud splatting (3DPCS) strategy is introduced to transform sparse LiDAR observations into geometrically consistent dense depth maps. A residual attention fusion (RAF) module is then designed to alleviate modal bias by using an image branch for coarse estimation and a gated fusion branch for refinement. In addition, a multimodal information bottleneck (MIB) module compacts features by filtering task-irrelevant redundancy. Experiments show that PRI-Net achieves high localization accuracy with lightweight architectures, while reducing feature dimensionality and improving edge-to-server UAV sensing efficiency and robustness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PRI-Net，一种面向无人机三维定位的轻量级多模态融合框架，通过点云投影稠密化、残差注意力融合和信息瓶颈，提升定位精度、通信效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机多模态定位方法受到LiDAR点云稀疏、图像与点云模态融合不均衡，以及边缘端到服务器链路受限条件下特征传输冗余等问题影响，难以同时实现高精度、低计算和高通信效率。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心模块：1）三维点云投影（3DPCS），将稀疏LiDAR观测转换为几何一致的稠密深度图；2）残差注意力融合（RAF），利用图像分支进行粗定位，并通过门控融合分支进行细化，以缓解模态偏置；3）多模态信息瓶颈（MIB），过滤与定位任务无关的冗余信息，压缩传输特征。整体框架强调轻量化和边缘—服务器协同。
AI.result: 实验表明，PRI-Net在轻量级架构下实现了较高的三维定位精度，同时降低了特征维度，并提升了边缘到服务器的无人机感知传输效率与系统鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体数据集、基线、指标或提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: PRI-Net通过稀疏几何补全、模态平衡融合和信息压缩的协同设计，有效应对无人机三维定位中的感知稀疏、融合偏置和通信冗余问题，适合资源受限的边缘智能场景。但其有效性仍需结合完整实验设置和定量结果进一步验证。

title: Turkish MMLU Pro: Traceable Option Augmentation and Its Validity Limits in Turkish Multiple-Choice Evaluation
comment: Preprint of a manuscript submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Adding answer options can lower multiple-choice scores without improving assessment validity. Turkish MMLU Pro examines this distinction using 12,000 Turkish-source questions across 58 sections. Each question retains its stem, five original options and source key, and receives five options copied from other questions in the same section. Sentence-embedding retrieval proposes candidates; a language model selects existing identifiers. Deterministic verification reconstructs all 60,000 additions. A 25-model calibration exposes scoring and generation-budget effects. Five evaluations produce source-key accuracies of 34.8%-81.4%. On 981 shared questions, one API-served model falls from 93.7% with five choices to 83.1% with ten; 102 of 115 lost correct responses select borrowed options. The decrease is 24.4 percentage points on heuristically flagged negative stems and 5.9 points elsewhere. A completed human-checked audit of 200 sampled questions, with undocumented reviewer tool use, yields 47 and 31 multiple-answer judgments across the two record sets, 25 of the latter unresolved. These records support concern about ambiguity, while their dependence and incomplete reviewer-method documentation limit validation. Because order and labels also change, the paired comparison measures augmentation as implemented. The contribution is a traceable construction and an analysis of its validity limits, not evidence that lower ten-choice scores measure knowledge better.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了 Turkish MMLU Pro，并比较五选项与十选项设置下模型表现，发现增加选项会显著降低部分模型准确率，但现有证据不足以证明十选项评分具有更高效度。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是检验一个重要区分：增加选择项可能降低多项选择题得分，但这种下降并不自动意味着测评效度提高。作者特别关注十选项设置是否更能测量知识，以及题目歧义、负向题干和评分/生成预算等因素对结果的影响。
AI.method: 研究使用12,000道土耳其语来源题目，覆盖58个部分。每题保留原题干、5个原始选项和来源答案，再从同部分其他题目复制5个选项作为新增干扰项。通过句向量检索提出候选项，由语言模型选择已有标识符，并以确定性验证重建全部60,000个新增选项。研究对25个模型进行校准，并开展5种评估；同时在981道共享题上比较五选项和十选项表现，并审计200道样题的人工作答记录。
AI.result: 不同评估中的来源答案准确率为34.8%—81.4%。在981道共享题上，一个API模型的准确率由五选项时的93.7%降至十选项时的83.1%；丢失的115个正确答案中有102个选择了借用选项。负向题干的下降幅度为24.4个百分点，其他题目为5.9个百分点。人工审计发现两组记录中分别有47和31个多答案判断，后者有25个未解决；审计结果提示题目存在歧义，但受样本依赖和审阅方法记录不完整的限制。
AI.conclusion: 增加到十个选项确实可能降低模型得分，且负向题干受影响更大，但该配对比较同时改变了选项顺序和标签，测量的是完整增广方案而非单一的选项数量效应。研究的主要贡献是提供可追溯的数据构建与效度局限分析，而不是证明较低的十选项得分更准确地反映模型知识。

title: CWM: Controllable White-Box Meta-Prompting for Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Reasoning Ability
summary: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained significant attention due to their strong language understanding and generation capabilities, demonstrating impressive reasoning abilities as well as effective utilization of external knowledge. Many studies have proposed methods that specialize in improving performance for individual tasks. However, ironically, only a limited number of attempts have explored general-purpose, task-agnostic methods. In this work, we present a unified framework integrating reasoning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tasks. We further propose Controllable White-Box Meta-Prompting (CWM), a low-cost white-box method for adaptive RAG tasks previously dominated by black-box approaches, without requiring external decision modules or multi-sampling. CWM achieves state-of-the-art performance on three adaptive RAG benchmarks across recent LLMs, including GPT-oss-20b, Qwen3-14b, and Llama3.1-8b, while also demonstrating strong generality by extending to reasoning tasks. In addition, CWM provides controllability by enabling retrieval decisions to be regulated through the manipulation of internal model signals. Our code is available at https://github.com/JeongEunhye00/CWM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可控白盒元提示（CWM），以统一框架协调推理与检索增强生成（RAG），无需外部决策模块或多次采样，即可低成本、自适应地决定是否检索，并在多个模型和任务上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型研究通常针对单一任务进行优化，面向不同任务均适用的通用、任务无关方法较少。尤其是在自适应RAG中，既有方法多依赖黑盒策略、外部决策模块或多次采样，成本较高且可控性不足。因此，论文旨在构建一种统一、低成本、可解释且可控的方法，同时处理推理和检索决策任务。
AI.method: 论文提出统一的推理与RAG框架，并设计Controllable White-Box Meta-Prompting（CWM）。该方法利用模型内部信号，通过元提示调节检索决策，在白盒条件下自适应判断何时需要检索；不依赖外部决策模块，也不需要多次采样。通过操纵内部模型信号，CWM还能够对检索行为进行显式控制。
AI.result: 在三个自适应RAG基准上，CWM在GPT-oss-20b、Qwen3-14b和Llama3.1-8b等近期大语言模型上取得当前最佳性能。同时，该方法能够迁移到推理任务，表现出较强的任务通用性。论文还表明，CWM具备通过内部信号调控检索决策的能力。
AI.conclusion: CWM为自适应RAG提供了一种低成本、白盒且可控的通用方案，并将RAG与推理任务纳入统一框架。实验结果显示，该方法兼具竞争力和泛化能力，有潜力减少对黑盒策略、外部模块及多次采样的依赖。

title: PuzzleMate: Benchmarking MLLMs for Egocentric Puzzle Assistance
summary:
Personal AI assistants hold the potential to evolve from digital interfaces into embodied companions capable of guiding users through complex physical activities. For these assistants to become integral to daily life, they must do more than identify objects; they must provide precise, step-by-step instructions that align with a user's real-time progress. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promise in general visual understanding, their ability to deliver grounded, sequential guidance for fine-grained manipulation tasks remains largely unverified.
  In this paper, we choose the jigsaw puzzle as a strategic testbed for this capability. Unlike general object recognition, puzzle solving demands high-precision spatial reasoning, the ability to distinguish between minute geometric variations, and a rigorous adherence to sequential logic.
  We investigate this capability through PuzzleMate, a novel framework focused on jigsaw puzzle solving captured through an egocentric viewpoint. We deploy PuzzleMate in a user-in-the-loop study to evaluate how well state-of-the-art MLLMs perceive the current puzzle state and generate actionable next-step instructions. Our analysis reveals seven key bottlenecks that limit their effectiveness. Building on these insights, we propose a benchmark that enables systematic evaluation of MLLMs' reasoning capabilities for puzzle solving. Our findings reveal a substantial performance gap in current models like GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5-Pro; while these MLLMs are highly capable, they struggle to navigate the intricate reasoning and sequential logic essential for jigsaw puzzle assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PuzzleMate，以拼图这一高精度、强序列逻辑任务为测试平台，评估多模态大语言模型在第一视角场景下理解拼图状态并生成可执行下一步指导的能力。研究通过用户参与实验识别出七类关键瓶颈，并据此构建系统化评测基准。结果表明，即使是能力较强的模型，在细粒度空间推理和连续操作指导方面仍存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型虽然具备较强的通用视觉理解能力，但其能否基于用户实时进度，针对精细操作任务提供准确、可靠且遵循顺序的逐步指导，尚未得到充分验证。拼图任务同时要求高精度空间推理、细微几何差异辨识和严格的步骤逻辑，因此适合作为检验具身个人智能助手能力的代表性测试平台。
AI.method: 提出 PuzzleMate 框架，以第一视角采集的拼图场景为研究对象，开展用户参与式实验。实验评估当前先进多模态大语言模型对拼图状态的感知能力，以及生成可执行下一步操作指令的能力。研究进一步分析模型失效模式，归纳出七类限制其有效性的关键瓶颈，并基于这些发现提出用于系统评估模型拼图推理能力的基准。
AI.result: 分析显示，当前多模态大语言模型在拼图辅助任务中受到七类关键瓶颈限制。尽管 GPT-5.2 和 Gemini-2.5-Pro 等模型具有较强的整体能力，但在识别细微空间关系、处理复杂推理以及维持连续且正确的操作顺序方面表现不足，形成了与理想拼图辅助能力之间的显著性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明，通用视觉理解能力并不等同于精细操作场景中的可靠具身指导能力。PuzzleMate 及其评测基准为研究多模态模型的状态理解、空间推理和序列决策提供了专门化工具，也说明未来个人 AI 助手需要在细粒度感知、长期状态跟踪和可执行行动规划方面进一步提升。

title: Temperature Fragility and the Conditional Benefits of Truncation Sampling
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/larosafrancesco289/decoding-robustness
summary: Large language models generate text by sampling each token from a predicted distribution, and a temperature parameter sets how far the draw strays from the most probable tokens. Truncation samplers such as top-p and min-p discard the least probable tokens before the draw, so that sampling at high temperature stays coherent. Their reported accuracy gains come from temperatures of 1.5 to 3, while the defaults of deployed systems cluster between 0.6 and 1.0. Whether they change accuracy at those defaults, and for which models, has not been measured. We test thirteen open-weight models on GSM8K and MMLU-Pro at temperatures 0.7, 1.0, and 1.3 in one controlled pipeline, ten of them under eight decoding configurations. Six of the thirteen models lose 17 to 38 accuracy points on MMLU-Pro between 0.7 and 1.3, and the other seven lose at most 10. The lost accuracy comes from generations that run to the token limit or never state an answer. These results suggest that truncation samplers improve accuracy primarily when higher temperatures substantially degrade model performance. Where accuracy remains stable across temperatures, none of the tested truncation samplers improves on plain temperature sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了截断采样器（top-p、min-p等）在接近实际部署默认温度下是否提升大语言模型准确率。结果显示，收益主要出现在高温会显著损害模型性能的模型上；若模型跨温度表现稳定，截断采样器并未优于普通温度采样。
AI.motivation: 已有研究报告截断采样器在1.5至3的高温设置下能够提升准确率，但实际部署系统常用温度约为0.6至1.0。论文试图填补这一测量空白：在更接近默认设置的温度下，截断采样器是否仍能提升准确率，以及这种效果是否取决于具体模型。
AI.method: 作者在统一、受控的实验流程中测试13个开放权重模型，使用GSM8K和MMLU-Pro两个基准，评估温度0.7、1.0和1.3。13个模型均接受温度变化测试，其中10个模型进一步比较8种解码配置，包括普通温度采样与不同截断采样器。作者还分析准确率下降对应的生成行为。
AI.result: MMLU-Pro上，13个模型中有6个在温度从0.7升至1.3时准确率下降17至38个百分点，另有7个模型的下降不超过10个百分点。准确率损失主要来自生成达到最大token限制，或生成过程中始终没有给出明确答案。在高温显著降低性能的模型上，截断采样器具有改善准确率的潜力；在跨温度表现稳定的模型上，测试的截断采样器均未超过普通温度采样。
AI.conclusion: 截断采样器的准确率优势并非普遍存在，其主要作用是缓解高温导致的性能退化，而不是在所有默认温度范围内持续提升推理或知识问答能力。实际应用中，应先检查模型对温度的敏感性，再决定是否采用top-p、min-p等截断策略。

title: Empirical Evaluation of Open-Source Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in ESG Domain
summary:
Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting is critical for corporate accountability, with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offering strong potential to automate KPI extraction. However, open-source LLM performance in domain-specific ESG tasks remains insufficiently understood. This paper evaluates open-source LLMs in ESG contexts using a structured framework and evaluation resource based on 498 real-world ESG reports from EU-listed companies (2010-2024).
  We evaluate seven open-source models (2B to 30B parameters) -- glm-4.7-flash, nemotron-3-nano:4b, qwen3:4b-instruct, gemma3:4b, gemma4:e4b, gemma4:e2b, and ministral-3:8b -- using 100 persona-based synthetic QA pairs covering ESG information needs. System performance is assessed via RAGAS metrics, including contextual recall, precision, relevance, faithfulness, answer relevancy, and factual correctness.
  Results show notable performance variations across architectures. Retrieval performance is strong across models (context recall around 0.58-0.61, context precision around 0.78-0.81, context relevance 0.965-0.985). Generation diverges most on faithfulness (0.607-0.822) and least on answer relevancy (0.760-0.881): glm-4.7-flash leads in faithfulness (0.822), qwen3 in factual correctness (0.449), and ministral-3 in answer relevancy (0.881). Low overall factual correctness (0.387-0.449) highlights the need for domain-specific fine-tuning. This work provides data-driven guidance for deploying open-source models in ESG reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向ESG报告信息抽取的评估框架，基于498份欧盟上市公司ESG报告和100组角色化合成问答，对7个开源大语言模型在RAG场景下的检索与生成能力进行比较。结果显示，各模型检索表现相近，但生成阶段尤其是忠实性和事实正确性差异明显；总体事实正确性偏低，说明仍需领域微调。
AI.motivation: ESG报告关系企业透明度与问责，利用大语言模型和检索增强生成自动提取关键绩效指标具有实际价值。然而，开源模型在专业化、领域特定的ESG任务中的能力尚未得到充分、系统的理解，缺乏可用于模型选择和部署的量化依据。因此，本文旨在建立结构化评估资源，比较不同规模和架构开源模型在ESG问答与信息抽取中的表现。
AI.method: 研究使用2010—2024年欧盟上市公司的498份真实ESG报告，设计覆盖ESG信息需求的100组基于角色的合成问答。选取7个参数规模约2B至30B的开源模型：glm-4.7-flash、nemotron-3-nano:4b、qwen3:4b-instruct、gemma3:4b、gemma4:e4b、gemma4:e2b和ministral-3:8b。在RAG流程下，使用RAGAS指标评估上下文召回率、上下文精确率、上下文相关性、忠实性、答案相关性和事实正确性。
AI.result: 不同架构模型存在明显性能差异。检索指标整体较稳定：上下文召回率约为0.58—0.61，上下文精确率约为0.78—0.81，上下文相关性约为0.965—0.985。生成质量差异主要体现在忠实性，其范围为0.607—0.822；答案相关性差异相对较小，范围为0.760—0.881。glm-4.7-flash在忠实性上最佳（0.822），qwen3在事实正确性上最佳（0.449），ministral-3在答案相关性上最佳（0.881）。总体事实正确性仅为0.387—0.449，显著低于其他指标。
AI.conclusion: 开源模型在ESG场景中的检索能力总体可靠且差异有限，但生成阶段，特别是事实正确性和忠实性，仍是主要瓶颈。模型选择应根据目标指标进行权衡，而不能仅依据参数规模或通用性能。研究结果支持在实际ESG部署中引入领域特定微调、事实核验和更严格的评估机制，以降低幻觉和事实错误风险。

title: MCIQA-2K: A Multi-Dimensional Dataset and No-Reference Quality Assessment Benchmark for Colorized Images
summary: Image colorization is an inherently ill-posed task, since a single grayscale image may correspond to multiple plausible colorized results. Consequently, conventional full-reference image quality assessment (IQA) metrics fail to accurately reflect human perceptual preferences for colorized images. In this paper, we present MCIQA-2K, a large-scale multi-dimensional benchmark specifically designed for no-reference quality assessment of colorized images. We construct a dataset containing 2,000 colorized images generated by five representative colorization models, together with human annotations across three perceptual dimensions: color smearing, semantic color misalignment, and global naturalness. Building upon the proposed benchmark, we further introduce MCIQA, a dedicated multi-branch NR-IQA framework for colorized images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MCIQA significantly outperforms existing full-reference and no-reference IQA methods on the proposed benchmark, while also exhibiting competitive generalization capability on several widely-used IQA datasets. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/ARBEZ-ZEBRA/MCIQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向彩色化图像无参考质量评价的多维基准数据集MCIQA-2K及专用评价模型MCIQA。数据集含2,000张由五种代表性彩色化模型生成的图像，并从色彩涂抹、语义色彩错配和整体自然度三个维度进行人工标注。实验表明，MCIQA在该基准上显著优于现有全参考和无参考IQA方法，并具备较好的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 图像彩色化具有内在的不适定性：同一灰度图像可能对应多个合理的彩色结果。因此，依赖参考图像的传统全参考图像质量评价指标难以准确反映人类对彩色化结果的感知偏好。现有评价体系缺少专门针对彩色化失真的大规模、多维度无参考基准，促使作者构建MCIQA-2K并设计相应的评价模型。
AI.method: 首先，构建MCIQA-2K数据集，收集五种代表性彩色化模型生成的2,000张彩色化图像，并围绕三类感知属性进行人工标注：色彩涂抹、语义色彩错配和整体自然度。其次，在该基准上提出多分支无参考图像质量评价框架MCIQA，用于分别建模不同感知维度并进行综合质量预测。最后，通过与现有全参考及无参考IQA方法比较，并在多个常用IQA数据集上测试泛化性能，验证模型有效性。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，MCIQA在MCIQA-2K上显著优于现有全参考和无参考IQA方法；同时，在多个广泛使用的IQA数据集上表现出具有竞争力的泛化能力。摘要未提供具体评价指标、提升幅度或消融实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了面向彩色化图像无参考质量评价的专用数据基础和模型框架。MCIQA-2K通过多维人工标注刻画彩色化图像的关键感知缺陷，MCIQA则能够更有效地预测人类质量偏好。数据集和代码公开发布，有助于推动彩色化图像质量评价研究。

title: How Lossless Is Lossless Speculative Decoding? The Role of Numerical Precision in Orthrus
summary:
Orthrus is a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion architecture that accelerates autoregressive language-model inference by generating multiple tokens in parallel while using a frozen autoregressive backbone. Its central claim is that an intra-model consensus mechanism enables lossless speculative decoding, producing the same output sequence as the autoregressive model.
  We independently reproduce Orthrus and examine this claim under different numerical precisions. Under BF16 inference, exact trajectory matching occurs in only 45% of cases for the authors' checkpoint and 43% for our independently trained model across 1,190 prompts from 12 domains. The probability of exact matching is also strongly associated with the response-conditional perplexity of the reference model. Despite this trajectory divergence, Orthrus does not show systematic degradation on downstream lm-eval-harness benchmarks. In contrast, repeating the trajectory evaluation with FP32 yields exact trajectory matching on all evaluated prompts.
  These results show that the practical losslessness of Orthrus depends on numerical precision and that exact trajectory equivalence should be evaluated separately from downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文复现并评估 Orthrus 混合自回归-扩散架构的“无损投机解码”主张，发现其精确轨迹一致性高度依赖数值精度：BF16 下仅约43%–45%，FP32 下则在所有测试提示上匹配；轨迹偏差未导致下游基准出现系统性性能下降。
AI.motivation: Orthrus 声称通过模型内部共识机制，在并行生成多个 token 的同时保持与冻结自回归骨干模型完全相同的输出序列，从而实现无损加速。该研究的动机是独立验证这一强主张，并区分“逐 token 轨迹完全一致”与“下游任务性能不下降”这两个不同层面的无损性。
AI.method: 研究者独立复现 Orthrus，并在作者提供的 checkpoint 和自主训练模型上进行评估。实验覆盖来自12个领域的1,190个提示，比较 BF16 与 FP32 推理下 Orthrus 和参考自回归模型的精确输出轨迹；同时分析精确匹配率与参考模型响应条件困惑度之间的关系，并使用 lm-eval-harness 检查下游任务表现。
AI.result: BF16 下，作者 checkpoint 的精确轨迹匹配率为45%，独立训练模型为43%；匹配概率与参考模型的响应条件困惑度存在强关联，说明模型对响应越不确定，轨迹越容易分歧。尽管 BF16 下出现轨迹偏离，Orthrus 在下游 lm-eval-harness 基准上没有表现出系统性退化。FP32 重复实验中，所有评估提示均实现精确轨迹匹配。
AI.conclusion: Orthrus 的实际无损性并非完全与架构本身无关，而是显著依赖数值精度。评估此类方法时，应将严格的输出轨迹等价性与下游任务性能分开报告：前者衡量是否真正复现参考模型，后者衡量轨迹偏差是否影响任务效果。

title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted by Findings of ICDM 2026, project: https://github.com/qky7/ProIQA
summary: Automatic Item Generation (AIG) is pivotal for personalized education, yet guaranteeing the pedagogical value of generated items remains a bottleneck. Existing Item Quality Assessment (IQA) methods typically rely on unscalable manual reviews or shallow stem-based metrics, failing to capture the reasoning process required for mathematical problem-solving. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes Process-based Item Quality Assessment (ProIQA), a process-aware framework for fine-grained quality assessment of math items. We first formulate IQA across three heterogeneous dimensions, including knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies, under a unified process-aware perspective. Based on this formulation, we construct a process-enhanced IQA resource by augmenting original item data with structured reasoning trees derived from raw solutions. Technically, ProIQA leverages Large Language Modelsto construct hierarchical reasoning trees and employs Graph Neural Networks (GNN) to encode their topological dependencies and procedural semantics. The resulting solving representation is fused with stem semantics through a dual-view (``Stem + Solving'') architecture, enabling comprehensive assessment across learning objectives. Extensive experiments on K12 mathematical datasets show that ProIQA effectively captures process-oriented features, offering a scalable data-driven solution for evaluating AIG outputs in intelligent education systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProIQA，一种面向数学题目生成质量评估的过程感知框架。该方法将知识概念、难度和学科能力三个维度统一建模，利用大语言模型从解答中构建层次化推理树，再通过图神经网络编码推理结构与过程语义，并与题干语义融合，以更全面、可扩展地评估自动生成数学题目的质量。实验表明，该方法在 K12 数学数据集上能够有效捕捉解题过程特征，为智能教育中的自动题目质量评估提供了数据驱动方案。
AI.motivation: 自动题目生成有助于实现个性化教育，但生成题目的教学价值和质量难以自动、细粒度地保证。现有题目质量评估方法主要依赖人工审核，成本高、可扩展性差；或仅基于题干表面语义，难以反映数学问题所要求的推理过程、知识关联和解题能力。因此，论文旨在建立一种能够理解解题过程并覆盖多种教学目标的可扩展质量评估方法。
AI.method: 论文首先从过程感知视角，将题目质量评估统一划分为知识概念、难度和学科能力三个异构维度。随后，利用原始题目及其解答构建过程增强型评估资源，并借助大语言模型将解答转换为层次化推理树。模型采用图神经网络编码推理树中的拓扑依赖关系和程序性语义，获得解题过程表示；同时编码题干语义，形成“题干 + 解题过程”的双视角架构，最终对不同学习目标下的题目质量进行综合评估。
AI.result: 在 K12 数学数据集上的大量实验显示，ProIQA能够更有效地提取过程导向特征，并支持对知识概念、难度和学科能力等维度进行质量评估。该框架相较于依赖人工审核或仅使用题干特征的方法，具有更好的过程建模能力和规模化应用潜力。不过，摘要未提供具体数据集名称、评价指标、基线模型及数值提升幅度，因此无法据此判断其绝对性能优势。
AI.conclusion: ProIQA通过融合结构化推理树、图神经网络和题干语义，为自动生成数学题目的过程感知质量评估提供了新的技术路径。其核心贡献在于把解题步骤及其依赖关系纳入 IQA，而不仅评估题目表面文本。总体而言，该方法有望提升 AIG 系统的教学可靠性和自动化评估能力，但其有效性仍需结合更详细的实验结果、跨数据集泛化表现、推理树构建误差及计算成本进行进一步验证。

title: CGGT: Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer for 3D Parametric Curve Reconstruction
summary: Recovering editable 3D parametric curves from 2D images is a fundamental challenge in computer graphics, bridging pixel-based perception and vector-based CAD modeling. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods often rely on dense calibrated views, precomputed 2D edge maps, and costly per-scene optimization, limiting their applicability to casually captured real-world inputs. We propose CGGT, a Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer that directly grounds 3D-consistent 2D curve instances in the image space from sparse, unposed multi-view images. CGGT combines a geometry-aware transformer encoder for multi-view feature learning with a curve-aware masked-attention decoder for cross-view instance association. In a single forward pass, it predicts camera parameters, dense depth maps, and instance-level 2D curve masks, which are then lifted into 3D and refined through a fast parametric optimization stage to recover compact, editable 3D curve primitives. To support structured curve learning, we introduce Wireframe-100K, a large-scale dataset comprising 100,000 CAD models with diverse topologies, realistic multi-view renderings, and accurate parametric curve annotations. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves substantial improvements in both reconstruction accuracy and efficiency, particularly under challenging sparse-view settings and in separating persistent 3D structural edges from view-dependent image edges caused by silhouettes, textures, and appearance variations. Despite being trained solely on synthetic data, CGGT generalizes well to real-world images, demonstrating its potential for practical CAD-style wireframe reconstruction from unconstrained visual inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CGGT，一种从稀疏、无位姿多视图图像中直接恢复具有三维一致性的二维曲线实例，并进一步重建紧凑、可编辑的三维参数化曲线。方法结合几何感知 Transformer、曲线感知掩码注意力解码器、单次前向预测与快速参数化优化；同时发布 Wireframe-100K 数据集。实验表明，该方法在稀疏视角下兼具较高重建精度与效率，并能较好地区分稳定的三维结构边缘和视角相关的图像边缘，且可从合成数据泛化到真实图像。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 NeRF 和 3D Gaussian Splatting 的三维曲线重建方法通常依赖密集且经过标定的多视图、预先计算的二维边缘图以及昂贵的逐场景优化，因此难以处理现实环境中随手拍摄的稀疏、无位姿图像。本文旨在弥合像素级视觉感知与矢量化 CAD 建模之间的差距，从非受控视觉输入中恢复结构化、参数化且可编辑的三维曲线。
AI.method: 提出 Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer（CGGT）。首先，使用几何感知 Transformer 编码器进行多视图特征学习；随后通过曲线感知的掩码注意力解码器完成跨视图曲线实例关联。在单次前向传播中联合预测相机参数、稠密深度图和实例级二维曲线掩码。之后将二维曲线提升至三维，并通过快速参数化优化恢复紧凑、可编辑的三维曲线基元。为支持结构化曲线学习，构建 Wireframe-100K 数据集，包含 100,000 个具有多样拓扑结构的 CAD 模型、真实感多视图渲染结果和精确的参数化曲线标注。
AI.result: 实验显示，CGGT 在重建精度和计算效率方面均取得显著提升，尤其适用于稀疏视角场景。该方法能够有效分离持续存在的三维结构边缘与由轮廓、纹理和外观变化造成的视角相关图像边缘。尽管仅使用合成数据训练，模型仍能较好地泛化到真实世界图像。
AI.conclusion: CGGT 为从稀疏、无标定或无位姿的真实图像中进行 CAD 风格三维线框重建提供了一种高效方案。其核心价值在于以学习式多视图几何和曲线实例关联替代密集视图及逐场景高成本优化，并通过参数化表示输出可编辑的三维曲线。Wireframe-100K 进一步为结构化三维曲线学习提供了数据基础。

title: Authorship attribution and aesthetic evaluation of AI poetry: a case study with Haiku
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures. Accepted as a full paper at the 2026 Joint 14th International Conference on Soft Computing and Intelligent Systems and 27th International Symposium on Advanced Intelligent Systems (SCIS&ISIS 2026), November 2-5, 2026
summary: This paper investigates the generation and human evaluation of Japanese haiku by contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on authorship perception and aesthetic judgment within a constrained poetic form. Using a few-shot prompting strategy, Japanese haiku were generated across a heterogeneous set of large language models, including open- and closed-source systems, medium-scale and large-scale architectures, models with native or adapted Japanese support, and multilingual proprietary models. These AI-generated haiku were combined with human-written ones and presented in a questionnaire distributed to students at Japanese universities in Tokyo. The survey assessed whether respondents could distinguish between AI-generated and human-written haiku and which cues informed their judgments. Recognition accuracy varied across models. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5, and StableLM-7B performed at approximately chance level (approx 0.50), whereas LLM-JP, Gemma-2B, and LLaMA-2 showed moderate detectability (approx 0.59-0.67). However, recognition was strongly item-dependent. Ratings of fluency, coherence, poeticness, and related aesthetic dimensions predicted perceived humanness but not correct classification, indicating an attribution bias linked to aesthetic evaluation and revealing a dissociation between aesthetic evaluation and true authorship detection. The extended analysis additionally examines generation-constraint adherence, participant-level characteristics, and exploratory LLM-based evaluations of haiku authorship. Overall, the findings suggest that as LLMs improve, surface-level creative plausibility may reduce reliable human discrimination within constrained poetic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当代大语言模型生成日语俳句的作者归因与审美评价。通过让东京日本高校学生判断混合呈现的人工俳句与AI俳句，结果发现不同模型的可识别性差异明显，但整体上审美评价与真实作者分类相分离：读者倾向于把流畅、连贯、富有诗意的作品判断为人类创作，却未必能准确识别其真实来源。随着模型生成质量提升，AI俳句在受限诗体中的表面创作可信度可能削弱人类辨别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有关于生成式AI创作的研究较多关注文本质量，却较少系统考察在严格形式约束的诗歌体裁中，人类如何判断作品作者，以及审美感受是否会影响作者归因。日语俳句具有篇幅短、形式规范明确、文化语境鲜明等特点，适合检验LLM的创作能力、约束遵循能力和人类作者识别能力。本文旨在弥补这一空白，并分析审美评价与真实作者识别之间是否存在偏差或分离。
AI.method: 研究采用少样本提示策略，使用多个异质性LLM生成日语俳句，涵盖开源与闭源、中等规模与大规模、原生或适配日语能力的模型，以及多语种商业模型。研究者将AI生成俳句与人工创作俳句混合后，制作问卷并分发给东京日本高校学生。受试者需要判断作品是否由AI生成或由人类创作，并评价流畅性、连贯性、诗意等审美维度。分析进一步考察模型间识别率差异、单条作品依赖性、生成约束遵循情况、参与者特征，以及使用LLM进行作者归因的探索性结果。
AI.result: 不同模型的作者识别准确率存在差异。GPT-5、Gemini 2.5和StableLM-7B的识别率约为0.50，接近随机水平；LLM-JP、Gemma-2B和LLaMA-2的识别率约为0.59—0.67，表现出中等程度的可识别性。然而，识别结果高度依赖具体诗句，而非仅由模型类别决定。流畅性、连贯性、诗意等评价能够预测受试者对“人类创作”的感知，却不能有效预测真实作者分类，表明存在由审美评价驱动的归因偏差。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，人类对LLM生成日语俳句的识别能力并不稳定，并且审美评价与真实作者检测之间存在明显脱钩。读者可能因作品流畅、连贯或富有诗意而将其归因于人类，即使该判断并不正确。随着LLM生成能力提升，其在受限诗歌形式中的表面创作可信度可能进一步增强，从而降低人类可靠区分AI与人类作品的能力。

title: Why LLM Agents Collapse Without Oversight: The Enforcement Gap as the Mechanism Behind Emergence World Failures
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: When Emergence World placed frontier LLM agents in an unsupervised multi-agent simulation, the results were alarming: agents committed crimes, starved, and enforced unanimous conformity -- without any external attacker. This paper identifies the mechanism. Reflexion-style agents already detect dangerous plan steps through iterative self-critique, yet the architecture provides no pathway from detection to action. We call this the enforcement gap: the audit sees the problem; the controller ignores it. Closing the gap requires a single conditional check -- fewer than 20 lines of code -- and reduces attack success by more than fourfold in large-scale experiments across frontier models, all five major agent frameworks, and an independent benchmark. We prove formally that when enforcement probability is near zero, detection quality is irrelevant to security. We further identify two compounding failure modes -- unreliable auditors and unparseable verdicts -- that explain every collapse pattern in Emergence World. A GRPO-trained enforcement controller resolves the ambiguity case. Together these results motivate a three-requirement Audit Enforcement Specification that is absent from every deployed framework today.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多智能体仿真中的审计—执行断裂：智能体能够识别危险计划，但控制器未必据此采取阻断行动。作者提出增加条件检查和执行控制器，并报告其在多种模型、框架及独立基准上的安全改进。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在解释 Emergence World 等无监督多智能体环境中出现的系统性失效现象，尤其是为何具备自我反思和风险审计能力的智能体仍会产生不安全行为。核心动机是识别从“检测风险”到“执行干预”之间的架构缺口，并建立可验证的安全规范。
AI.method: 作者将问题定义为 enforcement gap（执行缺口），分析 Reflexion 风格智能体的审计结果与控制器决策之间的断裂；提出一个少于 20 行代码的条件检查，将审计结论接入行动执行路径；在前沿模型、五类智能体框架和独立基准上开展大规模实验；进一步形式化证明当执行概率接近零时，检测质量对安全性几乎不起作用；分析不可靠审计器与不可解析 verdicts 两类复合失效，并训练 GRPO 执行控制器处理歧义情形。
AI.result: 加入执行检查后，攻击成功率降低超过四倍。形式化结果表明，在执行概率近乎为零时，提高风险检测质量不会显著改善安全性。作者认为，不可靠审计器和不可解析的审计结论能够解释 Emergence World 中观察到的各种崩溃模式；GRPO 训练的执行控制器可缓解歧义判定问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出 Audit Enforcement Specification，要求系统同时具备风险审计、可解析的审计结论以及能够据此采取行动的执行机制。作者声称当前部署的智能体框架均缺少这三项要求，因而仅提升审计能力并不足以保证安全，必须打通审计到控制的闭环。

title: Selective Tool Use for Agentic Change Visual Question Answering in Remote Sensing
summary: Change visual question answering (Change VQA) requires understanding semantic changes across bi-temporal remote sensing images. Although vision language models (VLMs) have shown promising performance on this task, they remain unreliable when answering questions that require explicit transition statistics, area measurements, or spatial information. To address this limitation, we propose a selective tool use framework in which a single VLM either answers directly or invokes a deterministic change analysis tool to obtain question specific evidence. Specifically, the selected tool operates on bi-temporal semantic maps and returns a structured observation, which the same VLM uses to generate its final answer. To support this framework, we construct a tool augmented extension of CDVQA covering eight question families and three tools for transition, spatial, and temporal analysis. Tool use supervision and observations are derived automatically from the original semantic annotations, without additional manual labeling. We then adapt Qwen3.5-4B using Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to jointly learn direct answering, tool invocation, and evidence conditioned answering. Experiments on 7,164 test questions show that selective tool use with reference semantic maps improves overall accuracy from 73.77% to 88.79% and average family accuracy from 69.11% to 89.65%. When the semantic maps are predicted automatically, the framework achieves 77.47% overall accuracy and 75.06% average family accuracy. These results demonstrate the benefit of question-specific semantic evidence for Change VQA, while highlighting the influence of semantic prediction quality on the resulting performance. Code and tool-augmented annotations will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yakoubbazi/ToolChangeVQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向变化视觉问答（Change VQA）的选择性工具调用框架：视觉语言模型根据问题决定直接回答，或调用确定性的变化分析工具，从双时相语义图中提取转移、空间和时间证据，再生成最终答案。基于Qwen3.5-4B与LoRA的实验表明，参考语义图下总体准确率由73.77%提升至88.79%，平均问题族准确率由69.11%提升至89.65%；使用自动预测语义图时，准确率分别为77.47%和75.06%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽然能够处理变化视觉问答，但在需要明确变化转移统计、面积测量和空间关系的问题上可靠性不足。主要原因是模型缺乏对双时相遥感图像进行精确、可验证的结构化变化分析能力。因此，论文旨在引入问题相关的确定性工具，为模型提供显式语义证据，同时避免对所有问题都进行不必要的工具调用。
AI.method: 提出选择性工具调用框架。单个视觉语言模型根据问题需求选择直接回答，或调用变化分析工具。工具处理双时相语义图，并返回结构化观测结果，模型再基于该证据生成答案。框架包含转移分析、空间分析和时间分析三类工具，覆盖八类问题。作者从原始语义标注自动生成工具调用监督和工具观测，无需额外人工标注；随后使用LoRA对Qwen3.5-4B进行适配，使其联合学习直接回答、工具调用和基于证据的回答。
AI.result: 在7164个测试问题上，使用参考语义图时，选择性工具调用将总体准确率从73.77%提升至88.79%，平均问题族准确率从69.11%提升至89.65%。当语义图由模型自动预测时，总体准确率为77.47%，平均问题族准确率为75.06%。这表明工具提供的显式、问题相关语义证据能够显著提升Change VQA性能，但自动语义预测误差会明显限制最终效果。
AI.conclusion: 选择性工具调用能够有效弥补视觉语言模型在精确变化统计、面积和空间推理方面的不足，并显著改善Change VQA表现。该方法的实际性能高度依赖语义图质量：参考语义图下收益显著，而自动预测语义图下性能下降明显。论文同时发布工具增强标注和代码，为后续研究提供了可复现基础。

title: Psychosis involves a deficit of information compression in connected speech
summary: Large language models (LLMs) with human-like performance on linguistic tasks have transformed the study of language in neurodiverse conditions. LLMs provide representations of linguistic input in the form of high-dimensional vectors (embeddings), and next-token predictions computed from these embeddings. Previous crosslinguistic evidence suggests a complexity reduction in the form of both lower intrinsic dimensionality (ID) of LLM representations and higher mean surprisal (prediction error) in psychosis. We hypothesized that these metrics reflect a general deficit of information compression in psychosis, linked to grammatical organization as what enables predictions in language.We operationalized surprisal difference as the difference between surprisal as estimated from word frequency and surprisal as based on a contextual LM, which is sensitive to grammatical organization over and above lexical concepts. Using a dataset of 144 Turkish speakers, including 106 patients with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders (SSD) - 56 with chronic schizophrenia (SZH), 33 with first-episode psychosis (FEP), and 17 with schizoaffective disorder (SZA) - and 38 healthy controls. We report: (1) Surprisal difference is attenuated in all clinical groups relative to controls, independently of word count; (2) Compressibility (intrinsic dimension) is reduced in SZH and FEP; (3) Syntactic complexity and compressibility both predict surprisal difference. These results, further refining an alteration in the geometry of the semantic space in psychosis as previously attested, suggest a broader deficit in information compression in this disorder, with a mechanistic underpinning in the operations of grammar.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用大型语言模型指标分析精神病谱系障碍中的语言信息压缩异常。土耳其语数据表明，患者的语境化惊讶度差异减弱，部分患者的表征内在维度降低；句法复杂度与可压缩性共同预测该指标，提示语法组织可能是信息压缩障碍的机制基础。
AI.motivation: 既有跨语言研究发现，精神病状态与语言模型表征内在维度降低及平均惊讶度升高相关，但这些现象是否反映更一般的信息压缩缺陷，以及语法组织在其中所起的作用，仍不清楚。本研究旨在检验精神病谱系障碍中的信息压缩异常，并探讨其与语法预测机制的关系。
AI.method: 研究分析144名土耳其语使用者的数据，包括106名精神分裂症谱系障碍患者（56名慢性精神分裂症、33名首发精神病、17名分裂情感性障碍）和38名健康对照。使用大型语言模型的词语嵌入和下一词预测，计算：（1）惊讶度差异，即基于词频的惊讶度与基于语境语言模型的惊讶度之差；（2）表征的内在维度，作为可压缩性的指标；并考察句法复杂度、可压缩性与惊讶度差异之间的关系，同时控制词数影响。
AI.result: 所有临床组的惊讶度差异均低于健康对照，且该结果不依赖文本词数。慢性精神分裂症组和首发精神病组的可压缩性（内在维度）降低。句法复杂度和可压缩性均能预测惊讶度差异。
AI.conclusion: 精神病谱系障碍可能存在比既往语义空间几何改变更广泛的信息压缩缺陷。该缺陷可能与语法组织能力受损有关，因为语法组织是形成语境化语言预测的重要基础。研究支持将大型语言模型表征指标作为刻画精神病语言异常及其机制的工具，但因研究基于单一语言和横断面数据，因果关系仍需进一步验证。

title: Reason What Matters: Retrieval-Grounded Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) learns unified representations across modalities, enabling a single model to support diverse retrieval tasks. Recent methods use Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to better interpret multimodal inputs before generating embeddings for complex retrieval tasks and further optimize this reasoning process through GRPO with retrieval-based rewards. However, two limitations hinder corpus-scale deployment. GRPO assigns all CoT tokens the same advantage, without identifying input-supported claims or evidence that distinguishes the positive from negatives. Moreover, generating a complete CoT before each embedding introduces substantial latency, even when a partial trace already provides sufficient retrieval evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Reason What Matters (ReWAM), a retrieval-grounded reasoning framework that uses retrieval feedback to guide both credit assignment and reasoning computation. Specifically, we introduce Retrieval-aware Self-Distillation (RASD), which constructs privileged guidance from input-supported evidence that distinguishes the positive item from retrieved hard negatives. An on-policy self-teacher uses this guidance to refine trajectory-level feedback into token-specific supervision for retrieval-relevant reasoning. We further develop Retrieval-adaptive Inference (RAI), which uses a retrieval confidence head to estimate the remaining retrieval utility of a partial CoT. It stops unproductive traces early and accelerates useful continuations with speculative decoding. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and MRMR demonstrate that ReWAM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance while delivering up to 5x the inference throughput of competitive explicit-CoT UME methods. These results bridge the gap between retrieval quality and inference efficiency, making reasoning-enhanced UME practical for large-scale deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReWAM，一种面向通用多模态嵌入（UME）的检索增强推理框架，通过检索反馈同时优化 CoT 的信用分配与推理计算，实现更高的检索性能和最高约 5 倍的推理吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 CoT 的 UME 方法能够提升复杂多模态检索能力，但存在两项关键问题：其一，GRPO 对所有 CoT token 使用相同优势，无法区分真正由输入支持、且能区分正样本与困难负样本的证据；其二，每次嵌入生成前都完整生成 CoT，导致较高延迟，即使部分推理轨迹已经包含足够的检索证据，也会继续进行无效计算。因此，需要一种能够依据检索相关性进行精细信用分配，并自适应终止或加速推理的方法。
AI.method: 提出 ReWAM（Reason What Matters）。其一，设计 Retrieval-aware Self-Distillation（RASD）：从输入支持的证据中构造特权指导信息，该证据能够区分正样本与检索得到的困难负样本；随后利用在线自教师，将轨迹级反馈细化为 token 级监督，从而强化与检索相关的推理。其二，设计 Retrieval-adaptive Inference（RAI）：引入检索置信度头，估计部分 CoT 的剩余检索效用；对低效推理轨迹提前停止，对有价值的后续生成采用投机解码，以降低推理延迟并提升吞吐。
AI.result: 在 MMEB-V2 和 MRMR 数据集上的大量实验表明，ReWAM 达到当前最优的检索性能，并且相较于具有显式 CoT 的竞争性 UME 方法，推理吞吐最高提升约 5 倍。
AI.conclusion: ReWAM 通过检索感知的 token 级信用分配和自适应推理计算，有效协调了检索质量与推理效率，缩小了两者之间的矛盾，使推理增强的通用多模态嵌入更适合大规模部署。

title: Sharing standardized image-derived data in computational pathology using DICOM
comment: Daniela P. Schacherer, Christopher P. Bridge: contributed equally
summary: Development and evaluation of computational pathology methods require access to large and diverse datasets. Over the past decade, various initiatives invested significantly into collecting, centralizing, and sharing pathology imaging data. In contrast, sharing of image-derived data such as region-of-interest delineations or segmentation masks is less well developed. In this work, we describe our approach to encoding and sharing image-derived pathology data in a standardized manner within the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Imaging Data Commons (IDC), a platform that hosts and provides public access to de-identified radiology and pathology data. The IDC relies on the Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) standard for data harmonization, yet the adoption of DICOM for pathology image-derived content has remained largely unexplored until now. Here, we present five representative datasets harmonized by conversion from their original representations into DICOM and shared publicly in the IDC. We demonstrate the benefits of this harmonization, describe contributions to critical open-source tooling, and discuss technical considerations relevant to broader adoption of DICOM for pathology image-derived data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于DICOM标准的方法，将病理图像衍生数据（如感兴趣区域标注和分割掩膜）进行规范化编码，并公开发布至NCI Imaging Data Commons（IDC），同时评估其应用价值与技术问题。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学方法的开发和评估依赖大规模、多样化数据集。虽然病理图像数据的收集、集中管理和共享已取得进展，但图像衍生数据，尤其是ROI轮廓和分割掩膜，仍缺乏统一、成熟的共享机制。由于IDC以DICOM作为数据协调与互操作标准，研究旨在探索DICOM在病理图像衍生数据领域的适用性，弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究团队将五个具有代表性的病理数据集从原始数据格式转换为DICOM格式，并将其整合、去标识化后发布到NCI Imaging Data Commons。研究同时完善相关开源工具，展示标准化数据在存储、访问和共享方面的优势，并分析DICOM用于病理图像衍生数据时的技术考量及推广条件。
AI.result: 五个代表性数据集成功完成从原始表示到DICOM的规范化转换，并在IDC中实现公开共享。研究证明，该方法能够促进病理图像衍生数据的统一管理和互操作，且推动了相关开源工具的发展。同时，研究总结了将DICOM扩展应用于病理图像衍生数据时需要关注的技术问题。摘要未提供具体的定量性能指标或用户评估结果。
AI.conclusion: DICOM可作为病理图像衍生数据标准化编码和共享的可行基础。将ROI标注、分割掩膜等数据纳入IDC，有助于提升数据的可发现性、可访问性和复用能力，并支持计算病理学方法的开发与验证。未来仍需进一步解决标准细化、工具完善及更广泛生态采用等问题。

title: To Each Language Its Tokenizer: Modular Tokenizers for Efficient Multilingual LLMs
summary: Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) traditionally rely on a single vocabulary shared by all supported languages, which can lead to uneven compression across them. Moreover, their large embedding and output matrices increase memory usage and slow inference, notably for small-scale models. It is also wasteful as models are often used for only a subset of languages. To address these issues, we introduce a modular framework for multilingual model training. First, we propose methods to learn large modular BPE and Unigram tokenizers that enable extraction of subtokenizers tailored to any language subset. These subtokenizers achieve compression on par with monolingual tokenizers and improve cross-lingual fairness. Second, we design a pretraining strategy that samples subtokenizers to form batches, restricting predictions to the relevant vocabulary subset and allowing efficient training despite a large vocabulary. This supports efficient inference with any combination of language-specific vocabularies. Therefore, it reduces memory usage and speeds up inference in models without sacrificing performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模块化多语言大模型训练框架，通过可组合的语言子词表和受限词表预测，改善不同语言间的压缩公平性，并降低模型的内存与推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言大模型通常为所有语言共享单一词表，导致不同语言的分词压缩效率不均衡，影响跨语言公平性。同时，大规模嵌入矩阵和输出矩阵会增加内存占用与推理延迟，尤其影响小规模模型；当模型只服务于部分语言时，完整词表也会造成资源浪费。
AI.method: 研究首先提出学习大型模块化BPE和Unigram分词器的方法，使其能够针对任意语言子集提取定制化子分词器，并使压缩性能接近单语分词器。随后提出一种预训练策略：按批次采样子分词器，仅对相关语言子集的词表进行预测，从而在保持大词表覆盖能力的同时提高训练效率。推理阶段也可以根据需求组合不同语言的词表模块。
AI.result: 所得到的子分词器在压缩效果上接近单语分词器，并改善了多语言之间的压缩公平性。模块化训练与受限词表预测能够降低内存使用、加快训练和推理，并支持任意语言组合，同时不牺牲模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，多语言模型的词表和训练过程可以模块化设计。通过按语言子集动态选择词表，模型能够兼顾跨语言公平性、资源效率和灵活部署，为面向特定语言组合的多语言模型提供了一种有效方案。

title: Evaluation Metrics for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly formalized as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP), in which an agent maximizes expected reward while keeping its expected cumulative cost below a specified safety bound. Existing safe RL benchmarks predominantly report whether an algorithm is safe on average, following this expectation-based guarantee. We argue that this convention is insufficient to reliably characterize an algorithm's true safety: it fails to capture how often and how severely the safety bound is violated, whether this holds consistently across tasks and safety bounds, and whether training-time behavior is representative of behavior of the final converged policy. Therefore, we introduce (i) evaluation metrics for safe RL that address each of these concerns and in addition allow for aggregation across tasks and safety bounds. We furthermore define (ii) a safety tier system to systematically categorize and compare algorithms in terms of safety and reliability at both training and for a final policy. Using this framework, we provide (iii) an empirical safety evaluation across multiple safety navigation tasks. Our results show that aggregate metrics, distributional reporting, and task- and safety bound-specific results each reveal information the other metrics cannot. We therefore recommend reporting all three jointly, rather than compressing this information into a single value, as is common practice. We provide SafeRLEval, an open-source evaluation suite to support the reliable characterization of safety in future safe RL research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SafeRLEval，用于更全面、可靠地评估安全强化学习算法，不仅考察平均成本是否满足安全约束，还分析违规频率、违规严重程度、任务与安全阈值的一致性，以及训练过程和最终策略之间的差异。作者提出三类互补评估指标和安全等级体系，并在多个安全导航任务上进行实证评估。结果表明，聚合指标、分布指标以及任务/阈值特定结果各自提供不可替代的信息，建议联合报告而非压缩为单一分数。
AI.motivation: 现有安全强化学习基准主要依据期望累计成本是否低于安全阈值来判断算法是否安全。这种平均意义下的评价无法充分反映真实安全性，例如安全约束被违反的频率和严重程度、算法在不同任务及不同安全阈值下是否稳定，以及训练阶段的行为是否能代表最终收敛策略。因此，论文旨在建立更细致、可靠且可跨任务和安全阈值比较的安全评估框架。
AI.method: 论文提出三项核心方法：（1）设计覆盖违规频率、违规严重程度、跨任务与跨安全阈值聚合，以及训练过程和最终策略表现的安全强化学习评估指标；（2）建立安全等级体系，从训练阶段和最终策略两个层面系统分类、比较算法的安全性与可靠性；（3）实现开源评估套件 SafeRLEval，并在多个安全导航任务上开展实证评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，聚合指标、分布式报告以及任务和安全阈值特定的结果能够揭示不同层面的信息，彼此不能完全替代。仅报告平均安全表现或单一汇总值，可能掩盖算法在违规频率、违规程度、任务泛化性和训练稳定性方面的重要差异。
AI.conclusion: 安全强化学习的评估不应局限于期望成本是否满足约束，也不宜将复杂安全表现压缩为单一分数。作者建议联合报告聚合指标、分布信息及任务/安全阈值特定结果，并同时区分训练阶段和最终策略的表现。SafeRLEval 为未来研究提供了标准化、可复现的安全评估工具。

title: Small Object Detection in Drone Aerial Imagery with LAF-YOLOv10
summary: General-purpose object detectors lose accuracy on UAV footage, where targets span only a handful of pixels and onboard compute is limited. Prior work composes independently-validated architectural techniques into one detector, assuming gains reported in isolation transfer once combined. We stress-test that assumption directly. LAF-YOLOv10 integrates four techniques into YOLOv10n: a Partial Convolution C2f (PC-C2f) backbone block, an Attention-Guided Feature Pyramid Network (AG-FPN), a P2 detection head replacing the large-object P5 head, and Wise-IoU v3 regression, asking whether their combined effect matches what each contributes alone. We train LAF-YOLOv10 three times (seeds 42, 123, 256) on VisDrone-DET2019, benchmark against unmodified YOLOv10n, and use TIDE error decomposition, per-category breakdown, per-component ablation, attention/loss comparisons, zero-shot transfer to UAVDT, and held-out/test-dev evaluation to localize where the combination succeeds or fails. Composability does not hold here. LAF-YOLOv10 reaches 24.0+/-0.4% mAP@0.5 at 2.14M parameters, 7.8 points below YOLOv10n (31.8%), a deficit that transfers to UAVDT (-10.0 points) and is confirmed by held-out and test-dev evaluation (23.5%, 22.5%). Background false positives, localization error, and duplicate detections move in the direction AG-FPN and Wise-IoU were designed to push. Ablation traces the deficit to a specific source: the P2/-P5 head swap costs 2.5 points independently plus a 2.5-point interaction penalty when layered onto a backbone weakened by PC-C2f, whose own 2.0-point loss is consistent with a partial pretrained-weight transplant (73/150 backbone tensors transfer). The failure is attributable to a specific interaction, not the four components individually. Composability must be verified directly, not assumed. Code/checkpoints: https://github.com/Mudassiruddin7/Small-Object-Detection-in-UAV-Imagery.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验四种面向无人机小目标检测的改进是否能够在YOLOv10n中可组合地叠加，结果表明组合不仅未带来增益，反而显著降低性能。LAF-YOLOv10在VisDrone-DET2019上仅取得24.0±0.4% mAP@0.5，较原始YOLOv10n低7.8个百分点；消融实验定位到主要问题是P2替换P5检测头与PC-C2f弱化骨干网络之间的交互。
AI.motivation: 通用目标检测器在无人机航拍场景中容易受到小目标像素占比低、背景复杂以及机载算力受限等因素影响。现有研究通常将分别验证有效的结构或损失函数直接组合到同一检测器中，并默认各组件的独立增益可以叠加。本文的动机是直接检验这一可组合性假设，识别组合失败的具体来源，而不是仅报告一个整体模型的性能。
AI.method: 以YOLOv10n为基线，集成四项技术构建LAF-YOLOv10：PC-C2f骨干模块、AG-FPN、以P2检测头替换大目标P5检测头，以及Wise-IoU v3回归损失。在VisDrone-DET2019上使用三个随机种子（42、123、256）训练，并与未修改的YOLOv10n比较。通过TIDE误差分解、类别级分析、逐组件消融、注意力与损失对比、UAVDT零样本迁移，以及held-out和test-dev评估，定位性能下降的原因。
AI.result: LAF-YOLOv10仅达到24.0±0.4% mAP@0.5，参数量为2.14M，较YOLOv10n的31.8%低7.8个百分点；该差距在UAVDT上仍为10.0个百分点，并在held-out集和test-dev上分别得到23.5%和22.5%的验证。背景误检、定位误差和重复检测并未按照AG-FPN与Wise-IoU预期的方向改善。消融结果显示，P2/-P5检测头替换单独造成2.5个百分点损失；当其叠加到已被PC-C2f削弱的骨干网络上时，额外产生2.5个百分点交互损失。PC-C2f自身造成2.0个百分点下降，且仅有150个骨干张量中的73个能够完成预训练权重迁移，说明预训练权重不完整迁移可能是性能下降的原因之一。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，检测组件的独立有效性并不能保证组合后的有效性。本文的失败并非四个组件分别都无效，而是主要源于P2检测头替换P5与PC-C2f弱化骨干网络之间的特定交互。因此，面向无人机小目标检测的架构组合必须通过直接实验、交互消融和跨数据集验证来确认，不能仅依据单组件结果推断组合收益。

title: Don't Count the Edits, Judge by the Outcome Alone: Reward-Based Evaluation for Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Grammatical error correction (GEC) evaluation has traditionally relied on reference or edit overlap, which can penalize valid rewrites that differ from gold corrections. Reference-free metrics reduce this dependence, but evaluating whether a fluent output is a valid correction of the source remains challenging. We propose SURE, a source-conditioned reward evaluator trained on within-source preferences spanning minimal-edit and rewrite-oriented corrections. SURE jointly learns an overall reward with criteria-level supervision for grammaticality, faithfulness, and fluency, together with span-level grounding for source-side error resolution. Experiments on SEEDA show that SURE performs competitively against strong baselines, with particular gains on rewrite-style corrections and more disentangled criteria-level diagnostics. Our code is available at https://github.com/hayeonggg/SURE.

AI.tldr: SURE 是一种面向语法错误纠正（GEC）的无参考评估模型。它基于同一源句下不同纠正结果的偏好数据进行训练，同时学习整体质量奖励、语法性/忠实性/流畅性等维度，以及源文本错误修复对应的片段级依据。实验表明，SURE 在 SEEDA 数据集上整体具有竞争力，并尤其适合评估改写型纠正。
AI.motivation: 传统 GEC 评估依赖参考答案或编辑重叠，容易惩罚那些虽然有效但与标准答案表达不同的改写。无参考指标虽减少了对参考答案的依赖，但仍难判断一个流畅输出是否真正纠正了源句错误，尤其是在改写幅度较大的场景下。因此，论文旨在构建一种能够结合源句、区分多个质量维度并支持改写型纠正评估的奖励评估器。
AI.method: 提出 SURE（source-conditioned reward evaluator）。模型以源句为条件，利用同一源句下的偏好关系训练，使其能够比较最小编辑型和改写型纠正结果。训练目标包括：学习整体质量奖励；对语法性、忠实性和流畅性进行标准级监督；通过片段级 grounding 将输出质量与源句中需要修复的错误区域对应起来，从而增强对错误解决情况的判断和可解释性。
AI.result: 在 SEEDA 数据集上的实验显示，SURE 相较强基线具有有竞争力的表现；其在改写风格的纠正结果评估上提升尤其明显。此外，SURE 能提供更加相互区分的标准级诊断，有助于分别分析语法性、忠实性和流畅性。
AI.conclusion: SURE 证明了源句条件建模、同源偏好学习、多维质量监督和片段级错误定位相结合，能够缓解 GEC 无参考评估中的有效改写识别问题。该方法不仅提升了改写型纠正的评估能力，也增强了评估结果的维度化诊断价值，但摘要未提供具体数值、跨数据集泛化结果或消融实验细节。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models for Time-Series Forecasting
summary: We study the adaptation of pretrained language models to univariate time-series forecasting through a parameter-efficient transfer learning framework, with the goal of understanding which design choices drive effective cross-modal transfer. While language models operate on discrete textual tokens, time series consist of continuous numerical observations with temporal dependencies. To bridge this modality gap, we project fixed-length time-series patches directly into the embedding space of a pretrained GPT-2 backbone, bypassing textual tokenization and treating the Transformer as a generic sequence encoder. Through controlled ablation studies on seven benchmark datasets spanning energy, weather, traffic, and finance, we analyze the effects of (i)~representation strategy (continuous embeddings versus textual serialisation), (ii)~adaptation regime (frozen backbone versus partial or full fine-tuning), (iii)~architectural components such as adapters, pooling strategies, and prediction heads, and (iv)~input context length. Continuous patch-based embeddings consistently outperform textual prompting and randomly initialised backbones. The adapted pipeline attains MASE within the range of specialised forecasting architectures while updating less than 1\% of total model parameters. Results further indicate that freezing the pretrained backbone and training lightweight projection and adapter modules provides a favourable accuracy--efficiency trade-off with stable behaviour across varying context lengths.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何将预训练语言模型高效迁移到单变量时间序列预测，通过把定长时间序列片段直接映射到GPT-2嵌入空间，并系统比较表示方式、微调策略、架构组件和上下文长度。结果表明，连续片段嵌入优于文本序列化；冻结主干并训练轻量模块可在更新少于1%参数的情况下取得接近专用预测模型的性能，并实现较好的准确率—效率平衡。
AI.motivation: 语言模型主要处理离散文本标记，而时间序列由连续数值及时间依赖关系构成，二者存在显著模态差异。本文旨在理解预训练语言模型迁移到时间序列预测时，哪些设计选择真正有助于跨模态迁移，并探索一种参数高效、稳定且具有竞争力的适配方案。
AI.method: 以预训练GPT-2为骨干，将固定长度的时间序列片段投影到其嵌入空间，绕过文本分词，并将Transformer作为通用序列编码器。研究采用参数高效迁移学习框架，在七个涵盖能源、天气、交通和金融的基准数据集上进行受控消融实验，比较连续嵌入与文本序列化、冻结/部分/完整微调，以及适配器、池化策略、预测头和输入上下文长度等因素。
AI.result: 连续的基于片段的嵌入稳定优于文本提示方式和随机初始化的骨干网络。该方法的MASE处于专用时间序列预测架构的性能范围内，同时更新的参数少于模型总参数的1%。实验还显示，冻结预训练骨干、仅训练轻量级投影层和适配器，能够在不同上下文长度下保持稳定表现，并获得较优的准确率—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 预训练语言模型可以通过直接的连续数值嵌入实现有效的时间序列适配，而不必将时间序列强行文本化。冻结主干并结合轻量投影与适配模块是一种实用的参数高效方案，但其性能与泛化能力仍主要依赖于片段表示、适配结构及上下文长度等设计选择。

title: A Building as a Repository: KIR, a Typed Intermediate Representation for Agent-Authored Building Information Models
