Our findings establish coordinate-token confidence as a powerful alternative to manual annotations for scalable GUI agent development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需人工标注的GUI grounding测试时训练方法：先利用坐标token置信度筛选伪标签并构造距离奖励，再进一步仅依赖负样本进行优化。CANL-7B在ScreenSpot-V2达到92.1%，在ScreenSpot-Pro达到33.8%，较基础模型提升8.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding需要将自然语言指令映射到屏幕上的精确坐标，但现有监督微调和强化学习方法依赖大量人工标注，成本高、难以扩展。同时，完整序列置信度不能准确反映坐标预测是否可靠，GUI坐标空间稀疏且正样本伪标签可能存在噪声，因此需要一种更稳健、无标注的测试时训练方案。
AI.method: 论文提出两个递进方法。第一，Confidence-Anchored Learning（CAL）利用坐标token的置信度而非完整输出序列的置信度筛选伪标签，并根据预测坐标与目标之间的距离分配二元奖励。第二，Confidence-Anchored Negative Learning（CANL）进一步只使用负样本进行优化，避免错误正样本带来的噪声和错误强化，从而适应稀疏GUI坐标空间。
AI.result: CANL-7B在ScreenSpot-V2上取得92.1%的准确率；在更具挑战性的ScreenSpot-Pro上取得33.8%，相比基础模型绝对提升8.9个百分点。结果表明，坐标token置信度能够有效支持无人工标注的GUI grounding测试时训练。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了坐标token级置信度可以作为人工标注的有效替代信号，并通过负样本学习提升测试时适应能力。CANL为低标注成本、可扩展的GUI智能体开发提供了可行路径，但其性能仍可能受置信度校准、负样本构造方式及不同界面分布变化影响。

title: Hypergraph-Regularized Gramian Volumes for Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Volume-based multimodal retrieval jointly scores a text query with a candidate's video, audio, and subtitle embeddings. While this approach captures higher-order within-candidate alignment, the score remains candidate-local, and semantically related training samples primarily serve as contrastive negatives. This work introduces Hypergraph-Regularized Gramian Volumes (HyVol), a training-time module that incorporates these semantic relations prior to evaluating the original volume loss. Document hyperedges connect the observed modalities of each candidate, whereas semantic hyperedges link candidates whose detached captions are mutual top-k neighbors. A shallow gated hyper-graph network applies residual corrections to the modality embeddings. Presence masks exclude unavailable streams from message passing, and identity padding preserves the determinant of the observed Gram submatrix without feature imputation. As refinement operates on embeddings rather than scores, the same construction applies to both Gram and HyperGram. We remove the hypergraph after training, leaving the backbone-only architecture, original scoring function, and retrieval cost unchanged. We train both backbones on a 150K-clip subset of VAST-27M and evaluate zero-shot performance on six benchmarks. Under the paired protocol, HyVol improves R@1 across all five retrieval benchmarks, with video-to-text gains reaching +8.3 on MSR-VTT and +7.6 on VATEX. Under missing-modality masking, the V2T margin remains positive in all experimental settings, although the T2V margin becomes slightly negative in four.

AI.tldr: HyVol在训练阶段通过文档超边和语义超边建模候选内部模态关系及候选间语义关系，并利用带门控的超图网络修正视频、音频和字幕嵌入；训练完成后移除超图，不改变原有体积评分和推理成本。在VAST-27M子集上训练并进行六个基准的零样本评估，配对协议下五个检索基准的R@1均提升，MSR-VTT和VATEX的视频到文本分别提升8.3和7.6；缺失模态下V2T仍全面获益，但T2V在部分设置略有下降。
AI.motivation: 传统基于体积的多模态检索虽然能捕获候选内部的高阶模态对齐，但评分是候选局部的，训练时语义相关样本主要被当作对比负样本使用，未能利用候选间的语义关系。该工作旨在将这些关系提前注入表示学习，同时保持原始评分函数、模型推理结构和检索开销不变，并增强缺失模态条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出训练时模块HyVol（Hypergraph-Regularized Gramian Volumes）。使用文档超边连接同一候选的可用模态，使用语义超边连接其脱离候选后的字幕表示所对应的互为top-k邻居的候选。通过浅层带门控的超图网络对模态嵌入施加残差修正；存在性掩码避免不可用流参与消息传递，恒等填充保持观测Gram子矩阵的行列式，避免特征插值。修正发生在嵌入层，因此同时适用于Gram和HyperGram；训练结束后移除超图，仅保留原骨干、原评分函数和原检索成本。
AI.result: 在VAST-27M的15万片段子集上训练两个骨干网络，并在六个基准上进行零样本评估。配对协议下，HyVol在五个检索基准上的R@1均有提升；视频到文本检索在MSR-VTT上提升8.3，在VATEX上提升7.6。缺失模态掩码实验中，视频到文本的提升在所有设置下保持为正，而文本到视频在四个设置下略有负提升。
AI.conclusion: HyVol证明了在训练阶段利用候选内模态结构与候选间语义邻域，能够有效改善体积式多模态检索，且不增加部署阶段的架构和计算成本。方法对V2T检索具有稳定收益，但在缺失模态场景下T2V收益不完全稳定，说明方向不对称性和模态缺失鲁棒性仍值得进一步研究。

title: Concept-Grounded Reasoning with Prompt-Driven Localization for Interpretable Structured Report Generation
summary: Medical imaging modalities such as ultrasound and X-ray are widely used in clinical practice, where diagnosis follows a structured, evidence-driven workflow aligned with standardized criteria. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise for automated medical report generation, most existing systems rely on end-to-end multimodal fusion without modeling clinically defined intermediate attributes, leading to limited grounding and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose CORAL (COncept-grounded ReAsoning with Localization), a multimodal framework that integrates spatial grounding and concept-level supervision into a unified reasoning process. CORAL employs a prompt-driven medical segmentation model to localize lesions and predicts multi-class clinical attributes through a Concept Bottleneck module. The resulting textual concept tokens are combined with mask-modulated visual features within an MLLM to enable structured report generation and diagnostic prediction. Experiments on BUS-CoT and IU X-ray datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in diagnostic accuracy, concept consistency, and report quality over strong general-purpose and medical MLLMs, indicating that concept-grounded reasoning better aligns generation with clinical decision processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORAL，一种将病灶空间定位、临床概念预测与多模态大语言模型报告生成统一起来的医学影像推理框架，在BUS-CoT和IU X-ray数据集上提升了诊断准确性、概念一致性和报告质量。
AI.motivation: 现有医学多模态大语言模型多采用端到端多模态融合，缺少临床定义的中间属性建模，导致生成结果的医学依据不足、空间定位能力有限、可解释性较弱，也难以遵循临床诊断中的结构化证据链。因此，论文旨在引入与临床决策流程一致的中间概念和病灶定位机制，使报告生成更加 grounded、可解释且符合诊断标准。
AI.method: 提出CORAL（COncept-grounded ReAsoning with Localization）框架。首先，利用提示驱动的医学分割模型对病灶进行空间定位；其次，通过Concept Bottleneck模块预测多类别临床属性，并将这些属性编码为文本概念标记；随后，将概念标记与由病灶掩码调制的视觉特征共同输入多模态大语言模型，用于结构化医学报告生成和诊断预测。该方法将空间证据与概念级监督整合到统一推理过程中。
AI.result: 在BUS-CoT和IU X-ray数据集上的实验表明，CORAL相较于强大的通用型和医学型多模态大语言模型，在诊断准确性、临床概念一致性以及医学报告质量方面均取得持续改进。摘要未提供具体指标、增益幅度或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果说明，将病灶定位与临床概念级推理结合，能够更好地使多模态模型的生成结果对齐临床决策流程。CORAL为提升医学报告生成的可解释性、证据 grounding 和诊断可靠性提供了一种有效方案。

title: Query-Conditioned Spherical Centroid Aggregation for Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Multimodal retrieval integrates video, audio, subtitles, and text; however, recent geometric aggregators, such as Gramian volumes, hyperbolic volumes, and spectral objectives, treat all modalities symmetrically. Under a unified evaluation protocol, their joint scores frequently lag behind the strongest single-modality pathway by 1.9 to 27.6 R@1. Controlled analyses attribute this outcome to uniform modality influence. This work introduces Spherical Centroid Aggregation with Learned Adaptive Relevance (SCALAR), a query-conditioned aggregator that assigns relevance-based weights to each available modality before computing a spherical centroid. SCALAR accommodates arbitrary modality subsets and is trained on masked, reduced-arity views using rank-8 LoRA adapters. Across five benchmarks, SCALAR achieves positive aggregation gain on four, reaching +4.0 R@1, while none of the evaluated prior aggregators is positive on more than one. A uniform-weight ablation reproduces the degradation observed with symmetric aggregation. With only 4.8 million trainable parameters, SCALAR attains the highest text-to-video R@1 on three and performs within seed variation of the best result on a fourth. Under test-time modality dropout, SCALAR's representation-stage score surpasses the released GRAM checkpoint at every evaluated masking rate and benchmark by 3.2 to 10.9 R@1. Finally, as modalities are removed, rerankers trained exclusively on complete modality sets increasingly converge toward their video-only pathways, diminishing these representation-level gains and underscoring a limitation of standard two-stage retrieval pipelines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SCALAR，一种面向多模态检索的查询条件自适应聚合器：先为视频、音频、字幕和文本等模态学习相关性权重，再计算球面质心。它支持任意模态子集，并通过掩码、降阶训练和秩8 LoRA 提升缺失模态下的鲁棒性。在五个基准上，SCALAR 在四个基准取得正聚合增益，最高提升 +4.0 R@1；在测试时模态丢失场景中，其表示阶段表现全面优于 GRAM，提升 3.2–10.9 R@1。
AI.motivation: 现有 Gramian volume、双曲体积和谱目标等几何聚合方法通常对所有模态施加对称、均匀的影响，但不同查询对各模态的依赖并不相同。统一评测显示，这种均匀模态影响会使多模态联合结果比最佳单模态路径低 1.9–27.6 个 R@1 点。因此，需要一种能够根据查询内容动态判断各模态价值、同时适应任意模态缺失组合的聚合方法。
AI.method: 提出 Spherical Centroid Aggregation with Learned Adaptive Relevance（SCALAR）。该方法首先基于查询学习每个可用模态的相关性权重，然后在球面表示空间中计算加权球面质心。训练时采用模态掩码和降阶视图，使模型直接学习减少模态数量时的表示；参数高效微调通过秩8 LoRA 适配器实现，仅训练约480万参数。论文还比较了统一权重消融、表示阶段检索与二阶段重排，并评估测试时模态随机丢失。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，SCALAR 在四个基准取得正的聚合增益，最高达到 +4.0 R@1；此前评估的聚合器均未在超过一个基准上取得正增益。统一权重消融重新产生了对称聚合的性能下降，验证了自适应模态权重的重要性。SCALAR 在三个基准取得最高文本到视频 R@1，在第四个基准上与最优方法的差异处于随机种子波动范围内。在测试时模态丢失条件下，SCALAR 的表示阶段得分在所有评估掩码率和基准上均超过发布的 GRAM 检查点，提升幅度为 3.2–10.9 R@1。
AI.conclusion: 多模态检索中的关键问题并非简单叠加更多模态，而是根据查询动态分配模态影响。SCALAR 通过学习相关性权重和面向缺失模态的训练，显著改善了聚合质量及模态丢失鲁棒性。结果同时表明，标准“表示检索加重排”两阶段流程存在瓶颈：重排器若只在完整模态集合上训练，随着模态减少会逐渐依赖视频单模态路径，从而削弱表示阶段获得的多模态收益。

title: Robust Multi-Model Fitting through Learning Neighbor Regions
summary: Multi-model fitting involves fitting multiple models accurately in a noisy environment. It is the basis for computer vision tasks such as scene reconstruction and mixed reality. However, its performance is often limited by insufficient feature utilization, inefficient optimization, model overlap, and the non-differentiable pipelines. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a robust coarse-to-fine framework called Learning Neighbor Regions (LNR). Recognizing that substantial computational resources are wasted on numerous bad minimum sets, we propose the coarse-level module. This module utilizes a neural network to extract and analyze geometric feature of both local point-wise relationships and global contextual information in minimum sets, outputting confidence to pre-select a small number of good minimum sets, thereby enhancing overall efficiency before solving hypotheses. To address model overlap, LNR encodes neighbor region features for each hypothesis in its fine-level module. These region features consist of geometric features of neighboring data points, which can be used by multiple regions simultaneously. This design allows the neural network to individually refine and score each hypothesis. Importantly, LNR is trained to learn directly from data point features rather than from the hypothesis parameters, thus avoiding differentiating the sampling process and the model solvers. Extensive experiments on four classic multi-model fitting tasks demonstrate that LNR achieves state-of-the-art performance. The analysis suggests that LNR can be easily adapted to various robust multi-model fitting tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为 Learning Neighbor Regions（LNR）的鲁棒粗到细多模型拟合框架，通过粗粒度候选筛选与细粒度邻域特征编码，提高噪声环境下多模型拟合的效率、精度和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 多模型拟合需要在噪声和外点干扰下同时估计多个模型，是场景重建、混合现实等计算机视觉任务的基础。现有方法受限于特征利用不足、优化效率低、模型重叠以及采样和求解流程不可微等问题；大量计算还被浪费在质量较差的最小集上。
AI.method: LNR采用粗到细的两级框架。粗粒度模块利用神经网络联合分析最小集中的局部点关系和全局上下文信息，预测候选置信度，从而预先筛选少量高质量最小集，再进行模型假设求解。细粒度模块针对每个假设编码其邻域区域特征，即邻近数据点的几何信息，使多个区域能够共享相关特征，并对各个假设进行独立细化和评分。模型直接从数据点特征中学习，而非从假设参数中学习，因此避免对采样过程和模型求解器进行微分。
AI.result: 在四项经典多模型拟合任务上的大量实验表明，LNR取得了当前最优性能。实验和分析还显示，该方法能够有效减少无效候选带来的计算开销，并较好地处理模型重叠问题。
AI.conclusion: LNR通过候选最小集预筛选和邻域区域特征建模，兼顾了计算效率、模型区分能力与训练可行性，缓解了传统多模型拟合中的关键局限。由于其直接基于数据点特征学习且不依赖可微采样或求解器，该框架易于迁移到不同的鲁棒多模型拟合任务中。

title: End-to-End Cell Detection via Instance-aware Graph Modeling
summary: Accurate cell detection and classification are crucial for pathological analysis, directly affecting diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning. To capture complex cellular interactions beyond visual appearance within the tumor microenvironment, several approaches have employed graph neural networks to model spatial and relational patterns among cell nuclei, yielding promising results. However, these methods typically adopt a two-stage paradigm of visual extraction followed by relational modeling, which necessitates separate tuning for each stage, thereby increasing pipeline complexity and hindering end-to-end joint optimization. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end framework for cell detection and classification that jointly models patch-level visual representations and instance-level interactions, which incorporates a dynamic graph construction module and an instance-aware graph network. Specifically, the graph construction module dynamically builds the graph structure using learnable queries derived from patch-level features as cell instance representations, with adjacency defined by integrating feature similarity and spatial distances. The instance-aware graph network performs adaptive instance filtering and feature reorganization, aggregating them over the cell graph into a topological latent state for a selective state-space transition driven by visual cues, fusing appearance and relational evidence. When evaluated on multiple datasets with different staining protocols for cell and nucleus detection, our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both detection and classification performance. The code will be released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/IGM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端的细胞检测与分类框架，通过动态构图和实例感知图网络联合建模图像外观、细胞实例及其空间关系，在多个不同染色协议的数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 细胞检测与分类直接影响病理诊断和治疗规划。现有图神经网络方法通常采用“视觉特征提取—关系建模”的两阶段流程，需要分别调优，流程复杂且难以进行端到端联合优化；同时，单纯依赖细胞外观难以充分刻画肿瘤微环境中的复杂细胞交互关系。因此，需要一种能够统一学习局部视觉表征与实例级空间关系的端到端方法。
AI.method: 提出端到端的细胞检测与分类框架，包含动态图构建模块和实例感知图网络。动态构图模块利用由图像块级特征生成的可学习查询，将其作为细胞实例表示，并结合特征相似度与空间距离定义邻接关系，从而动态构建细胞图。实例感知图网络执行自适应实例筛选与特征重组，将信息聚合为细胞图的拓扑潜在状态，并在视觉线索驱动的选择性状态空间转移中融合外观证据与关系证据，实现联合预测。
AI.result: 在多个采用不同染色协议的细胞和细胞核检测数据集上，该方法在检测性能和分类性能方面均显著优于现有方法，表明其具有较好的跨染色协议适应能力和综合建模效果。摘要未报告具体数据集名称、评价指标或提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，将图像块级视觉信息与实例级细胞关系在统一的端到端框架中联合建模，可以有效提升细胞检测与分类性能。动态构图和实例感知图推理是方法的核心贡献，为病理图像中的细胞级分析提供了更简洁且更具联合优化能力的方案。

title: Diffusion Trajectory Modeling for Semantic Correspondence
summary: Diffusion models generate images through an iterative diffusion process, and recent studies have demonstrated that the intermediate feature maps produced during this process contain rich visual representations, leading to their adoption across a variety of downstream tasks. However, most existing approaches are limited to either using a single feature map at a specific timestep or aggregating feature maps across multiple timesteps. We observe that intermediate representations in the diffusion process form meaningful trajectories along the time axis. In particular, the representation of each spatial patch evolves progressively throughout the generative process, encoding semantics that are difficult to capture from static snapshots alone. This observation motivates the need to treat diffusion representations as temporally structured trajectories rather than static snapshots. To this end, we propose Diffusion Trajectory Modeling (DTM), a framework that interprets the temporal evolution of each spatial patch as a trajectory and leverages it for semantic correspondence. By effectively modeling patch-wise trajectories generated across multiple timesteps, DTM captures correspondence cues that prior methods are not designed to capture. We further demonstrate empirically that spatially corresponding patches form similar trajectory patterns throughout the diffusion process, suggesting that the temporal axis of diffusion carries semantic information. Experiments on SPair-71k, SPair-U and AP-10K show that DTM achieves strong performance, presenting a new perspective for exploiting diffusion representations from a trajectory-centric viewpoint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Diffusion Trajectory Modeling（DTM），将扩散模型多个时间步中每个空间图像块的中间表示视为时序轨迹，而非单个静态特征或简单的多步聚合，并利用这些轨迹进行语义对应。实验表明，空间对应的图像块在扩散过程中具有相似的轨迹模式；在 SPair-71k、SPair-U 和 AP-10K 上取得了较强性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散表示方法通常只使用某个特定时间步的单一特征图，或对多个时间步的特征进行简单聚合，难以刻画表示随生成过程逐步演化所携带的语义信息。本文观察到，每个空间图像块的中间表示沿时间轴形成具有意义的演化轨迹，且对应区域的轨迹模式相似，因此需要一种面向轨迹的建模方式来提取静态特征难以捕捉的语义对应线索。
AI.method: 提出 Diffusion Trajectory Modeling（DTM）框架。该方法以空间图像块为基本单位，收集其在多个扩散时间步产生的中间表示，并将这些表示组织为 patch-wise temporal trajectories。随后对轨迹进行建模，用于图像间的语义对应匹配，从而利用扩散过程中的时序结构信息，而不是依赖单个时间步或无结构的特征聚合。
AI.result: 在 SPair-71k、SPair-U 和 AP-10K 三个语义对应基准上，DTM 均表现出较强的实验性能。结果还验证了核心观察：空间上语义对应的图像块在扩散时间轴上呈现相似的轨迹模式，说明扩散表示的时间维度确实包含有用的语义信息。摘要未给出具体数值、对比方法或统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: DTM 从轨迹中心视角重新利用扩散模型中间表示，将扩散过程的时间演化视为语义对应的重要信息来源。该工作说明，扩散表示不应仅被看作静态特征快照或简单时间聚合结果，patch 级时序轨迹能够提供额外的对应线索，并为扩散表示在下游视觉任务中的应用提供了新的建模方向。

title: CapsuleMotion: A Lightweight Real-Time Visual Motion Predictor for Capsule Endoscopy
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, accepted at the 22nd Annual International Conference on Body Sensor Networks (BSN2026)
summary: Video Capsule Endoscopy (VCE) is a non-invasive medical examination that allows for the observation of the small intestine, which is otherwise difficult to access. A fundamental challenge persists in the form of their limited size in order to still be swallowable. The resulting restricted battery capacity, however, contradicts with the power-intensive nature of image capture and transmission. Therefore, we propose CapsuleMotion, a patient-specific dynamic capsule behavior that utilizes the available energy in a goal-oriented manner to increase the likelihood of a complete screening of the gastrointestinal tract. By investigating and combining metrics from the on-device image compression, CapsuleMotion predicts the motion between two successive frames. The camera's frame rate will be modified in accordance with the predicted magnitude of motion. Furthermore, prior to entering the small intestine, the capsule operates in a low power mode with a significantly reduced frame rate. In this mode, the LocalizationNet is employed to determine the current organ, provided that motion was predicted. The proposed framework is evaluated on the Rhode Island VCE dataset and deployed on an ultra-low power single-core RISC-V demonstrator with an integrated hardware accelerator. CapsuleMotion demonstrated the capability to reduce electric energy consumption by up to 20.66% in comparison with conventional capsules that lack a dynamic frame rate. Additionally, the accuracy of detecting the entry point of the small intestine has been improved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CapsuleMotion，一种面向患者个体的动态胶囊内镜控制框架，通过预测连续帧间运动，自适应调节相机帧率，并在进入小肠前采用低功耗模式，以降低能耗并提高完整胃肠道筛查的可能性。实验显示，能耗最高降低20.66%，且小肠入口检测准确率得到提升。
AI.motivation: 视频胶囊内镜需要在可吞咽的小尺寸内集成有限容量电池，但图像采集与无线传输功耗较高，导致续航不足，可能无法完成整个胃肠道检查。因此，需要根据胶囊运动状态和检查阶段动态分配能量，在保证有效观测的同时降低不必要的采集功耗。
AI.method: CapsuleMotion利用设备端图像压缩相关指标预测相邻视频帧之间的运动幅度，并依据预测结果动态调整相机帧率：运动较大时提高采样能力，运动较小时降低帧率。此外，在进入小肠前让胶囊进入显著降低帧率的低功耗模式，并在检测到运动时调用LocalizationNet判断当前器官。该框架在Rhode Island VCE数据集上评估，并部署到集成硬件加速器的超低功耗单核RISC-V演示平台上。
AI.result: 与不具备动态帧率调节能力的传统胶囊相比，CapsuleMotion最多可降低20.66%的电能消耗；同时，小肠入口检测准确率有所提高。结果表明，该方法能够在降低能耗的同时改善关键解剖位置的识别。
AI.conclusion: 通过将运动感知、动态帧率控制和分阶段低功耗策略结合起来，CapsuleMotion有效缓解了胶囊内镜电池容量有限与图像采集功耗高之间的矛盾。该方法有望提高完整胃肠道筛查的成功概率，但摘要未说明其对整体诊断准确率、实时性开销及不同患者运动模式下鲁棒性的影响。

title: BSC-Net: A Small-Branch-Sensitive Structural Continuity Network for Coronary Vessel Segmentation and Quantitative Angiographic Analysis
summary: Vessel segmentation in X-ray coronary angiography (XCA) is a fundamental step for quantitative coronary analysis and subsequent assessment of coronary artery disease. However, accurate vessel segmentation remains challenging because of imaging noise, complex bifurcations, and the overlap of vessels and background structures, which can lead to disrupted vascular connectivity and missed small branches. In this work, we propose BSC-Net, a ResNet-U-Net-based framework tailored to improve small-vessel representation and repair vascular structural continuity. BSC-Net enhances small-vessel representation through targeted sampling and improves vascular structural continuity by integrating long-range contextual modeling and Edge-Informed Loss (EIL). BSC-Net was validated on two public XCA datasets, demonstrating state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in coronary vessel segmentation with Dice and IoU scores of 77.8%/90.6% and 64.5%/83.0%, respectively. Furthermore, based on the obtained vessel segmentation, we performed automated quantitative coronary analysis and derived clinically relevant morphological and hemodynamic parameters, including stenosis ratio, time-to-peak, and relative propagation velocity. These results demonstrate that BSC-Net produces accurate vessel segmentation results with preserved vascular continuity for quantitative coronary assessment, enabling reliable downstream analysis and clinical evaluation of coronary artery disease.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BSC-Net，一种基于ResNet-U-Net的X射线冠状动脉造影血管分割框架，通过定向采样增强小血管表征，并结合长程上下文建模与边缘感知损失（EIL）修复血管结构连续性。在两个公开数据集上取得先进性能，并支持狭窄率、达峰时间和相对传播速度等定量冠脉分析指标的自动计算。
AI.motivation: XCA血管分割是定量冠脉分析和冠状动脉疾病评估的基础，但成像噪声、复杂分叉、血管与背景结构重叠等因素会造成血管连通性中断及小分支漏检。现有方法需要进一步提升小血管识别能力和血管拓扑结构保持能力。
AI.method: BSC-Net采用ResNet-U-Net作为主体框架。方法一通过定向采样增强小血管特征表示；方法二引入长程上下文建模以捕获更大范围的血管结构信息；方法三设计边缘感知损失（Edge-Informed Loss, EIL），强化血管边界学习并改善结构连续性。模型在两个公开XCA数据集上进行验证，并基于分割结果开展自动化定量冠脉分析。
AI.result: 在两个公开XCA数据集上，BSC-Net取得了具有竞争力的SOTA结果。摘要报告的Dice/IoU指标分别为77.8%/90.6%和64.5%/83.0%。此外，模型分割结果可用于计算狭窄率、达峰时间和相对传播速度等形态学与血流动力学相关参数。
AI.conclusion: BSC-Net能够在XCA图像中提高血管分割精度，尤其有助于小血管表征和血管连续性保持，并为后续定量冠脉分析提供可靠基础。该方法具有辅助冠状动脉疾病评估和临床量化分析的潜力，但摘要未提供与各基线方法的具体比较、统计显著性、外部验证及临床应用限制。

title: ViCo-SAM3: Vision-Conditioned Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Camouflaged Object Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary camouflaged object segmentation (OVCOS) aims to segment unseen camouflaged objects under text guidance. We observe that SAM3 still suffers from a pronounced semantic gap between global textual semantics and fine-grained pixel-level visual cues in OVCOS. Meanwhile, fully fine-tuning the text encoder introduces heavy parameter overhead and risks overfitting to training categories, which compromises open-vocabulary representation flexibility. To address these issues, we propose ViCo-SAM3, a Vision-Conditioned alignment framework designed for OVCOS. Specifically, we introduce vision-conditioned (ViCo) module, which dynamically modulates text embeddings with global visual context, enabling textual representations to adapt to the current image content and thereby effectively bridging the semantic gap between vision and text. Building on this, we further design a vision-conditioned cross-modal binding (ViCoBind) module to enhance cross-modal interaction and semantic alignment between visual and textual representations. Without bells and whistles, ViCo-SAM3 achieves state-of-the-art performance on the OVCamo benchmark and demonstrates strong generalization.

AI.tldr: ViCo-SAM3 是一种面向开放词汇伪装目标分割的视觉条件跨模态对齐框架，通过视觉上下文调制文本嵌入，并增强视觉—文本交互，在不微调整个文本编码器的情况下弥合全局语义与像素级线索之间的差距；论文报告其在 OVCamo 基准上取得当前最佳性能并具备较强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇伪装目标分割需要依据文本提示分割训练类别之外的伪装目标，但 SAM3 中全局文本语义与细粒度像素视觉线索之间存在明显语义鸿沟。同时，完全微调文本编码器会带来较高参数开销，并可能对训练类别过拟合，从而削弱开放词汇表示的灵活性。因此，需要一种参数高效且能利用当前图像内容动态调整文本语义的对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出 ViCo-SAM3 框架。首先设计视觉条件模块（ViCo），利用全局视觉上下文动态调制文本嵌入，使文本表示能够适应当前图像内容，缩小视觉与文本之间的语义差距。随后设计视觉条件跨模态绑定模块（ViCoBind），加强视觉和文本表示之间的跨模态交互与语义对齐。整体方法避免对文本编码器进行完全微调。
AI.result: 论文摘要声称，ViCo-SAM3 在 OVCamo 基准上取得了当前最优性能，并表现出较强的泛化能力；同时，方法在无需复杂附加设计的情况下实现了有效改进。摘要未提供具体数据集划分、指标数值、参数量或相对基线提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: ViCo-SAM3 通过视觉条件化文本表示和跨模态绑定，有效缓解了开放词汇伪装目标分割中的语义对齐问题，并在保持开放词汇表示灵活性的同时获得了较强性能。该方法说明利用图像内容动态调整文本语义，是提升 OVCOS 泛化能力和细粒度分割效果的有效方向。

title: A Conservative OCR-Enabled Workflow for R214 Sodium Screening of South African Packaged Foods
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 10th IEEE ICTAS 2026; to appear in the conference proceedings. 7 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables
summary: Using food package images to monitor sodium and salt content against South Africa's R214 sodium limits is challenging when screening decisions require product identity, nutrition facts panel evidence, reporting basis, and category-specific thresholds. This study presents a conservative image-based workflow that combines region detection, optical character recognition (OCR), product identity and sodium evidence extraction, R214 category assignment, deterministic threshold comparison, and independent vision language model comparison. The evaluation used 442 packaged food products and 3 929 full package images from a real-world South African food packaging dataset. A YOLO26s small detector generated 4 195 region crops, and strict post-processing produced one sodium evidence row per product. The integrated workflow produced 290 OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE, 139 REVIEW, seven SCREEN-PASS, and six SCREEN-FAIL outcomes. The independent Qwen2.5-VL 7B vision language model workflow produced 387 OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE, 31 REVIEW, twenty SCREEN-PASS, and four SCREEN-FAIL outcomes. The workflows agreed on exact R214 category assignment for 415 of 442 products (93.9%) and on whether the assigned category was within R214 scope for 416 of 442 products (94.1%). Final screening outcome agreement was 307 out of 442 products, or 69.5%. Manual verification on 60 products showed lower strict outcome agreement than regulated status agreement, while all manual INSUFFICIENT DATA cases were kept out of SCREEN-PASS and SCREEN-FAIL by both automated workflows. The findings show that conservative image-based screening can organise package evidence, identify clear cases, and assign uncertain cases to REVIEW rather than forcing SCREEN-PASS or SCREEN-FAIL decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一套面向南非R214钠含量法规筛查的保守型图像分析工作流，整合目标区域检测、OCR、产品与钠证据提取、法规类别判定、确定性阈值比较及视觉语言模型交叉比较。在442个产品上，主工作流将大多数样本判为不在法规范围或需复核；与独立视觉语言模型在法规类别和适用范围上的一致性较高，但最终筛查结果一致性仅为69.5%。研究表明，图像筛查适合组织证据、识别明确案例和转交不确定案例复核，不宜替代人工或监管裁决。
AI.motivation: 南非R214钠限值的包装筛查不仅需要读取营养成分表，还必须确认产品身份、钠含量证据、报告基准及产品类别对应的法规阈值。真实包装图像存在视角、版面、OCR和信息缺失等问题，若自动系统强行输出合格或不合格，容易产生监管误判。因此，研究动机是构建一种能够保守处理不确定性、支持大规模初筛并保留可审计证据的图像分析流程。
AI.method: 研究使用442种包装食品、3929张完整包装图像。首先利用YOLO26s小型目标检测器生成4195个区域裁剪，再通过OCR和严格后处理提取产品身份及钠含量证据，并为每个产品生成一条钠证据记录。随后依据R214进行产品类别分配和范围判断，采用确定性阈值比较，将结果划分为OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE、REVIEW、SCREEN-PASS和SCREEN-FAIL。同时使用独立的Qwen2.5-VL 7B视觉语言模型流程进行对照，并在60个产品上开展人工验证。
AI.result: 主工作流输出290个OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE、139个REVIEW、7个SCREEN-PASS和6个SCREEN-FAIL；Qwen2.5-VL流程分别输出387、31、20和4个。两种流程在R214具体类别上的一致率为93.9%（415/442），在类别是否属于R214范围上的一致率为94.1%（416/442），但最终筛查结果完全一致率仅为69.5%（307/442），说明类别和法规适用性判断较稳定，而严格的最终状态判断更易受到证据提取、报告基准及不确定性处理影响。人工验证显示，严格结果一致性低于法规状态一致性；所有人工判定为INSUFFICIENT DATA的样本均未被自动流程错误地判为SCREEN-PASS或SCREEN-FAIL。
AI.conclusion: 图像驱动的保守筛查能够有效整理包装证据、识别明确案例并将证据不足或冲突样本转入REVIEW，从而降低自动化强判定的风险。其主要价值在于监管初筛和人工审核优先级排序，而不是完全替代人工核验。研究同时表明，应重点改进营养信息读取、报告基准识别、证据关联和最终状态决策，并使用人工复核处理SCREEN-PASS、SCREEN-FAIL及关键不确定案例。

title: AnchorGUI: Asymmetric Memory for Dual-Scale Learning in GUI Navigation
comment: Published in ECCV 2026. 41 pages including supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable autonomous GUI navigation, but agents still struggle to process and learn from dense, continuous visual histories. This bottleneck hinders both immediate error correction within a single episode (intra-trial) and experience distillation across multiple attempts (cross-trial). We trace these challenges to an empirical informational asymmetry in GUI navigation: while expected transitions can often be compressed into lightweight textual summaries, unexpected outcomes benefit from preserved screenshots as causal evidence for accurate diagnosis. Building on this insight, we propose AnchorGUI, a unified framework driven by the Cognitive State Anchor (CSA). The CSA acts as a per-step primitive that actively compares expected and observed transitions, converting passive multimodal trajectories into explicit prediction-error signals. These signals orchestrate a dual-scale learning mechanism via an asymmetric memory. For intra-trial correction, a sliding window selectively retains visual evidence for detected mismatches, providing immediate, visually-grounded feedback. For cross-trial distillation, this asymmetric memory focuses the computationally expensive credit assignment search space on likely failure steps. Experiments across four benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our approach. On AndroidWorld, AnchorGUI achieves a 57.3% success rate with a $2.4\times$ token reduction per step. Furthermore, cross-trial distillation reaches 69.2% success (+11.9% gain), significantly outperforming standard reflection methods while maintaining sub-linear context scaling.

AI.tldr: AnchorGUI提出认知状态锚（CSA）与非对称记忆机制，用于高效处理GUI导航中的连续视觉历史，同时支持单次任务内纠错和跨多次尝试的经验蒸馏。其核心发现是：预期转移可压缩为文本，而异常结果需要保留截图作为因果证据。实验表明，该方法在AndroidWorld上达到57.3%的成功率，并将每步token开销降低2.4倍；跨试次蒸馏成功率达到69.2%，较基线提升11.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽然能够执行自主GUI导航，但难以有效处理密集且连续的视觉历史。这一问题同时限制了单次交互中的即时错误修正，以及多次尝试之间的经验总结与迁移。论文进一步观察到GUI导航存在信息不对称：正常、可预期的状态转移通常可以压缩为文本，而意外结果则需要保留截图，才能提供可靠的因果诊断证据。因此，需要一种既能降低上下文成本、又能在关键异常处保留视觉信息的统一机制。
AI.method: 论文提出AnchorGUI框架，其核心是认知状态锚（Cognitive State Anchor, CSA）。CSA作为逐步处理单元，主动比较预期转移与实际观测转移，将被动的多模态轨迹转化为显式的预测误差信号。框架采用非对称记忆实现双尺度学习：在单次任务内，通过滑动窗口仅保留检测到状态不匹配位置的视觉证据，从而提供即时且视觉支撑的反馈；在跨次任务学习中，利用这些误差信号将代价高昂的信用分配搜索集中到潜在失败步骤，减少无关历史的计算。
AI.result: 在四个基准上的实验验证了方法有效性。AndroidWorld上，AnchorGUI取得57.3%的成功率，并将每步token消耗降低至基线的约1/2.4，即实现2.4倍token效率提升。跨试次经验蒸馏的成功率达到69.2%，较标准反思方法提升11.9个百分点，同时保持子线性上下文扩展特性。
AI.conclusion: AnchorGUI通过显式建模预测误差，并对正常状态与异常状态采用不同的信息保留策略，解决了GUI导航中视觉历史过长、错误诊断困难和经验蒸馏成本高的问题。结果表明，选择性保留视觉因果证据能够在降低上下文开销的同时提升任务成功率和跨试次学习效果。不过，摘要未说明四个基准的具体构成、基线设置、统计显著性及不同模块的消融结果，这些信息仍需查阅全文确认。

title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
summary: Multimodal agents can create complex videos in software such as Blender by coding without relying on diffusion models. Yet video understanding benchmarks still evaluate models mainly through question answering. If an agent truly understands a video, it can reconstruct it programmatically. We introduce BVB, Blender-VideoBench, a benchmark that tests this ability by asking agents to reconstruct real-world videos as animated Blender scenes. To ensure fair comparison, each agent programs the reconstruction through a lightweight harness, Mini-BVB, in an identical sandbox under a shared cost limit. The benchmark renders each reconstruction from its animated camera and evaluates it on two axes: (1) Dual VQA measures how many spatiotemporal facts the reconstruction preserves. (2) Latent Similarity measures how closely the reconstruction matches the source video perceptually. Our overall score, a square-root mean, favors balanced performance. We evaluate 51 configurations from 10 model families and analyze semantic retention, perceptual similarity, reasoning effort, and cost. The best model reaches 88.6 Latent Similarity but retains only 53.7% of the source-correct spatiotemporal answers. Additional reasoning improves visual similarity but does not close this gap in factual accuracy. In a blind study with 15 raters and five configurations, Latent Similarity correlates strongly with human preference. These results show that programmatic reconstruction is a viable test of agentic video understanding, and that semantic retention remains the main challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Blender-VideoBench（BVB），通过要求多模态智能体把真实视频重建为可编程的 Blender 动画场景，系统评估其视频理解能力。结果表明，模型能较好复现整体视觉外观，但对精确的时空事实保留不足；程序化重建因此可作为视频理解的新型评测方式。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准主要采用问答形式，难以充分检验智能体是否真正理解视频中的对象、动作、空间关系和时间变化。若智能体具备深入理解能力，应能够依据视频内容编程重建出相应的动画场景。因此，本文旨在建立一种更具生成性、可验证性和综合性的评测框架。
AI.method: 提出 BVB 基准及其轻量化执行环境 Mini-BVB。每个智能体在统一沙箱和共享成本预算下，通过编程在 Blender 中重建真实世界视频，并由动画相机渲染重建结果。评测包含两个维度：Dual VQA 衡量重建场景保留源视频时空事实的程度；Latent Similarity 衡量重建视频与原视频的感知相似度。最终使用平方根均值整合两项指标，以惩罚不均衡表现。实验覆盖 10 个模型家族的 51 种配置，并进一步分析语义保留、感知相似度、推理投入和成本；此外通过 15 名评审者、5 种配置进行盲测。
AI.result: 最佳模型的 Latent Similarity 达到 88.6，但仅保留了源视频中 53.7% 的正确时空问答事实，说明视觉外观相似与事实准确性之间存在明显差距。增加额外推理通常能够提升感知相似度，却无法弥补语义和时空事实保留方面的不足。盲测结果显示，Latent Similarity 与人类偏好具有较强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 程序化视频重建是一种可行的视频理解评测范式，能够超越单纯问答，检验智能体能否将视频内容转化为结构化、可执行的场景程序。当前主要瓶颈不是生成视觉上相似的结果，而是准确保留视频中的细粒度语义及时空事实。未来应重点提升模型的时序推理、关系建模和事实一致性。

title: CatchMonitor: a machine learning system for automated fish discard quantification
summary: We report on the continued development of CatchMonitor, resulting in a prototype computer vision system designed to automatically quantify discarded fish from video footage collected from Remote Electronic Monitoring (REM) systems on fishing trawlers. The analysis of trawler surveillance footage is a challenging problem due to the real-world conditions on board fishing vessels. Building on our prior work we improve the accuracy of species identification through the application of semi-supervised learning. We utilise a simple and robust object tracking approach, upon which we build our prototype discard quantification system. Finally we analyse the variability of manual discard quantification performed by multiple expert human analysts, using it as a benchmark against which we compare the performance of our system.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 CatchMonitor 原型系统，利用拖网渔船远程电子监测视频，通过半监督学习、目标跟踪和计算机视觉自动识别并量化被丢弃鱼类，并以多名专家的人工量化结果作为基准评估系统表现。
AI.motivation: 拖网渔船上的远程电子监测视频受船上复杂真实环境影响，人工分析耗时且不同专家之间可能存在量化差异，因此需要一种准确、稳健且可自动化的弃鱼识别与数量估计方法。
AI.method: 在既有 CatchMonitor 工作基础上，采用半监督学习提升鱼类物种识别准确率；使用简单且稳健的目标跟踪方法持续关联视频中的鱼体；构建弃鱼自动量化原型系统；同时分析多名专家进行人工弃鱼量化时的变异性，并将其作为系统评估基准。
AI.result: 研究形成了一个面向远程电子监测视频的计算机视觉弃鱼量化原型，并改进了物种识别能力。研究还获得了专家人工量化结果及其相互差异，为比较自动系统性能提供了参照。摘要未给出具体准确率、误差或统计显著性数据。
AI.conclusion: CatchMonitor 展示了利用计算机视觉自动分析拖网渔船弃鱼视频的可行性。半监督学习和目标跟踪增强了系统的实用性，而将专家间差异纳入基准评估，有助于更客观地判断自动量化系统的性能。

title: SyntheticDoc: A Large Synthetic Dataset for Document Unwarping and Illumination Correction
comment: D. Woortmann and T. Magne -- Equal contribution. Accepted at ECCV 2026 (Spotlight). 20 pages
summary: Deep learning models have become the standard tool for document rectification and illumination correction, yet their performance is fundamentally bound by their training data. For nearly a decade, the community has heavily relied on Doc3D, a pioneering but increasingly limited document unwarping dataset in terms of scale and quality. To address this bottleneck, we introduce SyntheticDoc, a massive, high-quality dataset designed to push the boundaries of document unwarping. SyntheticDoc is composed of 1,000,000 high-resolution procedurally generated training samples, alongside extensive validation and test sets. Each sample is paired with rich, pixel-perfect annotations, including UV maps, normal maps, albedo and shading. To ensure physical accuracy and photorealism, the paper geometries are generated via a physics-based simulator and rendered using a path tracer. To demonstrate the benefit of our dataset, we train a simple baseline model on SyntheticDoc and report on its performance in comparison to state-of-the-art methods on both document unwarping and illumination correction tasks. Our dataset is available at https://igl.ethz.ch/projects/SyntheticDoc/ and the code used to generate it at https://github.com/tanguymagne/SyntheticDoc .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SyntheticDoc，一个面向文档去扭曲与光照校正的大规模高质量合成数据集，包含100万张高分辨率训练样本及丰富的像素级标注，并通过基线实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法的性能高度依赖训练数据。社区长期依赖 Doc3D，但该数据集在规模、质量和标注丰富度方面逐渐成为瓶颈，限制了文档去扭曲与光照校正任务的进一步发展。因此，作者希望构建一个规模更大、物理真实性更强、标注更完整的新数据集。
AI.method: 作者构建 SyntheticDoc 数据集：通过基于物理的模拟器生成文档几何形变，使用路径追踪器进行高真实感渲染；数据集包含100万张高分辨率训练样本，以及大规模验证集和测试集。每个样本提供像素级精确的 UV 图、法线图、反照率图和阴影图等标注。随后，作者使用一个简单的基线模型进行训练，并将其与现有先进方法在文档去扭曲和光照校正任务上的表现进行比较。
AI.result: 摘要指出，基于 SyntheticDoc 训练的简单基线模型在文档去扭曲和光照校正任务上展现出竞争力，并用于证明新数据集的价值。不过，摘要没有给出具体的定量指标、数据集划分规模或相对于各方法的详细提升幅度。数据集与生成代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: SyntheticDoc 通过大规模、高分辨率、物理真实渲染和丰富像素级标注，缓解了现有文档去扭曲数据集规模与质量不足的问题。研究结果表明，高质量合成数据能够有效提升相关任务的模型性能，并为后续研究提供可复现的数据和生成工具。

title: Assessing nnU-Net Generalization across Brain Tumor Populations in BraTS-GoAT 2026
summary: BraTS-GoAT evaluates tumor segmentation across heterogeneous populations. We trained a conventional 3D nnU-Net on 1,351 labeled cases using five-fold cross-validation and 1,000 epochs per fold. The final predictor averaged all folds and applied test-time mirroring. On pooled official validation, global DSC values were 0.7805, 0.8288, and 0.8854 for enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT). Under matched fold-0 inference, mean regional Dice decreased from 0.9058 on source out-of-fold (OOF) cases to 0.8310 on pooled validation (difference--0.0747). Mirroring gave small single-fold gains but no clear ensemble benefit; a residual-encoder alternative reached 0.8282 mean Dice. In labeled OOF predictions, failure cases had substantially smaller reference ET volumes; after adjustment for ET and WT volume, lower Dice remained associated with more disconnected ET components and a smaller fraction of ET contained in the largest component.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了常规3D nnU-Net在BraTS-GoAT异质人群肿瘤分割中的泛化能力。模型在官方验证集上的ET、TC和WT全局DSC分别为0.7805、0.8288和0.8854；相较源域OOF结果，跨数据分布验证性能明显下降。失败主要与较小的增强肿瘤体积、更多不连通病灶组件以及最大连通组件占比更低有关。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是评估脑肿瘤分割模型从训练来源数据迁移到异质人群和官方验证数据时的性能变化，并识别影响分割失败的解剖或形态学因素。仅报告源域交叉验证结果可能高估模型的真实泛化能力，因此需要比较源域OOF与外部或 pooled validation 表现。
AI.method: 使用1,351例标注病例训练常规3D nnU-Net，采用五折交叉验证，每折训练1,000个epoch。最终预测器对所有折的结果进行集成，并采用测试时镜像增强。研究比较了源域OOF、官方 pooled validation 和匹配fold-0推理结果，同时评估测试时镜像及残差编码器替代模型的影响。针对失败案例，进一步在调整增强肿瘤（ET）和全肿瘤（WT）体积后，分析ET连通组件数量及最大连通组件占比与Dice的关系。
AI.result: 官方验证集的全局DSC为：ET 0.7805、TC 0.8288、WT 0.8854。匹配fold-0推理中，平均区域Dice由源域OOF的0.9058下降至pooled validation的0.8310，差值为-0.0747，说明存在明显的跨分布性能下降。测试时镜像在单折模型上仅带来小幅提升，对集成模型没有明确收益；残差编码器模型的平均Dice为0.8282，未显示出明显优势。失败病例的参考ET体积显著更小；在控制ET和WT体积后，较低Dice仍与更多不连通的ET组件及较低的最大ET连通组件占比相关。
AI.conclusion: 常规3D nnU-Net在源域数据上表现较好，但在异质验证人群中出现显著泛化损失，提示交叉验证性能不能充分代表真实部署效果。简单的测试时镜像或残差编码器替换并未有效解决该问题。分割困难不仅由肿瘤体积较小导致，也与增强肿瘤的碎片化和空间不连通性密切相关；未来应重点提升对小体积、非连通ET病灶的鲁棒性，并加强跨域验证。

title: PIVOT: Physics-Grounded Verification for AI-Generated Audio-Video Detection
summary: As generative models continue to advance, AI-generated content (AIGC) is becoming increasingly realistic, weakening the artifact cues commonly exploited by existing detectors. Nevertheless, faithfully reproducing the physical behavior of real-world events remains challenging for current generators. We therefore explore detecting AIGC by assessing whether the depicted event satisfies measurable constraints derived from physical laws. We introduce PIVOT, a physics-grounded AIGC detector, instantiated here for audio-video clips, that estimates physical quantities from video and audio, selects physical laws relevant to each clip, and verifies their measurable constraints. Beyond a real/fake decision, PIVOT returns supporting evidence that records the verification outcome, relevant time window, and supporting quantities for each applicable law. Although instantiated and evaluated here on audio-video data, the framework can, in principle, extend to other AIGC modalities whenever the physical quantities required for verification can be estimated reliably. We also introduce PhysForensics-Bench, comprising paired real and generated audio-video clips from nine event-centric scene families and two recent audio-video generators. On PhysForensics-Bench, PIVOT achieves 70.30% accuracy and 64.29% F1 score on Real+Seedance, and 72.16% accuracy and 65.82% F1 on Real+VEO. In comparison, direct inspection with Gemini 3.1 Pro obtains 53.96% accuracy and 60.09% F1 on Real+Seedance, and 57.22% accuracy and 63.44% F1 on Real+Veo. These results demonstrate the practical promise of physical-consistency verification as a structured and inspectable source of evidence that complements artifact-based AIGC detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIVOT，一种基于物理一致性验证的音视频AIGC检测框架。该方法从音频和视频中估计物理量，选择适用的物理定律并检验其可测约束，同时输出可审计的证据。作者还构建了PhysForensics-Bench数据集。实验表明，PIVOT在两种真实/生成数据设置下优于Gemini 3.1 Pro的直接视觉检查，但整体性能仍处于中等水平，说明物理一致性是有潜力的辅助检测信号。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC检测器主要依赖生成伪影，但随着生成模型质量提升，这些伪影逐渐减弱。相比之下，生成模型仍难以准确复现真实事件中的物理行为。因此，本文希望利用可测量的物理规律约束，提供比表面伪影更稳健、可解释、可审计的检测依据。
AI.method: 提出PIVOT框架，面向音视频片段执行三步处理：1）从视频和音频估计相关物理量；2）针对片段内容选择适用的物理定律；3）验证这些定律对应的可测约束是否成立。除输出真实/生成二分类结果外，还记录每条适用定律的验证结果、相关时间窗口及支持性物理量。作者进一步构建PhysForensics-Bench，包含九类事件中心场景的真实-生成配对音视频，以及两种近期音视频生成器产生的样本。
AI.result: 在Real+Seedance设置下，PIVOT取得70.30%的准确率和64.29%的F1；在Real+VEO设置下取得72.16%的准确率和65.82%的F1。Gemini 3.1 Pro直接检查分别取得53.96%准确率/60.09% F1，以及57.22%准确率/63.44% F1。PIVOT在准确率和F1上总体优于基线，显示物理一致性验证具有实际价值。
AI.conclusion: 物理规律约束可以作为结构化、可检查的AIGC检测证据，并有效补充传统伪影检测。PIVOT具有向其他模态扩展的潜力，但前提是能够可靠估计验证所需的物理量。根据当前结果，其性能尚未达到完全可靠的鉴别水平，未来仍需提升物理量估计、定律选择和跨生成器泛化能力。

title: What a gated sensing pipeline never looks at: bandwidth reduction and the misses behind it
comment: 13 pages, 6 tables, no figures. Reports a superseded detection result alongside the corrected run that replaces it; Table 6 carries every scored run of every staged flight
summary: An airborne sensor on a contested link cannot send video, so the appealing move is to send findings instead and report the ratio between the two. We evaluate a gated sensing pipeline that does this, combining learned object detection and image-text comparison with deterministic scheduling, gating, evidence accumulation and transmission rules. On staged footage with the semantic stage live it sends 38,736 bits over 211 s, a reduction of 41,977x, and names 1 of 4 staged events with no false report. That detection has since been superseded: a correction to how the tracker measures speed removed the measurement artefact the normality model had been learning from, and the flight no longer warms. Under the corrected code the pipeline names 1 of 7 staged events across four flights, and we report both. On a control flight where nothing was staged it reports nothing, a reduction of 155,830x: the largest number in the study and the least informative, because a reduction ratio measures the scene. The mechanisms that produce the reduction also decide which observations ever reach a decision, so the two cannot be reported apart. We give a tick-level trace of one flight (3,187 rows) that places each of three missed events at the stage where it stopped progressing: one produced no track, one failed the structural place test at 0.129, and one passed 539 structural ticks but reached only 3.192 against a boundary of 3.807. We also report one instance of a known failure mode, an online normality model absorbing the object it will later judge, measured against the threshold that object then failed. The evidence is one detection and six misses across four staged flights, beside one clean control, and we treat it as a case study. We give the reproduction protocol and generated results, identify which supporting artifacts are not distributed, and state which experiments did not run.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项以案例研究为定位的系统评估：在受限通信条件下，空中传感器通过“检测—语义比较—门控—证据累积—传输”流水线，仅发送事件结论而非视频。结果显示通信量可大幅下降，但检测性能很弱且受代码修正影响显著；通信压缩率与信息价值不能分开解释。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是解决空中传感器在通信受限或链路不可靠时难以传输视频的问题，探索用事件发现和文本化结论替代原始视频，并同时评估压缩通信量与事件识别能力。作者还希望揭示门控和调度机制如何影响哪些观测能够进入最终决策，以及修正实现错误后系统性能是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 构建并评估一个门控感知流水线，结合学习式目标检测、图像—文本比较、确定性调度、结构位置测试、证据累积、传输规则和在线正常性模型。在多次人工布置事件的飞行中记录逐tick执行轨迹，分析事件在流水线中的停止位置；同时进行一次无事件控制飞行。作者区分语义阶段在线时的旧结果与速度测量修正后的结果，并提供复现流程、生成结果、未分发的支撑材料及未执行的实验说明。
AI.result: 旧检测结果为211秒传输38,736比特，通信量减少41,977倍，并在4个布置事件中正确报告1个且无误报。修正跟踪器速度测量伪影后，跨4次飞行仅报告7个布置事件中的1个。无事件控制飞行没有报告任何内容，得到155,830倍的压缩率，但该数字主要反映场景而非系统信息能力。3个漏检事件分别因未生成轨迹、结构位置测试得分0.129未通过、以及证据累积达到3.192但低于3.807阈值而停止。另发现在线正常性模型吸收了其后需要判断的对象，构成已知失效模式。总体证据为4次布置飞行中的1次检测和6次漏检，另加1次干净控制飞行。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明了在特定场景下可实现极高通信压缩，但目前检测可靠性不足，且压缩率必须与门控机制、场景内容和漏检情况联合解读，不能作为独立性能指标。速度测量修正显著削弱了原先的检测结果，因此本文更适合作为透明的系统案例研究和失败模式分析，而非对成熟识别性能的验证。

title: A Unified Vision-Language Model for PSMA PET/CT Report Generation, Visual Question Answering, and Lesion Segmentation
summary: Accurate PSMA PET/CT interpretation is central to prostate cancer management, yet existing PET/CT AI models typically address isolated tasks. We propose a unified PSMA PET/CT vision-language model for report generation, visual question answering, and lesion segmentation. The framework adopts an LLaVA-style architecture, comprising a PET/CT vision encoder, an MLP-Mixer projection module, a LoRA-tuned large language model, and a 3D segmentation branch. Training followed a four-stage strategy: vision encoder pretraining, projection-layer alignment, VLM fine-tuning, and final multitask tuning. Language tasks used 5,747 PSMA PET/CT datasets with paired reports, while segmentation used the PSMA subset of AutoPET. The model outperformed PET2REP and a CT-based baseline across standard report-generation metrics, improved performance across VQA question types, and achieved higher Dice and lesion-level overlap F1 than SegAnyPET and nnUNet. These results support the feasibility of a unified framework for structured, interactive, interpretable PSMA PET/CT analysis with voxel-level grounding within a single multitask model architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的PSMA PET/CT视觉-语言多任务模型，同时支持报告生成、视觉问答（VQA）和病灶分割。模型采用LLaVA式架构，由PET/CT视觉编码器、MLP-Mixer投影模块、LoRA微调的大语言模型和三维分割分支组成，并通过四阶段训练实现多模态对齐与联合优化。实验表明，该模型在报告生成、VQA和病灶分割任务上均优于相应基线，证明了在单一框架中实现结构化、交互式、可解释且具备体素级定位的PSMA PET/CT分析的可行性。
AI.motivation: 准确解读PSMA PET/CT对前列腺癌管理至关重要，但现有PET/CT人工智能模型通常只针对单一任务，难以同时提供报告生成、交互式问答和病灶定位。因此，本文旨在构建一个统一的多任务视觉-语言模型，以整合影像理解、语言交互和体素级病灶分割能力。
AI.method: 模型采用LLaVA风格的多模态架构，包括PET/CT视觉编码器、MLP-Mixer投影模块、采用LoRA微调的大语言模型，以及独立的三维分割分支。训练分为四个阶段：视觉编码器预训练、投影层对齐、视觉-语言模型微调和最终多任务联合调优。语言任务使用5,747个带配对报告的PSMA PET/CT数据集，分割任务使用AutoPET中的PSMA子集。
AI.result: 在报告生成任务中，模型在标准评价指标上优于PET2REP和基于CT的基线模型；在VQA任务中，不同问题类型的性能均得到改善；在病灶分割任务中，模型取得了高于SegAnyPET和nnUNet的Dice系数及病灶级重叠F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，统一的PSMA PET/CT视觉-语言多任务模型能够在单一架构内有效结合报告生成、视觉问答和病灶分割，并实现结构化、交互式、可解释的影像分析。其体素级定位能力进一步增强了视觉-语言输出与具体病灶区域之间的联系，显示出辅助前列腺癌影像评估的潜力。

title: VideoScout: Learning Agentic Active Exploration with Adaptive Reasoning Pacing for Long Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress on short video understanding yet remain limited on long videos due to the limited visual context window. Prevailing approaches rely on uniform frame sampling or recent coarse-to-fine agentic zooming, both of which struggle to localize sparse, decisive evidence in sufficiently long videos. We formulate long video understanding as a \textbf{Sequential Evidence Acquisition (SEA)} problem, in which an agent reads the video turn by turn along the temporal axis, deciding at each turn how fast to watch, what evidence to retain, when to revisit uncertain segments, and when to stop and answer. Inspired by this view, we propose \textbf{VideoScout}, a multi-turn reasoning agent that instantiates the SEA paradigm through adaptive reasoning pacing. Specifically, by dynamically controlling the viewing pace, VideoScout enables efficient traversal of long videos within a bounded visual context window, allowing the agent to access more video content while balancing content analysis depth with reading efficiency. To train VideoScout, we construct VideoScout-66K, a set of over 66K high-quality exploration turns from 10K answer-verified trajectories, and adopt a two-stage pipeline: cold-start supervised fine-tuning teaches the agent per-turn output format, while the Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO) algorithm performs trajectory-level reinforcement learning with a composite reward that jointly considers answer accuracy, output format compliance, and the temporal alignment between the agent's viewing progress and the teacher's answer timing measured by intersection-over-union (IoU). Extensive experiments on long video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our 7B model achieves strong performance compared with existing trained 7B agentic models.

AI.tldr: VideoScout 将长视频理解建模为序贯证据获取（SEA）问题，通过多轮自适应观看节奏，在有限视觉上下文窗口内动态决定观看速度、保留证据、回看片段及停止时机。其采用两阶段训练：监督微调学习逐轮输出格式，DAPO轨迹级强化学习联合优化答案准确性、格式合规性与观看进度和教师答案时机的时间对齐。基于VideoScout-66K训练的7B模型在多个长视频理解与推理基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频理解方法主要依赖均匀采样或粗到细的代理式缩放，难以在超长视频中定位稀疏但关键的决定性证据，并且受限于视觉上下文窗口，无法兼顾视频覆盖范围与局部分析深度。因此，论文希望建立一种能够沿时间轴逐步探索、动态调整观看节奏并在不确定处回看的长视频理解机制。
AI.method: 论文提出VideoScout，将长视频理解形式化为序贯证据获取（SEA）任务。智能体以多轮方式读取视频，在每一轮动态决定观看速度、需要保留的证据、是否回看不确定片段以及何时停止并作答。训练采用两阶段流程：第一阶段进行冷启动监督微调，使模型掌握逐轮交互与输出格式；第二阶段使用Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization（DAPO）进行轨迹级强化学习。其复合奖励同时考虑答案准确性、输出格式合规性，以及智能体观看进度与教师答案时机之间基于时间交并比（IoU）的对齐程度。论文还构建了VideoScout-66K数据集，包含来自1万条答案验证轨迹的超过6.6万条高质量探索轮次。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于VideoScout-66K训练的7B模型在多个长视频理解和推理基准上取得了较强性能，相较现有已训练的7B代理模型具有竞争力。摘要未提供具体数据集名称、指标数值或增益幅度。
AI.conclusion: 自适应推理节奏能够有效缓解长视频理解中的视觉上下文限制，使模型在扩大视频覆盖范围的同时保留对关键片段的深入分析能力。VideoScout验证了将长视频理解建模为序贯证据获取、并结合轨迹级强化学习优化探索过程的可行性。

title: ModaLens: Measuring Image Sensitivity in Report-Conditioned Medical VLMs
summary: A radiology report can already answer a clinical question, so it is hard to tell whether a vision-language model also uses the image. ModaLens, a paired image-swap audit, measures how report availability changes image sensitivity: MedGemma-27B on 3,199 paired MIMIC-CXR cases from 293 patients, all 14 questions per case (13 finding-specific and one composite), each image replaced by one from another study, usually of the same patient, with question and report fixed. Under an explicit answer instruction, the model's generated answer changes on 4.26 percent of trials with the report and 20.94 percent without it, a paired increase of 16.7 points (patient-clustered 95 percent CI 15.6 to 17.7), so report availability reduces image-swap sensitivity under this protocol; the original prompt with a lowercase first-token readout gives 4.70 percent against 17.07 percent, and substitutions also move continuous answer scores where the binary prediction does not change. The labels are derived from reports, which limits conclusions about visual correctness; the direction replicates in two further model lineages. Code, the exact prompts and a run record for every number are at https://github.com/criticaldata/MODALENS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ModaLens 图像替换审计方法，评估报告可用性如何影响视觉语言模型对胸部X线图像变化的敏感性。实验显示，提供报告后模型对图像替换的答案变化率显著下降，表明报告可能削弱模型对图像的依赖或掩盖其图像敏感性；但由于标签源自报告，无法据此判断视觉回答是否正确。
AI.motivation: 放射学报告本身通常已经包含临床问题的答案，因此当视觉语言模型同时接收图像和报告时，仅观察模型输出无法判断其是否真正使用了图像。研究需要一种可操作的审计方法，分离报告信息与图像信息对模型回答的影响，并检验报告可用性是否改变模型的图像敏感性。
AI.method: 研究使用 ModaLens 配对图像替换审计：在保持问题和报告不变的情况下，将每个病例的图像替换为来自另一项检查的图像，通常仍来自同一患者，并比较模型在原图与替换图上的回答变化。实验对象为 MedGemma-27B，数据来自 MIMIC-CXR 的293名患者、3,199个配对病例；每个病例回答14个问题，包括13个特定征象问题和1个综合问题。研究分别测试有报告和无报告条件，并采用显式回答指令、原始提示词及连续答案分数等分析；置信区间按患者聚类计算，并在另外两种模型谱系上复现结果。
AI.result: 在显式回答指令下，有报告条件的答案变化率为4.26%，无报告条件为20.94%，配对差异为16.7个百分点，患者聚类95%置信区间为15.6至17.7个百分点。原始提示词结合小写首词读取时，对应结果为4.70%和17.07%。此外，即使二元预测未改变，图像替换仍会导致连续答案分数发生变化。该方向性结果在另外两种模型谱系中得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 在本实验协议下，提供放射学报告会显著降低模型对图像替换的输出敏感性，说明报告可能使模型更依赖文本信息，或使其视觉信息使用难以从输出中观察到。ModaLens可用于审计多模态模型是否对图像保持敏感。不过，标签由报告推导而来，因而研究不能直接证明模型的视觉判断正确性，也不能单凭答案变化率断言模型完全没有使用图像。代码、提示词和运行记录已公开。

title: SAM3D-Part: Interactive Part Selection and Generation from 3D Objects
summary: Part-level control is essential for modern 3D asset creation, where objects are frequently edited, reused, animated, or fabricated through their individual components. In many such workflows, users need only several specific components rather than a complete object decomposition. However, existing 3D generation methods produce all parts regardless of user intent, while promptable 3D segmentation methods typically output partial surfaces instead of reusable complete meshes. In addition, image-conditioned part generators further struggle to preserve hidden geometry and accurate placement without directly conditioning on the source mesh. To address these problems, we present SAM3D-Part, a prompt-driven framework for selective part generation from input 3D object meshes. Given a source mesh and a part prompt, SAM3D-Part first encodes the source geometry into compact mesh features and aligns them with the rendered image, selective mask, and point-map observations via pixel-wise channel fusion. The fused representation conditions a feed-forward generative model to produce only the queried component as a completed mesh. To place the generated part back into the source coordinate frame, SAM3D-Part predicts dense per-voxel correspondences and estimates the part transformation from distributed spatial evidence rather than a single global pose code. For sequential multi-part queries, previously generated parts are stored in a part cache and reused as contextual constraints, reducing conflicts among independently requested components. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate that SAM3D-Part can significantly improve source alignment, reduce conditioning cost, and enable consistent selective part generation, achieving state-of-the-art. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/Jiahao620/sam3d-part.

AI.tldr: SAM3D-Part 是一个面向输入三维网格和部件提示的选择性部件生成框架。它通过多模态几何融合、完整网格生成、稠密体素对应关系和部件缓存，实现特定部件的生成、准确回位及多部件一致性，并取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有三维生成方法通常无差别地产生完整对象的所有部件，无法满足用户只需要若干部件的场景；可提示三维分割方法往往只输出局部表面，难以直接复用为完整网格；基于图像的部件生成方法又容易丢失遮挡区域几何信息，并且难以保证部件在源对象中的准确位置。因此，需要一种直接利用源网格、支持按需生成完整部件并保持空间一致性的方案。
AI.method: 给定源三维网格和部件提示，方法首先将源几何编码为紧凑的网格特征，并与渲染图像、选择性掩码和点图观测进行像素级通道融合。融合后的表示用于条件化前馈生成模型，仅生成用户查询的目标部件及其完整网格。随后，模型预测稠密的逐体素对应关系，利用分布式空间证据估计部件变换，将生成部件放回源对象坐标系。对于连续的多部件查询，已生成部件被存入部件缓存，作为后续生成的上下文约束，以降低部件间冲突。
AI.result: 实验和消融研究表明，SAM3D-Part能够显著提升生成部件与源对象的空间对齐质量，降低条件信息成本，并支持一致的选择性多部件生成；总体性能达到当前最优水平。摘要未提供具体数据集、指标数值或定量提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了基于源网格的提示驱动选择性部件生成是可行且有效的。通过几何与视觉信息融合、稠密对应关系建模以及部件缓存机制，SAM3D-Part兼顾了部件完整性、空间准确性和多次查询的一致性，适用于三维资产编辑、复用、动画和制造等场景。

title: MedDiME: Efficient Latent Diffusion with Adaptive Masking for Medical Counterfactual Generation
summary: Medical counterfactual generation modifies images to change model predictions for interpretability. However, existing diffusion-based approaches are often prohibitively slow and memory-intensive, making them difficult to apply in high-resolution settings. Moreover, existing masking strategies are tightly coupled with pixel-space representations, making them incompatible with latent-space diffusion editing. To address these challenges, we propose MedDiME, a latent-space classifier-guided diffusion framework that reduces computational and memory overhead while introducing a latent-compatible, gradient-driven adaptive masking mechanism for spatially precise medical counterfactual generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MedDiME achieves high-quality counterfactual generation with significant efficiency gains compared to prior classifier-guided diffusion baselines, achieving up to 40 times faster inference and 13 times lower peak GPU memory usage.

AI.tldr: MedDiME是一种面向医学反事实图像生成的潜空间分类器引导扩散框架，通过潜空间编辑和梯度驱动的自适应掩码降低计算与显存开销，并实现空间精准的反事实生成。实验表明，其推理速度最高提升40倍，峰值GPU显存使用量降低13倍，同时保持较高生成质量。
AI.motivation: 医学反事实生成可通过修改图像来改变模型预测，从而帮助解释模型决策。然而，现有基于扩散模型的方法通常推理速度慢、显存消耗高，难以应用于高分辨率医学图像；此外，传统掩码策略依赖像素空间表示，无法直接适配潜空间扩散编辑。因此，需要一种兼顾效率、显存占用和空间编辑精度的潜空间反事实生成方法。
AI.method: 提出MedDiME，即潜空间分类器引导扩散框架。该方法在潜空间中进行扩散编辑，以减少计算量和显存使用；同时设计与潜空间兼容的、由梯度驱动的自适应掩码机制，根据分类器梯度确定需要修改的空间区域，从而实现更精准的医学反事实生成。
AI.result: 大量实验显示，MedDiME能够生成高质量的医学反事实图像，并相较于已有分类器引导扩散基线取得显著效率提升：推理速度最高提升40倍，峰值GPU显存使用量最高降低13倍。
AI.conclusion: MedDiME有效解决了医学反事实扩散生成中速度慢、显存占用高以及像素空间掩码难以迁移到潜空间的问题，在保持生成质量的同时显著提高了计算效率和空间编辑能力，具备应用于高分辨率医学图像可解释性分析的潜力。

title: From Model Patterns to Abstract Semantics in Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional Zero Shot Learning aims to recognize unseen compositions by recombining learned primitives. Recent methods rely on vision language models and attempt to explicitly model contextual variations of primitives through multiple representations. However, such approaches are limited by fixed variant capacity and competition between abstract and concrete semantics. In this work, we present a new perspective that views primitive variations as the context-driven activation of concrete visual cues rather than independent entities. Based on it, we propose CLEAR, a CLoze-style rEAsoning-based Re-ranking framework inspired by human perceptual processes. CLEAR extracts conditional variants from the primitive candidate set in a coarse-to-fine manner, performs cloze-style reasoning to infer high-level semantics, and re-ranks predictions to correct biases toward salient concrete primitives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLEAR consistently improves the Base Model and outperforms state-of-the-art methods on the challenging C-GQA and MIT-States datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/buptLwz/CLEAR.

AI.tldr: CLEAR 是一个面向组合零样本学习（CZSL）的 CLoze 风格推理重排序框架：它将原语变化视为上下文激活的具体视觉线索，而非固定数量的独立变体；通过粗到细提取条件变体、填空式推理获得高层语义，并重排序预测以缓解模型偏向显著具体原语的问题。在 C-GQA 和 MIT-States 上，CLEAR 稳定提升基础模型并优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 组合零样本学习需要识别训练中未见过的属性-对象等原语组合。现有依赖视觉语言模型的方法通常显式建模原语的上下文变化，但存在两个问题：变体容量固定，难以覆盖复杂变化；抽象语义与具体视觉语义之间存在竞争，模型容易偏向显著但不充分的具体原语，从而产生组合预测偏差。因此，论文希望以更符合感知过程的方式建模上下文引起的原语变化，并纠正预测偏置。
AI.method: 论文提出 CLEAR（CLoze-style rEAsoning-based Re-ranking）。其核心观点是：原语变化不是彼此独立的实体，而是由上下文驱动、对具体视觉线索的选择性激活。方法首先从原语候选集合中以粗到细的方式提取条件变体；随后采用类似 Cloze 填空的推理过程，根据上下文补全并推断更高层次的语义；最后对基础模型的候选预测进行重排序，抑制对显著具体原语的过度偏好，使抽象语义和视觉证据得到更合理的结合。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的 C-GQA 和 MIT-States 数据集上的大量实验表明，CLEAR 能够持续提升基础模型性能，并超过现有最先进方法。摘要未提供具体指标、提升幅度或消融实验结果。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR 通过将原语变体解释为上下文驱动的视觉线索激活，并引入粗到细候选提取、Cloze 风格语义推理和预测重排序，有效缓解了固定变体容量及具体语义主导造成的偏差。实验结果说明该框架对组合零样本学习具有较好的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Circuit-MLLM: Topological Logic-Guided Latent-Space Visual Reasoning for Circuit Schematic Understanding
comment: Accepted at European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Through pre-training on extensive text and image datasets, current multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on general tasks. However, circuit schematics present a unique challenge for MLLMs due to their dense component layouts and distinct topological logic, demanding fine-grained structural parsing to extract the electrical semantics. To address this, we propose Circuit-MLLM, a multimodal reasoning framework that reformulates circuit topology analysis as a process of device localization, path tracing, and sequential reasoning within the latent space. We introduce a circuit knowledge mining mechanism that deeply aligns the model's latent representations with structurally rich features derived from multi-granularity circuit vision experts, enabling the model to effectively internalize topological semantics. Building upon these internalized semantics, we devise a topology-guided sequencing strategy that decouples reasoning from the rigid raster-scan order, enforcing stepwise inference along the circuit's topological logic in latent space. Across diverse circuit analysis tasks, Circuit-MLLM consistently outperforms strong baselines, notably achieving a 25% higher average score than GPT-5.1, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our framework in circuit schematic topology analysis. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/IC-Yuan/Circuit-MLLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Circuit-MLLM，一种面向电路原理图拓扑分析的多模态推理框架。该方法将电路理解拆解为器件定位、路径追踪和序列推理，并通过电路知识挖掘与拓扑引导的推理顺序增强模型对电路结构语义的建模能力。在多种电路分析任务上，模型优于强基线，摘要声称平均得分比 GPT-5.1 高 25%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型虽然在通用视觉与文本任务上表现良好，但电路原理图具有器件布局密集、连接关系复杂以及强拓扑逻辑等特点。简单依赖图像的栅格扫描顺序难以准确解析器件之间的连接和电气语义，因此需要一种能够进行细粒度结构解析、路径追踪和拓扑推理的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Circuit-MLLM 多模态推理框架。首先，将电路拓扑分析建模为潜在空间中的器件定位、路径追踪与序列推理过程。其次，引入电路知识挖掘机制，利用多粒度电路视觉专家提取结构丰富的特征，并将其与模型潜在表示进行深度对齐，使模型学习电路拓扑语义。最后，设计拓扑引导的序列策略，摆脱固定的栅格扫描顺序，沿电路拓扑逻辑执行逐步潜在空间推理。
AI.result: 在多种电路分析任务上，Circuit-MLLM 持续优于强基线。摘要特别报告其平均得分比 GPT-5.1 高 25%，表明该方法在电路原理图拓扑分析中具有较强效果。不过摘要未提供具体数据集、任务划分、评价指标、统计显著性或消融实验结果，因此该性能结论仍需结合正文验证。
AI.conclusion: Circuit-MLLM 通过融合多粒度视觉特征、电路知识挖掘和拓扑引导推理，有效提升了多模态模型对电路原理图结构与拓扑语义的理解能力。其核心贡献在于将电路分析从基于图像顺序的识别任务转化为遵循拓扑逻辑的结构化推理任务。代码已公开，有利于复现和进一步研究。

title: Benchmarking Intra-Patient 3D Deformable Multimodal Image Registration
summary: Multimodal image registration is a key component of many clinical workflows, yet it remains challenging because corresponding anatomical structures often exhibit substantially different image intensities across modalities. In this work, we present a comprehensive benchmark of intra-patient 3D multimodal deformable registration methods across three datasets covering different anatomical regions and difficulty levels, including both synthetic deformation recovery and real clinical scenarios. We evaluate classical optimization-based approaches and modern learning-based methods, including recent deep learning and foundation models, using complementary metrics: Average Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), average 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), and a modality-independent structural similarity measure based on the MIND self-similarity context (MIND-SSC). Results show high variability across datasets, with learning-based methods demonstrating superior performance on large synthetic benchmarks, while only limited improvements are observed in real pelvic registration. A key finding of this study is the consistent disagreement between geometric metrics (DSC, HD95) and image-based similarity metrics (MIND-SSC), highlighting that improved overlap does not necessarily imply better global multimodal correspondence. Furthermore, anatomy-guided approaches achieve the highest overlap scores but exhibit degraded performance outside of segmented regions, revealing a trade-off between label-driven alignment and global structural coherence. Overall, our results indicate that no current method achieves robust performance across anatomies and modalities. We demonstrate that intra-patient 3D multimodal registration requires multi-criteria evaluation, including deformation-based metrics, and remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文对三类解剖区域、不同难度下的患者内三维多模态可变形配准方法进行系统基准评测。结果表明，学习型方法在大规模合成数据上优势明显，但在真实盆腔数据上的提升有限；几何指标与基于图像的MIND-SSC指标经常不一致，说明当前方法尚不能在不同解剖区域和模态间实现稳健、全面的配准。
AI.motivation: 三维多模态医学图像配准是临床工作流的重要环节，但不同模态之间的强度差异使对应解剖结构难以匹配。现有方法通常只在有限数据集或单一指标上进行评估，缺乏跨解剖区域、跨难度和跨方法类型的系统比较。此外，配准结果在局部标签重叠与全局结构一致性之间可能存在冲突，因此需要更全面的基准和多标准评价体系。
AI.method: 研究构建了覆盖不同解剖区域和难度等级的三数据集基准，包含合成形变恢复任务和真实临床场景。评估对象包括经典优化方法、深度学习方法以及基础模型。评价指标涵盖平均Dice相似系数（DSC）、平均95% Hausdorff距离（HD95）和基于MIND自相似上下文的模态无关结构相似性指标（MIND-SSC），并进一步考察解剖引导方法在分割区域内外的表现及形变质量。
AI.result: 不同数据集上的方法表现差异显著。学习型方法在大规模合成基准上通常优于传统方法，但在真实盆腔配准中的改进较为有限。DSC、HD95等几何指标与MIND-SSC图像相似性指标持续出现不一致，表明更高的标签重叠不必然意味着更好的全局多模态结构对应。解剖引导方法获得了最高的重叠分数，但在分割区域之外表现下降，反映出标签驱动配准与全局结构一致性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 当前没有一种方法能够在不同解剖区域和成像模态上均实现稳健的三维多模态配准。研究强调，配准评估不能依赖单一几何或图像相似性指标，还应纳入形变质量等多标准评价。患者内三维多模态配准仍是一个开放问题，未来需要提升真实临床场景中的泛化能力、全局结构保持能力和区域外形变可靠性。

title: Don't Send What You Don't Need: Question-Guided Token Pruning as a Privacy Defense for Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is increasingly used in privacy-sensitive and bandwidth-constrained settings. Federated Learning (FL), Split Learning (SL), and U-Shaped Split Learning (USL) keep raw data local, but transmitting all visual tokens across a model partition remains costly and can expose private information. We propose QPriv-VL, a question-guided, privacy-aware token-pruning framework for FL, SL, and USL that prunes visual tokens before transmission based on task utility and privacy sensitivity. Its core component is a lightweight Dynamic Threshold Predictor (DTP) that jointly estimates a sample-specific pruning ratio and a token-level retention mask in one forward pass. DTP combines question relevance, computed from cross-modal similarity between visual patches and the pooled question embedding, with a sensitivity signal derived from frozen DINOv2 features. This allows the model to suppress potentially sensitive regions while preserving patches useful for answering the question, without requiring sensitivity labels. We evaluate QPriv-VL on GQA, OK-VQA, VQAv2, SLAKE, VQA-RAD, and PathVQA against four privacy attack families: FSHA, FORA, iDLG, and attribute-inference membership inference attacks. DTP matches or outperforms fixed-ratio pruning while using substantially fewer transmitted tokens. On VQA-RAD, it reduces membership-inference attack success from 0.99 to 0.76-0.79, lowers FSHA and FORA reconstruction PSNR relative to fixed-ratio pruning, and preserves competitive VQA accuracy using about 40% of the original visual-token budget. A sensitivity exclusion ratio of 1.20 +/- 0.18 indicates preferential removal of privacy-sensitive patches, while explainability analysis shows that retention adapts to question semantics rather than generic visual saliency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QPriv-VL：一种面向视觉问答（VQA）的、问题引导且隐私感知的视觉 token 剪枝框架，适用于联邦学习、切分学习和 U 形切分学习。其核心 DTP 模块在一次前向传播中联合预测样本级剪枝比例与 token 保留掩码，依据问题相关性和隐私敏感性，在减少传输 token 的同时维持问答性能并降低隐私攻击风险。
AI.motivation: 在隐私敏感和带宽受限场景中，FL、SL 和 USL 虽能避免原始图像离开本地，但模型分割点之间传输全部视觉 token 仍带来较高通信成本，并可能泄露敏感视觉信息。固定比例剪枝难以同时适应不同问题的任务需求和图像区域的隐私敏感性，因此需要一种无需敏感性标注、能够动态保留有用区域并抑制敏感区域的机制。
AI.method: 提出 QPriv-VL 框架及其轻量级 Dynamic Threshold Predictor（DTP）。DTP 联合估计样本特定的剪枝比例和 token 级保留掩码：一方面，通过视觉 patch 与池化问题嵌入之间的跨模态相似度衡量问题相关性；另一方面，利用冻结的 DINOv2 特征构造隐私敏感性信号。根据任务效用与隐私风险对视觉 token 进行动态筛选，并将保留 token 用于 FL、SL 和 USL 中的跨分区传输。实验覆盖 GQA、OK-VQA、VQAv2、SLAKE、VQA-RAD 和 PathVQA，并采用 FSHA、FORA、iDLG 及属性推断/成员推断攻击进行评估。
AI.result: DTP 达到或超过固定比例剪枝的性能，同时显著减少传输 token。在 VQA-RAD 上，成员推断攻击成功率由 0.99 降至 0.76–0.79；相较固定比例剪枝，FSHA 和 FORA 的重建 PSNR 更低，表明重建攻击效果减弱。在保持具有竞争力的 VQA 准确率的同时，视觉 token 通信预算约降至原始规模的 40%。敏感区域排除比为 1.20 ± 0.18，说明模型倾向于优先移除隐私敏感 patch；可解释性分析表明，token 保留会随问题语义变化，而非仅依据通用视觉显著性。
AI.conclusion: QPriv-VL 有效统一了视觉 token 的通信压缩、任务相关信息保留和隐私风险缓解。结果表明，问题引导的动态剪枝比固定比例策略更适合隐私敏感型 VQA，能够在较低通信开销下提升对重建攻击和成员推断攻击的抵抗能力。不过，攻击成功率仍未降至较低水平，且摘要未报告完整的精度—隐私—通信权衡、不同模块的消融结果及跨数据集泛化细节，这些方面仍需进一步验证。

title: MambaMPD: A Mamba-Driven Segmentation Framework for Marine Pollution Detection from Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Accurate marine pollution detection (MPD) is essential for protecting coastal ecosystems and marine biodiversity. Vision Mamba models have shown promise in remote-sensing semantic segmentation by efficiently capturing long-range dependencies and global context, yet their potential for MPD remains underexplored. MPD is particularly challenging because of low signal-to-noise ratios, fragmented pollution patterns, and indistinct boundaries caused by the visual similarity between pollutants and the surrounding sea. To address these issues, we propose MambaMPD, an enhanced Mamba-based framework incorporating two complementary structural priors: Frequency-Aware Augmentation (FAA) and multi-scale Edge-Guided Attention (EGA). FAA integrates wavelet transforms into the encoder to decompose features into multi-scale frequency subbands, enabling the model to capture low-frequency contextual semantics and high-frequency structural details needed to identify small, low-contrast, and irregular pollution patterns. EGA adaptively fuses hierarchical, Laplacian-derived boundary cues with deep semantic representations, refining encoder features before decoding to sharpen boundaries and reduce ambiguity in visually confusing, spatially fragmented scenes. Together, these modules improve sensitivity to subtle pollution signals while preserving fine boundary structures. A U-Net-style decoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention and deep supervision progressively restores and refines semantic and spatial information across scales. Extensive experiments on two benchmark MPD datasets show that MambaMPD achieves higher mIoU than competing methods while requiring substantially less computation than foundation-model-based approaches. On MADOS, it improves F1 by 3.6% over OSDMamba; on M4D, it raises Oil Spill IoU by 6.82% over TransOilSeg.

AI.tldr: MambaMPD 是一种面向海洋污染语义分割的增强型 Mamba 框架，通过频率感知增强与多尺度边缘引导注意力，联合提升低对比度、碎片化污染区域的识别和边界分割能力；在 MADOS 与 M4D 数据集上优于对比方法，并显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 海洋污染检测对生态保护至关重要，但现有方法面临低信噪比、污染区域碎片化、目标边界模糊以及污染物与海水视觉相似等问题。尽管 Vision Mamba 擅长建模长程依赖和全局上下文，其在海洋污染检测中的应用仍不充分，因此需要同时增强细微污染信号建模能力与边界保持能力。
AI.method: 提出 MambaMPD 框架。1）频率感知增强（FAA）：在编码器中引入小波变换，将特征分解为多尺度频率子带，以分别建模低频语义上下文和高频结构细节，从而识别小尺度、低对比度和不规则污染模式。2）多尺度边缘引导注意力（EGA）：利用拉普拉斯算子提取层次化边界信息，并与深层语义特征自适应融合，在解码前细化编码器特征，改善模糊和碎片化场景中的边界定位。3）采用带压缩激励注意力和深度监督的 U-Net 式解码器，逐级恢复空间信息并优化多尺度预测。
AI.result: 在两个基准海洋污染检测数据集上的实验表明，MambaMPD 的 mIoU 高于竞争方法，同时比基于基础模型的方法需要更少计算量。在 MADOS 上，F1 比 OSDMamba 提升 3.6%；在 M4D 上，Oil Spill IoU 比 TransOilSeg 提升 6.82%。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合频域结构先验、边界先验与 Mamba 的全局建模能力，MambaMPD 能够更敏感地捕获微弱污染信号，并保持细粒度边界结构。该方法在检测精度与计算效率之间取得较好平衡，验证了其用于海洋污染遥感语义分割的有效性。

title: V-ICAL Bench: Evaluating Video In-Context Learning for Multimodal Agents in Interactive Environments
summary: While In-Context Learning (ICL) enables models to adapt from exemplars without parameter updates, multimodal ICL remains largely underexplored, particularly regarding video demonstrations in interactive environments. For multimodal agents, learning from videos presents unique challenges: they must translate in-context demonstrations into executable policies, ground these policies in novel visual states, and iteratively refine actions based on environmental feedback. We introduce V-ICAL, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate video-based ICL for multimodal agents. Comprising 342 interactive tasks across 37 environments, V-ICAL utilizes human-curated demonstration videos as task-specific behavioral exemplars, evaluating agents through sustained interaction from a target initialization. The benchmark seamlessly connects in-context knowledge induction with core agentic capabilities, including state grounding, temporal memory, planning, and adaptation in dynamic environments. Extensive evaluations across 19 state-of-the-art multimodal agents reveal significant limitations: the best-performing model, Seed-2.1-Pro, achieves a score of only 54.4/100, while other leading models (e.g., Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5.6) fail to surpass 50, far below the human baseline of 83.6. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that current agents struggle to reliably translate video exemplars into effective policies, failing to yield consistent performance gains. Ultimately, V-ICAL exposes a critical gap in the ICL capabilities of multimodal agents, underscoring an urgent need for future research.

AI.tldr: V-ICAL 是一个评估多模态智能体视频上下文学习能力的基准，包含342个交互任务和37个环境。实验表明，现有模型难以将视频示范稳定转化为可执行策略，最佳模型仅得54.4分，显著低于人类83.6分。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文学习研究主要聚焦文本或静态多模态输入，对交互环境中的视频示范学习关注不足。多模态智能体不仅需要理解视频内容，还必须将示范行为转化为策略，在新的视觉状态中进行状态定位，并依据环境反馈持续调整动作。因此，有必要建立专门的评测基准，系统衡量这些能力及其组合表现。
AI.method: 作者提出 V-ICAL 基准，覆盖37个交互环境中的342项任务。每项任务使用人工筛选的视频作为任务相关行为示范，并要求智能体从指定目标初始化状态开始持续交互。评测综合考察视频知识诱导、状态 grounding、时间记忆、规划以及动态环境中的适应能力。作者进一步测试19个先进多模态智能体，并通过受控对比实验分析视频示范是否能带来稳定的性能提升。
AI.result: 最佳模型 Seed-2.1-Pro 得分为54.4/100；其他代表性模型，如 Gemini-3.1-Pro 和 GPT-5.6，均未超过50分，明显低于83.6分的人类基线。受控实验显示，当前智能体通常无法可靠地把视频示范转化为有效策略，视频上下文并未持续带来一致的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: V-ICAL 揭示了多模态智能体在视频上下文学习方面存在显著能力缺口。当前模型在从示范中归纳行为规则、将规则 grounding 到新状态并结合反馈进行适应方面仍不成熟，未来需要加强视频到策略的映射、时序推理和交互式适应能力。

title: SURE-Map: Self-Correcting Streaming Geometric Foundation Model
summary: Streaming geometric foundation models are emerging as a compelling alternative to SLAM systems. Yet this streaming nature introduces a fundamental issue: each prediction is made from limited context, which is vulnerable to dynamic objects and weak textures. Small local errors accumulate into severe geometric distortion and long-horizon scale drift. We argue that reliable streaming reconstruction requires geometric foundation models to be not only predictive, but also self-correcting. We introduce SURE-Map, a self-correcting framework built upon two complementary principles. First, we explicitly model cross-view geometric uncertainty. Unlike conventional depth or point confidence, which primarily reflects the reliability of individual-view prediction, our uncertainty directly measures whether the jointly predicted pose and depth induce geometrically consistent cross-view pixel correspondences. Second, because local correction alone cannot eliminate slowly accumulating scale errors, we introduce multi-timescale self-correction: fast consecutive-frame inference preserves streaming efficiency, while sparse keyframe-window inference provides longer-range geometric evidence to periodically recalibrate the scale of recent trajectories. SURE-Map establishes new state-of-the-art performance for online feed-forward reconstruction across long-horizon benchmarks, reducing ATE-RMSE from 24.00 to 17.24 m on KITTI, 5.11 to 4.74 m on Oxford Spires, and 31.37 to 28.58 m on VBR, with further improvements to 15.17, 4.63, and 22.12 m when incorporating loop-closure refinement. Project page: https://mingkai-liu.github.io/projects/sure-map/.

AI.tldr: SURE-Map 面向长时序在线前馈三维重建，提出结合跨视图几何不确定性与多时间尺度自校正的框架，以抑制动态物体、弱纹理导致的局部误差累积和长期尺度漂移，并在 KITTI、Oxford Spires、VBR 上取得新的领先结果。
AI.motivation: 流式几何基础模型每次预测只能利用有限上下文，容易受到动态物体和弱纹理影响。局部位姿与深度误差会随时间累积，最终造成严重几何畸变和长时程尺度漂移。因此，在线重建模型不仅需要具备预测能力，还需要能够利用后续几何证据进行自我纠错。
AI.method: SURE-Map 包含两个核心机制：1）显式建模跨视图几何不确定性，不再只评估单视图深度或点的置信度，而是直接衡量联合预测的位姿与深度所诱导的跨视图像素对应是否具有几何一致性；2）采用多时间尺度自校正策略，利用连续帧推理保持流式效率，同时周期性地在稀疏关键帧窗口上进行较长范围的几何推理，为近期轨迹提供长期证据并重新校准尺度。
AI.result: 在长时程在线前馈重建基准上取得新的最佳性能。ATE-RMSE 在 KITTI 上由 24.00 m 降至 17.24 m，在 Oxford Spires 上由 5.11 m 降至 4.74 m，在 VBR 上由 31.37 m 降至 28.58 m。进一步加入闭环优化后，三个数据集分别达到 15.17 m、4.63 m 和 22.12 m。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，流式几何基础模型若要实现可靠的长时程重建，需要同时处理跨视图几何一致性和长期尺度漂移。SURE-Map 通过不确定性感知与多时间尺度自校正，将高效的局部流式推理和较强的长期几何约束结合起来，显著提升了在线重建的稳定性与精度。

title: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
summary: Diffusion Transformers deliver state-of-the-art video generation, but their long spatiotemporal sequences make attention the dominant deployment cost, and a deployable low-bit kernel must be accurate and fast. Accuracy is limited by outliers: a block's quantization scale is set by its largest entries, leaving typical entries confined to a narrow range of representable values. Prior work smooths queries and keys, but value outliers follow no fixed channel or spatiotemporal structure and remain the dominant source of output error. Speed is limited by softmax: low-bit Tensor Cores accelerate only the two matrix multiplications, so the high-precision exponential between them becomes the longest pipeline stage on datacenter GPUs. We propose VC-Attention, a training-free low-bit attention framework that addresses both by pairing Value smoothing with a fused probability Cast. V-Smooth reorders value tokens by lightweight online clustering, so the tokens in a hardware block quantize well together. It quantizes only the residual after subtracting the block mean, and restores that mean from the row sum the online softmax already maintains. ExpCast-FP8 maps log-domain scores directly to E4M3 probability codes with one fused multiply-add, eliminating the FP32 exponential and the format conversion. We implement VC-Attention for B200, B300, H200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090. Across Wan2.2, LongCat-Video, HunyuanVideo-1.5, and MiniMax-H3, VC-Attention improves fidelity over low-bit baselines, speeds up the attention kernel over BF16 FlashAttention-4 by 1.46-1.59x on datacenter Blackwell and Hopper and by 2.3-3.6x on workstation cards, and generates a clip 1.13-1.19x and 1.36-1.70x faster end to end.

AI.tldr: VC-Attention 是一种无需训练的低比特注意力框架，通过 V-Smooth 处理 Value 离群值，并用 ExpCast-FP8 融合概率计算以消除高精度指数运算，从而同时提升视频扩散 Transformer 的生成质量与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的时空序列很长，注意力成为部署瓶颈。现有低比特量化方法受离群值影响，尤其是 Value 中缺乏固定结构的离群值会导致显著输出误差；同时，Softmax 中的高精度指数计算和格式转换无法被低比特 Tensor Core 高效加速，成为性能瓶颈。因此需要一种同时解决量化精度和 Softmax 计算效率问题的可部署方案。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的 VC-Attention。其一，V-Smooth 使用轻量级在线聚类重排 Value token，使同一硬件块内的 token 更适合共同量化；量化时仅对减去块均值后的残差进行处理，并利用在线 Softmax 已维护的行和恢复均值。其二，ExpCast-FP8 在对数域分数上直接生成 E4M3 概率编码，通过一次融合乘加操作替代 FP32 指数计算和格式转换。该方法针对 B200、B300、H200、RTX PRO 6000 和 RTX 5090 实现。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.2、LongCat-Video、HunyuanVideo-1.5 和 MiniMax-H3 上，VC-Attention 相比低比特基线具有更高保真度。注意力内核相对 BF16 FlashAttention-4，在数据中心 Blackwell 和 Hopper GPU 上加速 1.46–1.59 倍，在工作站 GPU 上加速 2.3–3.6 倍；端到端视频片段生成速度分别提升 1.13–1.19 倍和 1.36–1.70 倍。
AI.conclusion: VC-Attention 通过联合优化 Value 量化与概率计算，缓解了低比特视频注意力中的精度和速度瓶颈。实验表明，该训练无关框架能够在多种视频生成模型和 GPU 平台上实现更高生成保真度及显著推理加速，具有较强的实际部署价值。

title: Integrating Multi-view Multi-light Surface Reconstruction into Cultural Heritage Workflows
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at VISART VIII, ECCV 2026 workshops
summary: Cultural heritage documentation increasingly relies on image-based 3D surface reconstruction, with photogrammetry software making such workflows accessible to archaeologists, conservators, and heritage technicians. These tools have been successful for conventional multi-view acquisition, but they do not routinely exploit richer multi-view, multi-light data, despite its potential for improving fine-scale surface reconstruction. This limitation is particularly relevant in heritage contexts, where controlled-light acquisition devices such as RTI domes are already used to capture illumination-varying image sets. The challenge is therefore to connect these existing acquisition practices with recent computer vision methods in a form that can be used within operational heritage workflows. In this work, we address this need by integrating state-of-the-art components from computer vision for multi-view, multi-light surface reconstruction into Meshroom, an open-source photogrammetry framework. Rather than proposing a new reconstruction algorithm, our contribution is to assemble and expose existing advanced methods, namely a complete photometric stereo ecosystem (calibrated, self-calibrated and universal), automatic object masking, and multi-view normal-and-reflectance integration, within a usable heritage-oriented workflow. The proposed system thus provides an intermediate software layer between computer vision research code and practical cultural heritage applications, making recent techniques easier to use and evaluate.

AI.tldr: 本文将先进的多视角、多光照表面重建方法集成到开源摄影测量框架Meshroom中，形成面向文化遗产工作的可用软件流程。系统涵盖完整的光度立体方案、自动目标掩膜，以及多视角法线与反射率融合，并重点解决研究代码向实际遗产记录应用转化的问题。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产记录日益依赖基于图像的三维表面重建，但现有摄影测量流程主要利用常规多视角数据，尚未充分利用多视角、多光照图像所包含的细节信息。文化遗产领域已经使用RTI穹顶等受控光照设备采集光照变化图像，因此亟需将这些既有采集实践与先进计算机视觉方法连接起来，并以适合考古学家、文物保护人员和遗产技术人员的方式纳入实际工作流。
AI.method: 作者没有提出新的重建算法，而是将现有先进组件集成并封装到开源摄影测量框架Meshroom中。具体包括完整的光度立体生态：标定光度立体、自标定光度立体和通用光度立体；自动目标掩膜；以及多视角法线与反射率融合。由此构建位于计算机视觉研究代码与文化遗产实际应用之间的中间软件层。
AI.result: 系统使先进的多视角、多光照表面重建技术能够在Meshroom中被访问、组合、使用和评估，降低了研究方法用于文化遗产工作流的门槛，并支持利用受控光照数据改善细尺度表面重建。摘要未提供定量实验指标或与基线方法的具体性能比较。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是工程集成与工作流转化，而非新算法设计。该系统将光度立体、自动掩膜和多视角融合等方法引入面向文化遗产的摄影测量流程，为连接计算机视觉研究成果与实际遗产记录应用提供了实用方案。

title: TRACE: Two-Stage Detector-Response Estimation With Angular Cosine Expansion for Ring Artifact Correction in Photon-Counting CT
summary: Detector response nonuniformity introduces systematic projection errors and ring artifacts in photon-counting detector computed tomography (PCD-CT). In measured PCD-CT data, residual stripe amplitudes vary slowly with projection angle, which fixed-bias models cannot adequately capture. We propose TRACE, a two-stage unsupervised sinogram decomposition method for estimating and correcting these response-related errors. TRACE represents stripes as a fixed bias plus low-order discrete cosine transform (DCT) components, using a small number of coefficients to describe angular variations at each detector element. A learnable analysis--synthesis architecture represents the ideal projections, while two-stage optimization separates them from fixed and then dynamic stripes. An angular-gradient soft orthogonality constraint suppresses correlated variations within the shared DCT gradient subspace, reducing the leakage of object structures into the artifact estimate. All parameters are optimized directly on the measured sinogram without paired training data. Experiments on measured QRM mouse phantom and porcine trotter data show that TRACE suppresses ring artifacts and improves image uniformity while preserving edge sharpness, soft-tissue texture, and trabecular detail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TRACE，一种无需配对训练数据的两阶段无监督正弦图分解方法，用于估计并校正光子计数探测器 CT 中随投影角缓慢变化的响应非均匀性误差，从而抑制环状伪影并提升重建图像质量。
AI.motivation: 光子计数探测器 CT 的响应非均匀性会在投影数据中引入系统误差，并在重建图像中形成环状伪影。实测数据中的条纹误差幅度会随投影角缓慢变化，传统固定偏置模型难以描述这种动态变化，因此需要一种能够同时建模固定误差和角度相关误差、且不依赖配对训练数据的方法。
AI.method: TRACE 采用两阶段无监督正弦图分解框架。首先，将条纹误差表示为固定偏置与低阶离散余弦变换（DCT）分量之和，以少量系数描述各探测器单元上的角度变化；随后利用可学习的分析—合成架构表示理想投影，并通过两阶段优化先分离固定条纹，再分离动态条纹。方法还引入角度梯度软正交约束，抑制共享 DCT 梯度子空间中的相关变化，降低物体结构泄漏到伪影估计中的风险。全部参数直接在实测正弦图上优化，无需配对训练样本。
AI.result: 在实测 QRM 小鼠模体和猪蹄数据上的实验表明，TRACE 能有效抑制环状伪影、改善图像均匀性，同时较好保持边缘清晰度、软组织纹理和骨小梁细节。
AI.conclusion: TRACE 能够有效刻画并校正 PCD-CT 中包含固定成分和缓慢角度变化成分的响应相关条纹误差。其实测数据上的无监督优化策略在无需配对数据的情况下提升了图像质量，并在伪影抑制与细节保持之间取得了较好平衡。

title: LynnReal-Omni: Native multi-modal Video Generation for Agentic Visual Workflows
summary: Video diffusion models are stochastic and hard to control: precise content often requires repeated sampling without guaranteed success, and long-horizon scenes drift in appearance, interactions, and temporal coherence. Agentic visual creation provides explicit references, editable 3D scenes, or executable game states for stable control, but does not by itself guarantee high object or character fidelity. Combining the two can enable stable, high-quality generation.
